		end,

			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_center_pos_2')
		end,
	}
	--endregion marker

	--region Sprite

	self.sprite = {
		sprite_info = {
			hasuo = 21104,
			elixir = 21099,
		},
		sprite_table = {},
		sprite_table_origin_parent = {},
		create = function(this, name, pos, item_id, scale, showoncharacter, target, drop_type, skip_text)
			scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
			showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, false)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = pos, item_id = item_id, show_on_character = showoncharacter,
					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = item.SpriteTransform.parent

			return item
		end,
		fly = function(this, name, target)
			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		consumed = function(this, name, target)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				quest_drop_item_util.consumed(this.sprite_table[name], target)
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end
	}
	--endregion Sprite

	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:load_resource()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	self.quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 8 or self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			self:set_ending_village_items()
			self:set_ending_village_npcs()
		elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 4 then
			self:disable_center_rock()

			if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress <= 7 then
				local fire_area = get_field_object('fire_area_1')
				fire_area.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(2, 0.5, 2))

				fire_area = get_field_object('fire_area_2')
				fire_area.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(2, 0.5, 2))
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
	self.sprite:dispose_all()
end

function local_class:disable_center_rock()
	-- 바위 제거
	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.field_object.center_rock(), active_state_type.disabled)
end

function local_class:set_ending_village_items()
	--sr_hasuo 스프라이트 8개 배치
	local hasuo_height_y_offset = vector(0, 0.7, 0)

	for idx = 1, 8 do
		local hasuo = self.field_object.hasuo(idx)
		local hasuo_pos = hasuo.Position + hasuo_height_y_offset

		self.sprite:create('hasuo_' .. idx, hasuo_pos,
				self.sprite.sprite_info.hasuo, 1, nil,
				nil, false)
	end

	self:disable_center_rock()

	-- 폭포로 가능 길 도어 오픈
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('s2_gimmick_door_3'))
end

			[self.dynamic_npc_group.fairy_a] = {
				fairy_a = 'memorial_cg_fairy_a',
			},
		},
		get = function(this, key, npc_name)
			if this.container ~= nil and type_util.is_table(this.container) then
				local dynamic_npc_group = this.container[key]

				return dynamic_npc_group[npc_name]
			end

			return nil
		end,
		get_group = function(this, key)
			return this.container[key]
		end,
		get_all = function(this)
			return this.container
		end,
		load_async = function(this, dyn_group_idx)
			if this.container == nil then
				this.container = {}
			end

			local count = 0
			for key, value in pairs(this.container) do
				count = count + table_util.get_size(value)
			end

			this.count = count
		end,
		dispose = function(this, dyn_group_idx)
			if this.container == nil then
				return
			end

			if this.container[dyn_group_idx] == nil then
				return
			end

			load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(this.container[dyn_group_idx])

			this.container[dyn_group_idx] = nil
		end,

		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.container == nil then
				return
			end

			for key, dyn_npc_group in pairs(this.container) do
				load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(dyn_npc_group)
				dyn_npc_group = nil
			end

			this.container = nil
			this.count = 0
		end,

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')
end

	start_coroutine(function()
		self.fx:load_async()

		--NPC 동적 생성
		self.dynamic_npcs:load_async(self.dynamic_npc_group.fairy_a)

		self:set_pre_npc()

	end)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))

	self.dynamic_npcs:dispose_all()

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.field_object.rock(1)) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.replay_minigame, self)

		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.field_object.rock(2)) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.play_waterfall_story, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'post_fairy_zone') then
		start_coroutine(function()
			--인도자 사라짐
			local npc = get_character('fairy_a')
			
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_02')
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.visible)
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, 0, 1)

			wait_for_sec(5)

			character_util.set_position(npc, vector(999, 0, 999))
		end)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name ~= self.mini_game_name then
		return false
	end

	sp_util.start_scene(self.end_mini_game, self)

	return true
end

function local_class:set_current_scene_npc(section_state)
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[section_state]

	if pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	linq(pre_npc_data):foreach(function(_, npc_data)
		local npc = get_character(npc_data.name)

		if npc == nil then
			if npc_data.name == 'leader' then
				npc = user_party.Leader
			else
				return
			end
		end

		if npc_data.remove_lv_ui ~= nil and npc_data.remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		npc_data.active_state = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.active_state, active_state_type.enabled)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, npc_data.active_state)

		npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if npc_data.pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if npc_data.fly ~= nil and npc_data.fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, npc_data.pos, isFlying)
		end

		if npc_data.dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, npc_data.dir, false)
		end

		if npc_data.emo ~= nil then
			if npc_data.emo == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, npc_data.emo)
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_info ~= nil then
			if npc_data.anim_info == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			elseif type_util.is_table(npc_data.anim_info) then
				npc_data.anim_info.one_shot_sfx = false

				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, npc_data.anim_info)
			elseif type_util.is_string(npc_data.anim_info) then
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = npc_data.anim_info, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_time_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, npc_data.anim_time_scale)
		end

		if npc_data.alpha_value ~= nil then
			local alpha_duration = 0

			if npc_data.alpha_duration ~= nil then
				alpha_duration = npc_data.alpha_duration
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, npc_data.alpha_value, alpha_duration)
		end

		if npc_data.keep_shake ~= nil and npc_data.keep_shake == true then
			character_util.shake(npc, npc_data.shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if npc_data.sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', npc_data.sorting_layer)
		end

		if npc_data.start_deactive_shadow then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, false)
		end

		if npc_data.scale_factor ~= nil then
			character_util.set_scale_factor(npc, npc.Name, npc_data.scale_factor)
		end

		if npc_data.attaching_equipment ~= nil then
			character_util.spine_set_attachment(npc, npc_data.attaching_equipment.slot, npc_data.attaching_equipment.equipment)
		end

		if npc_data.tint_color then
			local tint_color_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.tint_color_magnitude, 1)

			character_util.add_color(npc, npc_data.tint_color_key, npc_data.tint_color, tint_color_magnitude, 0.1)
		end

		if npc_data.emoticon_bubble ~= nil then
			npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.EmoticonInteractable.Create(npc_data.emoticon_bubble)
		else
			if not lua_helper.type_compare(npc.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
				npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			end

			if npc_data.talk ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk) then
				npc.Interactable.Talk = npc_data.talk
			end

			if npc_data.talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk_sfx) then
				npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = npc_data.talk_sfx
			end

			if npc_data.talk_scale ~= nil then
				npc.Interactable.BubbleScale = npc_data.talk_scale
			end
		end

		if npc_data.hitbox ~= nil then
			npc.Hitbox = npc_data.hitbox
		end

		if npc_data.post_func ~= nil then
			npc_data.post_func(npc)
		end

		if npc_data.add_listener ~= nil and npc_data.add_listener == true then
			character_util.add_listener(npc, self.controller)
		end
	end)
end

function local_class:play_waterfall_story()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)
	
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'mm_carp_girl_post_narration_4'})

	self.backup_pos = user_party.Leader.Position
	self.backup_dir = direction_util.to_str(user_party.Leader.Direction)

	self:waterfall_setting()

	self:waterfall_scene()

	self:waterfall_unsetting()

	--기존 ‘금린’을 중심으로 조명
	character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, self.backup_pos)
	scene_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, self.backup_dir, false)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	--폭포 연출에서 등장하는 NPC 다시 마을쪽으로 리셋
	self.controller:reset_waterfall_n_clear_village_npcs()

	--화면 1초에 걸쳐 페이드인
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)
end

function local_class:replay_minigame()
	local result = field_ui_util.show_narration_talk_branch_async({
		key = 'mm_carp_girl_post_narration_1'
	}, {
		{ 'mm_carp_girl_post_narration_2', 'mercy' },
		{ 'mm_carp_girl_post_narration_3', 'brutal' },
	})

	if result == 1 then
		-- 화면 1초에 걸쳐 페이드아웃
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()

		-- 페이드인하면 미니 게임_2 시작
		start_coroutine(self.start_mini_game_routine, self)
	end
end

function local_class:start_mini_game_routine()
	self.mini_game = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.mini_game_name)

	self.mini_game_loaded = false

	self.backup_pos = user_party.Leader.Position

	mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.mini_game_name, self.game_constants_key, function()
		self.mini_game_loaded = true
	end)

	while not self.mini_game_loaded do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)
end

function local_class:end_mini_game()
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, self.backup_pos)
	scene_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right', false)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('MemorialCarpGirlMainSection5')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = MemorialCarpGirlMain @
		Comment = @
		Index = 4 @
		NextSections = 5 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type MemorialCarpGirlMainController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'memorial_carp_girl'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		enter_event_zone = 2,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		twinkle = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle')
		end,
		blink = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Blink')
		end,
		explosion_boss = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_explosion_boss')
		end,
		last_hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		dead = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
		end,
		get = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_get')
		end,
		shuran_explosion = function()
			--FIXME: 스토리용 이펙트 오브젝트풀로 변경필요
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cwp_shuran_explosion')
		end
	})

	self.character = setmetatable({
		spec = {
			-- 윈링
			shuran = 'shuran',
			-- 영물 토끼
			spirit_rabbit = 'spirit_rabbit',
			-- 비행선
			balloon = 'balloon',
		}
	}, {
		__index = function(this, key)
			return get_character(this.spec[key])
		end
	})

	--두들점프 관련 변수들
	self.mini_game_name = 'DoodleJump'
	self.game_constants_key = 'memorial_carp_doodle_jump_hard'
	self.mini_game_loaded = false
	self.mini_game = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.fx:create_all()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = vector(134, 0, -15.5) },
		{ zone = 's2_field', target = get_field_object('peak_exit_d') },
	})
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

	self.mini_game = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state < self.states.enter_event_zone then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's5_event_zone') then
			self.current_state = self.states.enter_event_zone

			sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_waterfall_area, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's5_restricted_village_area') then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_restricted_area, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name ~= self.mini_game_name or
			self.current_state ~= self.states.enter_event_zone then
		return false
	end

	start_coroutine(self.clear_mini_game, self)
	return true
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	quest_marker_util.remove('main_quest')
end

function local_class:enter_restricted_area()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)
	local carp_girl = get_party_leader()

	--금린 (right, idle, idle) : [thought]이젠 정말 폭포로 가야 해….
	scene_util.play_thought_speech_action(carp_girl, self, 'right',
			nil,
			nil,
			'mm_cg_main_s5_0')

	--대사 종료 후, 금린 (right, idle, walk) 상태로, 1초에 걸쳐 2타일 좌측으로 이동(뒷걸음) 후 컨트롤 돌려줌
	wp_util.move_async(carp_girl, carp_girl.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0), nil, 1, { locked_dir = 'right' })

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:enter_waterfall_area()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	local carp_girl = get_party_leader()
	local shuran = self.character.shuran
	local spirit_rabbit = self.character.spirit_rabbit

	quest_marker_util.remove('main_quest')

	local dynamic_npc = {}

	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_align_pos_1')

	-- 금린 (up, idle, jump 1회 후 idle) notice 이모티콘 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(carp_girl, 'up', false)
	character_util.normal_jump(carp_girl, true)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(carp_girl, nil, 'notice')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				-- 금린 (up, idle, run) 상태로, 1초에 걸쳐 표기된 위치로 이동
				wp_util.move_async(carp_girl, center_pos, nil, 1.5, {
					run = true,
					play_sfx = true,
					locked_dir = 'up'
				})
			end,
			function()
				-- 사파 6종 동적 생성
				dynamic_npc = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async({
					s5_dynamic_sapa_1 = 'memorial_cg_sapa_male',
					s5_dynamic_sapa_2 = 'memorial_cg_sapa_male',
					s5_dynamic_sapa_3 = 'memorial_cg_sapa_female',
					s5_dynamic_sapa_4 = 'memorial_cg_sapa_female',

					-- 두목들
					s5_dynamic_sapa_5 = 'memorial_cg_sapa_female',
					s5_dynamic_sapa_6 = 'memorial_cg_sapa_male',

					-- 포트
					pot = 'memorial_cg_three_leg_pot',
				})

				-- 사파 대장들 알파 0으로 만들어둠
				for i = 5, 6 do
					local sapa = dynamic_npc['s5_dynamic_sapa_' .. i]

					field_object_util.set_active_state(sapa, active_state_type.enabled)
					character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(sapa, 0, 0)
					scene_util.set_anim(sapa, self, { name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false })
					sapa.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0.1)
				end
			end
	)

	-- 이동 후 금린 (up, idle, jump 1회 후 cast2) : 정말 두번째 폭포에 도착했네…!
	character_util.normal_jump_async(carp_girl, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(carp_girl, self, nil, 'cast2',
			nil, 'mm_cg_main_s5_1')

	-- 금린 (right, smile, cast) : …그 마을은 진정, 신선들이 머물다 가는 곳이었구나.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(carp_girl, self, 'right', 'cast',
			'smile', 'mm_cg_main_s5_2')

	--금린 (right, sleep_deep, cast) : [thought]그저, 조금 돌아왔을 뿐… 나는 똑바로 온 게 맞았던 것이야…!
	scene_util.play_thought_speech_action(carp_girl, self, 'right', 'cast',
			'sleep_deep', 'mm_cg_main_s5_2_1')

	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	scene_util.set_anim(carp_girl, self, 'eat')
	scene_util.set_direction(carp_girl, 'left')

	wait_for_sec(2)
	equipping_sfx:Stop()

	-- 금린 (left, tired, katana_idle 전환 시간 0.4초) 상태로 전환
	scene_util.set_direction(carp_girl, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(carp_girl, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(carp_girl, self, { name = 'katana_idle', mix_duration = 0.4 })
	wait_for_sec(0.05)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_costume_equip_01')

	-- 스파인 좌측에 아이템 ‘금색 비늘’ 생성
	local scale_item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
		item_id = 23000,
		pos = carp_girl.Position + vector(-0.2, 0.35, 0),
		spr_scale = 0.55,
		loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
		show_on_character = true,
	})

	-- 아이템 상위로 FX_Object_Twinkle 이펙트 1초간 출력 후 삭제
	local fx_twinkle = self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(carp_girl.Position + vector(-0.25, 0, 0.25))

function local_class:pot_scene(shuran, pot)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(pot, active_state_type.enabled)

	--시작 크기 0.5
	pot.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5
	pot.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5

	local pot_start_pos = shuran.Bounds.center
	character_util.set_position(pot, pot_start_pos)
	scene_util.set_anim(shuran, self, 'idle')

	local pot_move_duration = 0.2

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame, pot_move_duration, 0.5, 1, function(_, cur_value)
			local scale = unity_class.vector3.one * cur_value
			pot.transform.localScale = scale
		end),
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, pot, pos, nil, pot_move_duration, { locked_dir = 'right' }),
	})

	character_util.remove_anim(shuran)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	--sr_three_leg_pot가 1스케일이 되면 fire 애니메이션 재생
	local boiling_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_boiling_02',
		volume = 0.5,
		loop = true,
		type_priority = 'event',
		player_priority = 'npc'
	})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_noodlehouse_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(shuran, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(pot, self, 'fire')

	character_util.spine_set_attachment(shuran, '[base]weapon1', 'sr_pat_fan')

	scene_util.set_anim(shuran, self, { name = 'unique/boiling_pot', scale = 1.5, loop = true })

	return boiling_sfx
end

function local_class:start_mini_game_routine()
	self.mini_game = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.mini_game_name)

	self.mini_game_loaded = false

	mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.mini_game_name, self.game_constants_key, function()
		self.mini_game_loaded = true
	end)

	while not self.mini_game_loaded do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)
end

function local_class:clear_mini_game()
	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	self.controller:progress_section()
end

return local_class

					{ pos = pos, item_id = item_id, show_on_character = showoncharacter,
					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = item.SpriteTransform.parent

			return item
		end,
		fly = function(this, name, target)
			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		consumed = function(this, name, target)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				quest_drop_item_util.consumed(this.sprite_table[name], target)
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end

function local_class:set_current_scene_npc(section_state)

		return
	end

	linq(pre_npc_data):foreach(function(_, npc_data)
		local npc = get_character(npc_data.name)

		if npc == nil then
			if npc_data.name == 'leader' then
				npc = user_party.Leader
			elseif npc_data.name == 'china_hero' then
				npc = user_util.get_china_hero_character('china_hero_boy', 'china_hero_girl')
			else
				return
			end
		end

		if npc_data.remove_lv_ui ~= nil and npc_data.remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		npc_data.active_state = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.active_state, active_state_type.enabled)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, npc_data.active_state)


		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if npc_data.pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if npc_data.fly ~= nil and npc_data.fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, npc_data.pos, isFlying)
		end

		if npc_data.dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, npc_data.dir, false)
		end

		if npc_data.emo ~= nil then
			if npc_data.emo == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, npc_data.emo)
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_info ~= nil then
			if npc_data.anim_info == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			elseif type_util.is_table(npc_data.anim_info) then
				npc_data.anim_info.one_shot_sfx = false

				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, npc_data.anim_info)
			elseif type_util.is_string(npc_data.anim_info) then
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = npc_data.anim_info, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_time_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, npc_data.anim_time_scale)
		end

		if npc_data.alpha_value ~= nil then
			local alpha_duration = 0

			if npc_data.alpha_duration ~= nil then
				alpha_duration = npc_data.alpha_duration
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, npc_data.alpha_value, alpha_duration)
		end

		if npc_data.shake_magnitude ~= nil then
			scene_util.shake(npc, npc_data.shake_magnitude, 99999, false)
		end

		if npc_data.sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', npc_data.sorting_layer)
		end

		if npc_data.active_shadow ~= nil then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, npc_data.active_shadow)
		end

		if npc_data.scale_factor ~= nil then
			character_util.set_scale_factor(npc, npc.Name, npc_data.scale_factor)
		end

		if npc_data.attaching_equipment ~= nil then
			character_util.spine_set_attachment(npc, npc_data.attaching_equipment.slot, npc_data.attaching_equipment.equipment)
		end

		if npc_data.tint_color then
			local tint_color_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.tint_color_magnitude, 1)

			character_util.add_color(npc, npc_data.tint_color_key, npc_data.tint_color, tint_color_magnitude, 0.1)
		end

		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(npc, user_party.Leader) then
			npc.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()
			npc.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.CharacterBehaviour()
			npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

			if not lua_helper.type_compare(npc.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
				npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			end
		end

		if npc_data.talk ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk) then
			npc.Interactable.Talk = npc_data.talk
		end

		if npc_data.talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk_sfx) then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = npc_data.talk_sfx
		end

		if npc_data.hitbox ~= nil then
			npc.Hitbox = npc_data.hitbox
		end

		if npc_data.post_func ~= nil then
			npc_data.post_func(npc)
		end
	end)
end
--endregion

function local_class:play_intro_event()
	local carp_girl = user_party.Leader

	self:set_pre_npc()
	self:set_current_scene_npc(self.npc_placement_group.third_waterfall)

	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0, 'linear')
		screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')
	end

	local center_pos = self.marker.event_center(1)

	local camera_pos = center_pos + vector(0, 0, -4)
	camera_util.set_position(camera_pos)

	local start_pos = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down', center_pos + vector(-1.5, 0, 0), -1)

	--금린 (right, damaged, get)
	scene_util.set_direction(carp_girl, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(carp_girl, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(carp_girl, self, 'get')
	character_util.set_position(carp_girl, start_pos, true)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(carp_girl, false)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 1초간 화면 일반 페이드 인.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 0.6 })
	screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black)

	--금린 (right, damaged, get) 상태로, 1초에 걸쳐 이동
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	character_util.jump(carp_girl, 1, 1)
	character_util.move_to_async(carp_girl, camera_pos + vector(0, 1.5, -2.5),
			1, nil, false, false)

	--착지하자마자, 금린 (right, scared, cliff) 상태로 전환, 표정 및 모션 유지
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_projectile_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(carp_girl, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(carp_girl, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(carp_girl, self, 'cliff')
	character_util.set_position(carp_girl, carp_girl.Position, false)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--금린 (right, damaged, seat) 상태로 전환, 표정 및 모션 유지
	scene_util.set_emotion(carp_girl, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(carp_girl, self, 'seat')

	--전환 시 상위로 FX_hit 이펙트 출력 / 스파인 shake (0.03, 0.5) - 엉덩방아처럼
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
	self.fx.hit():Instantiate(carp_girl.Bounds.center)
	scene_util.shake(carp_girl, 0.03, 0.5, false)

	--2초 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--금린 (down, scared, cast) sweat 이모티콘 출력
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(carp_girl, self, 'down',
			'cast', 'scared', 'sweat')

	--금린 (up, idle, get) 상태로, 1초에 걸쳐 ‘카메라 조명하는 위치’로 이동
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(carp_girl, 'up', false)
	character_util.remove_emotion(carp_girl)
	scene_util.set_anim(carp_girl, self, 'get')
	character_util.jump(carp_girl, 1, 1)
	character_util.move_to_async(carp_girl, stage_camera.LookAtPosition,
			1, nil, false, false)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(carp_girl, true)

	--금린 (left, damaged, frustration 1회 후 마지막 프레임 유지) 스파인 shake (0.03, 1)
	scene_util.shake(carp_girl, 0.03, 1)
	scene_util.set_direction(carp_girl, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(carp_girl, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(carp_girl, self, { name = 'frustration', keep_anim = true, sfx = '01_hit_npc_01' })

	--금린 (left, damaged, frustration 마지막 프레임 유지된 상태) : 오… 올라왔어….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(carp_girl, self, 'left',
			nil, 'damaged', 'mm_cg_main_s6_1_1')

	--금린 (left, attack, frustration 마지막 프레임 유지된 상태) : 처, 처음으로…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(carp_girl, self, 'left',
			nil, 'attack', 'mm_cg_main_s6_1_2')

	--동시 실행
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--카메라 줌인 (3, 0.3)
				camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3, 0.3)
			end,
			function()
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')

				--금린 (left, smile, cast2) : [shout]내가 두번째 폭포를 올라왔다네!!!
				scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(carp_girl, self, 'left',
						'cast2', 'smile', 'mm_cg_main_s6_1_3')
			end
	)

	--금린 (left, smile, seat) silence 이모티콘
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(carp_girl, self, 'left',
			'seat', 'smile', 'silence')

	--금린 (left, tired, seat) : [thought]…곧바로 세번째 폭포를 오르는 건 욕심이겠지?
	--표정 및 모션 유지
	scene_util.play_thought_speech_action(carp_girl, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'seat', keep = true }, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'mm_cg_main_s6_1_4')

	--카메라 3초에 걸쳐 7타일 상단으로 이동, 동시에 줌아웃 (4. 3)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(3)
	camera_util.move_async(stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(0, 0, 7), 3)

	--카메라 이동 완료 후 2초 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--화면 0.5초에 걸쳐 페이드아웃
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--‘금린’ 중심으로 조명 후, 화면 0.5초에 걸쳐 페이드인
	camera_util.set_position(carp_girl.Position)
	scene_util.set_direction(carp_girl, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(carp_girl, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(carp_girl, self, 'cast')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black)

	--금린 (right, tired, cast) : [thought]역시… 많은 신선들이 이곳에 쓰러져있구나.
	scene_util.play_thought_speech_action(carp_girl, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'mm_cg_main_s6_1_5')

	--금린 (up, idle, cast) : [thought]그만큼 세번째 폭포가 가파르고, 위험한 거겠지.
	scene_util.play_thought_speech_action(carp_girl, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'mm_cg_main_s6_1_6')

	--금린 (left, sleep_deep, idle) 상태로 전환, 표정 및 모션 유지
	scene_util.set_direction(carp_girl, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(carp_girl, self, 'sleep_deep')
	character_util.remove_anim(carp_girl)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--금린 (left, idle, idle) : <b>하늘이 열리는 날</b>이 끝날 때까지 얼마 안 남았지만… 다급하면 일을 그르치는 법.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(carp_girl, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'mm_cg_main_s6_1_7')

	--금린 (left, smile, nod 2회) : 폭포가 잘 보이는 곳에서 잠시라도 쉬었다 출발하자…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(carp_girl, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, 'smile', 'mm_cg_main_s6_1_8')

	local quest_marker_pos = self.npc.carp_urgent().Position
	self.quest_marker:add({
		{
			zone = 'third_waterfall_field',
			target = quest_marker_pos + vector(0, 0, 1.5)
		},
	})

	self.fx_list['twinkle'] = self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(quest_marker_pos + vector(0, 0, 1))

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
end

function local_class:play_carp_urgent_event()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	local carp_girl = user_party.Leader
	local carp_urgent = self.npc.carp_urgent()
	local carp_informer = self.npc.carp_informer()
	local carp_fire = self.npc.carp_fire()
	local carp_wicked_1 = self.npc.carp_wicked(1)
	local carp_wicked_2 = self.npc.carp_wicked(2)

	self.quest_marker:remove()

	if self.fx_list['twinkle'] ~= nil then
		self.fx_list['twinkle']:Dispose()
		self.fx_list['twinkle'] = nil
	end

	--금린 (left, idle, walk) 상태로, 0.2초에 걸쳐 표기된 위치로 이동 후, (right, idle, seat) 상태로 전환, 표정 및 모션 유지
	wp_util.move_async(carp_girl, carp_urgent.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), nil, 0.2)

	scene_util.set_direction(carp_girl, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(carp_girl, self, 'seat')

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--앞잡이 신선_말풍선만 : [shout]백년화리님께서 거의 다 오르셨다!!!
	--말풍선 위치 (x 0.5, y 0.75) (*화면 중앙 상단을 의도)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(carp_informer, 'mm_cg_main_s6_2_1', true,
			{ viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.75) })

	--금린 (up, idle, idle) 상태로 전환
	scene_util.set_direction(carp_girl, 'up', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carp_girl)

	--동시 실행
	--카메라, 2초에 걸쳐 7타일 상단으로 이동
	camera_util.move(stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(0, 0, 7), 2)

	--화면, 1초 대기 후 1초에 걸쳐 페이드아웃
	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local cam_start_pos = self.marker.jump_pivot_pos(1) + vector(0, 0, -3)
	local cam_end_pos = cam_start_pos + vector(0, 0, 10)
	camera_util.set_position(cam_start_pos, true)

	--앞잡이 신선 (left, smile, success)
	scene_util.set_direction(carp_informer, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(carp_informer, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(carp_informer, self, 'success')
	character_util.set_position(carp_informer, self.marker.waterfall_npc(1) + vector(0, 0.5, -0.5))
	character_util.set_active_shadow(carp_informer, false)

	--백년화리 (right, damaged, frustration 마지막 프레임 유지된 상태)
	scene_util.set_direction(carp_fire, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(carp_fire, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(carp_fire, self, { name = 'frustration', keep_anim = true })
	character_util.set_position(carp_fire, self.marker.waterfall_npc(2))
	character_util.set_active_shadow(carp_fire, false)

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	local amb_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_amb_waterfall_01', fade_in_time = 1, loop = true
	})

			function()
				--카메라  위치로, 6초에 걸쳐 이동
				camera_util.move_async(stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(0, 0, 5), 6)

				--화면, 0.5초에 걸쳐 페이드 인
				screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black)
			end,
			function()

				wait_for_sec(1)

				scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(carp_informer, self, 'left',
						{ name = 'success', keep = true }, { name = 'smile', keep = true },

	--백년화리 (right, attack, frustration 마지막 프레임 유지된 상태) 스파인 shake (0.03, 0.5)

	--화면 1초에 걸쳐 페이드아웃

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	--금린 (up, idle, idle) silence 이모티콘 출력
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(carp_girl, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'silence')

	--못된 신선 B (left, damaged, idle) : [shout]나, 난 이제 그만할래!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(carp_wicked_2, self, 'left',
			nil, 'damaged', 'mm_cg_main_s6_2_3')

	--동시 실행
	--못된 신선 A (down, tired, cast) 상태로 전환, 표정 및 모션 유지
	scene_util.set_direction(carp_wicked_1, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(carp_wicked_1, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(carp_wicked_1, self, 'cast')

	--금린 (right, idle, idle) 상태로 전환
	scene_util.set_direction(carp_girl, 'right', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carp_girl)

	--못된 신선 B (down, tired, walk) 상태로, 2초에 걸쳐 9타일 하단으로 이동 후 삭제
	scene_util.set_emotion(carp_wicked_2, self, 'tired')
	character_util.remove_anim(carp_wicked_2)
	local outside_pos = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down', carp_wicked_2.Position, -1)
	wp_util.move_async(carp_wicked_2, outside_pos, nil, 2)

	character_util.set_position(carp_wicked_2, vector(999, 0, 999))

	--다급한 신선 (right, tired, hurt) : 쯧….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(carp_urgent, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'mm_cg_main_s6_2_4')

	--동시 실행
	--금린 (down, idle, idle) 상태로 전환
	scene_util.set_direction(carp_girl, 'down', false)

	--다급한 신선 (down, tired, walk) 상태로, 1초에 걸쳐 2타일 하단으로 이동
	scene_util.set_emotion(carp_urgent, self, 'tired')
	character_util.remove_anim(carp_urgent)
	wp_util.move_async(carp_urgent, carp_urgent.Position + vector(0, 0, -2), nil, 1)

	--동시 실행 (*다급한 신선 이동 완료 후)
	--다급한 신선 (down, tired, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(carp_urgent, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(carp_urgent, self, 'tired')

	--금린 (down, idle, cast2) : 이보게…!

function local_class:progress_npc_scale(npc, start_spine_scale, target_spine_scale, duration)
	start_spine_scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(start_spine_scale, 1)
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local cur_scale = start_spine_scale * (1 - progress) + target_spine_scale * progress

		character_util.set_scale_factor(npc, nil, cur_scale)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.set_scale_factor(npc, nil, target_spine_scale)
end

function local_class:fx_dispose_all()
	if self.fx_list then
		for _, target in pairs(self.fx_list) do
			if target then
				target:Dispose()
				target = nil
			end
		end

		self.fx_list = nil
	end
end

return local_class

function local_class:energyball_scene(npc, target)

	--region npc 애니메이션
	--윈링 (right, sleep_deep, cast)
	camera_util.move(npc.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5), 0.5)
	scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'cast')

	character_util.look_at(npc, target)
	character_util.add_fade_color(npc, npc.Name, unity_class.color.yellow, 0.8, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--기 폭발 흔들림
	camera_util.shake(1.3, 0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_cast_magic_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wing_fire_01')

	local fire_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fire_02', fade_in_time = 1, loop = true })

	local fx_trans = self.fx.energyball_trans():Instantiate(npc.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, npc.Transform)

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.5, 0.3)

	field_util.tint(npc.Name, unity_color({ 0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.3 }), 0.7)

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.5, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = 'jingak', loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_energy_ball_01')

	--endregion

	--region 이펙트 생성

	--파랑 이펙트 생성
	local blue_effect_time = 0.7
	local fx_blue = self.fx.energyball_blue():Instantiate(npc.Position + vector(0, 0, -1))
	fx_blue.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5
	camera_util.shake(0.6, 0.2)

	wait_for_sec(blue_effect_time)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_energy_ball_01')

	--빨강 이펙트 생성
	local red_effect_time = 1
	local fx_red = self.fx.energyball_red():Instantiate(npc.Position + vector(0, 0, 2))
	fx_red.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5
	camera_util.shake(0.6, 0.2)

	wait_for_sec(red_effect_time)


	--endregion

	--region 빨강/파랑 베지어 이동

	local result_target_pos = npc.Position + vector(2, 0, 0.5)

	local move_effect_bezier_curve = function(effect, spline_waypoints, cycle)
		local calculator = CS.Oak.BezierCurveCalculator()

		local bezier_curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Linear

		if (#spline_waypoints == 3) then
			bezier_curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Quadratic
		elseif (#spline_waypoints == 4) then
			bezier_curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Cubic
		end

		local list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
		for i = 1, #spline_waypoints do
			list:Add(spline_waypoints[i])
		end

		calculator:Add(list, cycle, bezier_curve_type)

		local time_passed = 0

		while time_passed < cycle do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local cur_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)

			calculator:UpdateFrame(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
			cur_pos = calculator.CurrentPosition

			effect.transform.position = cur_pos

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	local combine_move_duration = 0.4

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--파랑 이펙트
				local blue_effects_waypoints = {
					fx_blue.transform.position,
					result_target_pos + vector(-1.2, 0, -2.2),
					result_target_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.7),
				}
				move_effect_bezier_curve(fx_blue, blue_effects_waypoints, combine_move_duration)

			end,
			function()
				--빨강 이펙트
				local red_effects_waypoints = {
					fx_red.transform.position,
					result_target_pos + vector(-1.2, 0, 3.2),
					result_target_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.7),
				}
				move_effect_bezier_curve(fx_red, red_effects_waypoints, combine_move_duration)
			end,
			function()
				camera_util.move_async(result_target_pos, combine_move_duration)
			end
	)

	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(fire_sfx, 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_impact_lightning_02')

	local shake_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_03', fade_in_time = 1, loop = true })
	local cast_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_cast_magic_01', fade_in_time = 1, loop = true })

	--endregion

	--region 빨강/파랑 혼합
	local mix_duration = 1.5
	local fx_combine = self.fx.energyball_combine():Instantiate(result_target_pos,
			unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 90, 0)), nil)

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.5, 0.2)
	camera_util.shake(1.3, 0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.15, mix_duration)

	local great_absolute_move = function(effect, center, speed, start_radius, end_radius, init_time, duration)
		local effect_transform = effect.transform
		local running_time = init_time
		local total_speed = speed

		local time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			total_speed = total_speed + 10 * unity_class.time.deltaTime
			running_time = running_time + total_speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))
			local radius = start_radius * (1 - progress) + end_radius * progress
			local x = radius * math.sin(running_time) * radius
			local z = radius * math.cos(running_time) * radius
			effect_transform.position = center + vector(x, 0, z)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--크기가 줄어듬
				coroutine_util.while_each_frame(mix_duration, function(progress)
					local cur_scale_blue = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0.5, 0.2, progress)
					local cur_scale_red = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0.5, 0.2, progress)
					local cur_scale_combine = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(1, 0.5, progress)

					fx_blue.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * cur_scale_blue
					fx_red.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * cur_scale_red
					fx_combine.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * cur_scale_combine
				end)
			end,
			function()
				--파랑 회전
				great_absolute_move(fx_blue, result_target_pos, 7, 0.7, 0.3, math.pi, mix_duration)
			end,
			function()
				--빨강 회전
				great_absolute_move(fx_red, result_target_pos, 7, 0.7, 0.3, 0, mix_duration)
			end
	)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_impact_lightning_02')

	camera_util.shake(1.5, 0.3)

	--패왕빙염탄
	local fx_result = self.fx.energyball_result():Instantiate(result_target_pos)

	--윈링의 패왕빙염탄 에너지볼들의 크기, 현재의 0.7배로 축소
	fx_result.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7

	if fx_blue ~= nil then
		fx_blue:Dispose()
		fx_blue = nil
	end

	if fx_red ~= nil then
		fx_red:Dispose()
		fx_red = nil
	end

	--이펙트 치기 전 잠시 쉬기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--endregion

	--region 패왕빙염탄 발사
	start_coroutine(function()
		--윈링 (right, attack, shuran/attack_cwp 1회) : [shout]하아아압!!!
		scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(npc, self, 'right',
				nil, nil, { key = 'mm_cg_main_s7_33', skip = false })
	end)

	if npc == self.npc.shuran() then
		--윈링 (right, attack, shuran/attack_cwp 1회)
		scene_util.set_direction(npc, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(npc, self, { name = 'shuran/attack_cwp', loop = false })
	else
		scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'boong_attack_ready')

		wp_util.move_async(npc, npc.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), nil, 0.5, { locked_dir = 'right' })

		scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'boong_attack_ready_loop')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')

		wait_for_sec(1)

		scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = 'boong_attack', loop = false })

		wp_util.move_async(npc, npc.Position + vector(1.4, 0, 0), nil, 0.1, { locked_dir = 'right' })
	end

	local result_end_pos = vector(target.Position.x + 10, 0, npc.Position.z + 0.5)

	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.63)

	scene_util.set_direction(target, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = 'prostrate', loop = false })

	camera_util.move(result_end_pos + vector(-2, 0, 0), 0.7, { ignorecameragrids = true })

	do
		local start_pos = result_target_pos
		local end_pos = result_end_pos

		local time_passed = 0
		local duration = 0.6
		while time_passed < duration do
			local progress = interpolations_constants.ease_in_quad(time_passed, 0, 1, duration)

			fx_result.transform.position = start_pos * (1 - progress) + end_pos * progress

			coroutine.yield()

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end
	end

	camera_util.shake(0.5, 1.5)

	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(shake_sfx, 1)
	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(cast_sfx, 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_magic_shield_01')

	self.fx.energyball_explosion():Instantiate(fx_result.transform.position)
	if fx_result ~= nil then
		fx_result:Dispose()
		fx_result = nil
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	field_util.remove_tint(npc.Name, 0)

	--윈링 (right, tired, dead4 마지막 프레임 유지) 상태로 전환 후 대기
	scene_util.set_direction(npc, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = 'dead4', loop = false, scale = 999 })

	--악룡 (left, idle, idle) 상태로, 10타일 우측으로 이동 (*보이지 않게 하기 위함)
	target.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_break_crystal_01', start_clip_time = 1.65
	})

	camera_util.set_position(npc.Position)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_02')

	if fx_trans ~= nil then
		fx_trans:Dispose()
		fx_trans = nil
	end

	self.fx.energyball_trans_end():Instantiate(npc.Position)

	character_util.remove_fade_color(npc, npc.name, 1)

	camera_util.follow_target(npc, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--endregion
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	start_coroutine(function()
		self.dissolver = get_or_create_global_table('utils/SpineCharacterDissolver')
		self.dissolver:load_async('ondemand/memorial_carp_girl/theatres/dissolve', 'dissolve_material_container')
	end)

function local_class:start()
	start_coroutine(function()

		sp_util.enter_scene()

		self:before_boss_scene()

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene()

			self:after_boss_scene()
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(dragon, {

			viewport_pos = vector(0.7, 0.65),
			bubble_type = 'shout',
			skip = false,
			scale = 2,
		})

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:before_boss_scene()
	local carp_girl = self.npc.carp_girl()
	local dragon = self.npc.dragon()
	local pivot = self.marker.boss_pivot()

	--(x -4, y -11, z -134) / 크기 3배율
	self.loop_background_fx = self.fx.backstage():Instantiate(vector(-4, -11, -134))
	self.loop_background_fx.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 3

	--각성 금린 (right, idle, idle) / 무기 숨기기
	scene_util.set_direction(carp_girl, 'right', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carp_girl)
	character_util.set_position(carp_girl, pivot + vector(-7.5, 0, 0))

	scene_util.hide_weapon(carp_girl)

	character_util.set_active_shadow(dragon, false)
	character_util.set_position(dragon, pivot + vector(3.5, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_scale_factor(dragon, nil, 1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dragon)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(dragon, active_state_type.enabled)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	scene_util.set_direction(carp_girl, 'up')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--각성 금린 (down, idle, idle) 상태로 전환, 1초 대기
	scene_util.set_direction(carp_girl, 'down')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--각성 금린 (right, tired, question 1회 후 마지막 프레임 유지) : 흠… 하늘의 기운을 뺏기 위해 그대가 유리한 차원을 만든 것인가…?

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(carp_girl, self, 'right',

	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(dragon, 'mm_cg_main_s8_9', true, {
		viewport_pos = viewport_pos, scale = bubble_size, bubble_type = 'shout'
	})

	--악룡_말풍선만 (left, idle, idle) : [shout]너를 먹어치우고… 진정한 용이 되겠어…!
	--말풍선 위치 (x 0.6, y 0.75) (*화면 중앙 상단을 의도)
	--말풍선 크기 1.5
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(dragon, 'mm_cg_main_s8_10', true, {
		viewport_pos = viewport_pos, scale = bubble_size, bubble_type = 'shout'
	})

	--각성 금린 (right, tired, question 마지막 프레임 유지된 상태) silence 이모티콘

			nil, nil, 'silence')

	--각성 금린 (right, smile, idle) : 그래도… 마을이 더 파괴될 걱정은 안 해도 되니 좋구먼!
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carp_girl)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(carp_girl, self, 'right',
			nil, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'mm_cg_main_s8_11')

	--각성 금린 (right, smile, nod 2회 후 idle) : 그대에게도 시간이 없으니, 전력으로 가겠네! / 무기 보여주기

function local_class:after_boss_scene()

	local dragon = self.npc.dragon()
	local carp_girl = self.npc.carp_girl()
	local carp_fire = self.npc.carp_fire()
	local pivot = self.marker.village_pivot()

		stage_controller = nil

	scene_util.set_emotion(shuran, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(shuran, self, 'hurt')
	character_util.set_position(shuran, pivot + vector(-9.5, 0, 0))
	field_object_util.set_active_state(shuran, active_state_type.enabled)

	--각성 금린 (right, idle, idle) / 무기 숨기기
	scene_util.set_direction(carp_girl, 'right', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carp_girl)
	character_util.set_position(carp_girl, pivot + vector(-7.5, 0, 0))
	field_object_util.set_active_state(carp_girl, active_state_type.enabled)
	scene_util.hide_weapon(carp_girl)

	--악룡 (left, idle, idle) ※위 이미지가 의도한 크기와 위치
	character_util.set_position(dragon, pivot + vector(1.5, 2, 0.5))
	character_util.set_scale_factor(dragon, nil, 0.8)
	scene_util.set_direction(dragon, 'left', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dragon)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(dragon)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(dragon, active_state_type.enabled)

	local dragon_face_pos = dragon.Position + vector(-3, 0, 0)
	local dragon_mouse_pos = dragon.Position + vector(-3, 0, -1.5)

	--화면 ‘하얀색’인 상태로 2초 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--동시실행
	--화면 shake (0.3, 2) 실행
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 2)

	--악룡 (left, idle, dead 1회) 상태로 전환
	--악룡 (left, idle, dead 마지막 프레임 유지) 상태로 대기
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_13')
	scene_util.set_anim(dragon, self, { name = 'dead', loop = false })

	--TODO
	--6섹션 후반부터 적용되어 있던 반투명한 붉은색 필터, 여기서 제거
	--화면 1초에 걸쳐 페이드인
	screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1.4)

	--(*악룡 dead 모션 쓰러지는 타이밍 맞춰서) 동시 실행
	do
		local duration = 0.5

		--카메라 위치로 0.5초에 걸쳐 이동하면서 줌인 4로 변경
		camera_util.move(pivot, duration)

		--카메라 shake (0.5, 0.5)
		camera_util.shake(0.5, 0.5)

		--악룡 ‘얼굴’ 쪽에 FX_Common_SmokeScreen 이펙트 출력
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_druid_stomp_03')
		self.fx.smoke_screen():Instantiate(dragon_face_pos + vector(0, 0, -1))

		camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(4, duration)
	end

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--악룡 ‘입’ 쪽에 fx_maid_darkaura_loop 이펙트 2배로 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_03')
	local loop_smoke_fx = self.fx.darkaura():Instantiate(dragon_mouse_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.5))
	loop_smoke_fx.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2

	--악룡 스파인 2초간 색 제거 (*검은색으로 보이도록) 후 다시 2초간 기존 색으로 복구
	do
		local duration = 2

		character_util.add_fade_color(dragon, dragon.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, duration)

		wait_for_sec(duration)

		character_util.remove_fade_color(dragon, dragon.Name, duration)

		wait_for_sec(duration)
	end

	--악룡_말풍선만 (left, idle, dead 마지막 프레임 유지) : [shout]아, 안 돼….
	--대사 출력과 동시에 악룡 스파인 shake (0.03, 0.3)
	--말풍선 위치 (x 0.25, y 0.8) (*좌측 상단 의도) / 말풍선 크기 1.5
	local dragon_viewport_pos = vector(0.25, 0.8)

	scene_util.shake(dragon, 0.03, 0.3,false)
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(dragon, 'mm_cg_main_s8_1', true, {
		scale = 1.2, viewport_pos = dragon_viewport_pos })

	--악룡_말풍선만 (left, idle, dead 마지막 프레임 유지) : [shout]사라진다… 사라지고 싶지 않아….
	--대사 출력과 동시에 악룡 스파인 shake (0.03, 0.3)
	--말풍선 위치 (x 0.25, y 0.8) (*좌측 상단 의도) / 말풍선 크기 1.5
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.shake(dragon, 0.03, 0.3,false)
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(dragon, 'mm_cg_main_s8_2', true, {
		scale = 1.2, viewport_pos = dragon_viewport_pos })

	--표정 및 모션 유지
	--각성 금린 (right, idle, walk) 상태로, 2초에 걸쳐 3타일 우측으로 이동
	wp_util.move_async(carp_girl, carp_girl.Position + vector(4, 0, 0), nil, 2)

	--각성 금린 (right, smile, nod 2회 후 idle) : …약속하지 않았나. 두려워 마시게.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(carp_girl, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'mm_cg_main_s8_3')

	--각성 금린 (right, smile, walk) 상태로, 1초에 걸쳐 0.5타일 우측으로 이동 (*악룡에 바짝)
	wp_util.move_async(carp_girl, carp_girl.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), nil, 1)

	--동시 실행
	do
		local duration = 2

		--각성 금린 (right, sleep_deep, push) 상태로 전환, 표정 및 모션 유지
		scene_util.set_emotion(carp_girl, self, 'sleep_deep')
		scene_util.set_anim(carp_girl, self, 'push')

		--악룡 스파인 2초간 ‘하얀색’으로 변경
		character_util.add_fade_color(dragon, dragon.Name, unity_class.color.white, 1, duration)
		wait_for_sec(duration)
	end

	--동시 실행
	local intro_sfx
	do
		--카메라 shake (0.2, 4.5)
		camera_util.shake(0.2, 4.5)

		--출력되던 FX_Common_SmokeScreen 이펙트 삭제,
		loop_smoke_fx:Dispose()

		--동일한 위치에 fx_maid_darkaura_end ‘2배 크기’로 1회 출력
		local fx_end = self.fx.darkaura_end():Instantiate(dragon_mouse_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.5))
		fx_end.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2

		--동일한 위치에 FX_explosion_boss 이펙트 출력
		intro_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_boss_die_01', loop = false })
		loop_smoke_fx = self.fx.explosion_boss():Instantiate(dragon_mouse_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0))
	end

	--(비동기_위 동시 실행 3.5초 경과) 화면 1초에 걸쳐 페이드아웃
	wait_for_sec(3.5)


	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(intro_sfx, 2)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self:carp_scene()

	--페이드인 전 세팅 / 이전 ‘각성 금린과 악룡’ 위치로
	--(*악룡 스파인은 하얀색인 상태)
	camera_util.move_async(pivot, 0)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--화면 2초에 걸쳐 페이드인
	screen_util.fade_in_async(2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--악룡 스파인, 5초에 걸쳐 스파인 크기 0.2배로 축소되면서 좌측으로 이동
	--(*금린 앞에 계속 머리가 위치하도록)
	do
		local duration = 5

		wait_all_lua(
				function()
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_frieren_cast_01')
					character_util.spine_scale(dragon, unity_class.vector3.one * 0.2, duration)
				end,
				function()
					wp_util.move_async(dragon, carp_girl.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), nil, duration)
				end,
				function()
					wait_for_sec(1)
					music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_blizzard_02', volume = 0.5 })
				end
		)
	end

	--동시 실행
	do
		local duration = 2

		wait_all_lua(
				function()
					--악룡 스파인, 2초간 알파값 1에서 0으로 변경(*투명)되면서 삭제.
					self:hide_dissolve_fo(dragon, duration, false)

					character_util.set_position(dragon, vector(999, 0, 999))
					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dragon)
					character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(dragon, 1, 0)
					field_object_util.set_active_state(dragon, active_state_type.disabled)
				end,
				function()
					--백년화리 (left, sleep_deep, prostrate) 상태로, 각성 금린으로부터 vector(0.8, 0, -0.1) 위치에 2초간 알파값 0에서 1로 변경(*선명)되면서 생성
					--character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(carp_fire, 0, 0)
					scene_util.set_direction(carp_fire, 'left', false)
					scene_util.set_emotion(carp_fire, self, 'sleep_deep')
					scene_util.set_anim(carp_fire, self, 'prostrate')
					character_util.remove_color(carp_fire, carp_fire.Name, 0)
					character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(carp_fire, 1, 0)
					character_util.set_active_shadow(carp_fire, true)
					field_object_util.set_active_state(carp_fire, active_state_type.enabled)

					carp_fire.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0.1)

					wait_for_sec(0.1)

					character_util.set_position(carp_fire, carp_girl.Position + vector(0.8, 0, -0.1))

					self:show_dissolve_fo(carp_fire, duration)
				end
		)
	end

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--동시 실행
	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })

	do
		local duration = 1

		--각성 금린 (right, idle, eat) 상태로 전환, 표정 및 모션 유지
		character_util.remove_emotion(carp_girl)
		scene_util.set_anim(carp_girl, self, 'eat')

		--백년화리 (left, sleep_deep, prostrate) 스파인 shake (0.03, 1)
		scene_util.shake(carp_fire, 0.03, duration)

		wait_for_sec(duration)
	end

	--각성 금린 (right, idle, seat 전환 시간 0.4초) : 살아있구먼… 다행일세….
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(equipping_sfx)
	scene_util.set_anim(carp_girl, self, { name = 'seat', mix_duration = 0.4 })
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(carp_girl, 'mm_cg_main_s8_4')

	--각성 금린 (right, sleep_deep, seat) silence 이모티콘 출력
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(carp_girl, self, 'right',
			nil, 'sleep_deep', 'silence')

	--각성 금린 (right, smile, seat) : …정말 다행이야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(carp_girl, self, 'right',
			nil, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'mm_cg_main_s8_5')

	--윈링 (right, idle, walk) 상태로, 2초에 걸쳐 4타일 좌측으로 이동
	scene_util.set_emotion(shuran, self, 'idle')
	character_util.remove_anim(shuran)
	wp_util.move_async(shuran, shuran.Position + vector(4, 0, 0), nil, 2)

	--동시 실행
	do
		--윈링 (right, smile, cast2 상태로 jump 1회) 상태로 전환, 표정 및 모션 유지
		scene_util.set_emotion(shuran, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(shuran, self, 'cast2')
		character_util.normal_jump_async(shuran, '01_small_jump_01')

		--각성 금린 (left, smile, cast) 상태로 전환
		scene_util.set_direction(carp_girl, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(carp_girl, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(carp_girl, self, 'cast')

		wait_for_sec(2)

		--각성 금린 (left, smile, walk) 상태로 1초에 걸쳐 1.5타일 좌측으로 이동
		character_util.remove_anim(carp_girl)
		wp_util.move_async(carp_girl, carp_girl.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), nil, 1)
	end

	--동시 실행
	do
		--각성 금린 (left, damaged, damaged2) 상태로 전환
		scene_util.set_emotion(carp_girl, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(carp_girl, self, { name = 'damaged2', loop = false })

		--스파인 상위로 FX_small_explosion_yellow 이펙트 출력
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_light_01')
		self.fx.explosion_yellow():Instantiate(carp_girl.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))

		--윈링 (right, surprise, cast2) : [shout]그… 금린! (*표정 및 모션 유지)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'cast2', keep = true }, { name = 'surprise', keep = true }, 'mm_cg_main_s8_6')
	end

	character_util.add_fade_color(carp_girl, carp_girl.Name, unity_class.color.white, 1, 2)

	--스파인 상위로 FX_small_explosion_yellow 이펙트 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_light_01')
	self.fx.explosion_yellow():Instantiate(carp_girl.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))

	--각성 금린 (left, damaged, dead4 1회 후 prostrate) 상태로 전환하면서, 스파인 ‘하얀 색’으로 2초간 변경
	scene_util.set_anim_async(carp_girl, self, { name = 'dead4', count = 1 })
	scene_util.set_anim(carp_girl, self, 'prostrate')

	--동시 실행
	do
		local duration = 0.5
		--윈링 (right, damaged, run) 상태로, 0.5초에 걸쳐 2타일 우측으로 이동
		character_util.remove_anim(shuran)
		scene_util.set_emotion(shuran, self, 'damaged')

		wp_util.move(shuran, shuran.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0), nil, duration, { run = true })

		--화면 0.5초에 걸쳐 페이드아웃
		screen_util.fade_out_async(duration, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	end

	--페이드아웃 상태에서
	camera_util.set_position(self.marker.boss_pivot() + vector(-200, 0, 0))

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--대기 시간 2초
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--윈링_말풍선만 : [shout]아, 안 돼…!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(shuran, 'mm_cg_main_s8_7', true, { viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.5), scale = 1.2 })
	--말풍선 위치 (x 0.5, y 0.5) (*정가운데 의도) / 말풍선 크기 1.2
	--섹션 넘긴다.

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	character_util.convert_to_party_member(shuran, user_party)
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(shuran, param)

	character_util.convert_to_npc(carp_girl)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(shuran, active_state_type.enabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(carp_girl, active_state_type.enabled)

	self.controller:progress_section()
end

function local_class:carp_scene()
	local recollection_pivot = self.marker.recollection_pivot()
	local informer = self.npc.carp_informer()
	local wicked = self.npc.carp_wicked()
	local carp_extra_1 = self.npc.carp_extra(1)
	local carp_extra_2 = self.npc.carp_extra(2)

	local function npc_setting(npc, dir, emo, anim)
		scene_util.set_direction(npc, dir, false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, emo)
		scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, anim)
		character_util.add_color(npc, npc.Name, unity_class.color.black, 0.8, 0)
	end

	--페이드인 전 세팅
	--(*6섹션에 쓰러져있던 신선들, 그대로 대기 중)
	--카메라 위치 조명
	camera_util.move_async(recollection_pivot, 0)

	--앞잡이 신선 (left, damaged, prostrate) 검은 틴트 80% 상태
	character_util.set_position(informer, recollection_pivot + vector(-2, 0, 2))
	npc_setting(informer, 'left', 'damaged', 'prostrate')

	--못된 신선 A (right, damaged, prostrate) 검은 틴트 80% 상태
	character_util.set_position(wicked, recollection_pivot + vector(4, 0, 1.5))
	npc_setting(wicked, 'right', 'damaged', 'prostrate')

	--엑스트라 신선 A (right, damaged, prostrate) 검은 틴트 80% 상태
	character_util.set_position(carp_extra_1, recollection_pivot + vector(-1.5, 0, -2))
	npc_setting(carp_extra_1, 'right', 'damaged', 'prostrate')

	--엑스트라 신선 B (left, damaged, prostrate) 검은 틴트 80% 상태
	character_util.set_position(carp_extra_2, recollection_pivot + vector(0.5, 0, -3.5))
	npc_setting(carp_extra_2, 'left', 'damaged', 'prostrate')

	--화면 1초에 걸쳐 페이드인
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_cast_magic_05')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--못된 신선 A, 스파인 상위로 FX_Object_Twinkle 이펙트 1초간 출력
	local loop_twinkle = self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(wicked.Position)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--동시 실행
	do
		local duration = 1

		--못된 신선 A, 스파인 1초간 검은 틴트 제거
		character_util.remove_color(wicked, wicked.Name, duration)

		--엑스트라 신선 B, FX_Object_Twinkle 이펙트 1초간 출력
		loop_twinkle:Dispose()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_magic_heal_01')
		loop_twinkle = self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(carp_extra_2.Position)

		wait_for_sec(duration)
	end

	--동시 실행
	do
		local duration = 1

		--엑스트라 신선 B, 1초간 검은 틴트 제거
		character_util.remove_color(carp_extra_2, carp_extra_2.Name, duration)

		--엑스트라 신선 A, FX_Object_Twinkle 이펙트 1초간 출력
		loop_twinkle:Dispose()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_magic_heal_01')
		loop_twinkle = self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(carp_extra_1.Position)

		wait_for_sec(duration)
	end

	--동시 실행
	do
		local duration = 1

		--못된 신선 A (right, damaged, hurt) 상태로 전환, 표정 및 모션 유지
		scene_util.set_direction(wicked, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(wicked, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(wicked, self, 'hurt')

		--엑스트라 신선 A, 1초간 검은 틴트 제거
		character_util.remove_color(carp_extra_1, carp_extra_1.Name, duration)

		--앞잡이 신선, FX_Object_Twinkle 이펙트 1초간 출력
		loop_twinkle:Dispose()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_magic_heal_01')
		loop_twinkle = self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(informer.Position)

		wait_for_sec(duration)
	end

	--동시 실행

	end)
end

---@class CarpGirlSection4MiniEvent2

local mini_event = newclass('CarpGirlSection4MiniEvent2')

function mini_event:init(event_controller)
	--해당 이벤트들의 고유한 id 1 ~ 32까지 가능 (자동 할당)
	self.event_id = 2

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version + 1

	--Section4.lua 파일 (MemorialCarpGirlMainSection4)
	self.event_controller = event_controller

	--region Character

	self.get_character = {
		carp_girl = function()
			return get_character('carp_girl')
		end,
		--엑스트라 남성 B
		extra_male_b = function()
			return get_character('extra_male_b')
		end,
		--엑스트라 여성 D
		extra_female_d = function()
			return get_character('extra_female_d')
		end,
		--할아버지
		oldman = function()
			return get_character('oldman')
		end,
	}
	--endregion Character

	--region FieldObject
	self.get_fo = {
		rock = function()
			return get_field_object('s4_sub_event_rock')
		end,
	}
	--endregion FieldObject

	--region Fx

	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		last_hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,
		explosion = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_explosion_boss')
		end,
		twinkle = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle')
		end,
		buttbounce = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('mm_buttbounce')
		end,
	})

	self.fx_list = nil

	--endregion Fx

	self.wait_pos = vector(999, 0, 999)
end

function mini_event:enter()
	start_coroutine(function()
		--엑스트라 여성 D
		local extra_female_d = self.get_character.extra_female_d()
		--엑스트라 남성 B
		local extra_male_b = self.get_character.extra_male_b()
		--촌장 할아버지
		local oldman = self.get_character.oldman()

		local rock = self.get_fo.rock()

		field_object_util.set_active_state(rock, active_state_type.enabled)

		character_util.add_lua_listener(extra_female_d, self)
		character_util.add_lua_listener(extra_male_b, self)
		character_util.add_lua_listener(oldman, self)

		screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()

		self.fx_list = {}

		metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor(self.fx):load_async()

		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.event_controller.sub_event_marker_name .. 2,
				self.event_controller.main_quest_id,
				false,
				oldman.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5))
	end)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
end

function mini_event:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function mini_event:dispose()
end

--region Event

function mini_event:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function mini_event:on_interact_event(e)
	local npc_list = {
		--엑스트라 여성 D
		self.get_character.extra_female_d(),
		--엑스트라 남성 B
		self.get_character.extra_male_b(),
		--촌장 할아버지
		self.get_character.oldman()
	}

	for idx = 1, #npc_list do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, npc_list[idx]) then
			character_util.remove_lua_listener(npc_list[1], self)
			character_util.remove_lua_listener(npc_list[2], self)
			character_util.remove_lua_listener(npc_list[3], self)

			quest_marker_util.remove(self.event_controller.sub_event_marker_name .. 2)

			sp_util.start_scene(self.corrupted_chief_scene, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

--endregion Event

---@class CarpGirlSection4MiniEvent3

local mini_event = newclass('CarpGirlSection4MiniEvent3')

function mini_event:init(event_controller)
	--해당 이벤트들의 고유한 id 1 ~ 32까지 가능 (자동 할당)
	self.event_id = 3

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version + 1

	--Section4.lua 파일 (MemorialCarpGirlMainSection4)
	self.event_controller = event_controller

	--region Character

	self.get_character = {
		carp_girl = function()
			return get_character('carp_girl')
		end,
		--마을 여성
		civilian_female = function()
			return get_character('civilian_female')
		end,
		--엑스트라 여성 B
		extra_female_b = function()
			return get_character('extra_female_b')
		end,
	}
	--endregion Character

	--region FieldObject
	self.get_fo = {
		well = function(number)
			return get_field_object('s4_mid_event_well_' .. number)
		end,
	}
	--endregion FieldObject

	--region Fx

	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		last_hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,
		twinkle = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle')
		end,
		get = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_get')
		end,
		explosion = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_explosion_boss')
		end,
		vortex_contrail = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cg_water_vortex_contrail')
		end,
	})

	self.fx_list = nil

	--endregion Fx
	self.character = nil
end

function mini_event:enter()
	start_coroutine(function()
		--마을 여성
		local civilian_female = self.get_character.civilian_female()

		--엑스트라 여성 B
		local extra_female_b = self.get_character.extra_female_b()

		character_util.add_lua_listener(civilian_female, self)

		character_util.add_lua_listener(extra_female_b, self)

		screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()

		self.fx_list = {}

		metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor(self.fx):load_async()

		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.event_controller.sub_event_marker_name .. 3,
				self.event_controller.main_quest_id,
				false,
				civilian_female.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0))
	end)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
end

function mini_event:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self:fx_dispose_all()
end

function mini_event:dispose()

end

--region Event

function mini_event:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function mini_event:on_interact_event(e)
	local npc_list = {
		--마을 여성
		self.get_character.civilian_female(),
		--엑스트라 여성 B
		self.get_character.extra_female_b()
	}

	for idx = 1, #npc_list do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, npc_list[idx]) then
			character_util.remove_lua_listener(npc_list[1], self)
			character_util.remove_lua_listener(npc_list[2], self)

			quest_marker_util.remove(self.event_controller.sub_event_marker_name .. 3)

			sp_util.start_scene(self.purify_well_scene, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function mini_event:fx_dispose_all()
	if self.fx_list then
		for _, target in pairs(self.fx_list) do
			if target then
				target:Dispose()
				target = nil
			end
		end

		self.fx_list = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return mini_event()
	end
}
