--region 도서관 보드 공통 이벤트

function common_library_event:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)
	self.super:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)

	self.nar_data = nil
	self.choose_data = nil
	self.result_key = {}
	self.choose_complete_key = 'mm_magical_girl_board_event_1_7'

	self.is_interact = false
	self.twinkle_effect = nil

	self.get_question_item = function()
		return get_field_object('pooled_interact_item_5')
	end

	self.get_result_item = function()
		return get_field_object('pooled_interact_item_6')
	end

	self.get_fx_twinkle = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle')
	end

	self.get_fx_twinkle()
end

function common_library_event:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	-- 문제창 세팅
	local board = self.get_question_item()
	board.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('one_line_group_10_pos') + vector(0.5, 0, 0.5)
	board.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	field_object_util.set_active_state(board, active_state_type.enabled)

	self.twinkle_effect = self.get_fx_twinkle():Instantiate(board.Position + vector(0, 1.25, -0.8))

	-- 결과창 세팅
	local result_board = self.get_result_item()
	result_board.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('one_line_group_10_pos') + vector(-0.5, 0, 0.5)

	local narration_interactable = CS.Oak.NarrationInteractable()
	narration_interactable.StringKeys = self.result_key
	result_board.Interactable = narration_interactable

	field_object_util.set_active_state(result_board, active_state_type.enabled)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
end

function common_library_event:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	local board = self.get_question_item()
	board.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	field_object_util.set_active_state(board, active_state_type.disabled)

	board = self.get_result_item()
	board.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	field_object_util.set_active_state(board, active_state_type.disabled)

	-- Twinkle 이펙트 제거
	self:dispose_fx_twinkle()

	-- 나레이션 문제 데이터
	self.nar_data = nil

	-- 선택지 데이터
	self.choose_data = nil

	-- 결과 키
	self.result_key = nil

	self.super:exit()
end

function common_library_event:on_event(e)
	local board = self.get_question_item()

	if not self.is_interact and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, board) then
		self.is_interact = true
		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_board, self, board)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function common_library_event:interact_board(fo)
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	-- 오늘의 밸런스 게임! 당신의 소중한 한 표를 던져주세요.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'mm_magical_girl_board_event_1_0' })

	-- 문제
	field_ui_util.show_narration_talk_branch_async(self.nar_data, self.choose_data)

	-- 투표 완료! 결과는 내일 공개됩니다. / 투표 완료! 결과는 추후 공개됩니다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.choose_complete_key })

	-- Twinkle 이펙트 제거
	self:dispose_fx_twinkle()

	local narration_interactable = CS.Oak.NarrationInteractable()
	narration_interactable.StringKeys = { self.choose_complete_key }
	fo.Interactable = narration_interactable
end

function common_library_event:dispose_fx_twinkle()
	if self.twinkle_effect == nil then
		return
	end

	self.twinkle_effect:Dispose()
	self.twinkle_effect = nil
end

--endregion 도서관 보드 공통 이벤트

function local_class:init()
	self.main_quest_id = 7200103

	-- QuestOneLineManager Create
	local is_create
	is_create, self.group_manager = global_table_util.try_create('Quest/Etc/QuestOneLineController/QuestOneLineController')

	if not is_create then
		return
	end

	-- 생성 성공 시 그룹 매니져 initialize
	local path = 'Quest/Memorial/MagicalGirl/Common/MGEventGroupConstant'
	self.group_manager:initialize(self.main_quest_id, event_groups, path)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.group_manager ~= nil then
		self.group_manager:dispose()
		self.group_manager = nil
	end
end

function local_class:activate_group(zone_name, group_name)
	self.group_manager:activate_group_for_name(zone_name, group_name)
end

function local_class:deactivate_group(zone_name, group_name)
	self.group_manager:deactivate_group_for_name(zone_name, group_name)
end

function local_class:get_group(zone_name, group_name)
	return self.group_manager:get_group(zone_name, group_name)
end

do
	-- 1일차 두근두근 문예부
	local event = event_groups.day_1_literature_club

	function event:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)
		self.super:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)

		self.cached_items = {}
		self.zone_name = 'day_1_literature_club_zone'
		self.triggered = false
	end

	function event:enter()
		self.super:enter()

		-- 홍차 / 쿠키 세팅
		local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('one_line_literature_club_pos')

		local item_spec = {
			{
				item_id = 21507,
				pos = center_pos + vector(-2, 0.6, 1.5)
			},
			{
				item_id = 20431,
				pos = center_pos + vector(-4, 0.6, -1.5)
			},
		}

		for i = 1, #item_spec do
			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
				pos = item_spec[i].pos,
				item_id = item_spec[i].item_id,
				loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
				skip_text = true,
			})

			quest_drop_item_util.set_shadow_active(item, false)
			table.insert(self.cached_items, item)
		end

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	end

	function event:exit()
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

		-- 홍차 쿠키 제거
		for i = 1, #self.cached_items do
			quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.cached_items[i])
		end
		self.cached_items = nil

		self.super:exit()
	end

	function event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
		if not self.triggered and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name) then
			self.triggered = true

			start_coroutine(self.talk_routine, self)

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function event:talk_routine()
		local moniko_handler = self:get_handler('moniko')

		-- 모니코(right, smile, idle): 안녕, 신입생! 혹시 동아리 가입할 생각 없어?
		local moniko = moniko_handler:get_npc()

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', play_pos = moniko.Position, loop = false })
		moniko_handler:set_emotion(self, 'smile')
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(moniko_handler, 'mm_magical_girl_day_1_literature_club_1')

		-- 대사 끝나도 애니 표정 유지.
		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		--모니코(right, smile, cast): 심장이 콩닥콩닥 뛰는 문예부 말이야!
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(moniko_handler, 'mm_magical_girl_day_1_literature_club_2')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		--모니코(right, smile, idle): 우리는 방과후마다 각자 쓴 시를 교환해서 읽고 있어.
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(moniko_handler, 'mm_magical_girl_day_1_literature_club_3')

		-- 대사 끝나도 애니 표정 유지.
		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		--모니코(right, smile, idle): 아하하. 고민이 된다면 잠깐 들려서 쿠키만 먹고 가도 좋아.
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(moniko_handler, 'mm_magical_girl_day_1_literature_club_4')

		--모니코(up, idle, idle)
		moniko_handler:remove_emotion(moniko)
		character_util.set_direction(moniko, 'up')

		--연출 종료되면 모니코 원라인 대사: 문예부에 어서와.
		moniko_handler:set_one_line('mm_magical_girl_day_1_one_line_29')
	end
end

		self.super:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)
		self.interact_datas = nil
	end

	function event:enter()
		self.super:enter()

		self.interact_datas = {
			{
				handler_name = 'day_1_corridor_1',
				is_active = false,
				anim = 'nod',
				count = 2,
				key = 'mm_magical_girl_day_1_one_line_23',
				sfx = '03_dialogue_positive_01',
			},
			{
				handler_name = 'day_1_corridor_2',
				is_active = false,
				anim = 'attack',
				count = 2,
				key = 'mm_magical_girl_day_1_one_line_24',
				sfx = '01_bad_fairy_01',
			}
		}

		for i = 1, #self.interact_datas do
			local handler = self:get_handler(self.interact_datas[i].handler_name)
			local npc = handler:get_npc()
			character_util.add_lua_listener(npc, self)
		end

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	end

	function event:on_event(e)
		for i = 1, #self.interact_datas do
			local interact_data = self.interact_datas[i]
			local handler = self:get_handler(self.interact_datas[i].handler_name)
			local npc = handler:get_npc()

			if not interact_data.is_active and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, npc) then
				self.interact_datas[i].is_active = true
				start_coroutine(self.talk_routine, self, i, npc, interact_data)
				return true
			end
		end

		return false
	end

	function event:exit()
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

		for i = 1, #self.interact_datas do
			local handler = self:get_handler(self.interact_datas[i].handler_name)
			local npc = handler:get_npc()
			character_util.remove_lua_listener(npc, self)
		end

		self.interact_datas = nil
		self.super:exit()
	end

	function event:talk_routine(index, npc, interact_data)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(interact_data.sfx)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc, self, nil, {
			name = interact_data.anim, count = interact_data.count, one_shot_sfx = false },
				nil, { key = interact_data.key, skip = false })

		self.interact_datas[index].is_active = false
	end
end

			bubble_direction = 'ct',
			scale = 1.3

do
	-- 2일차 시달소
	local event = event_groups.day_2_time_leapt_girl

	function event:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)
		self.super:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)

		self.request_id = 0
		self.max_request_id = 4

		self.grid_name = 'school_left_grid'
		self.zone_name = 'post_time_leapt_girl_zone'

		self.is_active = false
		self.triggered = false
	end

	function event:enter()
		self.super:enter()

		self.is_active = false
		self.triggered = false

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	end

	function event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
		if not self.triggered and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name) then
			self:first_event_start()
			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function event:on_watching_camera_grid_changed_event(e)
		if not self.triggered or e.CameraGrid == nil then
			return false
		end

		if not self.is_active and e.CameraGrid.name == self.grid_name then
			start_coroutine(self.event_routine, self)
		else
			self.is_active = false
		end

		return true
	end

	function event:exit()
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WatchingCameraGridChangedEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

		local mako_handler = self:get_handler('mako')
		local mako = mako_handler:get_npc()
		mako.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

		self.super:exit()
	end

	function event:first_event_start()
		self.triggered = true

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WatchingCameraGridChangedEvent),
				'on_watching_camera_grid_changed_event')

		start_coroutine(self.event_routine, self)
	end

	function event:event_routine()
		self.is_active = true

		local hiaki_handler = self:get_handler('hiaki')
		local mako_handler = self:get_handler('mako')

		local mako = mako_handler:get_npc()
		local hiaki = hiaki_handler:get_npc()

		character_util.remove_anim(hiaki)
		character_util.remove_anim(mako)

		local function is_routine_end(current_request_id)
			return not self.activated or (self.is_active and self.request_id == current_request_id)
		end

		local speed = 7

		local pos_list = {
			field_util.get_marker_pos('one_line_group_9_pos') - vector(1, 0, 0),
			field_util.get_marker_pos('one_line_group_9_pos_1'),
			field_util.get_marker_pos('one_line_group_9_pos_2'),
			field_util.get_marker_pos('one_line_group_9_pos_3')
		}

		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(mako)
		scene_util.set_direction(mako, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_direction(hiaki, 'left', false)
		character_util.set_position(mako, pos_list[1])

		mako_handler:remove_emotion()
		mako_handler:remove_anim()

		hiaki_handler:remove_emotion()
		hiaki_handler:remove_anim()

		local current_request_id = self:set_request_id()
		while is_routine_end(current_request_id) do
			-- 히아키(left, idle, idle): 마코, 나랑 사귈래? 나 그렇게 못생기지도…
			self:show_stoppable_speech_async(hiaki_handler, 'mm_magical_girl_day_2_one_line_8')

			if not is_routine_end(current_request_id) then
				return
			end

			-- 마코(right, attack, idle)[shout]: 자, 잠깐!!!
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', play_pos = pos_list[1], loop = false })
			mako_handler:set_emotion(self, 'attack')
			self:show_stoppable_speech_async(mako_handler, 'mm_magical_girl_day_2_one_line_9', { bubble_type = 'shout' })

			if not is_routine_end(current_request_id) then
				return
			end

			mako.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

			-- 마코 왼쪽 오른쪽으로 (down, attack, run) 상태로 7의 속도로 이동 카메라 그리드 밖으로 벗어나면 아래 노란 위치로 순간 이동
			local duration = (pos_list[2] - pos_list[1]).magnitude / speed
			local time_passed = 0

			local run_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', parent = mako, loop = true })
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_aircraft_11', parent = mako, loop = false })

			scene_util.set_direction(mako, 'down', false)
			mako_handler:set_anim(self, 'run')
			while is_routine_end(current_request_id) and time_passed < duration do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
				mako.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos_list[1], pos_list[2], progress)
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			if not is_routine_end(current_request_id) then
				run_sfx:Stop()
				return
			end

			-- 히아키(down, idle, idle) question 이모티콘 버블 출력
			if hiaki ~= nil then
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_notice_01', play_pos = hiaki.Position })
				character_util.set_direction(hiaki, 'down')
				character_util.show_emoticon(hiaki, nil, 'question')
			end

			scene_util.set_direction(mako, 'right', false)
			mako.Position = pos_list[3]
			local end_pos = pos_list[4] + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
			duration = (pos_list[3] - end_pos).magnitude / speed

			-- 현 위치에서 마코 히아키 위치까지 (right, attack, run) 7의 속도로 이동
			time_passed = 0
			while is_routine_end(current_request_id) and time_passed < duration do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
				mako.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos_list[3], end_pos, progress)
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			if not is_routine_end(current_request_id) then
				run_sfx:Stop()
				return
			end

			-- 도착하면 마코(right, damaged, idle) 전환 + 마코 위로 fx_hit 출력
			run_sfx:Stop()
			mako_handler:set_emotion(self, 'damaged')
			mako_handler:set_anim(self, { name = 'damaged', one_shot_sfx = false })

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', play_pos = mako.Position, loop = false })
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(mako.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(mako)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(mako)

			local jump_dur = 0.3
			character_util.jump(mako, 0.5, jump_dur)

			local start_pos = mako.Position

			-- 마코 0.3초간 왼쪽 1타일 easeoutquad 상태로 이동
			time_passed = 0

			while is_routine_end(current_request_id) and time_passed < jump_dur do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / jump_dur)
				mako.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, pos_list[4], progress)

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			if not is_routine_end(current_request_id) then
				return
			end

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_trip_01', play_pos = mako.Position, loop = false })
			mako_handler:set_anim(self, { name = 'hurt', one_shot_sfx = false })

			-- 히아키(down, surprise, idle): 마코…?
			self:show_stoppable_speech_async(hiaki_handler, 'mm_magical_girl_day_2_one_line_10')

			if not is_routine_end(current_request_id) then
				return
			end

			-- 마코 (right, idle, idle) jump 1회
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_popup_01', play_pos = mako.Position, loop = false })
			mako_handler:remove_emotion()
			mako_handler:set_anim(self, 'get')
			character_util.normal_jump_async(mako)
			mako_handler:remove_anim()

			if not is_routine_end(current_request_id) then
				return
			end

			-- 마코 위 위치로 3의 속도로 정렬 (async 아님)
			start_pos = mako.Position
			end_pos = pos_list[1] - vector(0, 0, 1)
			duration = (end_pos - start_pos).magnitude / 3
			scene_util.set_direction(mako, 'left', false)
			mako_handler:set_anim(self, 'walk')

			time_passed = 0
			while is_routine_end(current_request_id) and time_passed < duration do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
				mako.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			if not is_routine_end(current_request_id) then
				return
			end

			start_pos = mako.Position
			end_pos = pos_list[1]
			duration = (end_pos - start_pos).magnitude / 3
			character_util.set_direction(mako, 'up')
			character_util.set_direction(hiaki, 'left')

			time_passed = 0
			while is_routine_end(current_request_id) and time_passed < duration do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
				mako.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			if not is_routine_end(current_request_id) then
				return
			end

			-- 마코(right, smile, idle): 안녕! 우리 동생 얘기나 할까?
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_positive_01', play_pos = mako.Position, loop = false })
			mako_handler:remove_anim()
			character_util.set_direction(mako, 'right')
			mako_handler:set_emotion(self, 'smile')
			self:show_stoppable_speech_async(mako_handler, 'mm_magical_girl_day_2_one_line_11')

			if not is_routine_end(current_request_id) then
				return
			end

			-- 히아키(left, idle, idle): 음, 그보다 할 말이 있는데…
			self:show_stoppable_speech_async(hiaki_handler, 'mm_magical_girl_day_2_one_line_12')
		end
	end

	function event:set_request_id()
		self.request_id = self.request_id + 1

		if self.request_id > self.max_request_id then
			self.request_id = 0
		end

		return self.request_id
	end

end

	local event = event_groups.day_4_daylight_1

	function event:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)

		self.is_interact = false

		self.get_pooled_item = function()

		end
	end

	function event:enter()
		self.super:enter()

		local kusmi_handler = self:get_handler('kusmi')
		local kusmi = kusmi_handler:get_npc()
		character_util.add_lua_listener(kusmi, self)

		self.ball_item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
			pos = kusmi.Position + vector(-0.3, 0, 0),
			item_id = 20782,
			loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
			skip_text = true,
			spr_scale = 0.7,
			show_on_character = true
		})

		self.ball_item:SetSortingLayer(true)
		self.ball_item.SpriteTransform.position = self.ball_item.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0)

		local paper_pos = vector(-2, 0, 15.5)
		self.paper_item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
			pos = vector(-2, 0, 15.5),
			item_id = 20022,
			loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
			skip_text = true,
		})

		local paper_fo = self.get_pooled_item()
		local narration_interactable = CS.Oak.NarrationInteractable()
		narration_interactable.InteractingSfx = '01_paper_01'
		narration_interactable.StringKeys = { 'mm_magical_girl_day_4_one_line_13_1' }
		paper_fo.Interactable = narration_interactable
		paper_fo.Position = paper_pos
		field_object_util.set_active_state(paper_fo, active_state_type.enabled)

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	end

	function event:on_event(e)
		local kusmi = self:get_handler('kusmi'):get_npc()

		if not self.is_interact and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, kusmi) then
			self.is_interact = true
			start_coroutine(self.interact_routine, self)
			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function event:interact_routine()
		local kusmi_handler = self:get_handler('kusmi')
		local kusmi = kusmi_handler:get_npc()
		character_util.remove_lua_listener(kusmi, self)

		local picther_handler = self:get_handler('picther')
		local picther = picther_handler:get_npc()

		local rie_handler = self:get_handler('rie')

		local ksumi_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('one_line_group_2_pos_1') + vector(11, 0, -7)

		-- 쿠스미(left, sleep_deep, idle)[thought]: 가볍게 던져야 된다… 무조건 가볍게… 
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', play_pos = ksumi_pos, loop = false })
		kusmi_handler:set_emotion(self, 'sleep_deep')
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(kusmi_handler, 'mm_magical_girl_day_4_one_line_14',
				{ bubble_type = 'thought' })

		-- 1초 대기
		wait_for_sec(1)
		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		-- 쿠스미(down, idle, attack) 아래쪽 10 타일까지 랜디 위치까지 0.4초에 걸쳐 princess_baseball 투척 (async 아님)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_aircraft_10', play_pos = ksumi_pos, loop = false })

		character_util.set_direction(kusmi, 'down')
		kusmi_handler:set_emotion(self, 'attack')

		local start_pos = kusmi.Position + vector(-0.3, 0, 0)
		local end_pos = picther.Position + vector(0, 0, 1)

		local time_passed = 0
		local duration = 0.4
		local height = 5

		local is_catch = false

		while self.activated and time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
			local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
			self.ball_item.Position = pos

			local h = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
			self.ball_item.SpriteTransform.position = pos + vector(0, h, 0)

			if not is_catch and progress > 0.25 then
				is_catch = true
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', play_pos = picther.Position, loop = false })
				character_util.set_direction(picther, 'up')
				character_util.set_direction(self:get_handler('rie'):get_npc(), 'up')
				character_util.normal_jump(picther)
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		local student_handler = self:get_handler('student')

		student_handler:remove_one_line()
		student_handler:set_emotion(self, 'surprise')
		character_util.normal_jump(student_handler:get_npc())

		-- 랜디 위치에 fx_get 이펙트 출력

				string_key = {},
				item = nil,
			},
		}

		for i = 1, #self.interact_item_data do
			local data = self.interact_item_data[i]

			local fo = get_field_object(data.fo_name)
			field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.enabled)
			fo.Position = data.pos

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
				pos = vector_util.get_x0z(data.pos, 0.65),
				item_id = 20022,
				loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
				skip_text = true,
			})

			quest_drop_item_util.set_shadow_active(item, false)
			self.interact_item_data[i].item = item

			if i < #self.interact_item_data - 1 then
				local narration_interactable = CS.Oak.NarrationInteractable()
				narration_interactable.InteractingSfx = '01_turn_page_01'
				narration_interactable.StringKeys = data.string_key
				fo.Interactable = narration_interactable
			else
				fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
			end
		end

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	end

	function event:exit()
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

		for i = 1, #self.interact_item_data do
			local fo = get_field_object(self.interact_item_data[i].fo_name)
			fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.disabled)

			if self.interact_item_data[i].item then
				quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.interact_item_data[i].item)
				self.interact_item_data[i].item = nil
			end
		end

		local moniko_handler = self:get_handler('moniko')
		local moniko = moniko_handler:get_npc()
		moniko.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

		character_util.remove_color(moniko, self.color_key, 0)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(moniko, 1, 0)
		field_ui_manager:SetUI(moniko, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		character_util.set_active_shadow(moniko, true)

		local yura_handler = self:get_handler('yura')
		local yura = yura_handler:get_npc()
		character_util.remove_lua_listener(yura, self)

		field_ui_manager:SetUI(yura, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		character_util.remove_color(yura, yura.Name, 0)

		if self.tea_item then
			quest_drop_item_util.rotate(self.tea_item, 0, 0)
			quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.tea_item)

			self.tea_item = nil
		end

		self.super:exit()
	end

	function event:on_event(e)
		local item = get_field_object('pooled_interact_item_4')
		local moniko_paper = get_field_object('pooled_interact_item_2')

		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, item) then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_paper, self, item)
			return true
		elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, moniko_paper) then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_moniko_paper, self, moniko_paper)
			return true
		end

		local yura_handler = self:get_handler('yura')

		if yura_handler ~= nil then
			local yura = yura_handler:get_npc()

			if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, yura) then
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_impact_02', play_pos = yura.Position, loop = false })
				character_util.remove_lua_listener(yura, self)
				character_util.add_color(yura, yura.Name, unity_class.color.black, 0.6, 3)
				return true
			end
		else
			logger_util.log('could not find yura handler')
		end

		return false
	end

		local grading_controller = get_or_create_global_table('utils/CameraColorGradingController')
		grading_controller:load_async('ondemand/memorial_magical_girl/effects', 'color_grading_image_effect_container', 'negative_effect')

do
	-- 마지막날 왼쪽
	local event = event_groups.post_daylight_1

	function event:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)
		self.super:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)

		self.zone_name = 'one_line_warehouse_zone'
		self.triggered = false

		self.spinner_items = nil

	end

	function event:enter()
		self.super:enter()

		self.spinner_items = {}

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	end

	function event:exit()
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

		for key, item in pairs(self.spinner_items) do
			if item ~= nil then
				quest_drop_item_util.cancel_shake(item, key)
				quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(item)
			end
		end

		self.super:exit()
	end

	function event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
		if not self.triggered and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name) then
			self.triggered = true

			start_coroutine(self.event_routine, self)

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function event:event_routine()
		local npc_2 = self:get_handler('npc_2')
		local npc_6 = self:get_handler('npc_6')
		local npc_2_pos = npc_2:get_npc().Position
		local npc_6_pos = npc_6:get_npc().Position

		-- 6번(right, attack, boong_attack_ready_loop): 간다, 무적참마회!
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', play_pos = npc_2_pos, loop = false })
		npc_2:set_anim(self, 'boong_attack_ready_loop')
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(npc_2, 'mm_magical_girl_day_5_one_line_7')

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		-- 6번(right, attack, boong_attack_ready_loop): 와라, 철권혈맹!
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', play_pos = npc_6_pos, loop = false })
		npc_6:set_emotion(self, 'attack')
		npc_6:set_anim(self, 'boong_attack_ready_loop')
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(npc_6, 'mm_magical_girl_day_5_one_line_8')

		-- 1초 대기 
		wait_for_sec(1)

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		-- 2번(right, attack, jingak 마지막 프레임 유지)[1.3배]: 하나…  
		npc_2:set_anim(self, { name = 'jingak', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_jingak_01' })
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(npc_2, 'mm_magical_girl_day_5_one_line_9', { scale = 1.3 })

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		-- 6번(left, attack, jingak 마지막 프레임 유지)[1.3배]: 둘…
		npc_6:set_anim(self, { name = 'jingak', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_jingak_01' })
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(npc_6, 'mm_magical_girl_day_5_one_line_10', { scale = 1.3 })

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		local speech_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('one_line_group_7_pos') + vector(-1.25, 0, 1)

		-- 2번(right, attack, jingak 마지막 프레임 유지)[shout 1.3배]: 고, 슛!!!!!!!
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_emphasize_01', play_pos = npc_2_pos, loop = false })
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(npc_2, 'mm_magical_girl_day_5_one_line_11', {
			scale = 1.3,
			bubble_type = 'shout',
			world_pos = speech_pos,
		})

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_throw_02', play_pos = npc_2_pos, loop = false })

		wait_all_lua(
				function()
					-- 2번 팽이 던지는 연출
					-- 2번 손에 mall_top_spiner 스프라이트 출력
					local key = 'post_npc_2_spinner'
					local npc = npc_2:get_npc()

					self.spinner_items[key] = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
						pos = npc_pos - vector(0, 0, 0.1),
						item_id = 21710,
						loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
						skip_text = true,
						spr_scale = 0.5,
					})
					quest_drop_item_util.rotate(self.spinner_items[key], -10, 0)

					-- 2번(right, attack, attack 1회 출력)
					npc_2:remove_anim()
					scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

					quest_drop_item_util.move_async(self.spinner_items[key], npc_pos + vector(1, 0, -0.1), {

					unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(npc_pos + vector(1, 0.1, 0))

					-- 2번 팽이 shake (0.03, 지속)
					quest_drop_item_util.shake(self.spinner_items[key], key, 0.03, 99999)

					-- 2번 팽이 0.3 타일 뒤로 이동
					quest_drop_item_util.move(self.spinner_items[key],
							self.spinner_items[key].Position - vector(0.2, 0, 0), { duration = 0.15 })
				end,
				function()
					-- 6번 팽이 던지는 연출 
					local key = 'post_npc_6_spinner'
					local npc = npc_6:get_npc()
					local npc_pos = npc.Position

					self.spinner_items[key] = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
						pos = npc_pos - vector(0, 0, 0.1),
						-- target = npc_pos - vector(0.9, 0, 0),
						item_id = 21710,
						loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
						skip_text = true,
						spr_scale = 0.5,
					})
					quest_drop_item_util.rotate(self.spinner_items[key], 60, 0)

					-- 6번(right, attack, attack 1회 출력)
					npc_6:remove_anim()
					scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

					quest_drop_item_util.move_async(self.spinner_items[key], npc_pos - vector(1, 0, 0.1), {

					quest_drop_item_util.shake(self.spinner_items[key], key, 0.03, 99999)

					-- 6번 팽이 0.3 타일 뒤로 이동
					quest_drop_item_util.move(self.spinner_items[key],
							self.spinner_items[key].Position + vector(0.2, 0, 0), { duration = 0.15 })

		npc_2:set_one_line('mm_magical_girl_day_5_one_line_12', '03_dialogue_ready_01')

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_jump_01', play_pos = teacher.Position, loop = false })
		cat_handler:set_emotion(self, 'smile')
		cat_handler:set_anim(self, 'get')

		local time_passed = 0
		local duration = 1
		local height = 1

		local start_pos = cat.Position
		local end_pos = teacher.Position + vector(0.75, 0, 0)

		while self.activated and time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
			local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
			local h = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
			character_util.set_position(cat, vector_util.get_x0z(pos, h), true)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		-- 이동 완료하면 다음 원라인 배치 
		character_util.set_position(cat, end_pos)

		-- 선생님(right, love, sing): 아이구. 우리 앙투아네트 드 포포~ 엄마 기다렸어?
		teacher_handler:set_emotion(self, 'love')
		teacher_handler:set_anim(self, 'sing')
		teacher_handler:set_one_line('mm_magical_girl_day_5_one_line_34', '03_dialogue_positive_01')

		-- 고양이(left, smile, happy)
		cat_handler:set_anim(self, 'happy')
	end
end

		end

	function event:talk_routine()
		local hiaki_handler = self:get_handler('hiaki')
		local hiaki = hiaki_handler:get_npc()
		character_util.remove_anim(hiaki)

		local mako_handler = self:get_handler('mako')
		local mako = mako_handler:get_npc()
		character_util.remove_anim(mako)

		local speed = 2

		local function move_routine(start_pos, end_pos)
			local time_passed = 0
			local duration = (end_pos - start_pos).magnitude / speed

			while self.activated and time_passed < duration do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
				hiaki.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end

		-- 마코(right, idle, idle): 히아키, 나 할 말이 있는데….
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', play_pos = mako.Position, loop = false })
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(mako_handler, 'mm_magical_girl_day_5_one_line_21')
		mako_handler:remove_emotion()

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		-- 히아키(left, idle, idle)[1.2]: 마코.
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(hiaki_handler, 'mm_magical_girl_day_5_one_line_23', { scale = 1.2 })

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		local start_pos = hiaki.Position
		local end_pos = hiaki.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.3)

		character_util.set_direction(hiaki, 'down')
		hiaki_handler:set_anim(self, 'walk')

		move_routine(start_pos, end_pos)

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		start_pos = hiaki.Position
		end_pos = hiaki.Position - vector(0.5, 0, 0)

		character_util.set_direction(hiaki, 'left')
		move_routine(start_pos, end_pos)

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		-- 마코 shake (0.03, 지속)
		-- 마코(right, tired, idle)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', play_pos = mako.Position, loop = false })
		character_util.shake(mako, 0.03, 9999)
		mako_handler:set_emotion(self, 'tired')

		hiaki_handler:add_dispose_action('speech', function(npc)
			local bubble = speech_bubble.instance:Get(npc)

			if bubble ~= nil then
				bubble:ResetBubble()
			end
		end)

		-- 히아키 : 미래에서 기다릴게.
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fade_out_02', play_pos = hiaki.Position, loop = false })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(hiaki, { key = 'mm_magical_girl_day_5_one_line_22' })

		start_pos = hiaki.Position
		end_pos = hiaki.Position - vector(16.5, 0, 0)
		move_routine(start_pos, end_pos)

		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		hiaki.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

		-- 마코(left, smile, idle): 금방 갈게. 뛰어갈게! 
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_positive_01', play_pos = mako.Position, loop = false })
		character_util.stop_shake(mako)
		character_util.set_direction(mako, 'left')
		mako_handler:set_emotion(self, 'smile')
		self:show_stoppable_speech_async(mako_handler, 'mm_magical_girl_day_5_one_line_24')
	end
end

function local_class:desk_align(npc, desk_pos)
	local npc_pos = npc.Position
	local dest_pos = desk_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0)

	local speed = 2

	local get_align_pos = function()
		local move_pos = nil

		if npc_pos.x < desk_pos.x then
			--x값이 작은 경우
			move_pos = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(npc, dest_pos, true)

		elseif npc_pos.z < desk_pos.z then
			--x값이 크고, z값이 작은 경우
			local first_move_pos = vector(
					npc.Position.x, 0, desk_pos.z + 1)

			wp_util.move_async(npc, first_move_pos, speed)

			move_pos = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(npc, dest_pos, true)
		elseif npc_pos.z > desk_pos.z then
			--x값이 크고, z값이 클 경우
			local first_move_pos = vector(
					npc.Position.x, 0, desk_pos.z + 1)

			wp_util.move_async(npc, first_move_pos, speed)

			move_pos = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(npc, dest_pos, true)
		end

		wp_util.move_async(npc, move_pos, speed, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })
	end

	get_align_pos()
end

	local rooftop_door_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('rooftop_exit_pos') + vector(0.5, 0, 0)

		Type = progress @
		QuestName = MemorialMagicalGirlMain @
		Comment = 섹션 10 마법 소녀 활동 @
		Index = 9 @
		NextSections = 10 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type MemorialMagicalGirlMainController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'memorial_magical_girl'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		first_scene = 2,
		second_scene = 3,
		third_scene = 4,
		done = 999,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	--region Character

	self.get_character = {
		--하루카(여)
		magical_girl_student = function()
			return get_character('magical_girl_student')
		end,
		--미스틱 바이올렛 (여) (하루카 변신)
		magical_girl = function()
			return get_character('magical_girl')
		end,
		--세리나(여)
		black_girl_student = function()
			return get_character('black_girl_student')
		end,
		--니어 블랙 (여) (세리나 변신)
		black_girl = function()
			return get_character('black_girl')
		end,
		--시바링
		dog = function()
			return get_character('mg_dog')
		end,
		--부타미
		pig = function()
			return get_character('mg_pig')
		end,
		--아야네 (여)
		mom = function()
			return get_character('mg_mom')
		end,
		--몬스터
		battle_monster = function(battle_number, monster_number)
			return get_character('s10_battle' .. battle_number .. '_' .. monster_number)
		end,
	}

	--endregion Character

	--region FieldObject
	self.get_fo = {
		car = function()
			return get_field_object('car')
		end,
	}
	--endregion FieldObject

	--region Marker

	self.get_marker_pos = {
		center = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_center_pos_' .. number)
		end
	}

	--endregion Marker

	--region Dynamic_npc
	--동적 할당 정보
	self.dynamic_npcs = {
		first_dynamic_npc = {
			npc_list = {},
			dynamic_npc_name = 'first_dynamic_npc_',
			dynamic_npc_data = nil
		},
		third_dynamic_npc = {
			npc_list = {},
			dynamic_npc_name = 'third_dynamic_npc_',
			dynamic_npc_data = nil
		},
		fifth_dynamic_npc = {
			npc_list = {},
			dynamic_npc_name = 'fifth_dynamic_npc_',
			dynamic_npc_data = nil
		},
		create_npcs = function(this)
			for name, npc_data in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'create_npcs' and name ~= 'dispose_all' and name ~= 'dispose_target' then
					-- 적 동적 생성
					local dynamic_npc_spec = {}

					for i = 1, #npc_data.dynamic_npc_data do
						dynamic_npc_spec[npc_data.dynamic_npc_name .. i] = npc_data.dynamic_npc_data[i]
					end

					npc_data.npc_list = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(dynamic_npc_spec)

					for i = 1, #npc_data.dynamic_npc_data do
						npc_data.npc_list[npc_data.dynamic_npc_name .. i].Position = self.wait_pos
					end
				end
			end
		end,
		dispose_target = function(target_list)
			load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(target_list)
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			for name, npc_data in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'create_npcs' and name ~= 'dispose_all' and name ~= 'dispose_target' then
					if npc_data.npc_list then
						load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(npc_data.npc_list)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	}

		sprite_info = {
			basket = 21698,
		},
		sprite_table = {},
		sprite_table_origin_parent = {},
		create = function(this, name, pos, item_id, scale, showoncharacter, target, drop_type, skip_text)
			scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
			showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, false)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = pos, item_id = item_id, show_on_character = showoncharacter,
					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = item.SpriteTransform.parent

			return item
		end,
		fly = function(this, name, target)
			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end
	}

	--endregion Sprite

	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self.controller:set_time_of_day()

	start_coroutine(function()
		music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async(
				{ name = 'ondemand/memorial_magical_girl/audio:bgm_magicalgirl_theme', state = 'field' })

		music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'combat' })
	end)

	self.controller:remove_equipment()
end

function local_class:start()
	--퀘스트 마커 출력
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'classroom_area_2', target = vector(2.5, 0, -101) },
		{ zone = 'classroom_area_1', target = get_field_object('1floor_exit_2') },
		{ zone = 'rooftop', target = get_field_object('rooftop_exit') },
	}, nil, nil, true)

	self.current_state = self.states.first_scene

	do
		start_coroutine(function()
			self.fx:create_all()
			self:create_npcs()

			local set_monster = function(battle_number, monster_count, battlegate_count)
				for idx = 1, monster_count do
					local battle_name = 's10_battle_' .. battle_number
					local monster = get_character(battle_name .. '_' .. idx)

					field_object_util.set_active_state(monster, active_state_type.enabled)
				end

				for idx = 1, battlegate_count do
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name .. battle_number .. '_' .. idx))
				end

				--start_coroutine(self.end_battle_scene, self)
			end

			--1번째 전투
			local battle_number = 1
			local battle_monster_number = 3
			local battlegate_count = 8

			set_monster(battle_number, battle_monster_number, battlegate_count)

			--2번째 전투
			battle_number = 2
			battle_monster_number = 5
			battlegate_count = 6

			set_monster(battle_number, battle_monster_number, battlegate_count)

			--3번째 전투
			battle_number = 3
			battle_monster_number = 12
			battlegate_count = 4

			set_monster(battle_number, battle_monster_number, battlegate_count)
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.is_not_battle_list.first and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.battle_zone_name .. 1) then
		self.is_not_battle_list.first = false

		local battle_number = 1
		local battle_monster_number = 3
		local battlegate_count = 8

		start_coroutine(self.battle_start, self, battle_number, battle_monster_number, battlegate_count)
	elseif self.is_not_battle_list.second and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.battle_zone_name .. 2) then
		self.is_not_battle_list.second = false

		local battle_number = 2
		local battle_monster_number = 5
		local battlegate_count = 6

		start_coroutine(self.battle_start, self, battle_number, battle_monster_number, battlegate_count)
	elseif self.is_not_battle_list.third and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.battle_zone_name .. 3) then
		self.is_not_battle_list.third = false

		local battle_number = 3
		local battle_monster_number = 12
		local battlegate_count = 4

		start_coroutine(self.battle_start, self, battle_number, battle_monster_number, battlegate_count)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:battle_start(battle_number, monster_count, battlegate_count)
	local dog = self.get_character.dog()

	self.controller:set_equipment()

	--배틀 시작시
	--배틀 구역에 들어가 배틀 게이트 올라올 시 시바링 스파인 위로 Fx_blink 출력되며 즉시 사라짐
	self.fx.blink():Instantiate(dog.Position)

	character_util.convert_to_npc(dog)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(dog, active_state_type.disabled)

	--몬스터 변경
	for idx = 1, monster_count do
		local battle_name = 's10_battle_' .. battle_number

		local monster = get_character(battle_name .. '_' .. idx)

		character_util.convert_to_monster(monster, battle_name, battle_name)

		command_util.publish_monster_notice(monster, get_party_leader(), 'battle')
	end

	--도어 닫기
	for idx = 1, battlegate_count do
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name .. battle_number .. '_' .. idx, false))
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	local magical_girl = get_character('magical_girl')

	-- 배틀액션 캔슬
	magical_girl.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)

	-- 무기 제거 후
	self.controller:remove_equipment()

	-- 하루카 state 리셋
	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(magical_girl, false)
	message_system:SendSync(magical_girl, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state))

	--전투가 끝났을 때
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name .. 1 then
		local battle_number = 1
		local battlegate_count = 8

		self:battle_end_check(battle_number, battlegate_count)
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name .. 2 then
		local battle_number = 2
		local battlegate_count = 6

		self:battle_end_check(battle_number, battlegate_count)
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name .. 3 then
		local battle_number = 3
		local battlegate_count = 4

		self:battle_end_check(battle_number, battlegate_count)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:battle_end_check(battle_number, battlegate_count)
	local dog = self.get_character.dog()

	field_object_util.set_active_state(dog, active_state_type.enabled)

	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(dog, user_party)

	self.fx.blink():Instantiate(dog.Position)

	self.battle_count = self.battle_count + 1

	for idx = 1, battlegate_count do
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name .. battle_number .. '_' .. idx, false))
	end

	if self.battle_count == 3 then
		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

		sp_util.start_scene(self.end_battle_scene, self)
	end
end

				move_duration, self, wp_key, { locked_dir = 'left', last_direction = 'left' })

				move_duration, self, wp_key)

function local_class:npc_setting(npc_data)
	for _, target_data in pairs(npc_data) do
		local target = target_data.target
		local target_pos = target_data.pos
		local target_dir = target_data.dir
		local target_emo = target_data.emo
		local target_anim = target_data.anim
		local target_tint = target_data.tint
		local target_shake = target_data.shake
		local target_is_anim_loop = target_data.is_anim_loop
		local target_effect = target_data.effect
		local target_alpha = target_data.alpha
		local target_function = target_data.coroutine_function
		local target_listener = target_data.listener
		local target_is_not_active = target_data.is_not_active
		local target_oneline_key = target_data.oneline_key
		local target_crash_behaviour = target_data.crash_behaviour
		local target_is_leader = target_data.is_leader
		local target_anim_scale = target_data.anim_scale

		character_util.spine_rotate(target, 0, 0)

		if target_is_not_active then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.disabled)
		else
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.enabled)
		end

		if target_crash_behaviour then
			target.CrashBehaviour = target_crash_behaviour
		end

		if not target_is_leader then
			target.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()
		end

		character_util.set_position(target, target_pos)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)

		scene_util.set_direction(target, target_dir, false)

		if target_emo then
			scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, target_emo)
		end

		if target_oneline_key then
			target.Interactable.Talk = target_oneline_key
		end

		if target_listener then
			character_util.add_listener(target, self.controller)
		end

		if target_anim then
			scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = target_anim, scale = target_anim_scale, loop = target_is_anim_loop, one_shot_sfx = false })
		end

		if target_shake then
			scene_util.shake(target, target_shake, 9999, false)
		end

		if target_tint then
			character_util.add_color(target, 'dark_tint', target_tint.color, target_tint.magnitude, 0)
		end

		if target_alpha then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(target, target_alpha, 0)
		end

		if target_effect then
			local fx = target_effect():Instantiate(target.Position)
			self.fx_list[target.Name] = fx
		end

		if target_function then
			start_coroutine(function()
				target_function(target)
			end)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:fx_dispose_all()
	if self.fx_list then
		for _, target in pairs(self.fx_list) do
			if target then
				target:Dispose()
				target = nil
			end
		end

		self.fx_list = nil
	end
end

--endregion Setting

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	self.fx:create_all()

	self.controller:set_time_of_day()

	self.stage_controller = get_stage_event_controller('MemorialMagicalGirlController')
	self.stage_controller.stage_amb_sfx.use_sfx = true
	self.stage_controller.stage_amb_sfx:play_sfx('01_amb_highschool_01')
end

function local_class:start()
	start_coroutine(function()
		self.dynamic_npcs:load_async(self.states.to_the_classroom)

		self:set_pre_npc()

		self:set_current_scene_npc(self.states.to_the_classroom)
	end)

	self.quest_marker:add({
		{ zone = 'campus_square', target = get_field_object('ouside_exit_2') },
		{ zone = 'classroom_area_1', target = self.marker.quest_marker(1) },
		{ zone = 'classroom_area_2', target = get_field_object('down_stair') },
		{ zone = 'rooftop', target = get_field_object('rooftop_exit') },
	})
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	self.dynamic_npcs:dispose()

	self.stage_controller.stage_amb_sfx.use_sfx = false
	self.stage_controller = nil

	if self.ambi_sfx ~= nil then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.ambi_sfx)
		self.ambi_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return self:on_interact_event(e)
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.character.black_girl_student()) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.to_black_girl then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.talk_with_black_girl_event, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_info.free_control_event_1.name) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.to_the_classroom then
			if not self.zone_info.free_control_event_1.check_play_event_once then
				self.zone_info.free_control_event_1.check_play_event_once = true

				start_coroutine(self.free_control_event, self, 1)

				return true
			end
		end
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_info.free_control_event_2.name) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.to_the_classroom then
			if not self.zone_info.free_control_event_2.check_play_event_once then
				self.zone_info.free_control_event_2.check_play_event_once = true

				start_coroutine(self.free_control_event, self, 2)

				return true
			end
		end
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_info.free_control_event_3.name) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.to_the_classroom then
			if not self.zone_info.free_control_event_3.check_play_event_once then
				self.zone_info.free_control_event_3.check_play_event_once = true

				start_coroutine(self.free_control_event, self, 3)

				return true
			end
		end
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_info.classroom_event_1.name) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.to_the_classroom then
			if not self.zone_info.classroom_event_1.check_play_event_once then
				self.zone_info.classroom_event_1.check_play_event_once = true

				sp_util.start_scene(self.classroom_event, self)

				return true
			end
		end
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_info.classroom_event_2.name) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.last_event_1 then
			if not self.zone_info.classroom_event_2.check_play_event_once then
				self.zone_info.classroom_event_2.check_play_event_once = true

				sp_util.start_scene(self.last_event, self)

				return true
			end
		end
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'rooftop') then
		if self.current_state == self.states.to_black_girl then
			start_coroutine(function()
				self.stage_controller.stage_amb_sfx:fade_out_sfx(2)

				self.ambi_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_highschool_01', loop = true, volume = 0.2, fade_in_time = 1, type_priority = 'event' })
			end)

			return true
		end
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_info.restart_bgm_classroom_area_2.name) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.last_event_1 then
			if not self.zone_info.restart_bgm_classroom_area_2.check_play_event_once then
				self.zone_info.restart_bgm_classroom_area_2.check_play_event_once = true

				start_coroutine(function()
					music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async(
							{ name = 'ondemand/memorial_magical_girl/audio:bgm_magicalgirl_day', state = 'field' })

					music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
					music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
				end)

				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), 'rooftop') then
		if self.current_state == self.states.to_black_girl or self.current_state == self.states.last_event_1 then
			start_coroutine(function()
				if self.ambi_sfx ~= nil then
					music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(self.ambi_sfx, 2)

					self.ambi_sfx = nil
				end
			end)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_current_scene_npc(section_state)
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[section_state]

	if pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	linq(pre_npc_data):foreach(function(_, npc_data)
		local npc = get_character(npc_data.name)

		if npc == nil then
			if npc_data.name == 'leader' then
				npc = user_party.Leader
			else
				return
			end
		end

		if npc_data.remove_lv_ui ~= nil and npc_data.remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		npc_data.active_state = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.active_state, active_state_type.enabled)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, npc_data.active_state)


		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if npc_data.pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if npc_data.fly ~= nil and npc_data.fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, npc_data.pos, isFlying)
		end

		if npc_data.dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, npc_data.dir, false)
		end

		if npc_data.emo ~= nil then
			if npc_data.emo == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, npc_data.emo)
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_info ~= nil then
			if npc_data.anim_info == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			elseif type_util.is_table(npc_data.anim_info) then
				npc_data.anim_info.one_shot_sfx = false

				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, npc_data.anim_info)
			elseif type_util.is_string(npc_data.anim_info) then
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = npc_data.anim_info, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_time_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, npc_data.anim_time_scale)
		end

		if npc_data.alpha_value ~= nil then
			local alpha_duration = 0

			if npc_data.alpha_duration ~= nil then
				alpha_duration = npc_data.alpha_duration
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, npc_data.alpha_value, alpha_duration)
		end

		if npc_data.keep_shake ~= nil and npc_data.keep_shake == true then
			character_util.shake(npc, npc_data.shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if npc_data.sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', npc_data.sorting_layer)
		end

		if npc_data.start_deactive_shadow then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, false)
		end

		if npc_data.scale_factor ~= nil then
			character_util.set_scale_factor(npc, npc.Name, npc_data.scale_factor)
		end

		if npc_data.tint_color then
			local tint_color_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.tint_color_magnitude, 1)

			character_util.add_color(npc, npc_data.tint_color_key, npc_data.tint_color, tint_color_magnitude, 0.1)
		end

		if npc_data.talk ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk) then
			if not lua_helper.type_compare(npc.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
				npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			end

			npc.Interactable.Talk = npc_data.talk
		end

		if npc_data.talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk_sfx) then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = npc_data.talk_sfx
		end

		if npc_data.hitbox ~= nil then
			npc.Hitbox = npc_data.hitbox
		end
	end)
end

function local_class:free_control_event(event_idx)
	if event_idx == 1 then
		local npc_1 = self.dynamic_npcs:get('s11_1_student_1')
		local npc_2 = self.dynamic_npcs:get('s11_1_student_2')

		--1번 NPC(right, smile, release 2회): 너 어제 봤어?! 미스틱 바이올렛!

function local_class:classroom_event()
	local magical_girl_student = self.character.magical_girl_student()
	local black_girl_student = self.character.black_girl_student()
	local bullying_girl_1 = self.character.bullying_girl(1)
	local bullying_girl_2 = self.character.bullying_girl(2)
	local npc_7 = self.dynamic_npcs:get('s11_1_student_7')
	local npc_8 = self.dynamic_npcs:get('s11_1_student_8')
	local npc_9 = self.dynamic_npcs:get('s11_1_student_9')

	self.quest_marker:remove()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--하루카 지정 위치로 2의 속도로 정렬
	--정렬 후 left, idle, idle 상태
	local end_pos = self.marker.magical_girl(1, 1)
	wp_util.move_async(magical_girl_student, end_pos, 2, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

	--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 9번에게 포커스 이동
	camera_util.move_async(npc_9.Position, 1)

	--0.7초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--9번(right, smile, eat)
	--모션 유지
	--1초 대기
	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' })

	scene_util.play_wait_action(npc_9, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'eat' }, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 1)

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(equipping_sfx)
	equipping_sfx = nil

	--이동 완료되면 다음 연출 진행
	--9번(down, smile, hold_loop)[1.2배]: 짜잔!! 미스틱 바이올렛 굿즈다!!!
	--손에 (임시)cwp_flowergirl 든 상태
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	self.sprite:create('magical_girl_weapon', npc_9.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.8),
			self.sprite.sprite_info.goods, 0.5, true, nil, nil, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_9, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'hold_loop', keep = true }, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, { key = 'mm_magical_girl_s11_1_1', skip = true, scale = 1.2 })

	--8번(up, idle, idle): 헉, 어떻게 구했어?! 요즘 가격 장난 아닌데!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_8, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'mm_magical_girl_s11_1_2')

	--7번(up, idle, idle): 으아, 내가 가지고 있던 니어 블랙 굿즈는 시세 떨어졌는데!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_7, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'mm_magical_girl_s11_1_3')

	--동시 연출
	--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 하루카에게 포커스 이동
	--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 3 크기로 줌인
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 1)
	camera_util.move_async(magical_girl_student.Position, 1)

	start_coroutine(function()
		while true do
			if (magical_girl_student.Position.x + 0.5) > bullying_girl_1.Position.x then
				break
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		--동시 연출
		--하루카 fx_hit 이펙트 출력
		self.fx.hit():Instantiate(magical_girl_student.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')

		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(magical_girl_student)

		--하루카 빨간색 위치로 (left, damaged, damaged) 상태로 직선 이동
		scene_util.set_direction(magical_girl_student, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(magical_girl_student, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(magical_girl_student, self, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.move_to_async(magical_girl_student,
				magical_girl_student.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0.5),
				0.3,
				nil,
				false,
				false)

		--도착하면 (right left, damaged, prostrate) 출력
		scene_util.set_direction(magical_girl_student, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(magical_girl_student, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(magical_girl_student, self, { name = 'prostrate' })

		self.fx.hit():Instantiate(magical_girl_student.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')
	end)

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--하루카(left, smile, idle): 다들… 내 얘기를 하고 있어… 헤헤…. (async 아님)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(magical_girl_student, self, 'left',
						nil, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, { key = 'mm_magical_girl_s11_1_4', skip = false })
			end,
			function()
				--카에데, 마이 walk 애니메이션으로 2의 속도로 이동
				--카에데 하루카 위치 도달하면 다음 연출 진행
				local wp_1 = {
					vector(bullying_girl_1.Position.x, 0, magical_girl_student.Position.z),
					magical_girl_student.Position,
				}
				local wp_2 = {
					vector(bullying_girl_2.Position.x, 0, magical_girl_student.Position.z),
					magical_girl_student.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
				}
				wp_util.move(bullying_girl_1, wp_1, 2)
				wp_util.move_async(bullying_girl_2, wp_2, 2)
			end
	)

	--위 연출 모두 완료되면 다음 진행
	--카에데(left, tired, idle): 비켜, 왜 교실 문을 막고 서 있어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bullying_girl_1, self, 'left',
			nil, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'mm_magical_girl_s11_1_5')

	--마이(left, tired, idle): 왜 실실 웃고 난리야? 짜증나.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bullying_girl_2, self, 'left',
			nil, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'mm_magical_girl_s11_1_6')

	--카에데, 마이 위 위치로 최단 거리로 3의 속도로 이동
	--이동 완료하면 카에데(right, idle, idle), 마이(left, idle, idle) 출력
	local end_pos_1 = self.marker.bullying_girl(1, 1, 2)
	local end_pos_2 = self.marker.bullying_girl(1, 2, 2)
	local wp_1 = {
		end_pos_1 + vector(2, 0, 1.5),
		end_pos_1 + vector(2, 0, 0),
		end_pos_1 + vector(1, 0, 0),
	}
	local wp_2 = {
		end_pos_2 + vector(2, 0, 1.5),
		end_pos_2 + vector(2, 0, 0),
		end_pos_2 + vector(1, 0, 0),
	}
	wp_util.move(bullying_girl_1, wp_1, 3, nil, { last_direction = 'right', end_callback = function()
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bullying_girl_1)
	end })
	wp_util.move(bullying_girl_2, wp_2, 3, nil, { last_direction = 'left', end_callback = function()
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bullying_girl_2)
	end })

	--위 연출 시작하고 2초 후 다음 연출 진행
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--동시 연출
	--하루카 shake (0.03, 1)
	character_util.shake(magical_girl_student, 0.03, 1)

	--mix duration 1초에 걸쳐 right, tired, idle 전환
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_wait_action(magical_girl_student, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'idle', mix_duration = 1 }, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 1)

	--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 2.5 크기로 줌인
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(2.5, 1)

	--하루카(right, tired, idle): 미스틱 바이올렛이… 내 진짜 모습이면 좋을텐데…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(magical_girl_student, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'mm_magical_girl_s11_1_7')

	--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 2 크기로 줌인
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(2, 1)

	start_coroutine(function()
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0, 0.5)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	end)

	if self.stage_controller == nil then
		self.stage_controller = get_stage_event_controller('MemorialMagicalGirlController')
	end
	self.stage_controller.stage_amb_sfx:change_sfx_volume(0.6, 1)

	--동시 연출
	--하루카 shake (0.05, 1)
	character_util.shake(magical_girl_student, 0.03, 1)
	--하루카(right, tired, idle): 내 정체를 알면… 쟤네도 나를 안 싫어할까…?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(magical_girl_student, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, { key = 'mm_magical_girl_s11_1_8', skip = true, scale = 0.8 })

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--동시 연출
	--카메라 shake (0.03, 0.7)
	camera_util.shake(0.03, 0.7)

	--하루카(right, surprise, idle) jump 1회
	scene_util.set_direction(magical_girl_student, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(magical_girl_student, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.remove_anim(magical_girl_student)
	character_util.normal_jump(magical_girl_student, true)

	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({
		name = 'bgm_novel_01', state = 'field'
	})
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	--세리나[shout](x: 0.5, y: 0.8): 하루카!
	--대사 한 번에 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(black_girl_student, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'mm_magical_girl_s11_1_9', type_speed = 0, viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.8), skip = true })

	--동시 연출
	--카메라 2초에 걸쳐 4.5 크기로 포커스 아웃
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(4.5, 2)

	--세리나 4의 속도로 이동하여 정렬
	--정렬하면 left, idle, idle 상태
	--세리나  a 지점 도달하면 10, 11, 12번 (down, surprise, idle) 마이(right, idle, idle) 출력
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(black_girl_student)
	wp_util.move_async(black_girl_student, self.marker.black_girl(1, 1), 4)

	local npc_10 = self.dynamic_npcs:get('s11_1_student_10')
	local npc_11 = self.dynamic_npcs:get('s11_1_student_11')
	local npc_12 = self.dynamic_npcs:get('s11_1_student_12')

	scene_util.set_direction(npc_10, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(npc_10, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_direction(npc_11, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(npc_11, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_direction(npc_12, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(npc_12, self, 'surprise')

	scene_util.set_direction(bullying_girl_2, 'right', false)

	wp_util.move_async(black_girl_student, self.marker.black_girl(1, 2), 4)

	--카에데(right, tired, cross_arm) : 세리나 선배?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bullying_girl_1, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'cross_arm', keep = true }, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'mm_magical_girl_s11_1_10')

	--마이(right, attack, release 2회): 지금 저 음침 하루카를 부른거야…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bullying_girl_2, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'mm_magical_girl_s11_1_11')

	--9번(down, tired, hold_loop): 응? 세리나 선배가 우리 반에 왔다고…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_9, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'hold_loop', keep = true }, 'tired', 'mm_magical_girl_s11_1_12')

	--9번(up, idle, idle) 상태로 0.5초 간 대기
	scene_util.set_direction(npc_9, 'up', false)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--9번(up, idle, embarrassed): 우왓!! 진짜잖아!!!
	--손에 든 (임시)cwp_flowergirl 제거
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	self.sprite:dispose('magical_girl_weapon')
	character_util.spine_remove_attachment(npc_9, '[base]weapon1')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_9, self, 'up',
			'embarrassed', 'idle', 'mm_magical_girl_s11_1_13')

	--하루카 2의 속도로 오른쪽 2 타일 이동해 right, idle, idle 정렬
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(magical_girl_student)
	wp_util.move_async(magical_girl_student, magical_girl_student.Position + vector(2, 0, 0), 2)

	--하루카(right, idle, cast): …세리나 선배? 무슨 일로….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(magical_girl_student, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'cast', keep = true }, nil, 'mm_magical_girl_s11_1_13_1')

	--세리나(left, smile, idle): 시간 괜찮으면 2층으로 와 볼래? 보여줄 게 있어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(black_girl_student, self, 'left',
			nil, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'mm_magical_girl_s11_1_14')

	--동시 연출
	--하루카 shake (0,03, 1)
	character_util.shake(magical_girl_student, 0.03, 1)

	--하루카(right, idle, idle): 엇, 아, 그게……
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(magical_girl_student)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(magical_girl_student, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'mm_magical_girl_s11_1_15')

	--하루카(right, question 마지막 프레임 유지)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(magical_girl_student, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(magical_girl_student, self, 'question')

	--0.7초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--세리나(left, idle, idle): 기다리고 있을게.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(black_girl_student, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'mm_magical_girl_s11_1_15_1')

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	start_coroutine(function()
		--위 연출 시작하고 0.5초 뒤
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--11번 노란색 위치로 right, surprise, idle 상태로 정렬
		--12번 노란색 위치로 right, surprise, idle 상태로 정렬
		--10번 right, idle, idle 전환

		scene_util.set_emotion(npc_11, self, 'surprise')
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc_12, self, 'surprise')

		local wp = {
			npc_12.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),

			npc_12.Position + vector(-2, 0, -0.5),

		wp_util.move(npc_12, wp, 4, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

		wp = {
			npc_11.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
			npc_11.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0.5),
		}
		wp_util.move(npc_11, wp, 4, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

		--12번(down, surprise, idle): 세리나 선배랑 말한 애 누구야?
		--대사 한 번에 출력하고 라이프 타임 1초
		scene_util.set_direction(npc_12, 'down', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc_12, self, 'surprise')
		character_util.remove_anim(npc_12)

function local_class:start_rift_night_event()

	local magical_girl_student = self.character.magical_girl_student()
	local black_girl = self.character.black_girl()
	local dog = self.character.dog()
	local pig = self.character.pig()

	self.controller:remove_equipment()

	self.controller:set_night(true)

	-- 11섹션 복도 npc 그룹 비활성화
	local stage_event_controller = get_stage_event_controller('MemorialMagicalGirlController')
	local one_line_controller = stage_event_controller.group_controller
	one_line_controller:deactivate_group('always_active_group_name_1', 'day_4_corridor')

	self:set_current_scene_npc(self.states.last_event_3)

	--1.5초간 아래 세팅으로 페이드 인 (바이올렛 포커스, 카메라값 4)

	camera_util.resize_to_default_async(0)

	self.stage_controller.stage_amb_sfx:play_sfx('01_amb_cave_01', 0.4, 1)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--시바링 (right, frown, idle) : 으으… 확실히 오늘따라 더욱 불길한 기운이 여기 감돌고 있다뭉.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_pet_grr_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dog, self, 'right',
			nil, 'burning', 'mm_magical_girl_s11_5_1')

	--바이올렛 (right, tired, idle) : 선배, 그런데 오늘은 다른 요괴들은 퇴치하지 않아도 될까요….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(magical_girl, self, 'right',
			nil, 'tired', 'mm_magical_girl_s11_5_2')

	--블랙 (left, idle, idle) : 잔챙이들 신경 쓸 때가 아니야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(black_girl, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'mm_magical_girl_s11_5_3')

	--동시 시작
	--화면 shake (0.1, 0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	--01_creature_15 + 03_mech_stomp_01
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_15')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')

	--부타미, 시바루, 블랙 (up, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(black_girl, 'up', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(magical_girl, 'up', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(pig, 'up', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(dog, 'up', false)

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(magical_girl, nil, 'notice')

	--바이올렛 (up,idle, idle) : 이건….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(magical_girl, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'mm_magical_girl_s11_5_4')

	--블랙 (up, idle, idle) : 왔다…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(black_girl, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'mm_magical_girl_s11_5_5')

	local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })

	--블랙, 부타미 5의 속도, run 자세로 3타일 위쪽 이동

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(black_girl,

			{ last_direction = 'up', run = true })

			pig.Position + vector(0, 0, 3), 5, nil, self, wp_key,
			{ last_direction = 'up', run = true })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(dash_sfx)

	--동시 시작 / 블랙, 부타미 이동 후 바로

	--바이올렛 (up, idle, idle) : 저…아직 준비가….

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(magical_girl, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'mm_magical_girl_s11_5_7')

	--블랙 (down, idle, idle) : [말풍선 1.25배] 바이올렛.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_08')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(black_girl, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, { key = 'mm_magical_girl_s11_5_8', skip = true, scale = 1.25 })

	--블랙 (down, idle, idle) : [말풍선 1.25배] 넌 마법소녀가 되어 언제가 가장 즐거웠어?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(black_girl, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, { key = 'mm_magical_girl_s11_5_9', skip = true, scale = 1.25 })

	--바이올렛 (up, idle, idle) : 네…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(magical_girl, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'mm_magical_girl_s11_5_10')

	--블랙 (down, smile, idle) : [말풍선 1.25배] 난 지금이야.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(black_girl, self, 'down',
			nil, 'smile', { key = 'mm_magical_girl_s11_5_11', skip = true, scale = 1.25 })

	--블랙 (down, idle, idle) : 그러니까 네 망설임으로 내 발목을 잡지 마.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(black_girl, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'mm_magical_girl_s11_5_12')

	--바이올렛 (up, idle, idle) : ….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(magical_girl, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'mm_magical_girl_s11_5_13')

	--시바루 (right, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(dog, 'right', false)

	dog.Interactable.Talk = nil

	--블랙, 부타미 7의 속도로 위쪽 이동하다 프레임 밖으로 나가면 제거.
	wp_key = 'wp_key'

	local outside_pos = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('up', black_girl.Position)

	dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })

	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(dash_sfx, 1)
		dash_sfx = nil
	end)

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(black_girl,
			outside_pos, 7, nil, self, wp_key,
			{ last_direction = 'up' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(pig,
			outside_pos + vector(1, 0, 0), 7, nil, self, wp_key,
			{ last_direction = 'up' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	character_util.set_position(black_girl, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_position(pig, vector(999, 0, 999))

	--하루카 스파인 정리
	character_util.set_position(magical_girl_student, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.convert_to_npc(magical_girl_student)

	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character_v2(magical_girl, param, true)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(magical_girl)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dog)

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(dog, user_party, false)

	self.dynamic_npcs:dispose()

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()

	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	self.controller:remove_equipment()

	self.controller:set_time_of_day()
end

function local_class:start()
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'classroom_area_2', target = self.get_marker_pos.rooftop_exit() + vector(0.5, 0, 0) },
		{ zone = 'classroom_area_1', target = vector(2.5, 0, -120) },
	}, nil, nil, true)

	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		local stage_controller = get_stage_event_controller('MemorialMagicalGirlController')
		stage_controller.stage_amb_sfx:play_sfx('01_amb_cave_01')
	end

	self.current_state = self.states.first_scene

	do
		--도어 교체 작업
		self.controller:active_rooftop_door_event_gimmick(true)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self:fx_dispose_all()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

--region Event

function local_class:on_event(e)
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local zone_name_1 = 's12_block_zone_1'

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), zone_name_1) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.block_zone_scene, self, vector_util.get_x0z(e.Zone.Bounds.center))
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local interact_door = self.get_fo.interact_door()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, interact_door) then
		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

		interact_door.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		sp_util.start_scene(self.door_interact_scene, self)
	end
end
--endregion Event

function local_class:block_zone_scene(pos)
	local npc_data = {
		--바이올렛(여)
		magical_girl = {
			target = self.get_character.magical_girl(),
		},
		--니어 블랙(여)
		dog = {
			target = self.get_character.dog(),
		},
	}

	--존에 도달하면 플레이어 컨트롤.
	--바이올렛 (down, attack, idle) : 빨리 선배부터 쫓아가자!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_data.magical_girl.target, self, 'down',
			nil, 'attack', 'mm_magical_girl_s12_1')

	--시바링 (하루카 방향, idle, idle) : 뭉!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_pet_bark_01')
	character_util.look_at(npc_data.dog.target, npc_data.magical_girl.target)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_data.dog.target, self, nil,
			nil, nil, 'mm_magical_girl_s12_2')

	--하루카 시바링 위 이미지 위치로 1초간 정렬 후 플레이어 컨트롤 해제.
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc_data.dog.target,
			pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 1.5), nil,
			1, self, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc_data.magical_girl.target,
			pos + vector(0.5, 0, 1.5), nil,
			1, self, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
	--재진입시 위 이벤트 반복
end
