function local_class:npc_setting(npc_data)
	for _, target_data in pairs(npc_data) do
		local target = target_data.target
		local target_pos = target_data.pos
		local target_dir = target_data.dir
		local target_emo = target_data.emo
		local target_anim = target_data.anim
		local target_tint = target_data.tint
		local target_shake = target_data.shake
		local target_is_anim_loop = target_data.is_anim_loop
		local target_effect = target_data.effect
		local target_alpha = target_data.alpha
		local target_function = target_data.coroutine_function
		local target_listener = target_data.listener
		local target_is_not_active = target_data.is_not_active
		local target_oneline_key = target_data.oneline_key
		local target_crash_behaviour = target_data.crash_behaviour
		local target_is_leader = target_data.is_leader

		character_util.spine_rotate(target, 0, 0)

		if target_is_not_active then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.disabled)
		else
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.enabled)
		end

		if target_crash_behaviour then
			target.CrashBehaviour = target_crash_behaviour
		end

		if not target_is_leader then
			target.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()
		end

		character_util.set_position(target, target_pos)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)

		scene_util.set_direction(target, target_dir, false)

		if target_emo then
			scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, target_emo)
		end

		if target_oneline_key then
			target.Interactable.Talk = target_oneline_key
		end

		if target_listener then
			character_util.add_listener(target, self.controller)
		end

		if target_anim then
			scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = target_anim, loop = target_is_anim_loop, one_shot_sfx = false })
		end

		if target_shake then
			scene_util.shake(target, target_shake, 9999, false)
		end

		if target_tint then
			character_util.add_color(target, 'dark_tint', target_tint.color, target_tint.magnitude, 0)
		end

		if target_alpha then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(target, target_alpha, 0)
		end

		if target_effect then
			local fx = target_effect():Instantiate(target.Position)
			self.fx_list[target.Name] = fx
		end

		if target_function then
			start_coroutine(function()
				target_function(target)
			end)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:fx_dispose_all()
	if self.fx_list then
		for _, target in pairs(self.fx_list) do
			if target then
				target:Dispose()
				target = nil
			end
		end

		self.fx_list = nil
	end
end

		end

function local_class:set_current_scene_npc(section_state)
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[section_state]

	if pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	linq(pre_npc_data):foreach(function(_, npc_data)
		local npc = get_character(npc_data.name)

		if npc == nil then
			if npc_data.name == 'leader' then
				npc = user_party.Leader
			else
				return
			end
		end

		if npc_data.remove_lv_ui ~= nil and npc_data.remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		npc_data.active_state = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.active_state, active_state_type.enabled)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, npc_data.active_state)


		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if npc_data.pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if npc_data.fly ~= nil and npc_data.fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, npc_data.pos, isFlying)
		end

		if npc_data.dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, npc_data.dir, false)
		end

		if npc_data.emo ~= nil then
			if npc_data.emo == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, npc_data.emo)
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_info ~= nil then
			if npc_data.anim_info == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			elseif type_util.is_table(npc_data.anim_info) then
				npc_data.anim_info.one_shot_sfx = false

				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, npc_data.anim_info)
			elseif type_util.is_string(npc_data.anim_info) then
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = npc_data.anim_info, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_time_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, npc_data.anim_time_scale)
		end

		if npc_data.alpha_value ~= nil then
			local alpha_duration = 0

			if npc_data.alpha_duration ~= nil then
				alpha_duration = npc_data.alpha_duration
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, npc_data.alpha_value, alpha_duration)
		end

		if npc_data.shake_magnitude ~= nil then
			character_util.shake(npc, npc_data.shake_magnitude, 999999)
		end

		if npc_data.sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', npc_data.sorting_layer)
		end

		if npc_data.start_deactive_shadow then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, false)
		end

		if npc_data.scale_factor ~= nil then
			character_util.set_scale_factor(npc, npc.Name, npc_data.scale_factor)
		end

		if npc_data.tint_color then
			local tint_color_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.tint_color_magnitude, 1)

			character_util.add_color(npc, npc_data.tint_color_key, npc_data.tint_color, tint_color_magnitude, 0.1)
		end

		if npc_data.talk ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk) then
			if not lua_helper.type_compare(npc.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
				npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			end

			npc.Interactable.Talk = npc_data.talk
		end

		if npc_data.talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk_sfx) then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = npc_data.talk_sfx
		end

		if npc_data.hitbox ~= nil then
			npc.Hitbox = npc_data.hitbox
		end
	end)
end

function local_class:rescue_people_from_monster()
	local magical_girl = self.character.magical_girl()
	local magical_girl_student = self.character.magical_girl_student()
	local dog = self.character.dog()
	local bullying_girl_1 = self.character.bullying_girl(1)
	local bullying_girl_2 = self.character.bullying_girl(2)
	local mom = self.character.mom()
	local monster_3 = self.character.monster_3()

	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name  = 'bgm_run', state = 'event', volume = 0.6 })
	self.stage_controller.stage_amb_sfx:fade_out_sfx(1)

	self.current_state = self.states.help_people

	self.quest_marker:remove()

	--아래 존에 진입하면 바로 플레이어 컨트롤 제한. 1초간 바이올렛, 시바루 아래와 같이 정렬
	local wp_key = 'wp_key'

	local end_pos = self.marker.magical_girl(1, 1)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(magical_girl,
			end_pos, 4, nil, self, wp_key,
			{ last_direction = 'down' })

	end_pos = self.marker.dog(1, 1)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dog,
			end_pos, 4, nil, self, wp_key,
			{ last_direction = 'down' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	--바이올렛, 시바루 (down, attack, staff_idle)
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(magical_girl, 'item1', 'cwp_magicalgirl_myth')
	scene_util.set_emotion(magical_girl, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(magical_girl, self, { name = 'staff_idle' })

	scene_util.set_emotion(dog, self, 'attack')

	--시바루 (down, attack, idle) jump 2회
	character_util.normal_double_jump(dog, true)

	--카메라 포커스 1초간 vector (20.5, 0, 11.5)로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(self.marker.camera(1, 1), 1)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--바이올렛 (down, attack, staff_idle) notice 이모티콘
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(magical_girl, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'notice')

	--바이올렛 (down, tired, cast) 캐릭터 shake (0.01, 1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(magical_girl, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(magical_girl, self, { name = 'cast' })
	character_util.shake(magical_girl, 0.01, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--시바루 (left, idle, idle) : 하루카?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dog, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'mm_magical_girl_s13_1_1')

	--바이올렛 (down, tired, idle) : 저 애들은… 카에데랑… 마이잖아…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(magical_girl, self, 'down',
			nil, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'mm_magical_girl_s13_1_2')

	--시바루 (down, idle, idle) : 뭉…! 그러고 보니 하루카 너를 괴롭히던….
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_pet_grr_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dog, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'mm_magical_girl_s13_1_3')

	--카에데 (left, damaged, cast) : 아아… 제발 누가 좀 도와줘….
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bullying_girl_1, self, 'left',
			nil, { name = 'damaged', keep = true }, 'mm_magical_girl_s13_1_4')

	scene_util.set_anim(bullying_girl_1, self, { name = 'cast', upper = true })
	scene_util.set_anim(bullying_girl_2, self, { name = 'cast', upper = true })

	--요괴 1의 속도로 0.5타일 우측 이동
	wp_util.move_async(monster_3, monster_3.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 1)

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--동시에 마이 대사 : 히익…!
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bullying_girl_2, self, nil,
						nil, nil, { key = 'mm_magical_girl_s13_1_5', skip = true })
			end,
			function()
				--카에데, 마이 (left, sacred, cast) 자세로 1의 속도로 0.5타일 우측 뒷걸음질 이동.
				wp_key = 'wp_key'

				scene_util.set_anim(bullying_girl_1, self, { name = 'walk' })
				scene_util.set_anim(bullying_girl_2, self, { name = 'walk' })

				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(bullying_girl_1,
						bullying_girl_1.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 1, nil, self, wp_key,
						{ locked_dir = 'left' })

				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(bullying_girl_2,
						bullying_girl_2.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 1, nil, self, wp_key,
						{ locked_dir = 'left' })

				wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

				character_util.remove_anim(bullying_girl_1, true)
				character_util.remove_anim(bullying_girl_2, true)
				scene_util.set_anim(bullying_girl_1, self, { name = 'cast' })
				scene_util.set_anim(bullying_girl_2, self, { name = 'cast' })

			end
	)

	--동시 시작

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--카메라 줌 인 (2.5, 2)
				camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.5, 2)
				--카메라 포커스 2초간 2.5타일 위로
				camera_util.move_async(stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(0, 0, 2.5), 2)
			end,
			function()
				--바이올렛 (down, tired, idle) : [thought] 나더러… 쟤들을 구하라고…?
				scene_util.set_emotion(magical_girl, self, 'tired')
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(magical_girl,
						{ key = 'mm_magical_girl_s13_1_6_0', skip = true, bubble_type = 'thought', dialogue_sfx_name = '03_dialogue_07' })
			end
	)

	--바이올렛 (down, tired, idle) : [thought] 날 항상 괴롭히고 조롱하는… 애들을…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(magical_girl,
			{ key = 'mm_magical_girl_s13_1_7_0', skip = true, bubble_type = 'thought', dialogue_sfx_name = '03_dialogue_07' })

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--바이올렛 (down, tired, idle) : [thought] 싫어….
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_03')
	character_util.remove_anim(magical_girl)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(magical_girl,
			{ key = 'mm_magical_girl_s13_1_6', skip = true, bubble_type = 'thought', dialogue_sfx_name = '03_dialogue_07' })

	--동시 시작
	--화면 shake (0.1, 0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

function local_class:set_current_scene_npc(section_state)
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[section_state]

	if pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	linq(pre_npc_data):foreach(function(_, npc_data)
		local npc = get_character(npc_data.name)

		if npc == nil then
			if npc_data.name == 'leader' then
				npc = user_party.Leader
			else
				return
			end
		end

		if npc_data.remove_lv_ui ~= nil and npc_data.remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		npc_data.active_state = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.active_state, active_state_type.enabled)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, npc_data.active_state)


		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if npc_data.pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if npc_data.fly ~= nil and npc_data.fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, npc_data.pos, isFlying)
		end

		if npc_data.dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, npc_data.dir, false)
		end

		if npc_data.emo ~= nil then
			if npc_data.emo == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, npc_data.emo)
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_info ~= nil then
			if npc_data.anim_info == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			elseif type_util.is_table(npc_data.anim_info) then
				npc_data.anim_info.one_shot_sfx = false

				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, npc_data.anim_info)
			elseif type_util.is_string(npc_data.anim_info) then
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = npc_data.anim_info, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_time_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, npc_data.anim_time_scale)
		end

		if npc_data.alpha_value ~= nil then
			local alpha_duration = 0

			if npc_data.alpha_duration ~= nil then
				alpha_duration = npc_data.alpha_duration
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, npc_data.alpha_value, alpha_duration)
		end

		if npc_data.shake_magnitude ~= nil then
			character_util.shake(npc, npc_data.shake_magnitude, 999999)
		end

		if npc_data.sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', npc_data.sorting_layer)
		end

		if npc_data.start_deactive_shadow then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, false)
		end

		if npc_data.scale_factor ~= nil then

function local_class:activate_battle()
	local boss = self.character.boss_monster()

	character_util.convert_to_monster(boss, self.battle_group_name, self.battle_zone_name)

function local_class:play_section_end_event()

	--화면 1.5초간 페이드 아웃. 끝날 때까지 대기

	do

		character_util.convert_to_npc(magical_girl)

	self.controller:progress_section()

		end,

				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil

	return false

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self.current_state = self.states.first_scene

	sp_util.start_scene(function()
		if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
			screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
			screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')
		end

		self.controller:set_time_of_day()

		self.fx:create_all()

		self:create_npcs()

		self:first_npc_setting()

		self:first_scene()

		self:second_npc_setting()

		self:second_scene()

		self:third_npc_setting()

		self:third_scene()

		self.current_state = self.states.second_scene
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self:fx_dispose_all()

	self.dynamic_npcs:dispose_all()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local zone_name_1 = 's15_zone_1'

	if self.states.second_scene == self.current_state and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), zone_name_1) then
		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			self:fourth_scene()

			self:fifth_npc_setting()

			self:fifth_scene()

			self.current_state = self.states.second_scene
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:first_scene()

		--바이올렛(여)
		magical_girl = {
			target = self.get_character.magical_girl(),
		},
		--보스
		boss = {
			target = self.get_character.boss()
		},
	}

	local center_pos_1 = self.get_marker_pos.center(1)

	--아래 세팅으로 1.5초간 페이드 in / 카메라값 5.5 , 포커스 vector (89.5,0,23.5)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(5.5, 0)

	camera_util.move_async(center_pos_1, 0)

	local blizzard_loop = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_blizzard_04', loop = true, volume = 0.4 })

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black)

	--동시 시작 (async 아님)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wolf_boss_jump_01')
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--화면 shake (0.1, 0.3)
				camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

				--보스 (right, idle, pounce) 자세로 y값 0.5까지 올라가며 3초간 포물선 그리며 우측 2타일 이동
				local jump_pos = npc_data.boss.target.Position + vector(2, 0, 0)

				scene_util.set_direction(npc_data.boss.target, 'right', false)
				scene_util.set_anim(npc_data.boss.target, self, 'pounce')

				character_util.jump(npc_data.boss.target, 0.5, 0.3 + (3 * 0.3))

				wp_util.move_async(npc_data.boss.target, jump_pos, nil, 0.3 + (3 * 0.3))

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc_data.boss.target)
			end,
			function()
				--위 연출의 화면 shake 끝나면 바로 타임스케일 0.3으로 전환
				wait_for_sec(0.3)

				time_util.mod('mod_key', 0.3)

				character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc_data.boss.target, 0)

				--리얼타임 3초간 카메라값 3으로 줌 인 시작
				camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3, 3 * 0.3)

				--카메라 줌인 끝나면 타임스케일 즉시 1로 변경 뒤 아래 연출 실행
				time_util.unmod('mod_key')
			end,
			function()
				--위 연출의 화면 shake 끝나면 바로 타임스케일 0.3으로 전환
				--카메라 줌 인 시작 4초 뒤 바이올렛 (left, attack, staff_attack 1회)
				wait_for_sec((0.3 + (3 * 0.27)) / 1)

				--바이올렛 앞으로 fx_magicalgirlmyth_linkatk_laser 출력
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_magicalgirl_support_01')
				local fx_laser = self.fx.magicalgirlmyth_linkatk_laser():Instantiate(
						npc_data.magical_girl.target.Bounds.center + vector(-1, 0, 0))

				fx_laser.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 180, 0))

				scene_util.set_direction(npc_data.magical_girl.target, 'left', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc_data.magical_girl.target, self, 'attack')
				scene_util.set_anim(npc_data.magical_girl.target, self, { name = 'staff_attack', loop = false })


			end,
			function()
				wait_for_sec(0.6)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_03')
			end
	)

	--동시 시작
	do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_magicalgirl_leader_02')

		--화면 shake (0.2, 0.3)
		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)

		--보스 (right, idle, damaged) + 일반 피격 연출 실행

		scene_util.set_anim(npc_data.boss.target, self, 'damaged')

		self.fx.lasthit():Instantiate(npc_data.boss.target.Bounds.center)

		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(npc_data.boss.target)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(npc_data.boss.target)

		--스크린 이펙트 fx_m_magical_girl_myth_main_r (임시) 출력
		self.fx.magical_girl_myth_main_r():Instantiate(npc_data.boss.target.Bounds.center)
	end

	--바이올렛 (left, attack, dualgun_idle) 전환
	scene_util.set_direction(npc_data.magical_girl.target, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(npc_data.magical_girl.target, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(npc_data.magical_girl.target, self, 'dualgun_idle')

	--동시 시작

		--보스 (right, idle, damaged) 캐릭터 shake (0.03, 1)
		scene_util.set_direction(npc_data.boss.target, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_anim(npc_data.boss.target, self, 'damaged')

		character_util.add_color(npc_data.boss.target, 'dark_tint', unity_class.color.black, 1, 1)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--보스 캐릭터 0.5초간 알파 페이드 아웃으로 사라짐.
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc_data.boss.target, 0, 0.5)

	scene_util.set_direction(npc_data.magical_girl.target, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(npc_data.magical_girl.target, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(npc_data.magical_girl.target, self, 'dualgun_idle')

	character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc_data.magical_girl.target, 'Under Effects', 0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_07')
	local alta_rainbow = self.fx.alta_rainbow():Instantiate(npc_data.magical_girl.target.Bounds.center + vector(0, 0.2, 0))

	--2초 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(blizzard_loop, 1)

	--1.5초간 페이드 아웃
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc_data.boss.target, 1, 0)

	character_util.remove_color(npc_data.boss.target, 'dark_tint', 0)

	npc_data.boss.target.Position = self.wait_pos

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc_data.boss.target)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc_data.magical_girl.target)

	character_util.spine_set_attachment(npc_data.magical_girl.target, '[base]weapon1', 'empty')

	--fx_mg_alta_rainbow (이펙트 교체 필요) 출력해제
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc_data.magical_girl.target, 'Default', 0)
	alta_rainbow:Dispose()
	alta_rainbow = nil
end

function local_class:npc_setting(npc_data)
	for _, target_data in pairs(npc_data) do
		local target = target_data.target
		local target_pos = target_data.pos
		local target_dir = target_data.dir
		local target_emo = target_data.emo
		local target_anim = target_data.anim
		local target_tint = target_data.tint
		local target_shake = target_data.shake
		local target_is_anim_loop = target_data.is_anim_loop
		local target_effect = target_data.effect
		local target_alpha = target_data.alpha
		local target_function = target_data.coroutine_function
		local target_listener = target_data.listener
		local target_is_not_active = target_data.is_not_active
		local target_oneline_key = target_data.oneline_key
		local target_crash_behaviour = target_data.crash_behaviour
		local target_is_leader = target_data.is_leader

		character_util.spine_rotate(target, 0, 0)

		if target_is_not_active then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.disabled)
		else
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.enabled)
		end

		if target_crash_behaviour then
			target.CrashBehaviour = target_crash_behaviour
		end

		if not target_is_leader then
			target.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()
		end

		character_util.set_position(target, target_pos)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)

		scene_util.set_direction(target, target_dir, false)

		if target_emo then
			scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, target_emo)
		end

		if target_oneline_key then
			target.Interactable.Talk = target_oneline_key
		end

		if target_listener then
			character_util.add_listener(target, self.controller)
		end

		if target_anim then
			scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = target_anim, loop = target_is_anim_loop, one_shot_sfx = false })
		end

		if target_shake then
			scene_util.shake(target, target_shake, 9999, false)
		end

		if target_tint then
			character_util.add_color(target, 'dark_tint', target_tint.color, target_tint.magnitude, 0)
		end

		if target_alpha then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(target, target_alpha, 0)
		end

		if target_effect then
			local fx = target_effect():Instantiate(target.Position)
			self.fx_list[target.Name] = fx
		end

		if target_function then
			start_coroutine(function()
				target_function(target)
			end)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:fx_dispose_all()
	if self.fx_list then
		for _, target in pairs(self.fx_list) do
			if target then
				target:Dispose()
				target = nil
			end
		end

		self.fx_list = nil
	end
end

--endregion Setting

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.fo.start_exit()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.dog_talk
		sp_util.start_scene(self.dog_talk_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.dog_talk and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.fo.desk()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.talk_event
		sp_util.start_scene(self.class_talk_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.talk_event then
		if not self.student_talk_check_list[1] and
				(type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.class_students[3]) or
						type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.class_students[4])) then
			self.student_talk_check_list[1] = true
			start_coroutine(function()
				sp_util.enter_scene()

				self:class_after_talk_1_scene()
			end)

			return true
		end

		if not self.student_talk_check_list[2] and
				(type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.characters.bullying_girl_1()) or
						type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.characters.bullying_girl_2())) then
			self.student_talk_check_list[2] = true
			start_coroutine(function()
				sp_util.enter_scene()

				self:class_after_talk_2_scene()
			end)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

	--2번 NPC

	--원라인 대사: 후우… 신입생 서열을 정할 때가 온 건가…

	--카에데

	--원라인 대사: 아~ 벌써 지루해~
	local bullying_girl_1 = self.characters.bullying_girl_1()
	character_util.set_position(bullying_girl_1, self.markers.bullying_girl_1_pos(1) + vector(0, 0, -0.5))
	character_util.set_direction(bullying_girl_1, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim(bullying_girl_1)
	scene_util.set_emotion(bullying_girl_1, self, 'doyagao')
	bullying_girl_1.Interactable.Talk = 'mm_magical_girl_s2_0'
	bullying_girl_1.Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_dialogue_bad_01'

	--마이
	--마이(memorial_mg_bullying_girl_2)(left, doyagao, idle)
	--원라인 대사: 나는 수업 때 네일이나 붙이려구.
	local bullying_girl_2 = self.characters.bullying_girl_2()
	character_util.set_position(bullying_girl_2, self.markers.bullying_girl_2_pos(1) + vector(0, 0, -0.5))
	character_util.set_direction(bullying_girl_2, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim(bullying_girl_2)
	scene_util.set_emotion(bullying_girl_2, self, 'doyagao')

function local_class:dog_talk_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local mg_dog = self.characters.mg_dog()

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

	self.fo.start_exit().Interactable = self.cashed_exit_interactable

	while not self.dynamic_npcs.is_loaded do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	for _, value in pairs(self.students) do
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(value)
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	do
		--2번 NPC(right, awesome, release 2회): 이 강아지 진짜 귀엽다!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.students[2], self, 'right',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil,
				{ key = 'mm_magical_girl_s2_1', type_speed = 0, skip = true })

		--시바링(right, smile, happy) 전환
		character_util.set_direction(mg_dog, 'right')
		scene_util.set_emotion(mg_dog, self, 'smile')
		--하루카(right, idle, idle)
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')

		--3번 NPC(left, awesome, release 2회): 못생겨서 더 귀여워!!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.students[3], self, 'left',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
				nil, { key = 'mm_magical_girl_s2_2', type_speed = 0, skip = true })

		--시바링(left, smile, happy) 전환
		scene_util.set_direction(mg_dog, 'left', false)

		--하루카(right, tired, idle question 마지막 프레임)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'question')
		wait_for_sec(spine_util.get_animation_duration(leader, 'question'))

		--1초 대기
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--하루카(up, idle, idle)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
		--시바링(left, surprise, idle) 상태로 점프 1회
		scene_util.set_emotion(mg_dog, self, 'surprise')
		character_util.remove_anim(mg_dog)
		character_util.normal_jump_async(mg_dog, true)

		--동시 연출
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_pet_hurt_01')
		--카메라 shake (0.03, 0.7)
		camera_util.shake(0.03, 0.7)
		--시바링(left, surprise, idle)[shout]: …하루카!
		--대사 한 번에 출력
		--말풍선은 꼬리 없는 말풍선으로 (x: 0.8, y: 0.7)에 출력
		scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(mg_dog, 'mm_magical_girl_s2_6',
				true, { type_speed = 0, viewport_pos = vector(0.8, 0.7) })
	end

	--0.7초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--하루카(up, idle, idle): 누가 나 부른 것 같은데….
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(leader, 'mm_magical_girl_s2_7')

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--동시 연출
	--시바링(left, attack, idle)[shout 1.2배]: 이쪽을 봐ㅈ…!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_pet_ordinary_01')
	--시바링 shake (0.03, 0.7)
	--대사 한 번에 출력
	scene_util.set_emotion(mg_dog, self, 'attack')
	character_util.remove_anim(mg_dog)
	--말풍선은 꼬리 없는 말풍선으로 (x: 0.8, y: 0.7)에 출력
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(mg_dog, 'mm_magical_girl_s2_8',
			true, { type_speed = 0, viewport_pos = vector(0.8, 0.7), scale = 1.2 })

	--동시 연출
	--카메라 shake (0.03, 0.7)
	camera_util.shake(0.03, 0.7)
	--하루카(right, surprise, idle) 전환
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')
	--2번, 3번, 6번, 5번, 시바링 현재 방향 유지한 채 surprise, idle로 전환
	scene_util.set_group_emotion(
			{ self.students[2], self.students[3], mg_dog }, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.remove_group_anim({ self.students[2], self.students[3] })
	--1번(down, mad, cast2): 다 안 비키나!!! 내가 먼저 쓰다듬을 거라고!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.students[1], self, 'down',
			{ name = 'cast2', keep = true }, { name = 'mad', keep = true },
			'mm_magical_girl_s2_9')

	--1번, 2번, 3번, 5번, 6번, 시바링 현재 모션 유지한 상태로 진행
	--이후 1번 마지막 대사로 원라인 처리
	self.students[1].Interactable.Talk = 'mm_magical_girl_s2_9'
	self.students[1].Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_dialogue_angry_01'

	for i = 2, #self.students do
		self.students[i].Interactable.Talk = nil
	end

	--0.7초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--하루카(right, tired, idle): 뭐지… 잘못 들었나?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'right',
			'idle', 'tired', 'mm_magical_girl_s2_10')

	--하루카 (up, idle, idle) 출력
	--하루카 위로 1의 속도로 1 타일  이동하면서 1초에 걸쳐 페이드 아웃으로 출력 제거
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(leader, 0, 1)
	wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position + vector(0, 0.75, 1.25), nil, 1)

	--위 연출 종료되면 아래 동시 연출 진행
	--동시 연출
	--카메라 2초에 걸쳐 페이드 아웃
	screen_util.fade_out(2, unity_class.color.black)
	--시바링(left, tired, idle) 전환
	scene_util.set_emotion(mg_dog, self, 'tired')
	--위 연출 시작하고 0.7초 뒤 다음 대사 출력
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--시바링: 하루카, 가면 안 돼ㅁ…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_pet_hurt_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(mg_dog, { key = 'mm_magical_girl_s2_11', skip = true })
	--페이드 아웃 완료되면 다음 연출 진행
	wait_for_sec(1.3)

	--동시 연출
	do
		local leader_start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('1floor_exit_2')

		character_util.set_position(leader, leader_start_pos)
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

		--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 페이드 인
		screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black)

		--하루카 지정 위치에 1초에 걸쳐 페이드 인되며 출력
		--출력 완료되면 하루카 (up, idle, walk) 상태로 2의 속도로 노란 위치까지 이동하고 정렬
		--정렬 애니메이션 (up, idle, idle)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(leader, 1, 1)
		wp_util.move_async(leader, leader_start_pos + vector(0, 0, 2), 2)
	end

	self.fo.desk().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

	--연출 종료
	--플레이어 컨트롤 돌려줌
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'campus_square', target = self.fo.start_exit() },
		{ zone = 'classroom_area_1', target = self.fo.desk() },
		{ zone = 'classroom_area_2', target = get_field_object('down_stair') }
	}, nil, nil, true)
end

function local_class:class_talk_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local bullying_girl_1 = self.characters.bullying_girl_1()
	local bullying_girl_2 = self.characters.bullying_girl_2()
	local leader_pos = self.markers.leader_pos(2)
	local teacher = self.dynamic_npcs:get('s2_teacher')

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

	--퀘스트 마커 위치인 책상과 인터랙트 시 강제 연출 진행
	self.fo.desk().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	local chair_seat_routine = function(target, pos)
		local wp = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(target, pos, true)

		wp_util.move_async(target, wp, 3, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
		scene_util.set_anim(target, self, 'get')
		character_util.jump(target, 1, 0.5)
		character_util.move_to_async(target, pos + vector(-1, 0.5, 0), 0.5)

		character_util.set_direction(target, 'up')
		scene_util.set_anim(target, self, 'meditation')
	end

	--하루카 아래 위치로 이동 / 책상 오브젝트 넘어서 가지 않도록 처리.
	self.controller:desk_align(leader, self.fo.desk().Position)

	--하루카(right, idle, question 1회 마지막 프레임 대기): 이 자리가 좋을까? 아니면…
	--모션 유지한 상태로 진행
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'question', keep = true }, nil, 'mm_magical_girl_s2_12')

	--0.7초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--NPC 배치
	do
		local student_3_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos(
				'right', self.markers.class_student_pos(3), 1) + vector(0, 0, -3)

		character_util.set_position(self.class_students[3], student_3_pos)
		character_util.set_position(self.class_students[4], student_3_pos + vector(1, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_position(self.class_students[5], student_3_pos + vector(2, 0, 0))
		--3번 NPC
		--일반 학생 (memorial_mg_student_2)(left, idle, idle)
		--4번 NPC
		--일반 학생 (memorial_mg_student_3)(left, idle, idle)
		--5번 NPC
		--일반 학생 (memorial_mg_student_4)(left, idle, idle)
		--3번, 4번, 5번 left, idle, walk 상태로 5.5초에 걸쳐 노란색 위치까지 이동 시작 (async 아님)
		local wp_key = 'student_wp'
		local student_3_end_pos = self.markers.chair_right_pos(1) + vector(0, 0, -1)
		local student_3_wp = wp_util.get_turn_twice_wp(self.class_students[3],
				student_3_end_pos, { x = student_3_end_pos.x + 6 })
		local student_4_wp = wp_util.get_turn_twice_wp(self.class_students[3],
				student_3_end_pos + vector(1, 0, 0), { x = student_3_end_pos.x + 6 })
		local student_5_wp = wp_util.get_turn_twice_wp(self.class_students[3],
				student_3_end_pos + vector(2, 0, 0), { x = student_3_end_pos.x + 6 })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.class_students[3], student_3_wp,
				nil, 5.5, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.class_students[4], student_4_wp,
				nil, 5.5, self, wp_key)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(self.class_students[5], student_5_wp,
				nil, 5.5, self, wp_key)

		-- 2초 대기
		wait_for_sec(2)

		--하루카(right, surprise, idle) 점프 1회
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')
		character_util.remove_anim(leader)
		character_util.normal_jump_async(leader, true)

		--하루카(right, surprise, cast): 애, 애들 온다…!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'right',
				'cast', 'surprise', 'mm_magical_girl_s2_16')

		--3번(left, idle, walk): 우리 반에 어떤 애들 있을까?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.class_students[3], self, 'left',
				nil, nil, 'mm_magical_girl_s2_13')

		--4번(left, awesome, walk): 완전 궁금해. 어제 설레서 잠이 안 오더라니까!
		scene_util.set_emotion(self.class_students[4], self, 'awesome')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.class_students[4], {
			key = 'mm_magical_girl_s2_14', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lt'
		})

		--0.7초 대기
		--하루카 노란색 위치로 2의 속도로 이동
		--이동 완료하면 right, idle, cast
		start_coroutine(function()
			local leader_wp = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(leader,
					self.markers.chair_right_pos(1) + vector(-1, 0, -1), false)

			wp_util.move_async(leader, leader_wp, 2)

			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'cast')
		end)

		--5번(left, smile, nod 2회): 나두. 그래서 밤 늦게까지 뉴튜브 보다가 겨우 잤어.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.class_students[5], self, 'left',
				{ name = 'nod', count = 2, upper = true },
				{ name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'mm_magical_girl_s2_15')

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--3번, 4번, 5번 노란색 위치로 이동 완료하면 다음 상태로 정렬
	--4번, 5번 (left, idle, idle)
	--3번 (right, smile, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(self.class_students[3], 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(self.class_students[3], self, 'smile')

	--이동 완료하면 카메라 1초에 걸쳐 2.7 크기로 줌 인
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(2.7, 1)

	--3번(right, smile, idle): 아! 혹시 루리 뉴튜브?
	--이후 모션 유지한 상태로 진행
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.class_students[3], self, 'right',
			nil, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'mm_magical_girl_s2_17')

	--하루카(right, idle, cast) shake (0.03, 0.7)
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'cast')
	scene_util.shake(leader, 0.03, 0.7)
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--3번(idle, smile, walk): 그럼 너희도 어제 올라온 영상 봤어?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.class_students[3], self, nil,
			nil, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'mm_magical_girl_s2_18')

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--하루카(right, tired, cast)[0.8배]: 저, 저기…
				scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(leader,
						'mm_magical_girl_s2_18_1',
						true, { scale = 0.8, bubble_direction = 'lb' })
			end,
			function()
				--위 연출 시작하고 0.3초 뒤 다음 대사 출력
				wait_for_sec(0.3)

				--5번(left, love, sing): 당연하지! 한 시간만에 조회수 백…
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.class_students[5], self, 'left',
						'sing', { name = 'love', keep = true }, 'mm_magical_girl_s2_19')
			end
	)


	--하루카(right, blush, idle)[shout 1.2배]: 저기…!!
	--5번 말풍선 덮으면서 출력
	--이후 모션 유지한 상태로 진행
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'blush')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(leader,
			'mm_magical_girl_s2_19_1', true, { scale = 1.2 })

	--0.7초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--3번, 4번, 5번 left, idle, idle 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')

function local_class:section_clear_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	--하루카 위 노란 위치로 2의 속도로 이동해 정렬
	--정렬 모션 (left, tired, idle)
	wp_util.move_async(leader, self.markers.chair_right_pos(4) + vector(0, 0, 2),
			2, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

	--하루카(left, tired, idle): 어떡하지… 나밖에 안 남았어…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
			nil, 'tired', 'mm_magical_girl_s2_125')

	--하루카 3의 속도로 회색 위치까지 이동해 도달하면 의자 위로 0.5초간 jump하여 앉음 (y값 0.5까지 올라감)
	do
		local wp = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(leader,
				self.markers.chair_right_pos(1) + vector(-2, 0, 0), true)

		wp_util.move_async(leader, wp, 3, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'get')
		character_util.jump(leader, 1, 0.5)
		character_util.move_to_async(leader, leader.Position + vector(1, 0.5, 0), 0.5)

		--의자 위로 올라가면 (left, idle, seat) 자세로 전환.
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')

function local_class:on_event(e)

		return self:on_interact_event(e)

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.show_exit and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.fo.shelf()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.get_key
		sp_util.start_scene(self.get_key_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state >= self.states.show_exit and not self.check_func and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.fo.exit_close_event_gimmick()) then
		self.check_func = true
		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene()
			self:exit_open_scene()
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.sfx_info.sfx_holder ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.sfx_info.zone_info do
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.sfx_info.zone_info[i].name) then
				if self.sfx_info.zone_info[i].fx_active then
					field_util.darken(self.tint_key, 0.5, 1.5)
				else
					field_util.undarken(self.tint_key, 1.5)
				end

				self:change_loop_sfx_volume(self.sfx_info.zone_info[i].volume)
				-- 볼륨 조절과 별개로 이벤트를 실행해야 하는 구간이 존재해 return true를 반환하지 않음
			end
		end
	end

	for i = 1, self.monster_info.count do
		if self.is_ghost_in[i] == false and lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and
				e.Zone.Name == self.monster_info.zone_name .. i and
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then
			self.is_ghost_in[i] = true
			local monster = self.dynamic_npcs:get(self.dynamic_npcs.monster_name .. i)

			self:dispose_ghost_appear_sfx()
			self.ghost_appear_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_ghost_disappear_01', volume = 0.7 })

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(monster, 1, 0.5)
			return true
		end
	end

	if not self.school_out_check and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's3_sfx_zone_b') then
		self.school_out_check = true
		sp_util.start_scene(self.school_out_scene, self, e.Zone)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's3_sfx_zone_d') then
		self.current_state = self.states.show_exit
		sp_util.start_scene(self.show_exit_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	for i = 1, self.monster_info.count do
		if self.is_ghost_in[i] and type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), self.monster_info.zone_name .. i) then
			self.is_ghost_in[i] = false
			self:dispose_ghost_disappear_sfx()
			
			local monster = self.dynamic_npcs:get(self.dynamic_npcs.monster_name .. i)
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(monster, 0, 0.5)
			self.ghost_disappear_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_magic_heal_03', loop = false })

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

			{ sfx_name = '01_amb_coma_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', fade_in_time = 1, volume = 0.6 })

	--하루카(left, sleep, seat): 흐음… 흠냐… 시끄러워….

	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(leader, 'mm_magical_girl_s3_1')

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--하루카 shake (0.03, 1)
	scene_util.shake(leader, 0.03, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(leader, 'mm_magical_girl_s3_2')

	--0.7초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--하루카(left, surprise, idle) 상태로 0.5초간 1타일 우측으로 jump 하며 의자에서 내려감

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')

		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'get')
		character_util.jump(leader, 1, 0.5)
		character_util.move_to_async(leader, chair_pos + vector(-1, -0.5, 0), 0.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
		character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	local exit_open = self.fo.exit_open()

		--화면 shake (0.1, 0.3)
		music_player_util.play_multiple_sfx_one_shot('01_ghost_agro_01', '01_ghost_disappear_03')
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

		--하루카 (down, scared, idle) jump 1회
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
		character_util.normal_jump_async(leader, true)

		--카메라 포커스 3초간 10.5타일 아래로 이동
		camera_util.move_async(stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(0, 0, -10.5), 3)

		-- 1번 (up, idle, idle)
		-- 2번 (left, idle, walk4legs, 프레임 멈춤)
		-- 3번 (down, idle, prostrate)
		local set_data_list = {
			{
				dir = 'up',
				pos = vector(0.5, 0, -55.5),
				anim = 'idle',
			},
			{
				dir = 'left',
				pos = vector(2.5, 0, -56.5),
				anim = 'walk4legs',
			},
			{
				dir = 'down',
				pos = vector(4.5, 0, -56),
				anim = 'prostrate',
			}
		}

		local monster_count = 3

		-- 요괴 1~3 캐릭터 shake (0.01, 1)
		for i = 1, monster_count do
			local data = set_data_list[i]
			local cur_monster = self.dynamic_npcs:get(self.dynamic_npcs.monster_name .. i)

			cur_monster.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(cur_monster, 0, 0)
			character_util.set_direction(cur_monster, data.dir)
			character_util.set_position(cur_monster, data.pos)
			scene_util.set_anim(cur_monster, self, { name = data.anim, loop = false, scale = 999 })

			-- 아래 위치에 요괴들 1초간 검은틴트 100% 상태로 알파 페이드인
			character_util.shake(cur_monster, 0.01, 1)
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(cur_monster, 1, 1)
		end

		--1초 대기
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ghost_disappear_01')
		wait_for_sec(1)

		for i = 1, monster_count do
			local cur_monster = self.dynamic_npcs:get(self.dynamic_npcs.monster_name .. i)
			cur_monster.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
		end

		--옥상 문 오브젝트 닫힘 오브젝트- > 열림 오브젝트로 전환
		--obj_in_exit_close -> obj_in_exit_open
		--이 연출 이후 쭉 obj_in_exit_open 상태가 될 수 있도록 세팅
		exit_open.Position = exit_close.Position
		exit_close.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

		--카메라 포커스 2초간 하루카에게로 이동
		camera_util.return_to_leader(2)

		--하루카 (down, scared, idle) : 빠, 빨리 올라가자…!
		scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(leader, 'mm_magical_girl_s3_21')

		--동시 시작
		--하루카 1의 속도로 1타일 이동하며 1초간 알파 페이드 아웃 (100% -> 0%)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(leader, 0, 1)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		wp_util.move(leader, leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), nil, 1, {
			run = true, play_sfx = true })

		--화면 1.5초간 페이드 아웃
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black)

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(leader, 1, 0)
		coroutine.yield()

		-- 옥상 도어 상호작용 오브젝트 교체
		self.controller:active_rooftop_door_event_gimmick(false)

		--이후 4섹션으로 이동
		self.controller:progress_section()
	end
end

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type MemorialMagicalGirlMainController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	self.cs_section = cs_section

	self.available_stage_names = 'memorial_magical_girl'

	self.get_marker_pos = {
		center = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_center_pos_' .. number)
		end
	}

	--endregion Marker

	--region Sprite

	self.sprite = {
		sprite_info = {
			cwp_knight = 21593,
		},
		sprite_table = {},
		sprite_table_origin_parent = {},
		create = function(this, name, pos, item_id, scale, showoncharacter, target, drop_type, skip_text)
			scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
			showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, false)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = pos, item_id = item_id, show_on_character = showoncharacter,
					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = item.SpriteTransform.parent

			return item
		end,
		fly = function(this, name, target)
			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end
	}

	--endregion Sprite

	--region Fx

	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		lasthit = function()

		end,

		end,

			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_mm_magical_black_slash')
		end,
	})

	self.fx_list = nil

	--endregion Fx

	--region Etc

	self.wait_pos = vector(999, 0, 999)

	-- 메인 퀘스트 id

function local_class:hero_landing_copy_not_emo_anim(fo, dir, pos, jump_height, fall_duration, finish_y_pos, data)
	dir = lua_helper.get_or_default(dir, fo.Direction)
	pos = lua_helper.get_or_default(pos, fo.Position)
	finish_y_pos = lua_helper.get_or_default(finish_y_pos, 0)
	jump_height = lua_helper.get_or_default(jump_height, 10)
	fall_duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(fall_duration, 0.4)

	local info = {}

	info.is_hit = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'is_hit', false)
	info.shadow_offset_y = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'shadow_offset_y', 0)
	info.is_active = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'is_active', true)

	-- 캐릭터를 히어로 랜딩 할 위치로 배치
	if info.is_active then
		character_util.set_active_state(fo, 'enabled')
	end

	character_util.set_position(fo, pos + vector(0, jump_height, 0), true)
	character_util.set_direction(fo, dir)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local start_pos = fo.Position
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, fo.Position.y, 0)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		if start_pos.y + dist_y > finish_y_pos then
			character_util.set_position(fo, start_pos + vector(0, dist_y, 0))
		else
			character_util.set_position(fo, vector(start_pos.x, finish_y_pos, start_pos.z))
		end

		fo.SpineController.ShadowOffsetY = info.shadow_offset_y - fo.Position.y

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--TODO: 착지 될 때 효과음이 고정이라면 여기서 랜딩 끝날 때의 사운드 재생 하는 것도 좋을 듯함
	character_util.set_position(fo, vector(start_pos.x, finish_y_pos, start_pos.z))

	if info.is_hit then
		self.fx.hit():Instantiate(vector(start_pos.x, finish_y_pos, start_pos.z))
	end
end

--베지어 곡선
function local_class:bezier_curves(start_pos, end_pos, progress, height, height_x1, height_x2)
	height_x1 = lua_helper.get_or_default(height_x1, 0)
	height_x2 = lua_helper.get_or_default(height_x2, 0)

	local pos = {
		start_pos,
		start_pos + vector(height_x1, height, 0),
		end_pos + vector(height_x2, height, 0),
		end_pos
	}
	local a_pos, b_pos, c_pos, d_pos, e_pos, f_pos

	a_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[1], pos[2], progress)
	b_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[2], pos[3], progress)
	c_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[3], pos[4], progress)
	d_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(a_pos, b_pos, progress)
	e_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(b_pos, c_pos, progress)
	f_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(d_pos, e_pos, progress)

	return f_pos
end

function local_class:npc_setting(npc_data)
	for _, target_data in pairs(npc_data) do
		local target = target_data.target
		local target_pos = target_data.pos
		local target_dir = target_data.dir
		local target_emo = target_data.emo
		local target_anim = target_data.anim
		local target_tint = target_data.tint
		local target_shake = target_data.shake
		local target_is_anim_loop = target_data.is_anim_loop
		local target_effect = target_data.effect
		local target_alpha = target_data.alpha
		local target_function = target_data.coroutine_function
		local target_listener = target_data.listener
		local target_is_not_active = target_data.is_not_active
		local target_oneline_key = target_data.oneline_key
		local target_crash_behaviour = target_data.crash_behaviour
		local target_is_leader = target_data.is_leader

		character_util.spine_rotate(target, 0, 0)

		if target_is_not_active then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.disabled)
		else
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.enabled)
		end

		if target_crash_behaviour then
			target.CrashBehaviour = target_crash_behaviour
		end

		if not target_is_leader then
			target.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()
		end
		character_util.set_position(target, target_pos)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)

		scene_util.set_direction(target, target_dir, false)

		if target_emo then
			scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, target_emo)
		end

		if target_oneline_key then
			target.Interactable.Talk = target_oneline_key
		end

		if target_listener then
			character_util.add_listener(target, self.controller)
		end

		if target_anim then

	self.sprite = {
		sprite_info = {
			cwp_knight = 21593,
		},
		sprite_table = {},
		sprite_table_origin_parent = {},
		create = function(this, name, pos, item_id, scale, showoncharacter, target, drop_type, skip_text)
			scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
			showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, false)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = pos, item_id = item_id, show_on_character = showoncharacter,
					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = item.SpriteTransform.parent

			return item
		end,
		fly = function(this, name, target)
			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end
	}

function local_class:hero_landing_copy_not_emo_anim(fo, dir, pos, jump_height, fall_duration, finish_y_pos, data)
	dir = lua_helper.get_or_default(dir, fo.Direction)
	pos = lua_helper.get_or_default(pos, fo.Position)
	finish_y_pos = lua_helper.get_or_default(finish_y_pos, 0)
	jump_height = lua_helper.get_or_default(jump_height, 10)
	fall_duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(fall_duration, 0.4)

	local info = {}

	info.is_hit = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'is_hit', false)
	info.shadow_offset_y = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'shadow_offset_y', 0)
	info.is_active = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'is_active', true)

	-- 캐릭터를 히어로 랜딩 할 위치로 배치
	if info.is_active then
		character_util.set_active_state(fo, 'enabled')
	end

	character_util.set_position(fo, pos + vector(0, jump_height, 0), true)
	character_util.set_direction(fo, dir)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local start_pos = fo.Position
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, fo.Position.y, 0)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		if start_pos.y + dist_y > finish_y_pos then
			character_util.set_position(fo, start_pos + vector(0, dist_y, 0))
		else
			character_util.set_position(fo, vector(start_pos.x, finish_y_pos, start_pos.z))
		end

		fo.SpineController.ShadowOffsetY = info.shadow_offset_y - fo.Position.y

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--TODO: 착지 될 때 효과음이 고정이라면 여기서 랜딩 끝날 때의 사운드 재생 하는 것도 좋을 듯함
	character_util.set_position(fo, vector(start_pos.x, finish_y_pos, start_pos.z))

	if info.is_hit then
		self.fx.hit():Instantiate(vector(start_pos.x, finish_y_pos, start_pos.z))
	end
end

--베지어 곡선
function local_class:bezier_curves(start_pos, end_pos, progress, height, height_x1, height_x2)
	height_x1 = lua_helper.get_or_default(height_x1, 0)
	height_x2 = lua_helper.get_or_default(height_x2, 0)

	local pos = {
		start_pos,
		start_pos + vector(height_x1, height, 0),
		end_pos + vector(height_x2, height, 0),
		end_pos
	}
	local a_pos, b_pos, c_pos, d_pos, e_pos, f_pos

	a_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[1], pos[2], progress)
	b_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[2], pos[3], progress)
	c_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[3], pos[4], progress)
	d_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(a_pos, b_pos, progress)
	e_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(b_pos, c_pos, progress)
	f_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(d_pos, e_pos, progress)

	return f_pos
end

function local_class:npc_setting(npc_data)
	for _, target_data in pairs(npc_data) do
		local target = target_data.target
		local target_pos = target_data.pos
		local target_dir = target_data.dir
		local target_emo = target_data.emo
		local target_anim = target_data.anim
		local target_tint = target_data.tint
		local target_shake = target_data.shake
		local target_is_anim_loop = target_data.is_anim_loop
		local target_effect = target_data.effect
		local target_alpha = target_data.alpha
		local target_function = target_data.coroutine_function
		local target_listener = target_data.listener
		local target_is_not_active = target_data.is_not_active
		local target_oneline_key = target_data.oneline_key
		local target_crash_behaviour = target_data.crash_behaviour
		local target_is_leader = target_data.is_leader

		character_util.spine_rotate(target, 0, 0)

		if target_is_not_active then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.disabled)
		else
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.enabled)
		end

		if target_crash_behaviour then
			target.CrashBehaviour = target_crash_behaviour
		end

		if not target_is_leader then
			target.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()
		end
		character_util.set_position(target, target_pos)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)

		scene_util.set_direction(target, target_dir, false)

		if target_emo then
			scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, target_emo)
		end

		if target_oneline_key then
			target.Interactable.Talk = target_oneline_key
		end

		if target_listener then
			character_util.add_listener(target, self.controller)
		end

		if target_anim then
			scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = target_anim, loop = target_is_anim_loop, one_shot_sfx = false })
		end

		if target_shake then
			scene_util.shake(target, target_shake, 9999, false)
		end

		if target_tint then
			character_util.add_color(target, 'dark_tint', target_tint.color, target_tint.magnitude, 0)
		end

		if target_alpha then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(target, target_alpha, 0)
		end

		if target_effect then
			local fx = target_effect():Instantiate(target.Position)
			self.fx_list[target.Name] = fx
		end

		if target_function then
			start_coroutine(function()
				target_function(target)
			end)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:fx_dispose_all()
	if self.fx_list then
		for _, target in pairs(self.fx_list) do
			if target then
				target:Dispose()
				target = nil
			end
		end

		self.fx_list = nil
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.fx:create_all()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self:set_fo()

	self.controller:set_time_of_day()

	self.controller:remove_equipment()

	start_coroutine(function()
		music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({
			name = 'ondemand/memorial_magical_girl/audio:bgm_magicalgirl_day', state = 'field'
		})

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)
	end)

	self.stage_controller = get_stage_event_controller('MemorialMagicalGirlController')
	self.stage_controller.stage_amb_sfx:play_sfx('01_amb_highschool_01', 0.4, 1)
end

function local_class:start()
	start_coroutine(function()
		sp_util.enter_scene()

		if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
			screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
			screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')
		end

		self:opening_event()
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.dynamic_npcs:dispose()

	if self.ambi_sfx ~= nil then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.ambi_sfx)
		self.ambi_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return self:on_interact_event(e)
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.field_object.waste_basket()) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.to_the_dog_on_the_roof then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.hallway_event_1_2, self)

			return true
		end
	elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.character.dog()) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.to_the_dog_on_the_roof then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.fourth_event, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_info.classroom) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.first_floor_classroom then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.second_event, self)

			return true
		end
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_info.hallway_1.name) then
		if self.current_state > self.states.first_floor_classroom then
			if not self.zone_info.hallway_1.has_run_once then
				self.zone_info.hallway_1.has_run_once = true

				start_coroutine(self.hallway_event_1_1, self)

				return true
			end
		end

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_info.hallway_2.name) then
		if self.current_state > self.states.first_floor_classroom then
			if not self.zone_info.hallway_2.has_run_once then
				self.zone_info.hallway_2.has_run_once = true

				start_coroutine(self.hallway_event_2, self)

				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_current_scene_npc(section_state)
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[section_state]

	if pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	linq(pre_npc_data):foreach(function(_, npc_data)
		local npc = get_character(npc_data.name)

		if npc == nil then
			if npc_data.name == 'leader' then
				npc = user_party.Leader
			else
				return
			end
		end

		if npc_data.remove_lv_ui ~= nil and npc_data.remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		npc_data.active_state = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.active_state, active_state_type.enabled)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, npc_data.active_state)


		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if npc_data.pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if npc_data.fly ~= nil and npc_data.fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, npc_data.pos, isFlying)
		end

		if npc_data.dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, npc_data.dir, false)
		end

		if npc_data.emo ~= nil then
			if npc_data.emo == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, npc_data.emo)
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_info ~= nil then
			if npc_data.anim_info == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			elseif type_util.is_table(npc_data.anim_info) then
				npc_data.anim_info.one_shot_sfx = false

				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, npc_data.anim_info)
			elseif type_util.is_string(npc_data.anim_info) then
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = npc_data.anim_info, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_time_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, npc_data.anim_time_scale)
		end

		if npc_data.alpha_value ~= nil then
			local alpha_duration = 0

			if npc_data.alpha_duration ~= nil then
				alpha_duration = npc_data.alpha_duration
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, npc_data.alpha_value, alpha_duration)
		end

		if npc_data.keep_shake ~= nil and npc_data.keep_shake == true then
			character_util.shake(npc, npc_data.shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if npc_data.sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', npc_data.sorting_layer)
		end

		if npc_data.start_deactive_shadow then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, false)
		end

		if npc_data.scale_factor ~= nil then
			character_util.set_scale_factor(npc, npc.Name, npc_data.scale_factor)
		end

		if npc_data.tint_color then
			local tint_color_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.tint_color_magnitude, 1)

			character_util.add_color(npc, npc_data.tint_color_key, npc_data.tint_color, tint_color_magnitude, 0.1)
		end

		if npc_data.talk ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk) then
			if not lua_helper.type_compare(npc.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
				npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			end

			npc.Interactable.Talk = npc_data.talk
		end

		if npc_data.talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk_sfx) then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = npc_data.talk_sfx
		end

		if npc_data.hitbox ~= nil then
			npc.Hitbox = npc_data.hitbox
		end

		npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end)
end

	character_util.remove_emotion(fo)
	scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, { name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false })

	scene_util.set_direction(fo, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(fo, self, 'tired')
	character_util.remove_anim(fo)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bullying_girl_2)
	scene_util.set_direction(bullying_girl_2, 'up', false)
	bullying_girl_2.Interactable.Talk = 'mm_magical_girl_s9_one_line_2'

				--아야네 (down, tired, idle)
				scene_util.set_direction(mom, 'down', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(mom, self, 'tired')
				character_util.remove_anim(mom)
			end,
			function()
				--카메라 포커스 1.5초간 하루카에게 이동.
				camera_util.return_to_leader(1.5)
			end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--하루카 (up, tired, idle) : 하지만… 엄마한테 어떻게 말해야할지 모르겠는걸….

	fo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

		{ zone = 'campus_square', target = get_field_object('ouside_exit_2') },
		{ zone = 'classroom_area_1', target = self.marker.student(2, 1, 1) + vector(0.5, 1, 0) },

function local_class:rooftop_event()

	local dog = self.character.dog()
	local streamer = self.character.streamer()

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(streamer, 0, 0)
	character_util.force_update_spines(streamer, 0.1)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	self.quest_marker:remove()

	-- 1.5초간 하루카 위 이미지 위치 정렬
	wp_util.move_async(magical_girl_student, dog.Position + vector(2, 0, 0), nil, 1.5, { last_direction = 'left' })

	character_util.set_position(streamer, dog.Position + vector(1, 0, 0))

	--시바링 (right, smile, happy) : 하루카다뭉! 날 보러 온거야뭉?!

			nil, nil, 'mm_magical_girl_s9_3_0_1')

	--01_pet_ordinary_01 + 03_dialogue_positive_01

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')

	--시바링 (right, smile, happy) heart 이모티콘
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(dog, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'happy', keep = true }, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'heart')

	--하루카 (left, blush, cast) : 벼, 별건 아니고, 루리 뉴튜브에 나랑… 네 목소리가 나와서!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')

			{ name = 'cast', keep = true }, { name = 'blush', keep = true }, 'mm_magical_girl_s9_3_0_2')

	--하루카 (left, smile, throw 1회) 자세로 maiden_phone 아이템 1타일 좌측에 던짐
	scene_util.set_direction(magical_girl_student, 'left', false)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_02')
		self.sprite:create('phone', magical_girl_student.Position,
				self.sprite.sprite_info.phone, 1, true, dog.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), nil, true)
	end })

	wait_for_sec(1.25)

	--maiden_phone 아이템 바닥에 놓여있음.
	--mall_phone 아이템에서 말풍선 출력
	--루리 : 어때? 들려? ‘미스틱 바이올렛!’ 이라고 외치는 소리!
	--포트레이트 있음

	--시바링 : [shout] 미스틱 바이올렛의 탄생이다뭉!
	--아이템에서 나오는 말풍선입니다. 따로 포트레이트 X 말풍선만.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(streamer, { key = 'mm_magical_girl_s9_3_2', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	scene_util.set_direction(dog, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(dog, self, 'greed')

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--jump 2회
				character_util.normal_double_jump(dog, true)
			end,
			function()
				--시바링 (right, greed, idle)  : 내 목소리다뭉!
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dog, self, 'right',
						nil, nil, 'mm_magical_girl_s9_3_3')
			end
	)

	--시바링 (right, frown, idle) : 앗, 근데…. 내 목소리가 이렇게 모두에게 공개되면 안되는데….

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dog, self, 'right',
			nil, 'frown', 'mm_magical_girl_s9_3_4')

	--시바링 (right, frown, idle, 유지) : 너무 흥분해서 목소리를 감추는 마법이 잠깐 풀렸나보다뭉….

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dog, self, 'right',
			nil, { name = 'frown', keep = true }, 'mm_magical_girl_s9_3_4_1')

	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(magical_girl_student, self, 'left',
			nil, 'smile', 'sweat')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(magical_girl_student, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'cast', keep = true }, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'mm_magical_girl_s9_3_4_2')

	--시바링 (right, smile, happy) : 나도 네가 마법소녀가 되어줘서 너무 기쁘다뭉!
