function local_class:sunyeo_shoot(sunyeo, target_pos, direction, speed, char_dir, anim_name, play_explosion)
	direction = lua_helper.get_or_default(direction, 'right')
	speed = lua_helper.get_or_default(speed, 10)
	anim_name = lua_helper.get_or_default(anim_name, 'sunyeo/attack_manual')
	char_dir = lua_helper.get_or_default(char_dir, direction)
	play_explosion = lua_helper.get_or_default(play_explosion, (target_pos ~= nil and true or false))

	local start_pos = sunyeo.Position
	local end_pos = target_pos
	local diff = end_pos - start_pos
	local velocity = vector_util.magnitude(end_pos - start_pos)
	local normalized_diff = vector_util.normalized(diff)
	local duration = velocity / speed

	scene_util.set_direction(sunyeo, char_dir, false)

	if type_util.is_string(anim_name) then
		scene_util.set_anim(sunyeo, self, { name = anim_name, loop = false })
	else
		scene_util.set_anim(sunyeo, self, anim_name)
	end

	sunyeo.SpineController.AimPoint = vector(normalized_diff.x, normalized_diff.z + normalized_diff.y * 0.7071)

	local cast_fx_pos = sunyeo.Bounds.center + normalized_diff * 0.9
	local offset_table = {
		left = vector(0, 0, 0.3),
		right = vector(0, 0, -0.3),
		up = vector(0, 0, -0.2),
		down = vector(0, 0, -0.2),
	}

	--배틀 액션에 명시된 발사 타이밍 대기 시간…은 0.4초였으나 이상해서 변경
	local wait_time = 0.1
	wait_for_sec(wait_time)

	--다빈 평타 공격 애니메이션
	local get_xz_angle = function(target_vector)
		local x = target_vector.x
		--잔상 y위치 루트 2 만큼 곱해준 보정값만큼 다시 나눠주고, 그 값을 z값에 더함.
		local z = target_vector.z + target_vector.y * 0.7071
		local angle_rad = math.atan(z, x)  -- atan2(z, x) 사용
		local angle_deg = math.deg(angle_rad)  -- 라디안을 도(degree)로 변환

		if angle_deg < 0 then
			angle_deg = angle_deg + 360  -- 음수일 경우 보정
		end

		return angle_deg
	end

	--천자총통 위치에 fx_sunyeo_basic_fire
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_sunyeo_shoot_01')
	local fire = self.fx.sunyeo_fire():Instantiate(cast_fx_pos + offset_table[direction])
	fire.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -get_xz_angle(normalized_diff), 0)

	--fx_sunyeo_basic_proj 천자총통 총구 위치로부터 배전함까지 속도10로 이동
	local proj = self.fx.sunyeo_proj():Instantiate(cast_fx_pos + offset_table[direction])

	--fx_sunyeo_basic_proj에 fx_sunyeo_basic_proj_contrail 함께 출력
	local contrail = self.fx.sunyeo_contrail():Instantiate(cast_fx_pos + offset_table[direction])

	local eff_start_pos = cast_fx_pos + offset_table[direction]
	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local cur_pos = progress * end_pos + (1 - progress) * eff_start_pos
		proj.transform.localPosition = cur_pos
		contrail.transform.localPosition = cur_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--fx_sunyeo_basic_proj 목표지점에 도착하면 목표지점 위치에 fx_sunyeo_basic_proj_explosion
	if proj ~= nil then
		proj:Dispose()
		proj = nil
	end

	if contrail ~= nil then
		contrail:Dispose()
		contrail = nil
	end

	if play_explosion then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_sunyeo_cannon_shoot_02')
		self.fx.sunyeo_explosion():Instantiate(end_pos)
	end

	sunyeo.SpineController.AimPoint = nil
end

function local_class:start_scene(func, ...)
	local args = { ... }
	local routine = function()
		-- 이전 리더에 대한 정보를 미리 캐싱해둬야 해제가 가능함
		local cached_leader = get_party_leader()

		sp_util.enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false })

		yield_return_func(func, table.unpack(args))

		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, cached_leader)
	end

	return start_coroutine(routine)
end

function local_class:instantiate_fx_loop(fx, name, pos)
	if self.fx_list == nil then
		self.fx_list = {}
	end

	local fx_loop = fx:Instantiate(pos)
	self.fx_list[name] = fx_loop

function local_class:dispose_fx_all()
	if self.fx_list then
		for _, fx in pairs(self.fx_list) do
			if fx then
				fx:Dispose()
				fx = nil
			end
		end

		self.fx_list = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_fx_loop_list(fx_name)
	if type(fx_name) == "table" then
		for i = 1, #fx_name do
			local name = fx_name[i]

			local fx = self.fx_list[name]
			fx:Dispose()
			fx = nil
		end
	else
		local fx = self.fx_list[fx_name]
		fx:Dispose()
		fx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:play_sfx_ambient(data)
	self.ambi_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(data)

function local_class:change_sfx_ambient_volume(volume, duration)
	music_player_util.change_sfx_volume(self.ambi_sfx, volume, duration)

function local_class:finish_sfx_ambient(duration)

		music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(self.ambi_sfx, duration)
	else
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.ambi_sfx)
	end

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = pos, item_id = item_id, show_on_character = showoncharacter,
					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item

			return item
		end,
		get = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				return this.sprite_table[name]
			end

			return nil
		end,
		consumed = function(this, name, target)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				quest_drop_item_util.consumed(this.sprite_table[name], target)
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
		end
	}
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	local fence = self.object.fence()
	fence.Transform:Find('unbroken').gameObject:SetActive(true)
	fence.Transform:Find('broken').gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:start()
	start_coroutine(function()
		self.fx:load_async()

		if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
			sp_util.enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false })
		end

		self.fx:load_async()

		self:pre_setting()

		self:intro_scene()

		--배전함에 노란색 퀘스트 마커 출력
		quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
			{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.object.fence() },
		})

		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('sub_quest')
	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.broken_fence then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.object.fence()) then
			start_coroutine(self.interact_broken_breaker_panel, self)
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc.business(3)) then
			self.controller:start_scene(function()
				self:interact_business_3()
				self.controller:progress_section()
			end)
		end
	end

end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.npc.sunyeo(), self.zone_name.fence) and
			self.current_state == self.states.intro then

		self.controller:start_scene(function()
			self.current_state = self.states.fence
			self:fence_zone_scene()
			self.current_state = self.states.broken_fence
			quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
				{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.npc.business(3) },
			})
		end)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:pre_setting()
	local sunyeo = self.npc.sunyeo()

	character_util.set_position(sunyeo, self.marker.start_pos())
	character_util.set_direction(sunyeo, 'right')
end

function local_class:intro_scene()
	local sunyeo = self.npc.sunyeo()

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		self.controller:play_sfx_ambient({ sfx_name = '01_amb_city_03', fade_in_time = 2, volume = 0.7,
		                                   loop = true, type_priority = 'default' })
	end

	--2초에 걸쳐 페이드 인
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(2, unity_class.color.black)

	--다빈(right, idle, idle) : 문어 촉수를 달고 있는 자의 흔적을 쫓아 많은 곳을 다녔어요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(sunyeo, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'mm_sunyeo_main_s2_1')

	--다빈(right, idle, idle) : 그리고 이런 낯선 장소까지 도달하게 되었네요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(sunyeo, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'mm_sunyeo_main_s2_2')

	--다빈(right, attack, idle) : 이번에는 바다 마녀를 찾고야 말겠습니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(sunyeo, self, 'right',
			nil, 'attack', 'mm_sunyeo_main_s2_3')

	music_player:PlayStageIntroMusic()

	scene_util.show_weapon(sunyeo)
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString(stage.Name), 1)
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	party_util.set_direction('right')
	scene_util.set_anim(sunyeo, self, 'victory_get')
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(sunyeo)

	--플레이어 컨트롤 해제
	--다빈 메모리얼 단편집 ui 출력
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

	self.controller:finish_sfx_ambient(1)

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
end

function local_class:fence_zone_scene()
	local pivot_pos = self.marker.align_pos()

	local sunyeo = self.npc.sunyeo()
	local fence = self.object.fence()

	local business_1 = self.npc.business(1)
	local business_2 = self.npc.business(2)
	local business_3 = self.npc.business(3)
	local business_4 = self.npc.business(4)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--다빈 이벤트 존 진입 시
	--노란색 퀘스트 마커 제거

	--플레이어 컨트롤 뺏고 1초에 걸쳐 다빈(right, idle, idle) 이미지 위치로 정렬
	wp_util.move_async(sunyeo, pivot_pos, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'right' })

	--다빈(right, attack, attack 1회 후 idle) : 저기 문어 촉수가!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(sunyeo, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'attack', count = 1 }, 'attack', 'mm_sunyeo_main_s2_4')

	--1초에 걸쳐 현재 화면에서 배전함 포커스하여 카메라 4에서 3으로 줌인
	camera_util.move(fence.Position, 1)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3, 1)

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--다빈(right, attack, idle) : 이번에는 제대로 찾아온 것 같습니다!
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(sunyeo, self, 'right',
			nil, 'attack', { key = 'mm_sunyeo_main_s2_5', skip = true, viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2) })

	--1초에 걸쳐 포커스 다빈으로 변경하여 3에서 4로 줌 아웃
	camera_util.move(sunyeo.Position, 1)
	camera_util.resize_to_default_async(1)

	--cwp_sunyeo_epick 장착
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(sunyeo, '[base]weapon1', 'cwp_sunyeo')

	--다빈(right, attack, sunyeo/idle) : 포격 개시합니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_yagi_reload_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(sunyeo, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'sunyeo/idle', keep = true }, { name = 'attack', keep = true },
			'mm_sunyeo_main_s2_6')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--화면터치 QTE 활성화, QTE 화면터치 1회(실패 없음)
	qte_play_util.tap(1)
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--다빈(right, damaged, reload 1회) : 방포!
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(sunyeo, self, 'right',
						nil, 'damaged', 'mm_sunyeo_main_s2_7')
			end,
			function()

				time_util.mod('slow', 0.6)

				self.controller:sunyeo_shoot(sunyeo, fence.Position + vector(0, 1, 0), 'right', 20)

				--0.03값으로 화면 전체 shake 0.5
				camera_util.shake(0.03, 1.5)

				--(임시)obj_fence2 위치에 FX_Common_SmokeScreen
				local fence_pos = fence.Position
				self.fx.smoke_screen():Instantiate(fence_pos + vector(0, 0, 1))

				--(임시)obj_fence2 제거되고 (임시)wall_fence_1_1로 교체
				fence.Transform:Find('unbroken').gameObject:SetActive(false)
				fence.Transform:Find('broken').gameObject:SetActive(true)

				time_util.unmod('slow')
			end
	)

	character_util.remove_anim(sunyeo)

	--다빈(right, tired, cross_arm) : question 이모티콘 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(sunyeo, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'cross_arm', loop = false }, 'tired', 'question')
	--자세 유지

	--obj_building4에서 애니메이션 출력
	--obj_building4_ani, off 애니메이션 1회 출력 후, off_idle로 전환
	local building = self.object.building()
	animator_util.play(building, 'off')

	--건물 위치에 말풍선 출력

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--말풍선 : [shout](화면비 : x=0.63, y=0.7) 무슨 일이야!
				camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.25)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(business_1, {
					key = 'mm_sunyeo_main_s2_9',
					viewport_pos = vector(0.63, 0.7),
					skip = false,
					bubble_type = 'shout'
				})
			end,
			function()
				--‘무슨 일이야!’ 말풍선 출력 직후 0.5초 후
				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				--말풍선 : [shout](화면비 x=0.9, y=0.88) 전쟁인가…?
				camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.25)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_02')
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(business_2, {
					key = 'mm_sunyeo_main_s2_10',
					viewport_pos = vector(0.9, 0.88),
					skip = false,
					bubble_type = 'shout'
				})
			end,
			function()
				--‘전쟁이라고? 오늘 하루 종일 작업한 거 저장 안 했는데!!!’ 말풍선 출력 직후 0.5초 후
				wait_for_sec(1)

				--말풍선 : [shout])(화면비 x=0.86, y=0.68) 전쟁이라고? 오늘 하루 종일 작업한 거 저장 안 했는데!!!
				camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.25)
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(business_3, {
					key = 'mm_sunyeo_main_s2_11',
					viewport_pos = vector(0.86, 0.68),
					skip = false,
					bubble_type = 'shout'
				})
			end,
			function()
				wait_for_sec(1.5)

				--말풍선 : [shout](화면비x=0.57, y=0.9) 가, 강제 퇴근이다!!!
				camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.25)
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(business_4, {
					key = 'mm_sunyeo_main_s2_12',
					viewport_pos = vector(0.57, 0.9),
					skip = false,
					bubble_type = 'shout'
				})
			end
	)

	--동시연출
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--다빈(left, idle, idle)
				--0.8초 대기
				scene_util.set_direction(sunyeo, 'left', false)
				wait_for_sec(0.8)

				--다빈(right, idle, idle)
				--0.8초 대기
				scene_util.set_direction(sunyeo, 'right', false)
				wait_for_sec(0.8)

				--다빈(left, idle, idle)
				--0.8초 대기
				scene_util.set_direction(sunyeo, 'left', false)
				wait_for_sec(0.8)

				--다빈(right, idle, idle)
				--0.8초 대기
				scene_util.set_direction(sunyeo, 'right', false)
				wait_for_sec(0.8)
			end,
			function()
				local building_pivot_pos = pivot_pos + vector(2.5, 0, 2)
				local building_out_pos = pivot_pos + vector(2.5, 0, 0)
				local move_key = 's2_building_out'

				--회사원 마족1(이동방향, scared, walk) obj_building4 위치에서 생성되어 속도 4으로 [A]위치로 이동 후, 원라인 전환
				business_1.Position = building_pivot_pos
				field_object_util.set_active_state(business_1, active_state_type.enabled)

				local b1_wp = {
					building_out_pos + vector(0, 0, -1),
					building_out_pos + vector(-7.5, 0, -1),
				}

				scene_util.set_emotion(business_1, self, 'scared')
				character_util.remove_anim(business_1)
				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(business_1, b1_wp, 4, nil, self, move_key, { run = true, end_callback = function()
					--회사원 마족1(down, scared, cast) - 저, 저장 못 하고 나왔는데 어쩌지.
					scene_util.set_direction(business_1, 'down', false)
					scene_util.set_emotion(business_1, self, 'scared')
					scene_util.set_anim(business_1, self, 'cast')
					business_1.Interactable.Talk = 'mm_sunyeo_main_s2_oneline_1_1'
					business_1.Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_dialogue_sadness_02'
				end })

				--회사원 마족2(이동방향, scared, walk) obj_building4 위치에서 생성되어 속도 4.5으로 [B]위치로 이동 후 제거, 원라인 전환
				business_2.Position = building_pivot_pos
				field_object_util.set_active_state(business_2, active_state_type.enabled)

				local b2_wp = { building_out_pos + vector(0, 0, -2), building_out_pos + vector(-7.5, 0, -2) }

				scene_util.set_emotion(business_2, self, 'scared')
				character_util.remove_anim(business_2)
				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(business_2, b2_wp, 4.5, nil, self, move_key, { run = true, end_callback = function()
					--회사원 마족2(up, idle, idle) - 자동 저장 됐을거야 너무 걱정하지마.
					scene_util.set_direction(business_2, 'up', false)
					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()
					business_2.Interactable.Talk = 'mm_sunyeo_main_s2_oneline_1_2'
				end })

				--회사원 마족3(이동방향, smile,  walk) obj_building4 위치에서 생성되어 속도 4로 [C]위치로 이동 후, (left, smile, clap)
				business_3.Position = building_pivot_pos
				field_object_util.set_active_state(business_3, active_state_type.enabled)

				local b3_wp = { building_out_pos + vector(0, 0, -3), building_out_pos + vector(5, 0, -3) }

				scene_util.set_emotion(business_3, self, 'smile')
				character_util.remove_anim(business_3)
				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(business_3, b3_wp, 4, nil, self, move_key, { run = true, end_callback = function()
					character_util.set_direction(business_3, 'left')
					scene_util.set_emotion(business_3, self, 'smile')
					scene_util.set_anim(business_3, self, { name = 'clap', one_shot_sfx = false })

					--회사원 마족3
					business_3.Interactable.Talk = nil
					character_util.add_listener(business_3, self.controller)
				end })

				--회사원 마족(남)4 (이동방향, tired, run) obj_building4 위치에서 생성되어 속도 5.5으로 [D]위치로 이동 후, 원라인 전환
				business_4.Position = building_pivot_pos
				field_object_util.set_active_state(business_4, active_state_type.enabled)

				local b4_wp = {
					building_out_pos + vector(0, 0, -4),
					building_out_pos + vector(-5.5, 0, -4),
					building_out_pos + vector(-5.5, 0, 2)
				}

				scene_util.set_emotion(business_4, self, 'tired')
				character_util.remove_anim(business_4)
				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(business_4, b4_wp, 5.5, nil, self, move_key, { run = true, end_callback = function()
					--회사원 마족4(right, idle, cross_arm) - 한동안 휴가인가?
					scene_util.set_direction(business_4, 'right', false)
					character_util.remove_emotion(business_4)
					scene_util.set_anim(business_4, self, { name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false })
					business_4.Interactable.Talk = 'mm_sunyeo_main_s2_oneline_1_4'
					business_4.Interactable.TalkSfx = '01_rustle_01'
				end })

				wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
			end
	)

	--플레이어 컨트롤 해제
	--배전함 잔해에 하늘색 마커 출력
	--회사원 마족3에 퀘스트 마커 출력

	fence.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sunyeo)

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:interact_broken_breaker_panel()
	local sunyeo = self.npc.sunyeo()

	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(sunyeo, 'mm_sunyeo_main_s2_14', false)
end

function local_class:interact_business_3()
	local sunyeo = self.npc.sunyeo()
	local business_3 = self.npc.business(3)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--회사원 마족3과 인터랙트 시, 1초에 걸쳐 회사원 마족3에 좌측 정렬
	wp_util.move_async(sunyeo, business_3.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), nil, 1, { last_direction = 'right' })

	--다빈(right, tired, idle) : 저… 괜찮으신가요…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(sunyeo, self, 'right',
			nil, 'tired', 'mm_sunyeo_main_s2_17')

	--회사원 마족3(left, smile, nod 2회) : 괜찮고말고! 오히려 좋은걸!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(business_3, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, 'smile', 'mm_sunyeo_main_s2_18')

	--회사원 마족3(left, smile, cast2) : 하하하하. 방금 내 소원이 이뤄졌거든.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(business_3, self, 'left',
			'cast2', 'smile', 'mm_sunyeo_main_s2_19')

	--회사원 마족(left, smile, cast2) : 문어 촉수를 달고 있던 그 자가 진짜 내 소원을 들어 줬다고!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(business_3, self, 'left',
			'cast2', 'smile', 'mm_sunyeo_main_s2_20')

	--회사원 마족(left, smile, idle) : 출근을 하지 않게 해달라고 소원을 빌었었거든.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(business_3, self, 'left',
			nil, 'smile', 'mm_sunyeo_main_s2_21')

	--회사원 마족3(left, smile, staff_idle) : 그런데 방금 회사 전기가 나가버렸지 뭐야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(business_3, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'staff_idle', one_shot_sfx = '01_swing_01' }, 'smile', 'mm_sunyeo_main_s2_22')

	--회사원 마족3(left, awesome, idle) : 복구되려면 한참 걸릴 것 같데
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(business_3, self, 'left',
			nil, { name = 'awesome', keep = true }, 'mm_sunyeo_main_s2_23')

	--회사원 마족3(left, awesome, cast2) : 하하하하, 이제 쉴 수 있게 됐어!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(business_3, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'cast2', one_shot_sfx = '01_swing_01' }, nil, 'mm_sunyeo_main_s2_24')

	wait_all_lua(

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'memorial_sunyeo'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		first_zone_scene = 2,
		second_zone_scene = 3,
		done = 999
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	--region Character

	self.get_character = {
		--다빈
		sunyeo = function()
			return get_character('sunyeo')
		end,
		octopus_salesman = function()
			return get_character('octopus_salesman')
		end,
		--회사원 1~4
		business = function(idx)
			return get_character('s2_oneline_' .. idx)
		end
	}

	--endregion Character

	--region Dynamic_npc
	--동적 할당 정보
	self.dynamic_npcs = {
		first_dynamic_npc = {
			npc_list = {},
			dynamic_npc_name = 'first_dynamic_npc_',
			dynamic_npc_data = nil
		},
		create_npcs = function(this)
			for name, npc_data in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'create_npcs' and name ~= 'dispose_all' and name ~= 'dispose_target' then
					-- 적 동적 생성
					local dynamic_npc_spec = {}

					for i = 1, #npc_data.dynamic_npc_data do
						dynamic_npc_spec[npc_data.dynamic_npc_name .. i] = npc_data.dynamic_npc_data[i]
					end

					npc_data.npc_list = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(dynamic_npc_spec)

					for i = 1, #npc_data.dynamic_npc_data do
						npc_data.npc_list[npc_data.dynamic_npc_name .. i].Position = self.wait_pos
					end
				end
			end
		end,
		dispose_target = function(target_list)
			load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(target_list)
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			for name, npc_data in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'create_npcs' and name ~= 'dispose_all' and name ~= 'dispose_target' then
					if npc_data.npc_list then
						load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(npc_data.npc_list)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	}
	--endregion Dynamic_npc

	--region Sprite

	self.sprite = {
		sprite_info = {
			turkey = 21734,
		},
		sprite_table = {},
		sprite_table_origin_parent = {},
		create = function(this, name, pos, item_id, scale, showoncharacter, target, drop_type, skip_text)
			scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
			showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, false)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = pos, item_id = item_id, show_on_character = showoncharacter,
					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = item.SpriteTransform.parent

			return item
		end,
		fly = function(this, name, target)
			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end
	}

	--endregion Sprite

	--region Marker

	self.get_marker_pos = {
		center = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_center_pos_' .. number)
		end,

		sunyeo = function(scene, pos_number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_sunyeo_' .. scene .. '_' .. pos_number)
		end,
	}

	--endregion Marker

	--region Fx

	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,

		lasthit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,

		smoke_screen = function()

		end,

		food_smoke = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_mm_sy_food_smoke')
		end,
	})

	self.fx_list = nil

	--endregion Fx

	--region etc

	self.wait_pos = vector(999, 0, 999)
	self.zone_name = 's3_zone_'

	--endregion
end

function local_class:npc_setting(npc_data)
	for _, target_data in pairs(npc_data) do
		local target = target_data.target
		local target_pos = target_data.pos
		local target_dir = target_data.dir
		local target_emo = target_data.emo
		local target_anim = target_data.anim
		local target_tint = target_data.tint
		local target_shake = target_data.shake
		local target_is_anim_loop = target_data.is_anim_loop
		local target_effect = target_data.effect
		local target_alpha = target_data.alpha
		local target_function = target_data.coroutine_function
		local target_listener = target_data.listener
		local target_is_not_active = target_data.is_not_active
		local target_oneline_key = target_data.oneline_key
		local target_crash_behaviour = target_data.crash_behaviour
		local target_is_leader = target_data.is_leader
		local target_anim_scale = target_data.anim_scale

		character_util.spine_rotate(target, 0, 0)

		if target_is_not_active then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.disabled)
		else
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.enabled)
		end

		if target_crash_behaviour then
			target.CrashBehaviour = target_crash_behaviour
		end

		if not target_is_leader then
			target.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()
		end

		character_util.set_position(target, target_pos)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)

		scene_util.set_direction(target, target_dir, false)

		if target_emo then
			scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, target_emo)
		end

		if target_oneline_key then
			target.Interactable.Talk = target_oneline_key
		end

		if target_listener then
			character_util.add_listener(target, self.controller)
		end

		if target_anim then
			scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = target_anim, scale = target_anim_scale, loop = target_is_anim_loop, one_shot_sfx = false })
		end

		if target_shake then
			scene_util.shake(target, target_shake, 9999, false)
		end

		if target_tint then
			character_util.add_color(target, 'dark_tint', target_tint.color, target_tint.magnitude, 0)
		end

		if target_alpha then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(target, target_alpha, 0)
		end

		if target_effect then
			local fx = target_effect():Instantiate(target.Position)
			self.fx_list[target.Name] = fx
		end

		if target_function then
			start_coroutine(function()
				target_function(target)
			end)
		end
	end
end

		scene_util.set_direction(business_4, 'right', false)

		business_2.Interactable.Talk = 'mm_sunyeo_main_s2_oneline_2_2'
		business_2.Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_dialogue_tipsy_01'

		--회사원 마족3(left, scared, idle) - 자료 복구 작업 때문에 풀야근에 주말 출근까지…? 내가 속은거야…?
		scene_util.set_direction(business_3, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(business_3, self, 'scared')
		character_util.remove_anim(business_3)
		business_3.Interactable.Talk = 'mm_sunyeo_main_s2_oneline_2_3'
		business_3.Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_dialogue_sadness_01'

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(business_4)

	end

	}

		none = 1,

		event_1 = 2,
		-- 4섹션 이벤트 2를 보는 중

		-- 4섹션에서 이벤트 두개 이상 깼을 때,
		event_2 = 4,
	}

	self.cur_section_event_state = self.section_event_state.none

	self.get_fx_smoke = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_smokescreen')
	end

	self.fx = {
		cached_inst = {},

		food_smoke = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_mm_sy_food_smoke')
		end,

		cache = function(this, fx, key)
			if this.cached_inst == nil then
				this.cached_inst = {}
			end

			this.cached_inst[key] = fx
		end,

		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if type_util.is_function(load_func) and
						name ~= 'load_all' and
						name ~= 'cache' and
						name ~= 'dispose' and
						name ~= 'dispose_all' then

					load_func()
				end
			end
		end,

		dispose = function(this, key)
			this.cached_inst[key]:Dispose()
			this.cached_inst[key] = nil
		end,

		dispose_all = function(this, clear_table)
			for _, cashed_fx in pairs(this.cached_inst) do
				cashed_fx:Dispose()
				cashed_fx = nil
			end

			if clear_table then
				this.cached_inst = nil
			end
		end
	}

	self.dynamic_npc = nil
	self.is_loaded = false

	self.cached_turkey_item = nil
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.mini_event_controller:exit()
	self.mini_event_controller:dispose()
	self.mini_event_controller = nil

	self:dispose_turkey_item()
	self:dispose_dynamic_npc()

	if self.fx ~= nil then
		self.fx:dispose_all(true)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	self.mini_event_controller:on_event(e)
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.cur_section_event_state ~= self.section_event_state.event_1 then
		return false
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's4_event_1_zone') then
		self.cur_section_event_state = self.section_event_state.event_1_showing
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
		start_coroutine(self.first_clear_event, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:load_mini_event_state()
	local cur_mini_event_state_pack = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, self.mini_event_save_state_key)

	-- 0 미만이면 등록된게 없으므로 return
	if cur_mini_event_state_pack < 0 then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, #self.mini_event_save_state do
		local is_clear = ((cur_mini_event_state_pack >> (i - 1)) & 0x1) or (cur_mini_event_state_pack & 0x1)
		self.mini_event_save_state[i] = is_clear
	end
end

-- 미니 이벤트 클리어 했는지
function local_class:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(mini_event_id)
	if #self.mini_event_save_state < mini_event_id then
		return false
	end

	return self.mini_event_save_state[mini_event_id] > 0
end

-- 현재 퀘스트 스테이트들을 합친 값 구하기
function local_class:get_pack_state_value()
	local data = 0
	local state = self.mini_event_save_state

	for i = 1, #state do
		local value = i > 1 and ((state[i] << (i - 1)) & (0x1 << (i - 1))) or (state[i] & 0x1)
		data = data | value
	end

	return data
end

function local_class:save_mini_event_cleared_state(mini_event_id)
	-- 이벤트 아이디에 해당하는 퀘스트를 1로
	self.mini_event_save_state[mini_event_id] = 1

	-- 미니이벤트 플래그 합친 값으로 저장
	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, self.mini_event_save_state_key,
			self:get_pack_state_value())

	local clear_count = self:get_clear_count()

	if clear_count >= 1 and self.cur_section_event_state == self.section_event_state.none then
		-- 클리어 카운트가 1 이상이면서 아직 아무이벤트도 안 본 상태라면 이벤트 1 세팅
		self.cur_section_event_state = self.section_event_state.event_1
		self:load_event_1_npc_async()
	elseif clear_count >= 2 and self.cur_section_event_state < self.section_event_state.event_2 then
		-- 클리어 카운트 2이상일 경우 npc 변경
		self.cur_section_event_state = self.section_event_state.event_2

		self:dispose_turkey_item()
		self:dispose_dynamic_npc()
		self:set_event_2_npc()
	end

	-- 3 이상일 경우에는 원라인 교체
	if clear_count >= #self.mini_event_save_state then
		local clear_oneline_number = { 1, 2, 3 }
		local active_oneline_number = { 4, 5, 6 }
		local count = 3

		for index = 1, count do
			local clear_oneline = get_character('s4_oneline_' .. clear_oneline_number[index])
			local active_oneline = get_character('s4_oneline_' .. active_oneline_number[index])

			field_object_util.set_active_state(clear_oneline, active_state_type.disabled)
			field_object_util.set_active_state(active_oneline, active_state_type.enabled)
		end

		self.controller:progress_section()
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)

			return true
		end
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_info.meet_sea_witch.name) then

		end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	-- 아라의 hp가 50% 이하로 떨어지면
	if self.current_state == self.states.fight_sea_witch and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.character.sea_witch()) then
		local current_hp_percentage = e.Info.target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HpRatio * 100
		local hp_percentage = 50

		if current_hp_percentage <= hp_percentage then
			self.current_state = self.states.battle_end_event

			-- 배틀 강제 종료
			stage.BattleManager:ForceEndBattles()

			start_coroutine(self.process_battle_end_event, self)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_current_scene_npc(section_state)
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[section_state]

	if pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	linq(pre_npc_data):foreach(function(_, npc_data)
		local npc = get_character(npc_data.name)

		if npc == nil then
			if npc_data.name == 'leader' then
				npc = user_party.Leader
			else
				return
			end
		end

		if npc_data.remove_lv_ui ~= nil and npc_data.remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		npc_data.active_state = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.active_state, active_state_type.enabled)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, npc_data.active_state)


		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if npc_data.pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if npc_data.fly ~= nil and npc_data.fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, npc_data.pos, isFlying)
		end

		if npc_data.dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, npc_data.dir, false)
		end

		if npc_data.emo ~= nil then
			if npc_data.emo == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, npc_data.emo)
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_info ~= nil then
			if npc_data.anim_info == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			elseif type_util.is_table(npc_data.anim_info) then
				npc_data.anim_info.one_shot_sfx = false

				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, npc_data.anim_info)
			elseif type_util.is_string(npc_data.anim_info) then
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = npc_data.anim_info, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_time_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, npc_data.anim_time_scale)
		end

		if npc_data.alpha_value ~= nil then
			local alpha_duration = 0

			if npc_data.alpha_duration ~= nil then
				alpha_duration = npc_data.alpha_duration
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, npc_data.alpha_value, alpha_duration)
		end

		if npc_data.keep_shake ~= nil and npc_data.keep_shake == true then
			character_util.shake(npc, npc_data.shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if npc_data.sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', npc_data.sorting_layer)
		end

		if npc_data.start_deactive_shadow then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, false)
		end

		if npc_data.scale_factor ~= nil then
			character_util.set_scale_factor(npc, npc.Name, npc_data.scale_factor)
		end

		if npc_data.tint_color then
			local tint_color_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.tint_color_magnitude, 1)

			character_util.add_color(npc, npc_data.tint_color_key, npc_data.tint_color, tint_color_magnitude, 0.1)
		end

		if npc_data.talk ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk) then
			if not lua_helper.type_compare(npc.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
				npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			end

			npc.Interactable.Talk = npc_data.talk
		end

		if npc_data.talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk_sfx) then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = npc_data.talk_sfx
		end

		if npc_data.hitbox ~= nil then
			npc.Hitbox = npc_data.hitbox
		end

		npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end)
end

function local_class:falling_citizen_event()
	self.controller.s5_dynamic_npcs:load_async(self.controller.load_dyn_npc_scene.falling_citizen)
	local civil = self.controller.s5_dynamic_npcs:get('s5_civil_1')
	local sunyeo = self.character.sunyeo()
	local civil_pos = self.marker.civil(1, 1)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--이미지 위치에 1초에 걸쳐 정렬
	local move_pos_list = {
		self.marker.sunyeo(2, 1),
	}
	wp_util.move_async(sunyeo, move_pos_list, 4, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

	--아래의 항목 동시에 실행
	--다빈 (right, attack, idle) 실행 후 유지.
	--마족 1 : [shout] 이세계야 내가 간다아아아아아아!!!
	--위치 : x 0.7 / y 0.7
	--크기 : 1.3배
	--화면 0.3 / 0.3 shake 실행.
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(sunyeo, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
			{ key = 'mm_sunyeo_main_s5_2_0', scale = 1.3, viewport_pos = vector(0.7, 0.7), skip = false, force_sfx = true })

	start_coroutine(function()
		local fall_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fall_down_01', type_priority = 'event', loop = true })

		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(fall_sfx, 0.5)
		fall_sfx = nil
	end)

	local outside_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right', civil_pos, 5)
	--outside_pos = outside_pos + vector(0, 10, 0)

	time_util.mod('mod_key', 0.3)

	scene_util.set_emotion(civil, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(civil, self, { name = 'embarrassed', one_shot_sfx = false })

	--Section1의 마족1이 이미지상 타일 위치에서 생성 후, 마족1이 y좌표 3에서 0.5초에 걸쳐쳐 포물선을 그리면서 360도 회전하면서 [A]위치로 이동.(1.5초간 타임 스케일 0.3배)
	character_util.spine_rotate(civil, 360, 0.5)
	--sp_util.sine_move(civil, { from = outside_pos, to = civil_pos,
	--								 duration = 0.5, height = 2.0})
	self:sine_move(civil, outside_pos, civil_pos, 0.5, 5)

	time_util.unmod('mod_key')

	character_util.set_position(civil, vector(civil.Position.x, 0, civil.Position.z))

	--마족1(left, damaged, prostrate)
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--02_hit_big_01 + 01_trip_03
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_03')
				scene_util.set_direction(civil, 'left', false)
				scene_util.set_anim_async(civil, self, { name = 'prostrate', keep_anim = true })
				scene_util.set_emotion(civil, self, 'damaged')
			end,
			function()
				--마족1 npc 플레이어가 통과하지 않게 적용 부탁드립니다.
				civil.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

function local_class:sine_move(npc, start_pos, end_pos, duration, height)
	local time_passed = 0
	local progress = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local lerp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height + lerp_pos.y
		local cur_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(lerp_pos, cur_y)
		npc.Position = cur_pos
		npc.SpineController.ShadowTransform.position = vector_util.get_x0z(lerp_pos) + vector(0, 0.05, 0)
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	npc.Position = end_pos
end

	self.current_state = self.states.fight_sea_witch

	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
end

function local_class:activate_battle()
	local sea_witch = self.character.sea_witch()

	character_util.convert_to_monster(sea_witch, self.battle_group_name, self.battle_zone_name)

	character_util.set_death_type(sea_witch, death_type_constants.none)

	command_util.publish_monster_notice(sea_witch, get_party_leader(), 'battle')
end

function local_class:control_battle_gates(state)
	for i = 1, self.battle_gate_count do
		if state == 'close' then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('sea_witch_battlegate_' .. i))
		elseif state == 'open' then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('sea_witch_battlegate_' .. i, false))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:process_battle_end_event()
	local sunyeo = self.character.sunyeo()
	local sea_witch = self.character.sea_witch()

	sp_util.enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false })

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('combat', 0.6)

			{ name = 'sunyeo/idle', keep = true }, { name = 'attack', keep = true },

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

		--D 지점에 생성된 촉수 중심으로 fx_sea_witch_role_atk_decal_loop 실행 시작.

		scene_util.set_direction(sunyeo, 'up', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(sunyeo, self, 'attack')

		--실행 완료까지 대기 후, 0.5초 추가 대기.

	do
		--E지점 동시 실행

		character_util.set_position(tentacle_2, e_pos)
		character_util.set_active_shadow(tentacle_2, false)

	local item = nil
	local bone_follower = nil

	local custom_sprite = nil

		--F지점 동시 실행

		wait_for_sec(0.1)

		wait_all_lua(
				function()
					--다빈(left, damaged, prostrate) 자세로 속도4로 y좌표 최대 0.5까지 상승하며 1타일 우측으로 이동.(애니메이션 스케일 0.5배)

					scene_util.set_anim(sunyeo, self, { name = 'prostrate' })

					--02_octo_hit_01 + 01_trip_02
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_octo_hit_01')
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_02')

					wp_util.move_async(sunyeo,
							sunyeo.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),

				function()
					--다빈 장비 장착 해제 + 다빈 중심에서부터 0의 사이즈로 0.8초에 걸쳐 문어 손 지점에 이동하며 사이즈 0.75로 상승시킴.
					scene_util.set_direction(sunyeo, 'left', false)
					scene_util.set_emotion(sunyeo, self, 'damaged')
					scene_util.set_anim(sunyeo, self, { name = 'prostrate', scale = 0.5 })

					item = self.sprite:create('sunyeo_gun_1', sunyeo.Bounds.center, self.sprite.sprite_info.gun, 0)
					custom_sprite = item.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

					local duration = 0.8

					quest_drop_item_util.scale(item, vector(0.7, 0.7, 0.7), duration)
					quest_drop_item_util.move_async(item,
							tentacle_3.Bounds.center + vector(-0.3, 1.1, 0), { duration = duration })

					custom_sprite.PixelToWorld = current_pixel_to_world * 0.7
					custom_sprite:Rebuild()
					bone_follower = self:attach_spine(tentacle_3, item, 'leg6')
				end

	scene_util.set_anim_async(sea_witch, self, { name = 'clap', count = 2 })

	--0.3초 대기.

	--D 지점 촉수 (right, idle, attack) 을 실행하고, 실행 타이밍에 맞춰 부착된 천자총통을 15의 속도로 Y 7 높이, 우상단 화면 바깥 지점으로 날아간 뒤 화면 이탈 후 사라짐.
	do
		local outside_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos(
				'right', sunyeo.Position, 3)

		self:detach_spine(bone_follower)

		scene_util.set_anim(tentacle_3, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_01')
		quest_drop_item_util.rotate(item, 360, 0.75)
		sp_util.sine_move(item, { from = item.Position, to = outside_pos,
		                          duration = 0.75, height = 7.0 })

		-- PixelToWorld 원복
		custom_sprite.PixelToWorld = current_pixel_to_world
		custom_sprite:Rebuild()

		self.sprite:dispose('sunyeo_gun_1')
	end

	--다빈(left, attack, prostrate) : 아, 안돼! 천자총통이!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(sunyeo, self, 'left',
			nil, 'attack', 'mm_sunyeo_main_s5_4_4')

	--아래 항목 동시에 실행
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--해당 시점 이후 다빈 prostrate 애니메이션에서부터 idle을 이어서 2초간 실행. 해당 연출은 대기하지 않음.
				scene_util.set_anim(sunyeo, self, { name = 'idle', mix_duration = 2 })

				--다빈 0.01 / 지속 shake 시작.
				scene_util.shake(sunyeo, 0.01, 9999)

				-- 해당 시점부터 다빈 tired 이모션 지속.
				scene_util.set_emotion(sunyeo, self, 'tired')

				wait_for_sec(2)
			end,
			function()
				--아라(right, smile, idle) : 아하하, 이제 더 수는 없겠지? 귀찮은 선녀.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(sea_witch, self, 'right',
						nil, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'mm_sunyeo_main_s5_4_5')

				--아라(right, smile, idle) : 그 같잖은 화포는 네 손을 떠났다. 너에게 있는 건 흔해빠진 몸뚱아리 뿐.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(sea_witch, self, 'right',
						nil, nil, 'mm_sunyeo_main_s5_4_5_1')

				--아라(right, doyagao, idle) : 보잘것없는 선녀 주제에… 이제 뭘 할 수 있겠느냐?
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(sea_witch, self, 'right',
						nil, { name = 'doyagao', keep = true }, 'mm_sunyeo_main_s5_4_6')

			end
	)
	--이후 아라 대사, 다빈 연출 모두 완료되는 시점까지 대기.

	--다빈 (left, sleep_deep, idle) 상태로 silence 이모티콘 출력 후 완료까지 대기.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(sunyeo, self, nil,

	character_util.stop_shake(sunyeo)

	--다빈(left, sleep_deep, idle) : 그래요. 당신의 말대로 전 보잘것없는 선녀입니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(sunyeo, self, 'left',
			nil, { name = 'sleep_deep', keep = true }, 'mm_sunyeo_main_s5_4_8')

	--다빈 : 하지만 우리 선녀들은 항상 답을 찾아왔습니다.
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(sunyeo, 'mm_sunyeo_main_s5_4_9')

	--다빈(left, sleep_deep, idle) :  도력이 없는 선배들이… 물리력이라는 해답을 찾아 다리를 연마하고…
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(sunyeo, 'mm_sunyeo_main_s5_4_9_1')

	--다빈(left, sleep_deep, idle) : 지금도 선녀들은 악을 뿌리뽑기 위해 새로운 힘을 찾고 있습니다.
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(sunyeo, 'mm_sunyeo_main_s5_4_9_2')

	--다빈(left, attack, idle) : 그들이 포기하지 않는 한… 저도 선녀로서 포기할 수 없어요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(sunyeo, self, 'left',
			nil, 'attack', 'mm_sunyeo_main_s5_4_10')

	--다빈(left, attack, release 2회 후 idle) : 악을 무찌르는 것에 포기란 없으니까!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(sunyeo, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'mm_sunyeo_main_s5_4_11')

	self.controller:progress_section()
end

function local_class:attach_spine(fo, fx_target, bone_name)
	local bone_follower = fx_target.SpriteTransform.gameObject:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))

	--leg4

	--leg6
	--leg7
	--leg8

	return bone_follower
end

function local_class:detach_spine(bone_follower)
	CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(bone_follower)
end

return local_class

		end,
	}

	-- dynamic_npc

				s6_sea_witch_tentacle_1_3 = 'memorial_sunyeo_sea_witch_tentacle',
				s6_sea_witch_tentacle_1_4 = 'memorial_sunyeo_sea_witch_tentacle',
				s6_sea_witch_tentacle_1_5 = 'memorial_sunyeo_sea_witch_tentacle',
				s6_sea_witch_tentacle_1_6 = 'memorial_sunyeo_sea_witch_tentacle',

				s6_sea_witch_tentacle_2_1 = 'memorial_sunyeo_sea_witch_tentacle',
				s6_sea_witch_tentacle_2_2 = 'memorial_sunyeo_sea_witch_tentacle',
				s6_sea_witch_tentacle_2_3 = 'memorial_sunyeo_sea_witch_tentacle',
				s6_sea_witch_tentacle_2_4 = 'memorial_sunyeo_sea_witch_tentacle',
				s6_sea_witch_tentacle_2_5 = 'memorial_sunyeo_sea_witch_tentacle',
				s6_sea_witch_tentacle_2_6 = 'memorial_sunyeo_sea_witch_tentacle',

				s6_sea_witch_tentacle_2_8 = 'memorial_sunyeo_sea_witch_tentacle',
			},
		},
		get = function(this, key)
			return this.container[key]
		end,
		load_async = function(this, section_state)
			if this.count == 0 then
				this.container = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(this.specs[section_state])
			else
				local new_container = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(this.specs[section_state])

				for key, value in pairs(new_container) do
					this.container[key] = value
				end
			end

			this.count = table_util.get_size(this.container)
		end,
		dispose = function(this)
			if this.container == nil then
				return
			end

			for idx = 1, #this.container do
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(this.container[idx])
			end

			load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(this.container)

			this.container = nil

			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_m_sunyeo_support_fire')
		end,

			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_m_sunyeo_support_hit')
		end,

		water_splash_out = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_common_water_splash_out')
		end,

			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_mm_sy_common_water_splash_out')
		end,

		end,

		tentacle_loop = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_m_seawitch_tentacle_loop')
		end,

		water_splash_loop = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_mm_sy_fish_water_splash2_loop')
		end,
	})

	--region Sprite
	self.sprite = {
		sprite_info = {
			gun = 21744,
		},

		sprite_table = {},
		create = function(this, name, pos, item_id, scale, showoncharacter, target, drop_type, skip_text)
			scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
			showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, false)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = pos, item_id = item_id, show_on_character = showoncharacter,
					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item

			return item
		end,
		get = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				return this.sprite_table[name]
			end

			return nil
		end,
		consumed = function(this, name, target)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				quest_drop_item_util.consumed(this.sprite_table[name], target)
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
		end
	}
	--endregion Sprite
end

function local_class:start()
	self:set_pre_npc()

	start_coroutine(function()

			sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

			self:set_tentacle()

			self:set_current_scene_npc(self.states.none)

			screen_util.fade_out(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'event', name = 'bgm_suspense_theme', volume = 0.6 })
		end

		start_coroutine(self.android_appears_event, self)
	end)

function local_class:set_current_scene_npc(section_state)
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[section_state]

	if pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	linq(pre_npc_data):foreach(function(_, npc_data)
		local npc = get_character(npc_data.name)

		if npc == nil then
			if npc_data.name == 'leader' then
				npc = user_party.Leader
			else
				return
			end
		end

		if npc_data.remove_lv_ui ~= nil and npc_data.remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		npc_data.active_state = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.active_state, active_state_type.enabled)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, npc_data.active_state)


		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if npc_data.pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if npc_data.fly ~= nil and npc_data.fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, npc_data.pos, isFlying)
		end

		if npc_data.dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, npc_data.dir, false)
		end

		if npc_data.emo ~= nil then
			if npc_data.emo == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, npc_data.emo)
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_info ~= nil then
			if npc_data.anim_info == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			elseif type_util.is_table(npc_data.anim_info) then
				npc_data.anim_info.one_shot_sfx = false

				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, npc_data.anim_info)
			elseif type_util.is_string(npc_data.anim_info) then
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = npc_data.anim_info, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_time_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, npc_data.anim_time_scale)
		end

		if npc_data.alpha_value ~= nil then
			local alpha_duration = 0

			if npc_data.alpha_duration ~= nil then
				alpha_duration = npc_data.alpha_duration
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, npc_data.alpha_value, alpha_duration)
		end

		if npc_data.keep_shake ~= nil and npc_data.keep_shake == true then
			character_util.shake(npc, npc_data.shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if npc_data.sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', npc_data.sorting_layer)
		end

		if npc_data.start_deactive_shadow then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, false)
		end

		if npc_data.scale_factor ~= nil then
			character_util.set_scale_factor(npc, npc.Name, npc_data.scale_factor)
		end

		if npc_data.tint_color then
			local tint_color_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.tint_color_magnitude, 1)

			character_util.add_color(npc, npc_data.tint_color_key, npc_data.tint_color, tint_color_magnitude, 0.1)
		end

		if npc_data.talk ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk) then
			if not lua_helper.type_compare(npc.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
				npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			end

			npc.Interactable.Talk = npc_data.talk
		end

		if npc_data.talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk_sfx) then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = npc_data.talk_sfx
		end

		if npc_data.hitbox ~= nil then
			npc.Hitbox = npc_data.hitbox
		end

		npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end)
end

function local_class:android_appears_event()
	local sunyeo = self.character.sunyeo()
	local sea_witch = self.character.sea_witch()
	local cleaner = self.character.clean_android()
	local fat = self.character.fat_android()
	local fat_weapon = self.character.fat_android_weapon()
	local detective = self.character.detective_android()

	self.current_state = self.states.battle_end_event

	--아라 무기 제거
	scene_util.hide_weapon(sea_witch)

	camera_util.set_position(self.marker.prev_section_sea_witch(3, 1) + vector(2, 0, 0))

	local outside_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', self.marker.clean_android(1, 1), -2)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(cleaner, active_state_type.enabled)
	character_util.set_position(cleaner, outside_pos + vector(-4, 0, 0))
	scene_util.set_direction(cleaner, 'up', false)
	cleaner.Interactable.Talk = ''

	field_object_util.set_active_state(detective, active_state_type.enabled)
	character_util.set_position(detective, self.marker.detective_android(1, 1))
	character_util.set_position(detective, outside_pos + vector(-2, 0, 0))
	scene_util.set_direction(detective, 'up', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(detective, self, { name = 'hold_loop', upper = true })
	detective.Interactable.Talk = ''

	field_object_util.set_active_state(fat, active_state_type.enabled)
	character_util.set_position(fat, outside_pos)
	scene_util.set_direction(fat, 'up', false)
	fat.Interactable.Talk = ''

	local item = self.sprite:create('sunyeo_gun', vector(999, 0, 999), self.sprite.sprite_info.gun, 0.7)
	self.item_linked_npc = false
	start_coroutine(function()
		self.item_linked_npc = true

		while self.item_linked_npc do
			if item ~= nil and item.Position ~= nil then
				item.Position = detective.Position + vector(0, 1, 0)
			else
				break
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end)

	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	end

	--다빈 (down, attack, cast) 실행 후 유지.
	scene_util.set_direction(sunyeo, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(sunyeo, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(sunyeo, self, 'cast')

	--화면 0.3 / 0.3 shake 실행.
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

	start_coroutine(function()
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0, 0.5)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'event', name = 'bgm_battle_event', volume = 0.6 })
	end)

	--말풍선 : [shout 1.3배] (화면비 x=0.2, y=0.2) 맞아요! 아직 포기하긴 일러요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cleaner, { key = 'mm_sunyeo_main_s6_1_1', skip = true,
														   bubble_type = 'shout', scale = 1.3, viewport_pos = vector(0.2, 0.2) })

	-- 동시연출
	--청소부 안드로이드, 형사 안드로이드, 덩치 안드로이드 카메라 밖에서 생성 후
	--청소부 안드(이동방향, idle, run) [C]위치로 4초에 걸쳐 이동.
	--형사 안드(이동방향, idle, hold_loop) 자세로 천자총통cwp_sunyeo을 들고 [B]위치로 4초에 걸쳐 이동.
	--덩치 안드(이동방향, idle, walk)[A]위치로 4초에 걸쳐 이동.

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--카메라 중심 4초에 걸쳐 연두 지점으로 이동.
				camera_util.move_async(self.marker.camera(1, 1), 4)
			end,
			function()
				local align_key = 'party_wp'

				local move_pos_list = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(cleaner,
						self.marker.clean_android(1, 2), true)
				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(cleaner, move_pos_list, nil, 4,
						self, align_key, { run = true, last_direction = 'left' })

				move_pos_list = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(detective,
						self.marker.detective_android(1, 2), true)
				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(detective, move_pos_list, nil, 4,
						self, align_key, { run = true, last_direction = 'left' })

				move_pos_list = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(fat,
						self.marker.fat_android(1, 2), true)
				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fat, move_pos_list, nil, 4,
						self, align_key, { run = true, last_direction = 'left' })

				wp_util.wait_move_end(self, align_key)
			end
	)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--다빈 (right, attack, cast) 실행 후 유지.
	scene_util.set_direction(sunyeo, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(sunyeo, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(sunyeo, self, 'cast')

	character_util.remove_anim(detective, true)


	--형사 안드(left, idle, throw 1회 후 idle)
	--형사가 들고있던 천자총통(cwp_sunyeo) 제거 후, 해당 지점에서부터 다빈의 위치까지 drop item을 실행하여 천자총통(cwp_sunyeo)이 다빈 위치까지 날아감.
	scene_util.set_anim(detective, self, { name = 'throw', count = 1 })

	local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(detective, 'throw')

	self.item_linked_npc = false

	wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.5)

	self.sprite:dispose('sunyeo_gun')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_01')
	self.sprite:create('sunyeo_gun_2', detective.Position, self.sprite.sprite_info.gun, 0.7, true,
			sunyeo.Position, quest_drop_item_drop_type.physics, true)

	wait_for_sec(0.75)

	--천자총통(cwp_sunyeo)에게 닿으면 fx_get 와 함께 다빈에게 획득되고, 다빈(right, attack, sunyeo/idle) + 천자총통 장착 상태로 변경.
	scene_util.set_direction(sunyeo, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(sunyeo, self, 'attack')
	self.controller:show_weapon(sunyeo)
	character_util.remove_anim(sunyeo)

	self.sprite:consumed('sunyeo_gun_2', sunyeo)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--다빈(right, smile, sunyeo/idle) : 이건 제 천자총통…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(sunyeo, self, 'right',
			nil, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'mm_sunyeo_main_s6_1_1_1')

	--청소부 안드(left, smile, idle) : 이게 필요하신거죠?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(cleaner, self, 'left',
			nil, 'smile', 'mm_sunyeo_main_s6_1_2')

	--덩치 안드(left, idle, idle) : 네가 우리를 도와준 것처럼!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fat, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'mm_sunyeo_main_s6_1_3')

	--형사 안드(left, smlie, idle) : 이번에는 내가 당신을 돕겠소!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective, self, 'left',
			nil, 'smile', 'mm_sunyeo_main_s6_1_4')

	--아래의 항목 동시에 실행,
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--카메라 연두 지점 중심으로 0.5초에 걸쳐 이동.
				camera_util.move_async(self.marker.camera(1, 2), 0.5)

function local_class:screen_out_fly_away_async(fo, target_pos, duration, dir, rotate, scale)
	character_util.spine_rotate(fo, dir * rotate * 360, duration + 0.2)
	character_util.spine_scale(fo, unity_class.vector3.one * scale, duration)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(fo, false)

	local start_pos = fo.Position
	local end_pos = target_pos

	fo.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Top Effects', 1000)

	self:sine_move(fo, start_pos, end_pos, duration, 4)

	--초기화
	fo.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 0)

	character_util.spine_rotate(fo, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_scale(fo, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(fo, true)
end

function local_class:sine_move(npc, start_pos, end_pos, duration, height)
	local time_passed = 0
	local progress = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local amp_x = start_pos.x - end_pos.x
		local amp_z = start_pos.z - end_pos.z

		local x, z = calculate_parabolic_movement_xz(
				start_pos.x, start_pos.z, end_pos.x, end_pos.z, height, time_passed
		)

		npc.Position = vector(x, 0, z)
		npc.SpineController.ShadowTransform.position = vector(x, 0, z) + vector(0, 0.05, 0)
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function calculate_parabolic_movement_xz(start_x, start_z, end_x, end_z, peak_z_offset, t)
	local new_x = start_x + (end_x - start_x) * t
	local base_z = start_z + (end_z - start_z) * t

	local arc_height = (-4 * t * t + 4 * t) * peak_z_offset

	local new_z = base_z + arc_height

	return new_x, new_z
end

return local_class

function local_class:set_current_scene_npc(section_state)
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[section_state]

	if pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	linq(pre_npc_data):foreach(function(_, npc_data)
		local npc = get_character(npc_data.name)

		if npc == nil then
			if npc_data.name == 'leader' then
				npc = user_party.Leader
			else
				return
			end
		end

		if npc_data.remove_lv_ui ~= nil and npc_data.remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		npc_data.active_state = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.active_state, active_state_type.enabled)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, npc_data.active_state)


		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if npc_data.pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if npc_data.fly ~= nil and npc_data.fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, npc_data.pos, isFlying)
		end

		if npc_data.dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, npc_data.dir, false)
		end

		if npc_data.emo ~= nil then
			if npc_data.emo == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, npc_data.emo)
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_info ~= nil then
			if npc_data.anim_info == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			elseif type_util.is_table(npc_data.anim_info) then
				npc_data.anim_info.one_shot_sfx = false

				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, npc_data.anim_info)
			elseif type_util.is_string(npc_data.anim_info) then
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = npc_data.anim_info, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end


		if npc_data.anim_time_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, npc_data.anim_time_scale)
		end

		if npc_data.alpha_value ~= nil then
			local alpha_duration = 0

			if npc_data.alpha_duration ~= nil then
				alpha_duration = npc_data.alpha_duration
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, npc_data.alpha_value, alpha_duration)
		end

		if npc_data.keep_shake ~= nil and npc_data.keep_shake == true then
			character_util.shake(npc, npc_data.shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if npc_data.sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', npc_data.sorting_layer)
		end

		if npc_data.start_deactive_shadow then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, false)
		end

		if npc_data.scale_factor ~= nil then
			character_util.set_scale_factor(npc, npc.Name, npc_data.scale_factor)
		end

		if npc_data.tint_color then
			local tint_color_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.tint_color_magnitude, 1)

			character_util.add_color(npc, npc_data.tint_color_key, npc_data.tint_color, tint_color_magnitude, 0.1)
		end

		if npc_data.talk ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk) then
			if not lua_helper.type_compare(npc.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
				npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			end

			npc.Interactable.Talk = npc_data.talk
		end

		if npc_data.talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk_sfx) then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = npc_data.talk_sfx
		end

		if npc_data.hitbox ~= nil then
			npc.Hitbox = npc_data.hitbox
		end

		npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end)
end

function local_class:warehouse_scene()
	local sunyeo = self.dynamic_npcs:get('s7_sunyeo_myth')

	camera_util.move_async(sunyeo.Position, 0, { end_target = sunyeo })

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_kunoichi', state = 'event' })

	--2초에 걸쳐서 페이드인
	screen_util.fade_in_async(2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--1.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--다빈(left, idle, idle) 속도2로 처음 지점에서 [A]위치로 이동
	local move_pos = self.marker.sunyeo(1, 2)
	wp_util.move_async(sunyeo, move_pos, 2, nil)

	--다빈(left, smile, nod 2회 후 cross_arm)
	scene_util.set_emotion(sunyeo, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(sunyeo, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

	--1.5초 대기
	scene_util.play_wait_action(sunyeo, self, 'left',
			'cross_arm', 'smile', 1.5)

	--다빈 [A] 위치에서부터 [B] 위치까지 [진행방향, idle, walk]로 이동.
	do
		local wp = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(sunyeo, self.marker.sunyeo(1, 4), false)

		wp_util.move_async(sunyeo, wp, 2, nil, { last_direction = 'up' })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	end

	--다빈 [B]위치 도착 시, (up, idle, question) 실행 후 대기.
	scene_util.set_anim_async(sunyeo, self, { name = 'question', loop = false, keep_anim = true })

	--1.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--다빈 [B] 위치에서부터 [C] 위치까지 [진행방향, idle, walk]로 이동.
	do
		character_util.remove_anim(sunyeo)
		local wp = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(sunyeo, self.marker.sunyeo(1, 6), true)

		wp_util.move_async(sunyeo, wp, 2, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })
	end

	--다빈(right, smile, nod 2회 후 cross_arm)
	scene_util.set_emotion(sunyeo, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(sunyeo, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

	--1.5초 대기
	scene_util.play_wait_action(sunyeo, self, 'right',
			'cross_arm', 'smile', 1.5)

	--아래 항목 동시에 실행.
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--선녀 엑스트라 1 : [shout] 포대장님! 교육생들 모두 도착했습니다!!
				--위치 x 0.5 / y 0.2
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
				scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(sunyeo, 'mm_sunyeo_main_s7_0_1',
						true, { viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2) })
			end,
			function()
				--다빈 (down, attack, jump 1회) 실행.
				character_util.set_direction(sunyeo, 'down')
				scene_util.set_emotion(sunyeo, self, 'attack')
				character_util.normal_jump_async(sunyeo, true)
			end
	)

	--다빈 (down, smile, cast2) : 넵! 나가겠습니다!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(sunyeo, self, 'down',
			'cas2', 'smile', 'mm_sunyeo_main_s7_0_2')

	--동시 연출
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--다빈(이동방향, idle, walk) 속도2 [D]위치에서 화살표 방향으로 이동
				local move_pos_list = {
					self.marker.sunyeo(1, 7),
					self.marker.sunyeo(1, 8),
				}
				wp_util.move_async(sunyeo, move_pos_list, 2, nil)

				move_pos = self.marker.sunyeo(1, 8) + vector(0, 0, -5)
				wp_util.move_async(sunyeo, move_pos, 2, nil)
			end,
			function()
				--2초에 걸쳐 페이드 아웃
				screen_util.fade_out_async(2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
			end
	)
end

	CS.Oak.Game.Instance:StageToLobby(true)
end

local controller = newclass('Main4MiniEventController')

function controller:init(quest_controller)
	self.quest_controller = quest_controller

	local file_path_prefix = 'Quest/Memorial/Sunyeo/Main/Main4MiniEvents/'

	local script_file_names = {
		file_path_prefix .. 'MiniEvent1.lua',
		file_path_prefix .. 'MiniEvent2.lua',
		file_path_prefix .. 'MiniEvent3.lua',
	}

	self.has_been_initialized = false

	self.event_scripts = self:load_scripts(script_file_names)
end

function controller:load_scripts(file_names)
	local scripts = {}

	for i = 1, #file_names do
		local script = get_or_create_global_table(file_names[i])
		if script ~= nil then
			table.insert(scripts, script(self))
		end
	end

	return scripts
end

function controller:enter()
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		local is_event_cleared = self.quest_controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(self.event_scripts[i].event_flag)

		if not is_event_cleared then
			lua_helper.call_nullable(self.event_scripts[i], 'enter', self.event_scripts[i])
		end
	end
end

function controller:start()
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		lua_helper.call_nullable(self.event_scripts[i], 'start', self.event_scripts[i])
	end
end

function controller:exit()
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		-- 좀 더 직관적인 Nullable Call 방식은 없을까???
		lua_helper.call_nullable(self.event_scripts[i], 'exit', self.event_scripts[i])
	end

	self.quest_controller = nil
end

function controller:dispose()
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		-- 좀 더 직관적인 Nullable Call 방식은 없을까???
		lua_helper.call_nullable(self.event_scripts[i], 'dispose', self.event_scripts[i])
	end
end

function controller:on_event(e)
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		local is_event_cleared = self.quest_controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(i)

		if not is_event_cleared then
			lua_helper.call_nullable(self.event_scripts[i], 'on_event', self.event_scripts[i], e)
		end
	end
end

function controller:is_every_events_cleared()
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		if not self.quest_controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(i) then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

function controller:get_uncleared_events()
	local event_list = {}
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		if not self.quest_controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(i) then
			table.insert(event_list, self.event_scripts[i])
		end
	end

	return event_list
end

return {
	create = function()
		return controller
	end
}

function mini_event:enter()
	if not self.quest_controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(self.event_flag) then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

		start_coroutine(function()
			self.fx:load_async()

			self.dynamic_npcs:load_async()

			self.current_state = self.states.loaded

			--TODO: 다이나믹 NPC는 생성 완료 후 접근해야 한다.
			local index = 1
			self:trash_action(function(trash)
				character_util.set_position(trash, self.get_trash_pos(index))
				field_object_util.set_active_state(trash, active_state_type.enabled)

				field_ui_util.remove_ui(trash, field_ui_type.character_stats)

				index = index + 1
			end)

			self:mouse_action(function(mouse)
				field_ui_util.remove_ui(mouse, field_ui_type.character_stats)
				mouse.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
			end)
		end)
	end
end

function mini_event:start()
	if not self.quest_controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(self.event_flag) then
		self:npc_setting()
	else
		-- 해당 이벤트 클리어 재진입 처리
		local pivot = self.get_marker_after_pos() + vector(2, 0, -2)
		local android = self.get_clean_android()

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android)
		character_util.set_position(android, pivot + vector(-0.2, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(android, 'right')
		android.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
		android.Interactable.Talk = 'mm_sunyeo_main_s4_a1_106'

		field_object_util.set_active_state(android, active_state_type.enabled)
	end
end

function mini_event:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
end

function mini_event:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.meet_android and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_clean_android()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.interact_android

		self.is_interact_android = true

		quest_marker_util.remove(self.get_clean_android().Name)

		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.get_clean_android())

		self.quest_controller.controller:start_scene(self.interact_android, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.interact_android and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_clean_android()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.minigame_start

		quest_marker_util.remove(self.get_clean_android().Name)

		self.quest_controller.controller:start_scene(self.re_interact_android, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function mini_event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.loaded and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's4_a1_clean_android_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.meet_android

		start_coroutine(self.meet_clean_android, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function mini_event:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if self.current_state ~= self.states.minigame_start then
		return false
	end

	return false
end

function mini_event:on_damage_event(e)
	if self.current_state ~= self.states.minigame_start then
		return
	end

	self:trash_action(function(trash)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, trash) then
			self.fx.dead():Instantiate(trash.Position)

			field_object_util.set_active_state(trash, active_state_type.disabled)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(trash)

			self.mouse_manager.active_trash_table[trash.name] = false

			if self.mouse_manager.spec_name[trash.name] ~= nil then
				if self.is_first_meet_mouse == false then
					self.is_first_meet_mouse = true
				end

				self:mouse_active(trash)
			end
		end
	end)

	self:mouse_action(function(mouse)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, mouse) then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_die_mouse_01')
			self.mouse_manager.active_mouse_table[mouse.name] = false
			self.fx.dead():Instantiate(mouse.Position)
			self:reset_mouse(mouse)
		end
	end)
end

function mini_event:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent))

	self.event_controller = nil
end

function mini_event:dispose()
end

function mini_event:mouse_active(trash)
	local mouse_name_table = self.mouse_manager.spec_name[trash.name]
	local count = table_util.get_size(mouse_name_table)

	for index = 1, count do
		start_coroutine(function()
			local mouse_name = mouse_name_table[index]
			local pos_prefix = self.mouse_manager.pos_spec[mouse_name]
			local mouse = get_character(mouse_name)

			character_util.set_position(mouse, trash.Position)
			field_object_util.set_active_state(mouse, active_state_type.enabled)

			-- 엔티티그룹만 적으로 바꾸고 암살 불가능하도록
			mouse.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy
			stage.BattleManager:AddToNoAssassination(mouse)

			local start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(pos_prefix .. 1)
			local waypoints = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(mouse, start_pos, true)
			local move_count = 4

			wp_util.move_async(mouse, waypoints, 11)

			while not self.quest_controller.controller.is_stage_ended and not self.is_time_out and not self.is_game_clear do
				for move_index = 1, move_count do
					self:mouse_move_async(mouse, field_util.get_marker_pos(pos_prefix .. move_index), 11, nil, { run = true })

					if self.quest_controller.controller.is_stage_ended or self.is_time_out or self.is_game_clear then
						character_util.stop(mouse)
						return
					end

					character_util.set_side_direction(mouse)

					character_util.set_anim(mouse, { name = 'eat', loop = true })

					self:mouse_wait_for_sec(1)

					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mouse)

					if self.quest_controller.controller.is_stage_ended or self.is_time_out or self.is_game_clear then
						character_util.stop(mouse)
						return
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end
