function mini_event:minigame_start()
	local sunyeo = self.get_sunyeo()
	local android = self.get_clean_android()
	local pivot = self.get_marker_before_pos()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

	self.is_time_out = false
	self.is_first_meet_mouse = false
	self.is_game_clear = false

	self:trash_action(function(trash)
		trash.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
		trash.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterDamagedBehaviour.Create()

		-- 엔티티그룹만 적으로 바꾸고 암살 불가능하도록
		trash.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy
		stage.BattleManager:AddToNoAssassination(trash)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.FieldUITopHPBarIgnoreTargetEvent.Create(trash, true))

		field_object_util.set_active_state(trash, active_state_type.enabled)
	end)

	self:mouse_action(function(mouse)
		character_util.spine_scale(mouse, unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5, 0)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(mouse, active_state_type.enabled)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.FieldUITopHPBarIgnoreTargetEvent.Create(mouse, true))
	end)

	self:invisible_wall_action(function(trash)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(trash, active_state_type.enabled)
	end)

	character_util.set_position(sunyeo, pivot)
	character_util.set_direction(sunyeo, 'down')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sunyeo)
	character_util.set_emotion(sunyeo, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	character_util.hide_weapon(sunyeo, false)

	character_util.set_position(android, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.remove_relate_event(android, self.quest_controller)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self:minigame_routine()
end

function mini_event:minigame_routine()
	local android = self.get_clean_android()
	local sunyeo = self.get_sunyeo()
	local viewport = vector(0.75, 0.75)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--청소부 안드(down, idle, idle)
	--다빈(down, sleep_deep, sunyeo/idle)
	--천자총통 장착 유지 상태
	--청소부 안드(down, attack, idle) : 이제 1분 후면 청소 점검 시간이예요!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(android, 'mm_sunyeo_main_s4_a1_65', true, { viewport_pos = viewport })

	--청소부 안드(down, attack, idle) : 1분 안에 이 방에 있는 쓰레기를 전부 없애주세요!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(android, 'mm_sunyeo_main_s4_a1_66', true, { viewport_pos = viewport })

	--카운트 다운 대기 화면 출력
	--3, 2, 1 카운트 이후 액티비티 진행
	for i = 1, 3 do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
		screen_util.show_stage_title('mm_sunyeo_main_s4_a1_activity_' .. i, 2.1)
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	field_ui_util.show_ui()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sunyeo)
	scene_util.show_weapon(sunyeo)

	party_util.reset_controllers()

	-- 카운트 다운 후 지정된 시간을 표시해 줄 타이머 UI를 중앙 상단 표시
	-- 총 타이머 60초
	local time_limit = 60
	local time_passed = 0
	local timer_loop_sfx = nil

	--시계 UI 표시와 동시에 BGM 재생 시작, 볼륨 1
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'bgm_car_crash', state = 'event', volume = 1})

	timer_util.start_timer({
		duration = time_limit, handler = self,
		callback = 'timer_finished', show_ui = true,
	})

	while not self.quest_controller.controller.is_stage_ended and not self.is_time_out and not self.is_first_meet_mouse do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= time_limit - 10 and timer_loop_sfx == nil then
			timer_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '02_gimmick_ticking_loop_01', loop = true,})
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if self.quest_controller.controller.is_stage_ended then
		return
	end

	if self.is_time_out then
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sunyeo)
		scene_util.hide_weapon(sunyeo)

		self:minigame_fail()

		return
	end

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--액티비티 진행
				--obj_homeless_2, 2~8번 중 1개 파괴 시
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
				--청소부 안드로이드(down, scared, idle) : [shout] 저, 저기 쥐, 쥐가!!
				scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(android, 'mm_sunyeo_main_s4_a1_67', false, { viewport_pos = viewport })

				--청소부 안드로이드(down, scared, idle) : 쥐가 있으면 청소 점검은 무조건 최하점이예요.
				scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(android, 'mm_sunyeo_main_s4_a1_68', false, { viewport_pos = viewport })

				--청소부 안드로이드(down, scared, idle) : 쥐, 쥐를 잡아야 해요!
				scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(android, 'mm_sunyeo_main_s4_a1_69', false, { viewport_pos = viewport })
			end,
			function()
				while not self.quest_controller.controller.is_stage_ended and not self.is_time_out and not self.is_game_clear do
					local is_clear = true

					time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

					if time_passed >= time_limit - 10 and timer_loop_sfx == nil then
						timer_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '02_gimmick_ticking_loop_01', loop = true,})
					end

					for _, active in pairs(self.mouse_manager.active_trash_table) do
						if active then
							is_clear = false
						end
					end

					for _, active in pairs(self.mouse_manager.active_mouse_table) do
						if active then
							is_clear = false
						end
					end

					if is_clear then
						self.is_game_clear = true
						break
					end

					coroutine.yield()
				end
			end
	)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sunyeo)
	scene_util.hide_weapon(sunyeo)

	if timer_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		timer_loop_sfx:Stop()
		timer_loop_sfx = nil
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field', volume = 0})

	if self.quest_controller.controller.is_stage_ended then
		return
	end

	if self.is_time_out then
		self:minigame_fail()

		return
	end

	self:minigame_clear()
end

function mini_event:minigame_fail()
	local android = self.get_clean_android()
	local sunyeo = self.get_sunyeo()

	self.current_state = self.states.interact_android

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

	do
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
		field_ui_util.hide_ui()
	end

	--목표물을 모두 제거하지 못하고, 타이밍이 0초가 되었을 때
	--다빈(현재 방향, tired, seat)
	character_util.set_emotion(sunyeo, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim(sunyeo, { name = 'seat' })

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--동시 연출
	--액티비티 실패 UI 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_02')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString('mm_sunyeo_main_s4_a1_activity_fail'))

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--서큘러 페이드 아웃을 1초에 걸쳐 실행 후, 액티비티 시작 전으로 돌아감.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	self:trash_action(function(trash)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(trash, active_state_type.enabled)
	end)

	self:invisible_wall_action(function(trash)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(trash, active_state_type.disabled)
	end)

	self:mouse_action(function(mouse)
		self:reset_mouse(mouse)
	end)

	for key, _ in pairs(self.mouse_manager.active_trash_table) do
		self.mouse_manager.active_trash_table[key] = true
	end

	for key, _ in pairs(self.mouse_manager.active_mouse_table) do
		self.mouse_manager.active_mouse_table[key] = true
	end

	do
		local pivot = self.get_marker_after_pos()

		character_util.set_position(android, pivot)
		character_util.set_direction(android, 'right')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android)
		character_util.set_emotion(android, { name = 'tired' })

		character_util.set_position(sunyeo, pivot + vector(1, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(sunyeo, 'left')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sunyeo)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	--청소부 안드(right, tired, idle) : 다행히 아직 청소 점검 평가가 시작되지 않았네요…

function mini_event:timer_finished()
	self.is_time_out = true

	timer_util.end_timer(self, true)
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.quest_controller, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent))

	return true
end

	local pivot = self.get_marker_after_pos()
	local android = self.get_clean_android()

	--청소부 안드로이드(left, tired, push) 이미지 타일 위치에서 좌측 0.4타일 이동한 위치

	character_util.set_direction(android, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(android, { name = 'push' })
	character_util.set_emotion(android, { name = 'tired' })

	field_object_util.set_active_state(android, active_state_type.enabled)
	android.Interactable.Talk = ''

	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(android.Name, self.quest_controller.cs_controller.QuestId, true, android)
	--시트 스펙 : memorial_sunyeo_android_female
	--청소부 안드로이드 머리 위에 퀘스트 마커 출력되어 있음
end

function mini_event:wait_for_sec(time)
	local s = unity_class.time.time
	while self.is_interact_android == false and unity_class.time.time - s < time do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function mini_event:trash_action(action)
	local count = 17

	for index = 2, (count + 1) do
		local trash = self.dynamic_npcs:get_npcs(index)

		local y_offset = vector(0,0.5,0)
		local duration = 0.25

		local time_passed = 0
		local current_pos = head.Position

		for index = 1, 2 do
			time_passed = 0

			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = time_passed / duration

				head.Position = current_pos * (1 - progress) + (current_pos + y_offset) * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield()
			end

			head.Position = (current_pos + y_offset)
			time_passed = 0

			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = time_passed / duration

				head.Position = (current_pos + y_offset) * (1 - progress) + current_pos * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield()
			end
		end

		head.Position = current_pos
	end

	--덩치 안드로이드 머리 초기 배치 방향 및 이모션 변경
	--(right, tired, idle)

function mini_event:move_async(fo, target_pos, dur)
	local time_passed = 0
	local current_pos = fo.Position

	while not self.quest_controller.controller.is_stage_ended and time_passed < dur do
		local progress = time_passed / dur

		fo.Position = current_pos * (1 - progress) + target_pos * progress

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	fo.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController)).Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	self.android_spine_controller:ClearEmotion()

	if self.quest_controller.controller.is_stage_ended then
		return
	end

	fo.Position = target_pos
end

end

function mini_event:set_emotion(str)
	self.android_spine_controller:SetEmotion(str, true)
end

return {
	create = function()
		return mini_event
	end
}

	-- fx
	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({

		end,

			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Common_BasicShot_Gun_earth')
		end,
		dead = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
		end,
		splash_out = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_common_water_splash_out')
		end,
		splash_in = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_common_water_splash_in')
		end,
		smoke = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Common_SmokeScreen')
		end
	})

	self.is_android_interact = false

	self.shoot_helper = nil

	self.nowhere = vector(999, 0, 999)

	--region Sprite
	self.sprite = {
		sprite_info = {
			dollar = 21749,
		},
		sprite_table = {},
		sprite_table_origin_parent = {},
		create = function(this, name, pos, item_id, scale, showoncharacter, target, drop_type, skip_text)
			scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
			showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, false)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = pos, item_id = item_id, show_on_character = showoncharacter,
					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = item.SpriteTransform.parent

			return item
		end,
		fly = function(this, name, target)
			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end
	}
	--endregion Sprite
end

function mini_event:enter()
	if not self.event_controller.quest_controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(self.event_flag) then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

		start_coroutine(function()
			screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()

			self.fx:load_async()

			self.current_state = self.states.loaded
		end)
	end
end

	if not self.event_controller.quest_controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(self.event_flag) then

		self:npc_setting()
	else
		-- 해당 이벤트 클리어 재진입 처리
		local pivot = self.get_marker_park() + vector(0,0,-3)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.sprite:dispose_all()

	self.event_controller = nil
end

end

		return self:on_interact_event(e)

	if self.current_state == self.states.meet_android and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_detective_android()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.interact_android

		character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_detective_android(), self.quest_controller)

		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.get_detective_android())

		quest_marker_util.remove(self.get_detective_android().Name)

	return false

function mini_event:android_shoot(android, target_pos, direction, speed, anim_scale, is_3d_sound)
	direction = lua_helper.get_or_default(direction, 'right')
	speed = lua_helper.get_or_default(speed, 10)
	anim_scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(anim_scale, 1)
	is_3d_sound = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_3d_sound, false)

	local start_pos = android.Position
	local end_pos = target_pos
	local diff = end_pos - start_pos
	local velocity = vector_util.magnitude(end_pos - start_pos)
	local normalized_diff = vector_util.normalized(diff)
	local duration = velocity / speed

	if is_3d_sound then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_gun_reload_01', loop = false, parent = android })
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_reload_01')
	end

	scene_util.set_direction(android, direction, false)
	scene_util.set_anim_async(android, self,
			{ name = 'rifle_reload', loop = false, scale = anim_scale, keep_anim = true })
	android.SpineController.AimPoint = vector(normalized_diff.x, normalized_diff.z + normalized_diff.y * 0.7071)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--형사 안드로이드(right, idle, rifle_shoot 1회)
	scene_util.set_anim(android, self, { name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = false })

	local cast_fx_pos = android.Bounds.center + normalized_diff * 1
	local offset_table = {
		left = vector(-0.7, 0, 0),
		right = vector(0.7, 0, 0),
		up = vector(0, 0, -0.2),
		down = vector(0, 0, -0.2),
	}

	--배틀 액션에 명시된 발사 타이밍 대기 시간…은 0.4초였으나 이상해서 변경
	local wait_time = 0.1

	wait_for_sec(wait_time)

	--다빈 평타 공격 애니메이션
	local get_xz_angle = function(target_vector)
		local x = target_vector.x
		--잔상 y위치 루트 2 만큼 곱해준 보정값만큼 다시 나눠주고, 그 값을 z값에 더함.
		local z = target_vector.z + target_vector.y * 0.7071
		local angle_rad = math.atan(z, x)  -- atan2(z, x) 사용
		local angle_deg = math.deg(angle_rad)  -- 라디안을 도(degree)로 변환

		if angle_deg < 0 then
			angle_deg = angle_deg + 360  -- 음수일 경우 보정
		end

		return angle_deg
	end

	self.shoot_helper:ShootTargetPosition(end_pos, offset_table[direction], 0, nil, false)

	--nw_2000_sniper_rifle 총구 위치에 FX_Common_BasicShot_Gun_earth
	local fire = self.fx.android_fire():Instantiate(cast_fx_pos + offset_table[direction])

	fire.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -get_xz_angle(normalized_diff), 0)
end

	}

local local_class = newclass('ThiefEvidenceController')

function local_class:init()
	-- 현재 연결되어있는 루아 클래스
	-- 메인 섹션 13, 14만 사용할 것임
	self.connected_class = nil

	-- 버튼 GameObject
	self.clue_ui_button = nil
	self.clue_ui_button_controller = nil

	-- 팝업창이 열려있는지
	self.clue_ui_popup_on = false

	-- 버튼을 사용할 수 있는지
	self.clue_ui_button_on = false

	--버튼이 강제로 막힌 상태인지
	self.clue_ui_button_blocked = false

	-- 전투 중인지 상태 체크
	self.is_battle = false

	self.resholder = nil

	self.item_prefix = 'thief_inventory_item_'
end

function local_class:pre_load_async()
	if self.resholder ~= nil then
		return
	end

	self.resholder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()


	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.resholder, 'ondemand/memorial_thief/ui', 'EvidencePopup', function(prefab)
				local book_obj = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
				local overlay = book_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.IUIOverlay))
				overlay.UISceneManager = stage.UISceneManager
				book_obj:SetActive(false)
			end)

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.resholder, 'ondemand/memorial_thief/ui', 'EvidenceButton', function(prefab)
				self.clue_ui_button = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)

				self.clue_ui_button_controller = self.clue_ui_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.EvidenceButtonUI))

				local button = self.clue_ui_button.transform:Find('Contents'):Find('Button')

				local button_component = button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UIButton))

				button_component.onClick:Clear()
				CS.EventDelegate.Set(button_component.onClick, function()
					self:show_clue_popup()
				end)

				self.clue_ui_button:SetActive(false)
			end)

	self.clue_ui_popup_on = false
	self.clue_ui_button_on = false

	message_system:SubscribeOnce(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent), 'on_stage_start_event')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:set_connected_class(nil)

	if self.resholder ~= nil then
		self.resholder:Dispose()
	end
	self.resholder = nil

	--게임 오브젝트들 Destroy
	if is_unity_null(self.clue_ui_button) == false then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.clue_ui_button)
	end
	self.clue_ui_button = nil

	self.clue_ui_button_controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_start_event(e)
	-- 만약 FieldUI를 꺼둔 상태이면 blocking 될 것이므로 패스 -> 나중에 켜짐
	-- FieldUI를 켜둔 상태이면 사작할 때 켜줄 수 있음
	self:show_clue_button()

	return true
end

function local_class:on_connect()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIShowEvent), 'on_field_ui_show_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIHideEvent), 'on_field_ui_hide_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent), 'on_battle_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), 'on_battle_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GameOverEvent), 'on_game_over_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent), 'on_field_object_revived_event')
end

function local_class:on_disconnect()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIShowEvent), 'on_field_ui_show_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIHideEvent), 'on_field_ui_hide_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent), 'on_battle_start_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), 'on_battle_end_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GameOverEvent), 'on_game_over_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent), 'on_field_object_revived_event')
end

function local_class:set_connected_class(target)
	if self.connected_class ~= target then
		-- 해제 했다가 다시 연결하는 경우 구독 요청이 씹힐 수가 있음
		if self.connected_class ~= nil and target ~= nil then
			-- 현재 연결된것도 같이 바꿔줌
			self.connected_class = target
			return
		end

		if self.connected_class ~= nil then
			self:on_disconnect()
		end

		self.connected_class = target

		if target ~= nil then
			self:on_connect()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:show_clue_popup(close_cb, present_cb, open_index)
	if self.connected_class ~= nil and self.connected_class.get_clue_ui_data ~= nil and self.clue_ui_popup_on == false then
		self.clue_ui_popup_on = true

		local data = self.connected_class:get_clue_ui_data()

		local evidence_data = CS.Oak.UI.EvidencePopupState()
		evidence_data.EvidenceList = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.UI.EvidenceItemState)

		for _, info in pairs(data) do
			local clue_data = CS.Oak.UI.EvidenceItemState()

			clue_data.Id = info.id
			clue_data.Portrait = info.sprite

			--변경될 아이템 명이 존재하면 item_prefix..index를 대체
			if info.pending_title ~= nil then
				clue_data.Title = info.pending_title
			else
				clue_data.Title = self.item_prefix .. info.info_index
			end

			clue_data.DescKey = self.item_prefix .. info.info_index .. '_desc_' .. info.progress
			clue_data.HintKey = self.item_prefix .. info.info_index .. '_locked_desc_1'
			clue_data.ButtonState = info.enabled
					and CS.Oak.UI.EvidenceItemState.EvidenceButtonState.Normal
					or CS.Oak.UI.EvidenceItemState.EvidenceButtonState.Disable
			clue_data.CurrentCount = info.cur_count
			clue_data.MaxCount = #data

			evidence_data.EvidenceList:Add(clue_data)
		end

		evidence_data.SelectIndex = open_index or 0

		evidence_data.EnablePresentButton = present_cb ~= nil

		evidence_data.CloseCb = function()
			if close_cb ~= nil then
				close_cb()
			end
			self:on_hide_clue_popup()
		end
		evidence_data.PresentCb = function(result)
			if present_cb ~= nil then
				present_cb(result)
			end
			ui_scene_manager:PopOverlay()
			self:on_hide_clue_popup()
		end

		ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.EvidencePopup.Instance, evidence_data)
	end
end

function local_class:on_hide_clue_popup()
	self.clue_ui_popup_on = false
end

function local_class:show_clue_popup_async(open_index)
	if self.clue_ui_popup_on then
		return
	end

	self:show_clue_popup(nil, nil, open_index)
	self:wait_until_popup_off()
end

-- 팝업이 닫힐 때까지 기다림
-- sp_util.play_normal_screenplay를 사용하지 않고 컨트롤을 뺏는 연출을 진행할 때는 연출 코루틴 시작 부분에서 이 함수 호출
function local_class:wait_until_popup_off()
	if self.connected_class == nil then
		return
	end

	while self.clue_ui_popup_on do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

-- Interact 또는 ZoneEnter 등으로 연출이 진행되는 경우 증거 물품 팝업이 열려있을 수 있음
-- 증거 물품 팝업이 닫힐 때 까지 기다리고 sp_util.play_normal_screenplay를 실행하도록 함
function local_class:play_normal_screenplay(func, ...)
	local args = { ... }
	local routine = function()
		self:wait_until_popup_off()

		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		local cached_leader = user_party.Leader
		if cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
			cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(
					stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
		end

		yield_return_func(func, table.unpack(args))

		if cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
			cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(
					stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
		end

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end

	return coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(routine))
end

function local_class:show_clue_button()
	if self.is_battle then
		return
	end

	if self.clue_ui_button_blocked == false and self.connected_class ~= nil then
		if self.clue_ui_button_on == false then
			self.clue_ui_button_on = true
			self.clue_ui_button_controller:UpdateIcon()
			self.clue_ui_button:SetActive(true)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:hide_clue_button()
	if self.clue_ui_button_on then
		self.clue_ui_button_on = false
		self.clue_ui_button:SetActive(false)
	end
end

function local_class:toggle_block_button(is_blocking)
	self.clue_ui_button_blocked = is_blocking
end

--region 예외처리
function local_class:on_field_ui_show_event(e)
	self:show_clue_button()

	return true
end

function local_class:on_field_ui_hide_event(e)
	self:hide_clue_button()

	return true
end

function local_class:on_battle_start_event(e)
	self.is_battle = true

	self:hide_clue_button()

	return true
end

function local_class:on_battle_end_event(e)
	if user_party.Leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead == true then
		return false
	end

	self.is_battle = false

	self:show_clue_button()

	return true
end

function local_class:on_game_over_event(e)
	self:hide_clue_button()

	return true
end

function local_class:on_field_object_revived_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		self:show_clue_button()
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class();
	end
}

---@class MemorialThiefMainController : QuestControllerBase
local local_class = newclass('MemorialThiefMainController', controller_base)

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.super:init(cs_controller)

	-- 사용할 섹션 스크립트 정보. 주석 해제하고 사용
	self.script_config = {
		HasPreSection = false,
		NormalSectionCount = 9,
		HasPostSection = false
	}

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version + 1

	self.group_controller = nil

	self.evidence_controller = nil
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	self.group_controller = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Memorial/Thief/Common/OneLineDataControllerMemorialThief')

	self.evidence_controller = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Memorial/Thief/Common/ThiefEvidenceController')
	self.evidence_controller:pre_load_async()
	message_system:SubscribeOnce(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent), 'on_stage_start_event')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
	self:dispose_group_controller()

	self:set_disconnected_class_on_controller()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_start_event(e)
	if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress ~= nil and
			self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.IsComplete then
		--퀘스트 완료 후 재 접속시 증거품 UI 출력함.
		start_coroutine(self.set_connected_class_on_controller, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress ~= nil and
			self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.InnerProgress ~= 0 then
		self:set_active_background_scroller(active_state_type.disabled)
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
	self:dispose_group_controller()
end

function local_class:dispose_group_controller()
	if self.group_controller ~= nil then
		self.group_controller:dispose()
		self.group_controller = nil
	end
end

--TODO 후일담 섹션이 추가되고 리리스 사무실 관련 장면이 생긴다면, 활성화 시켜줘야함.
function local_class:set_active_background_scroller(active_state)
	local fo = get_field_object('background_scroller')
	field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state)

	if active_state == active_state_type.enabled then
		local background_scroller = fo.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.BackgroundScroller))
		background_scroller:Init()
	end
end

--증거품 컨트롤러 UI를 이 퀘스트 컨트롤러에 연결 시키고, 증거품 UI를 출력합니다.
--아래 get_clue_ui_data를 커스텀하게 사용할 게 아니라면, 증거품 UI를 출력하기 위해 각 섹션에서 해당 함수를 사용하면 됩니다.
function local_class:set_connected_class_on_controller(show_clue_button)
	local all_constants = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Memorial/Thief/Common/ThiefEvidenceConstants')
	self.clue_infos = all_constants[stage.Name]
	self.evidence_controller:set_connected_class(self)

	show_clue_button = lua_helper.get_or_default(show_clue_button,true)
	if show_clue_button then
		self.evidence_controller:show_clue_button()
	end
end

function local_class:set_disconnected_class_on_controller()
	if self.evidence_controller ~= nil then
		self.evidence_controller:set_connected_class(nil)
		self.evidence_controller = nil
	end
end

--증거품 UI가 이 퀘스트 컨트롤러에 연결 되어 있다면, 아래 함수를 통해 데이터를 가져옵니다.
--4섹션과 6섹션은 각각의 섹션 스크립트에 연결 되어있어, 해당 함수를 타지 않습니다.
function local_class:get_clue_ui_data()
	local data = {}
	for index, info in pairs(self.clue_infos) do
		table.insert(data, { id = index, info_index = index, sprite = info.sprite_name,
							 enabled = true, cur_count = #self.clue_infos, progress = info.progress_goal,
							 pending_title = info.pending_title })
	end
	return data
end

return local_class

			birthday_cake = 21762,

		},
		sprite_table = {},
		sprite_table_origin_parent = {},
		create = function(this, name, pos, item_id, scale, showoncharacter, target, drop_type, skip_text)
			scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
			showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, false)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = pos, item_id = item_id, show_on_character = showoncharacter,
					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = item.SpriteTransform.parent

			return item
		end,
		get = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				return this.sprite_table[name]
			end

			return nil
		end,
		consumed = function(this, name, target)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				quest_drop_item_util.consumed(this.sprite_table[name], target)
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		fly = function(this, name, target)
			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end
	}

			local text_fade_in_duration = 0.5

			local text_maintain_duration = 1.5
			local text_exposure_duration = text_fade_in_duration + text_maintain_duration + text_fade_out_duration

			local text_speed = 0

			wait_all({

						text,
						text_width,
						text_speed,
						text_exposure_duration
				),
				util.cs_generator(function()
					--fade in 대기
					this.fade_typing_text_in(this, this.ui, text_fade_in_duration)

					--노출 시간 대기

					--fade out 대기

			local start_alpha = typing_text.Label.alpha
			local end_alpha = target_alpha

			coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(duration, start_alpha, end_alpha, function(_, cur_value)
				typing_text.Label.alpha = cur_value
			end)
		end,

		dispose = function(this)
			if this.ui ~= nil then
				CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(this.ui.gameObject)
				this.ui = nil
			end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self:set_pre_npc()
	self:set_current_scene_npc(self.npc_placement_group.party_position)
	self:set_current_scene_npc(self.npc_placement_group.main_npc_positions)
end

function local_class:start()
	start_coroutine(function()
		sp_util.enter_scene()

		_, self.operator_ui = global_table_util.try_create_operator_ui()
		self.operator_ui:load_async('ui/stage/common', 'StageOperatorUI')

		if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
			screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
			screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')
		end

		self.dynamic_npcs:load_async()
		self.typing_text:load_async()
		self.typing_text:set()

		self:opening_event()

		self.robot_routine:set()
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.operator_ui = nil

	self.quest_marker:remove()

	self.robot_routine:reset()

	self.typing_text:dispose()
	self.dynamic_npcs:dispose()

	self.sprite:dispose_all()

	self:dispose_buzz_sfx()

	for _, info in pairs(self.talk_info) do
		character_util.remove_relate_event(info.target, self.controller)
	end

	--맵 전역에 있는 안드로이드 로봇 npc 사라진다.
	for i = 1, 5 do
		local android = self.npc.android(i)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android)
		character_util.set_position(android, vector(999, 0, 999))
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	for i, info in ipairs(self.talk_info) do
		if not info.check_talk and
				self.current_state == self.states.show_lobby and
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, info.target) then
			info.check_talk = true
			quest_marker_util.remove(info.marker_key)
			sp_util.start_scene(info.func, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.to_the_party_room and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc.business_male()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.business_male
		start_coroutine(self.talk_with_business_man_in_party_room, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_state == self.states.none then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.zones.inspection.name) and
				not self.zones.inspection.once.passed then
			self.current_state = self.states.inspection

			self.zones.inspection.once.passed = true

			sp_util.start_scene(self.inspection_event, self)

			return true
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.inspection and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's2_lobby_event') then
		self.current_state = self.states.show_lobby
		sp_util.start_scene(self.show_lobby_scene, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state >= self.states.show_lobby then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.zones.android.name) and
				not self.zones.android.once.passed then
			self.zones.android.once.passed = true

			start_coroutine(self.play_android_event, self)

			return true
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.leave_noble_room then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.zones.noble.name) and
				not self.zones.noble.once.passed then
			self.zones.noble.once.passed = true

			sp_util.start_scene(self.talk_with_noble_male_2nd, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

		return
	end

	linq(pre_npc_data):foreach(function(_, npc_data)
		local npc = get_character(npc_data.name)

		if npc == nil then
			if npc_data.name == 'leader' then
				npc = user_party.Leader
			else
				return
			end
		end

		if npc_data.remove_lv_ui ~= nil and npc_data.remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		npc_data.active_state = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.active_state, active_state_type.enabled)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, npc_data.active_state)


		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if npc_data.pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if npc_data.fly ~= nil and npc_data.fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, npc_data.pos, isFlying)
		end

		if npc_data.dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, npc_data.dir, false)
		end

		if npc_data.emo ~= nil then
			if npc_data.emo == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, npc_data.emo)
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_info ~= nil then
			if npc_data.anim_info == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			elseif type_util.is_table(npc_data.anim_info) then
				npc_data.anim_info.one_shot_sfx = false

				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, npc_data.anim_info)
			elseif type_util.is_string(npc_data.anim_info) then
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = npc_data.anim_info, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_time_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, npc_data.anim_time_scale)
		end

		if npc_data.alpha_value ~= nil then
			local alpha_duration = 0

			if npc_data.alpha_duration ~= nil then
				alpha_duration = npc_data.alpha_duration
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, npc_data.alpha_value, alpha_duration)
		end

		if npc_data.keep_shake ~= nil and npc_data.keep_shake == true then
			character_util.shake(npc, npc_data.shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if npc_data.sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', npc_data.sorting_layer)
		end

		if npc_data.start_deactive_shadow then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, false)
		end

		if npc_data.scale_factor ~= nil then
			character_util.set_scale_factor(npc, npc.Name, npc_data.scale_factor)
		end

		if npc_data.attaching_equipment ~= nil then
			character_util.spine_set_attachment(npc, npc_data.attaching_equipment.slot, npc_data.attaching_equipment.equipment)
		end

		if npc_data.tint_color then
			local tint_color_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.tint_color_magnitude, 1)

			character_util.add_color(npc, npc_data.tint_color_key, npc_data.tint_color, tint_color_magnitude, 0.1)
		end

		if npc_data.talk ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk) then
			if not lua_helper.type_compare(npc.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
				npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			end

			npc.Interactable.Talk = npc_data.talk
		end

		if npc_data.talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk_sfx) then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = npc_data.talk_sfx
		end

		if npc_data.hitbox ~= nil then
			npc.Hitbox = npc_data.hitbox
		end

		if npc_data.post_func ~= nil then
			npc_data.post_func(npc)
		end
	end)
end
--endregion

function local_class:opening_event()
	self:start_contact_with_demon_queen_event()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent.Instance)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
end

function local_class:start_contact_with_demon_queen_event()

	local mad_scientist = self.npc.mad_scientist()

	camera_util.move_async(demon_inspector.Position, 0, { end_target = demon_inspector })

	--화면 암전 상태로 2초 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--나레이션 : 일주일 뒤…
	start_coroutine(function()
		self.typing_text:play_narration('mm_thief_main_s2_1_0')
	end)

	--2초에 걸쳐 카메라 검정색으로 페이드 인. async
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2, volume = 0.6 })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(2, unity_class.color.black)

	--이전 카메라 줌인 상태 (3.0)
	--12초에 걸쳐 카메라 천천히 줌 아웃시켜 카메라 값 4.0으로 맞춘다. async 아님.
	camera_util.resize_to_default(12)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--리리스 : 명단에 있던 인원들은 오늘 전부 참석했어.
	self.operator_ui:speech_sprite_async('memorial_th_demon_queen', 'mm_thief_main_s2_1_1')

	--리리스 : 괴도 녀석도 오딜 너처럼 변장을 하고 들어왔을 거고.
	self.operator_ui:speech_sprite_async('memorial_th_demon_queen', 'mm_thief_main_s2_1_2')

	--여긴 아무나 들어올 수 없는 곳이니까.
	self.operator_ui:speech_sprite_async('memorial_th_demon_queen', 'mm_thief_main_s2_1_2_1')

	--리리스 : 기억하고 있지? 네 가명은 ‘벨’이야. 직업은 과학자.
	--대사 스킵 불가 + 대사 완료까지 대기.
	self.operator_ui:speech_sprite_async('memorial_th_demon_queen', 'mm_thief_main_s2_1_3', { can_skip = false })

	--리리스 : 현재 위치는 40층 플로어. 가장 돈이 많은 부자들을 그곳에 모아 놨어.
	self.operator_ui:speech_sprite_async('memorial_th_demon_queen', 'mm_thief_main_s2_1_4')

	--리리스 : 예고장대로라면… 녀석은 거기서 무언가를 저지르겠지.
	self.operator_ui:speech_sprite_async('memorial_th_demon_queen', 'mm_thief_main_s2_1_5')

	--리리스 : <b>목걸이</b>를 조심하라나 뭐라나… 정말이지 속을 알 수 없는 녀석이야.
	self.operator_ui:speech_sprite_async('memorial_th_demon_queen', 'mm_thief_main_s2_1_5_1')

	--리리스 : 본 행사가 시작되기 전까지 괴도를 막아줘.
	--대사 스킵 불가 + 대사 완료까지 대기.
	self.operator_ui:speech_sprite_async('memorial_th_demon_queen', 'mm_thief_main_s2_1_6', { can_skip = false })

	--리리스 : 네오=페더레이션의 조사만으로도 바쁠 텐데 미안하군.

	--오딜 (right, idle, twohand_idle) : 염려 마시죠, 리리스님.

			nil, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s2_1_9')

	--그레모리 (left, doyagao, release 2회) : 후히히… 볼 만한 복장인데?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mad_scientist, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'doyagao', 'mm_thief_main_s2_1_11')

	--오딜 (right, tired, bomb_idle) annoyed 이모티콘 출력, async
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(demon_inspector, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'annoyed')

	--오딜 (right, tired, bomb_idle) : 이런 차림은 적응이 안 된단 말이지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_inspector, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'mm_thief_main_s2_1_12')

	--그레모리 (left, tired, cast) : 으으… 그래도 네가 부러워, 오딜…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mad_scientist, self, 'left',
			'cast', 'tired', 'mm_thief_main_s2_1_13')

	--그레모리 (left, smile, release 2회) : 다른 사람도 아니고 가, 각하의 부탁이잖아…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mad_scientist, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'smile', 'mm_thief_main_s2_1_14')

	--오딜 (right, tired, idle) : 그런가…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_inspector, self, 'right',
			nil, 'tired', 'mm_thief_main_s2_1_15')

	--오딜 (right, idle, idle) : 뭐, 너도 몸 조심해.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_inspector, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s2_1_16')

	--오딜 (right, idle, nod 2회) : 최근 들어 그 녀석들… 동향이 심상치 않으니까.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_inspector, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s2_1_17')

	--그레모리 (left, doyagao, cast) : 후후후… 그거라면 걱정 안 해도 괜찮아.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mad_scientist, self, 'left',
			'cast', 'doyagao', 'mm_thief_main_s2_1_18')

	--그레모리 (left, doyagao, cast) : 그, 그러면 나는 이만….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mad_scientist, self, 'left',
			'cast', 'doyagao', 'mm_thief_main_s2_1_19')

	--그레모리 (up, idle, walk) 애니적용, 4초에 걸쳐 z값 +2.5 타일 이동한다. async
	local move_pos_list = {
		mad_scientist.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
		mad_scientist.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 1),
		mad_scientist.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 4),
	}
	wp_util.move(mad_scientist, move_pos_list, nil, 4)

	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	--그레모리 스파인 0.5초에 걸쳐 알파페이드아웃된다. async
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(mad_scientist, 0, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--오딜 (left, tired, idle) 0.5초 대기

			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'idle' },
			{ name = 'tired' },
			0.5)

	--오딜 (left, sleep_deep, question 1회, 마지막 프레임 유지) : 괴도 루시라…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_inspector, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'question', loop = false, keep = true }, 'sleep_deep', 'mm_thief_main_s2_1_20')

	--오딜 (left, sleep_deep, question 마지막 프레임 상태) : 질긴 악연이군.

function local_class:inspection_event()

	local staff_1 = self.npc.staff_male(1)
	local staff_2 = self.npc.staff_female(1)
	local demon_inspector = self.npc.demon_inspector()

	--오딜 ■ (up, idle, walk) 애니 적용하여 1초에 걸쳐 위와 같이 정렬한다.

		vector(move_end_pos.x, 0, demon_inspector.Position.z),
		move_end_pos,
	}

			'release', nil, 'mm_thief_main_s2_2_1')

	--직원1 (right, idle, question 1회 마지막 프레임 유지) : 성함이 어떻게 되시죠?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff_1, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'question', loop = false, keep = true }, 'idle', 'mm_thief_main_s2_2_2')

	--직원1 (right, idle, cross_arm)
	scene_util.set_anim(staff_1, self, 'cross_arm')

	--오딜 (left, idle, idle) : 흠흠, ‘벨’ 입니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_inspector, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s2_2_3')

	--직원1 (right, idle, cross_arm) : 음… 직업이…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff_1, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false, keep = true },
			nil, 'mm_thief_main_s2_2_4')

	--직원1 (right, idle, cross_arm) : 과학자시라고요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff_1, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s2_2_5')
	character_util.remove_anim(staff_1)

	--오딜 (left, idle, nod 2회) async
	scene_util.set_anim_async(demon_inspector, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

	--동시 실행
	--직원2 (left, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(staff_2, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(staff_2, self, 'idle')
	scene_util.set_anim(staff_2, self, 'idle')

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--카메라 줌 인 (3.7, 0.3)
				camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3.7, 0.3)
			end,
			function()
				--직원1 (현재 방향, idle, walk) 애니 적용, 4의 속도로 위 동선 따라 이동
				move_pos_list = {
					staff_1.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
					staff_1.Position + vector(2, 0, 1),
					staff_1.Position + vector(2, 0, 0),
				}
				wp_util.move_async(staff_1, move_pos_list, 4,
						nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

				scene_util.set_anim(staff_1, self, 'cross_arm')
			end
	)

	--오딜 (right, tired, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(demon_inspector, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_inspector, self, 'tired')
	character_util.remove_anim(demon_inspector)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--동시 실행
	do
		local move_list = {
			staff_1.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
			staff_1.Position + vector(-2, 0, 1),
			staff_1.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0)
		}

		--카메라 줌 인 (3.3, 0.3)
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.3, 0.3)

		--직원1 (현재 방향, idle, walk) 애니 적용, 4의 속도로 위 동선 따라 이동
		--도착 시 (right, idle, question 1회 실시) 실행 후 마지막프레임으로 전환
		character_util.remove_anim(staff_1)
		wp_util.move_async(staff_1, move_list, 4, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

		scene_util.set_anim(staff_1, self, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	end

	--오딜 (left, tired, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(demon_inspector, 'left', false)

	--직원2 (left, tired, idle) shake (0.02, 0.5) 1회 async 아님.
	scene_util.set_emotion(staff_2, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.shake(staff_2, 0.02, 0.5)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--동시 실행
	do
		local move_list = {
			staff_1.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
			staff_1.Position + vector(2, 0, 1),
			staff_1.Position + vector(2, 0, 0)
		}

		--카메라 줌 인 (3.0, 0.3)
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 0.3)

		--직원1 (현재 방향, idle, walk) 애니 적용, 4의 속도로 위 동선 따라 이동
		--도착 시 (left, idle, idle) 로 전환
		character_util.remove_anim(staff_1)
		wp_util.move_async(staff_1, move_list, 4, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })
	end

	--오딜 (right, tired, idle)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(demon_inspector)
	scene_util.set_direction(demon_inspector, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_inspector, self, 'tired')

	--직원2 (left, tired, bomb_idle)
	scene_util.set_anim(staff_2, self, 'bomb_idle')

	--직원1 (left, idle, idle) : 어딘가 낯이 익은데…
	--말풍선 크기 0.7
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff_1, self, nil, nil, nil,
			{ key = 'mm_thief_main_s2_2_6', scale = 0.7, skip = true })

	--직원1 (left, idle, question 1회 실행 마지막 프레임 유지) silence 이모티콘 출력, async
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(staff_1, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'question', loop = false, keep = true }, 'idle', 'silence')

	--직원1 (left, idle, nod 1회) : 그럼 지금부터 위험 물품 확인 진행하겠습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff_1, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 1 }, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s2_2_7')

	--동시 실행 async
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--카메라 줌 아웃 (4.0, 0.3)
				camera_util.resize_to_default_async(0.3)
			end,
			function()
				--직원1 (right, tired, idle)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(staff_1)
				scene_util.set_direction(staff_1, 'right', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(staff_1, self, 'tired')

				--화면 shake (0.2, 0.3)
				camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)

				wait_for_sec(0.3)
			end,
			function()
				--직원2 (left, attack, release 2회) : [shout] 이봐!
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
				scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(staff_2, self, 'left',
						{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
						'attack', 'mm_thief_main_s2_2_8')
			end
	)

	--직원2 (left, tired, bomb_idle) : 한 분 한 분 그렇게 질질 끌면 행사 시작도 못 한다니까.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff_2, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'mm_thief_main_s2_2_9')

	--직원2 (left, tired, idle) : 명단 이상 없고, 뭐 위험 물품도 없네. 입장시켜드려.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff_2, self, 'left',
			nil, 'tired', 'mm_thief_main_s2_2_10')

	--직원1 (right, tired, cast) : 그… 그치만 그랬다가 혹시라도…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff_1, self, 'right',
			'cast', 'tired', 'mm_thief_main_s2_2_11')

	--직원2 (left, tired, idle) annoyed 이모티콘 출력 async
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(staff_2, self, 'left',
			nil, 'tired', 'annoyed')

	--직원2 (left, attack, idle) : …지금 말대꾸 하는 거야?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff_2, self, 'left',
			nil, 'attack', 'mm_thief_main_s2_2_11_1')

	--직원1 (right, scared, cast)
	scene_util.set_direction(staff_1, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(staff_1, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(staff_1, self, 'cast')

	--직원1 shake (0.03, 1.0) async
	scene_util.shake(staff_1, 0.03, 1, '03_runaway_02')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--직원1 (right, attack, release 2회) : 네, 넵, 선배님! 알겠습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff_1, self, nil,
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'mm_thief_main_s2_2_12')

	--동시 실행 async
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--직원2 (right, idle, walk) 애니 적용, 2의 속도로 오른쪽으로 1.5타일 이동
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(staff_2)
				wp_util.move_async(staff_2, staff_2.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0),
						2, nil)
			end,
			function()
				--직원1 (left, idle, release 2회) : 신원 확인되었습니다.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff_1, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false },
						{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'idle', 'mm_thief_main_s2_2_13')
			end
	)

	--동시 실행 async
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--직원2 (right, tired, eat)
				scene_util.set_direction(staff_2, 'right', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(staff_2, self, 'tired')
				scene_util.set_anim(staff_2, self, 'eat')
			end,
			function()
				--오딜 (right, idle, idle) : 고마워요.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_inspector, self, 'right',
						nil, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s2_2_14')
			end
	)

	--직원1 (right, idle, walk) 애니 적용, 4의 속도로 위 동선 따라 이동 async
	wp_util.move_async(staff_1, staff_2.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 4, nil)

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--직원1 (right, tired, idle) : 선배님, 죄송합니다… 리리스 타워 때 이후로 제가 예민해졌나 봐요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff_1, self, 'right',
			nil, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'mm_thief_main_s2_2_15')

	--직원2 (left, tired, bomb_idle) : 뭐, 그럴 만도 하지. 이해해.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff_2, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'mm_thief_main_s2_2_16')

	--이후 직원 원라인NPC로 전환한다.
	--직원1 (right, tired, idle) : 이렇게 적당히 넘어가도 괜찮겠죠…?
	scene_util.set_direction(staff_1, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(staff_1, self, 'tired')
	character_util.remove_anim(staff_1)
	staff_1.Interactable.Talk = 'mm_thief_main_s2_oneline_1_1'
	staff_1.Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_dialogue_tipsy_01'

	--직원2 (left, tired, bomb_idle) : 부자들 상대로 피곤하게 굴어봤자 우리만 손해야.
	scene_util.set_direction(staff_2, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(staff_2, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(staff_2, self, 'bomb_idle')
	staff_2.Interactable.Talk = 'mm_thief_main_s2_oneline_1_2'
	staff_2.Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_dialogue_bad_01'

	self:on_food_pickup(self.npc.android(1), 1, self.sprite.sprite_info.birthday_cake, 'up')
	self:on_food_pickup(self.npc.android(2), 2, self.sprite.sprite_info.baked_turkey, 'down')

	local narration_interactable = CS.Oak.NarrationInteractable()
	narration_interactable.StringKeys = { 'mm_thief_main_s2_oneline_1_3' }

	self.npc.android(4).Interactable = narration_interactable
	self.npc.android(5).Interactable = narration_interactable

	--플레이어 컨트롤 돌려준다.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(demon_inspector)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

---트리거존 접촉할 경우,
function local_class:show_lobby_scene()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--이벤트 시작과 함께 환경음 루프 재생 시작
	self.buzz_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_01',
		player_priority = 'npc',
		type_priority = 'loop',
		loop = true,
		volume = 0.4,
	})

	local demon_inspector = self.npc.demon_inspector()

	--메인퀘스트 마커 제거한다.
	self.quest_marker:remove()

	--오딜 (up, idle, walk) 애니 적용, 1초에 걸쳐 위와 같이 정렬한다.
	--async
	wp_util.move_async(demon_inspector, self.marker.demon_inspector(2, 2),
			nil, 1, { last_direction = 'up' })

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--오딜 (left, idle, idle) 상태로 1초 대기
	scene_util.set_direction(demon_inspector, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--오딜 (right, idle, idle) 상태로 1초 대기
	scene_util.set_direction(demon_inspector, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--오딜 (up, idle, idle) silence 이모티콘 출력
	--async
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(demon_inspector, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'silence')

	--동시 실행
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--카메라 줌 아웃 (6.0, 1.0)
				camera_util.resize_by_ratio(6, 1)
				--12초에 걸쳐 카메라 포커스 오딜 위치에서 마름모 위치까지 이동
				camera_util.move_async(stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(0, 0, 20), 12)
			end,
			function()
				--1초 대기.
				wait_for_sec(1)

				--오딜 : 이곳이 교류회장 로비인가.
				--위치 x 0.5 / y 0.2
				--대사 스킵 불가 + 대사 완료까지 대기.
				scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(demon_inspector, 'mm_thief_main_s2_0_1',
						false, { viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2), scale = 1.5, force_sfx = true })

				--오딜 : 이름 한 번 씩은 들어본 거물들만 모였군.
				--위치 x 0.5 / y 0.2
				--대사 스킵 불가 + 대사 완료까지 대기.
				scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(demon_inspector, 'mm_thief_main_s2_0_2',
						false, { viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2), scale = 1.5, force_sfx = true })

				--오딜 : 이들 중에 한 명… 변장한 루시가 숨어 있다.
				--위치 x 0.5 / y 0.2
				--대사 스킵 불가 + 대사 완료까지 대기.
				scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(demon_inspector, 'mm_thief_main_s2_0_3',
						false, { viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2), scale = 1.5, force_sfx = true })

				--0.5초 대기
				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				--화면 1.5 초에 걸쳐서 검정색 페이드 아웃.
				screen_util.fade_out_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black)
			end
	)

	--페이드 인 전 세팅
	--카메라 포커스 오딜 위치로 리셋
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	--카메라 크기 4.0으로 리셋
	camera_util.resize_to_default_async(0)

	--화면 1.5초에 걸쳐 검은색 페이드 인
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black)

	--오딜 (right, idle, cross_arm) : 하지만…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_inspector, self, { dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cross_arm', keep = true }, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s2_0_4')

	--오딜 (right, idle, cross_arm) : 다 내가 알고 있는 얼굴과 판박이야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_inspector, self, nil,
			nil, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s2_0_5')

	--오딜 (right, idle, nod 2회) : 역시 예상대로 루시는 변장의 귀재로군.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_inspector, self, nil,
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s2_0_6')

	--오딜 (right, idle, bomb_idle) : 외견의 차이만으로 알아채는 건 불가능에 가깝다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_inspector, self, nil,
			'bomb_idle', nil, 'mm_thief_main_s2_0_7')

	--오딜 (right, idle, cross_arm)  : 그렇다면… 남은 단서는 <b>행동</b>뿐.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_inspector, self, nil,
			'cross_arm', nil, 'mm_thief_main_s2_0_8')

	--오딜 (right, idle, bomb_idle) : 방금 본 자들 중에 <b>수상쩍게 행동</b>했던 녀석들은…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_inspector, self, nil,
			'bomb_idle', nil, 'mm_thief_main_s2_0_9')

	--오딜 (up, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(demon_inspector, 'up', false)

	--동시 실행
	--카메라 포커스 0.4초에 걸쳐 리니아 위치로 이동
	camera_util.move_to_target(self.npc.pianist(), 0.4)

	--카메라 줌 인 (2.5, 0.4)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(2.5, 0.4)

	--오딜 : 우선은 저 피아니스트 여자.
	--위치 x 0.5 / y 0.2
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(demon_inspector, 'mm_thief_main_s2_0_10',
			true, { viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2) })

	--오딜 : ‘리니아’ 라고 하는 이름이었을 거다.
	--위치 x 0.5 / y 0.2
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(demon_inspector, 'mm_thief_main_s2_0_11',
			true, { viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2) })

	--오딜 : 왜 교류회장까지 와서 악기 조율이나 하고 있는 거지?
	--위치 x 0.5 / y 0.2
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(demon_inspector, 'mm_thief_main_s2_0_12',
			true, { viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2) })

	--카메라 포커스 0.4초에 걸쳐 노턴 위치로 이동
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(self.npc.engineer(), 0.4)

	--오딜 : 그 건너편의 공학자 남자도 미심쩍어.
	--위치 x 0.5 / y 0.2
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(demon_inspector, 'mm_thief_main_s2_0_13',
			true, { viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2) })

	--오딜 : 꽤 유명한 안드로이드 기술자였지… ‘노턴’이라고 했던가.
	--위치 x 0.5 / y 0.2
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(demon_inspector, 'mm_thief_main_s2_0_14',
			true, { viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2) })

	--오딜 : 아까부터 의미심장하게 안드로이드 로봇을 관찰하고 있다.
	--위치 x 0.5 / y 0.2
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(demon_inspector, 'mm_thief_main_s2_0_15',
			true, { viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2) })

	--카메라 포커스 0.6초에 걸쳐 아시카 위치로 이동
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(self.npc.noble_male(), 0.6)

	--오딜 : 상단의 저 사업가 남자도 마찬가지. 분위기가 수상해.
	--위치 x 0.5 / y 0.2
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(demon_inspector, 'mm_thief_main_s2_0_16',
			true, { viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2) })

	--오딜 : 모두가 웃고 떠드는 마당에…
	--위치 x 0.5 / y 0.2
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(demon_inspector, 'mm_thief_main_s2_0_17',
			true, { viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2) })

	--오딜 : 혼자 저렇게 뚱해 있는 이유가 뭐지?
	--위치 x 0.5 / y 0.2
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(demon_inspector, 'mm_thief_main_s2_0_18',
			true, { viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2) })

	--동시 실행 async
	--카메라 줌 인 (4.0, 1.5)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1.5)

	--카메라 포커스 1.5초에 걸쳐 오딜 위치로 복귀한다.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1.5)

	--오딜 (up, idle, idle) silence 이모티콘 출력.
	--async
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(demon_inspector, nil, 'silence')

	--오딜 (right, idle, nod 2회) : 우선 저들한테서 정보를 캐내 보자.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_inspector, self, { dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s2_0_19')

	--리니아 / 노턴 / 아시카 위치에 메인퀘스트 마커 출력
	--플레이어 컨트롤 돌려준다.
	for _, info in ipairs(self.talk_info) do
		local npc = info.target

		character_util.add_listener(npc, self.controller)
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(info.marker_key, self.cs_controller.QuestId, true, npc)
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:play_android_event()
	local android_1 = self.npc.android(1)
	local android_2 = self.npc.android(2)

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--0.5초 대기
				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				--로봇1 (up, idle, throw 1회)
				--whiteday_cake 스프라이트 0.5초에 걸쳐 식탁 위로 포물선 적용하여 던져진다.
				self:on_food_put_down(android_1, android_1.Position + vector(0, 0.52, 1.25), 1)

				--로봇1 (left, idle, idle) 상태로 전환
				scene_util.set_direction(android_1, 'left', false)
				field_object_util.set_active_state(android_1, active_state_type.enabled)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android_1, true)

				local narration_interactable = CS.Oak.NarrationInteractable()

function local_class:on_food_pickup(android, num, item_idx, dir)
	local height = 1.2
	local move_end_offset = vector(0, height, 0)
	self.sprite:create('food_' .. num, android.Position + move_end_offset,
			item_idx, 1, true, nil, nil, true)

	character_util.set_direction(android, dir)
	scene_util.set_anim(android, self, { name = 'hold_loop', upper = true })
end

function local_class:on_food_put_down(android, item_drop_pos, item_idx)
	local food = self.sprite:get('food_' .. item_idx)
	local height = 1.2
	local move_end_offset = vector(0, height, 0)
	food.Position = android.Position + move_end_offset

	coroutine.yield()

	scene_util.set_anim(android, self, { name = 'throw', sfx_name = '01_throw_01', count = 1 })

	sp_util.sine_move(food, { from = food.Position, to = item_drop_pos,
	                          duration = 0.5, height = 1.0 })
end

function local_class:talk_info_end_scene()

		if not info.check_talk then
			return
		end
	end

	self.current_state = self.states.to_the_party_room

	local demon_inspector = self.npc.demon_inspector()
	local business_male = self.npc.business_male()

	--오딜 생각 말풍선 (right, idle, nod 2회) : 좋아. 일단 이걸로 용의자 세 명의 확인은 끝났다.

			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, 'idle', 'mm_thief_main_s2_middle_1')

		end,

		fade_in_async = function(this, duration, fade_value)
			local time_passed = 0
			local value = lua_helper.get_or_default(fade_value, 1)

			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Min(time_passed / duration, value)

				this.controller:set_background_alpha(progress)

				coroutine.yield()

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			end
		end,

		fade_out_async = function(this, duration)
			local time_passed = 0

				local clamped_alpha = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(current_alpha)

				coroutine.yield()

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			end

			--this.controller:set_background_alpha(0.0)
		end
	}

	-- 오딜 나가지 못하게 관리하는 존
	self.zone_out_check = false
	self.zone_out_info = {
		{
			zone_name = 's3_out_zone_left',
			dir = 'left'
		},
		{
			zone_name = 's3_out_zone_up',
			dir = 'up'
		}
	}

function local_class:enter()
	self.fx:create_all()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self:set_pre_npc()
	self:set_current_scene_npc(self.npc_placement_group.main_npc_positions)

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	--self:create_black_tint()
end

function local_class:start()
	start_coroutine(function()
		self.background_util:load_resource()

		sp_util.enter_scene()

		if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
			screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
			screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')
		end

		self:opening_event()
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self:dispose_amb_piano_sfx()
	self.rope_npc:exit_rope_npc()

	self.background_util.controller = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_state == self.states.into_the_cabin then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.zones.cabin.name) and
				not self.zones.cabin.once.passed then
			self.current_state = self.states.section_end
			self.zones.cabin.once.passed = true

			start_coroutine(function()
				sp_util.enter_scene()
				self:enter_the_cabin()
			end)

			return true
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #self.zone_out_info do
		if not self.zone_out_check and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.zone_out_info[i].zone_name) then
			self.zone_out_check = true
			sp_util.start_scene(self.out_zone_enter_scene, self, e.Zone, self.zone_out_info[i].dir)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_current_scene_npc(section_state)
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[section_state]

	if pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	linq(pre_npc_data):foreach(function(_, npc_data)
		local npc = get_character(npc_data.name)

		if npc == nil then
			if npc_data.name == 'leader' then
				npc = user_party.Leader
			else
				return
			end
		end

		if npc_data.remove_lv_ui ~= nil and npc_data.remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		npc_data.active_state = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.active_state, active_state_type.enabled)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, npc_data.active_state)


		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if npc_data.pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if npc_data.fly ~= nil and npc_data.fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, npc_data.pos, isFlying)
		end

		if npc_data.dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, npc_data.dir, false)
		end

		if npc_data.emo ~= nil then
			if npc_data.emo == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, npc_data.emo)
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_info ~= nil then
			if npc_data.anim_info == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			elseif type_util.is_table(npc_data.anim_info) then
				npc_data.anim_info.one_shot_sfx = false

				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, npc_data.anim_info)
			elseif type_util.is_string(npc_data.anim_info) then
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = npc_data.anim_info, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_time_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, npc_data.anim_time_scale)
		end

		if npc_data.alpha_value ~= nil then
			local alpha_duration = 0

			if npc_data.alpha_duration ~= nil then
				alpha_duration = npc_data.alpha_duration
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, npc_data.alpha_value, alpha_duration)
		end

		if npc_data.keep_shake ~= nil and npc_data.keep_shake == true then
			character_util.shake(npc, npc_data.shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if npc_data.sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', npc_data.sorting_layer)
		end

		if npc_data.start_deactive_shadow then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, false)
		end

		if npc_data.scale_factor ~= nil then
			character_util.set_scale_factor(npc, npc.Name, npc_data.scale_factor)
		end

		if npc_data.attaching_equipment ~= nil then
			character_util.spine_set_attachment(npc, npc_data.attaching_equipment.slot, npc_data.attaching_equipment.equipment)
		end

		if npc_data.tint_color then
			local tint_color_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.tint_color_magnitude, 1)

			character_util.add_color(npc, npc_data.tint_color_key, npc_data.tint_color, tint_color_magnitude, 0.1)
		end

		if npc_data.talk ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk) then
			if not lua_helper.type_compare(npc.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
				npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			end

			npc.Interactable.Talk = npc_data.talk
		end

		if npc_data.talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk_sfx) then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = npc_data.talk_sfx
		end

		if npc_data.hitbox ~= nil then
			npc.Hitbox = npc_data.hitbox
		end

		if npc_data.post_func ~= nil then
			npc_data.post_func(npc)
		end
	end)
end

function local_class:out_zone_enter_scene(zone, dir)

	self:set_amb_piano_volume(0.5)

function local_class:set_npc_sorting_layer(npc, layer_name, order)
	if layer_name == nil then
		layer_name = 'Default'
	end

	if order == nil then
		order = 0
	end

	local origin_dir = npc.Direction
	npc.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	npc.SpineController:SetSortingLayer(layer_name, order)
	npc.Direction = origin_dir
end

function local_class:dispose_amb_piano_sfx()
	if self.amb_piano_sfx == nil then
		return
	end

	self.amb_piano_sfx:FadeOut(1)

end

function local_class:set_amb_piano_volume(volume)
	if self.amb_piano_sfx == nil then
		return
	end

	self.amb_piano_sfx.Volume = volume
end

return local_class

	self.clue_infos = all_constants[stage.Name]

	self.evidence_controller = self.controller.evidence_controller
	self:setting_clue_item()
	self.evidence_controller:set_connected_class(self)
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.clue_investigate_count == 0 and
			self.clue_gather_count == 0 then
		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0, 'linear')
			screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			self:create_dynamic_npc()
			self:setting_intro()
			self:intro_scene()
			self:setting_npc()
			self:setting_sub_clue()

			--나레이션 : 교류회장 곳곳을 수색하며 증거를 수집하세요.
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'mm_thief_main_s3_3_36' })
			self:setting_quest_marker_by_clue_progress()
			self.evidence_controller:show_clue_button()

			if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent.Instance)
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
			end
		end)
	else
		start_coroutine(function()
			local leader = get_party_leader()
			sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

			self:create_dynamic_npc()
			self:setting_npc()
			self:setting_sub_clue()

			screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0, 'linear')
			screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
			screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')

			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'victory_get')
			screen_util.show_stage_title()
			wait_for_sec(1.5)
			character_util.remove_anim(leader)
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field', name = 'ondemand/v2_22_lilithtower/audio:bgm_lilith_tower'})

			if self.clue_investigate_count == #self.clue_infos then
				--남은 증거품이 없을 때
				--증거 수집 종료 연출 실행
				self.current_state = self.states.all_clue
				self:on_all_clue_scene()
			else
				--증거품이 남았을 때
				--나레이션 : 교류회장 곳곳을 수색하며 증거를 수집하세요.
				field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'mm_thief_main_s3_3_36' })
				self:setting_quest_marker_by_clue_progress()
				self.evidence_controller:show_clue_button()

				if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent.Instance)
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
				end

				music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field', name = 'ondemand/v2_22_lilithtower/audio:bgm_lilith_tower'})
				music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

				sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
			end
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.evidence_controller ~= nil then
		self.evidence_controller:hide_clue_button()
		self.evidence_controller:set_connected_class(nil)
		self.evidence_controller = nil
	end

	self:unsetting_npc()
	self:unsetting_sub_clue()
	self.quest_marker:remove()

	self:dispose_dynamic_npc()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.getting_clue then
		--region npc 대화
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc.pianist()) then
			start_coroutine(self.interact_pianist, self)

			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc.noble_male()) then
			start_coroutine(self.interact_noble_male, self)

			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc.engineer()) then
			start_coroutine(self.interact_engineer, self)

			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc.staff_male(1)) or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc.staff_female(1)) then
			start_coroutine(self.interact_staff, self, e.Target)

			return true
		end


		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.dynamic_npc_list.s4_dynamic_npc_2) then
			local dynamic_npc_2 = self.dynamic_npc_list.s4_dynamic_npc_2

			character_util.remove_lua_listener(dynamic_npc_2, self)

			start_coroutine(function()
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dynamic_npc_2, self, nil,
						nil, nil, { key = 'mm_thief_main_s4_5_7', skip = false })
			end)

			dynamic_npc_2.Interactable.Talk = 'mm_thief_main_s4_5_7'

			local narration_interactable = CS.Oak.NarrationInteractable()
			narration_interactable.StringKeys = { 'thief_inventory_item_sub_desc_8_1'}

			self.object.sub_clue_fo(7).Interactable = narration_interactable
		end
		--endregion

		--region 증거 수집
		for index, info in pairs(self.clue_infos) do
			local fo = self.object.clue_fo(index)
			if info.progress == self.clue_progress.none and
					lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, fo) then
				start_coroutine(function()
					sp_util.enter_scene()

					self:interact_clue(index)
				end)
				return true
			end
		end
		--endregion
	end
end
