function local_class:setting_clue_item()
	local clue_binary = self:get_clue_data()
	for index, info in pairs(self.clue_infos) do
		local fo = self.object.clue_fo(index)

		-- 00 : 미수집 / 01 : 수집 / 10 : 대화이벤트 완료 / 11 : 미사용
		info.progress = ((clue_binary >> (info.binary_exponent * 2)) & 3)

		if info.progress == self.clue_progress.none then
			--미수집
			info.item_fo = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
				pos = fo.Position + info.sprite_offset,
				item_id = info.item_id,
				loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
				show_on_character = false,
				spr_scale = info.scale
			})

			field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.enabled)
			fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
			fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
			if info.hitbox ~= nil then
				fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), info.hitbox)
			end

			self:add_clue_emoticon(fo, index)
		elseif info.progress == self.clue_progress.gathered then
			--수집
			self.clue_gather_count = self.clue_gather_count + 1

			if info.progress == info.s4_progress_goal then
				self.clue_investigate_count = self.clue_investigate_count + 1
			end
		elseif info.progress == self.clue_progress.investigate then
			--대화 이벤트 완료 후 재접속 하더라도 증거품 갯수 늘어나 있어야 함.
			self.clue_gather_count = self.clue_gather_count + 1

			--대화이벤트 완료
			if info.progress == info.s4_progress_goal then
				self.clue_investigate_count = self.clue_investigate_count + 1
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:setting_sub_clue()
	for i = 1, #self.sub_clue_item do
		if i == 5 then
			goto continue
		end
		local sub_clue = self.object.sub_clue_fo(i)
		local narration_interactable = CS.Oak.NarrationInteractable()
		if i == 10 then
			narration_interactable.StringKeys = {
				'thief_inventory_item_sub_desc_11_1',
				'thief_inventory_item_sub_desc_11_2'
			}
		elseif i > 12 then
			narration_interactable.StringKeys = { 'thief_inventory_item_sub_desc_' .. i }
		else
			narration_interactable.StringKeys = { 'thief_inventory_item_sub_desc_' .. i + 1 }
		end

		sub_clue.Interactable = narration_interactable
		if self.sub_clue_item[i].hitbox ~= nil then
			sub_clue.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(self.sub_clue_item[i].hitbox)
		end

		if self.sub_clue_item[i].item_id ~= nil then
			self.sub_clue_item[i].item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
				item_id = self.sub_clue_item[i].item_id,
				spr_scale = self.sub_clue_item[i].scale,
				pos = self.object.sub_clue_fo(i).Position + self.sub_clue_item[i].offset,
				loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
				show_on_character = false,
				skip_text = true,
			})
		end

		self.sub_clue_item[i].emoticon = character_util.show_emoticon_with_data(sub_clue,
				nil, 'custom', 'emoticon_bubble_agora_evidence.png',
				{ no_time_limit = true })

		:: continue ::
	end
end

function local_class:unsetting_sub_clue()
	for i = 1, #self.sub_clue_item do
		if self.sub_clue_item[i].item ~= nil then
			quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.sub_clue_item[i].item)
		end
		self.sub_clue_item[i].item = nil

		if self.sub_clue_item[i].emoticon ~= nil then
			self.sub_clue_item[i].emoticon:Dispose()
		end
		self.sub_clue_item[i].emoticon = nil
	end
end

function local_class:add_clue_emoticon(fo, clue_index)
	self.clue_infos[clue_index].emoticon = character_util.show_emoticon_with_data(fo,
			nil, 'custom', 'emoticon_bubble_agora_evidence.png',
			{ no_time_limit = true })
end

function local_class:remove_clue_emoticon(clue_index)
	if self.clue_infos[clue_index].emoticon ~= nil then
		self.clue_infos[clue_index].emoticon:Dispose()
	end
	self.clue_infos[clue_index].emoticon = nil
end

function local_class:interact_clue(index)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local fo = self.object.clue_fo(index)

	local x_valve = fo.Position.x - leader.Position.x

	if x_valve == 0 then
		x_valve = 1
	end

	local diff = vector(x_valve, 0, 0)
	local direction = vector_util.to_direction(diff)

	fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	if self.clue_infos[index].item_id ~= 21793 then
		fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end

	--증거품 인터렉트시, 아래 나레이션 출력과 함께 이모티콘 제거한다.
	self:remove_clue_emoticon(index)

	--오딜 (단서 방향 - 오른쪽 왼쪽만, idle, eat) 1초간 실시
	local sfx_loop_eat = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true})

	character_util.set_direction(leader, direction)
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'eat')

	wait_for_sec(0.31)

	quest_drop_item_util.consumed(self.clue_infos[index].item_fo, get_party_leader())

	wait_for_sec(0.69)

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	sfx_loop_eat:Stop()

	if self.clue_infos[index].item_id == 21775 then
		--오딜 (현재방향, idle, walk4legs 프레임 정지) 상태로 전환.
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, {name = 'walk4legs', loop = false})

		wait_for_sec(0.15)

		leader.SpineController.TimeScale = 0
	end

	self:after_gather_clue_scene(index)
end

function local_class:after_gather_clue_scene(clue_index)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	--피해자 신상은 획득과 동시에 조사가 완료됨
	self:add_clue_data_async(clue_index, self.clue_progress.gathered)

	local is_all_clue = (self.clue_gather_count == #self.clue_infos)

	--내레이션 박스 출력 : 중요한 증거품을 수집하였다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'mm_thief_main_s4_5_1' })

	--증거품 확인 UI 즉시 출력한다.
	self.evidence_controller:show_clue_popup_async(clue_index - 1)

	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'sleep_deep')

	self:setting_quest_marker_by_clue_progress()

	if clue_index == self.clue_index.wire then
		--오딜 생각말풍선 (현재 방향, sleep_deep, idle) : 루이스는 이 피아노 줄에 목이 감긴 채로 죽어 있었다.
		scene_util.show_thought_speech_async(leader, 'mm_thief_main_s4_6_1')

		--오딜 생각말풍선 (현재 방향, sleep_deep, idle) : 그러고 보니…
		scene_util.show_thought_speech_async(leader, 'mm_thief_main_s4_6_2')

		--오딜 생각말풍선 (현재 방향, sleep_deep, idle) : 이 와이어는 어디에 연결되어 있었던 거지?
		scene_util.show_thought_speech_async(leader, 'mm_thief_main_s4_6_3')

		--오딜 (left, attack, idle) notice 이모티콘 출력, async
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(leader, self, 'left', nil, 'attack', 'notice')

		--오딜 (left, idle, idle) : 위에서부터 빛이 새어나오는 것을 보니…
		scene_util.show_thought_speech_async(leader, 'mm_thief_main_s4_6_3_1')

		--오딜(left, idle, nod 2회) : 위쪽의 <b>환풍구</b>를 활용한 모양이군!
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
		scene_util.show_thought_speech_async(leader, 'mm_thief_main_s4_6_3_2')

		character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

		--조사 완료
		self:after_investigate_clue_scene(self.clue_index.wire, false)
	elseif clue_index == self.clue_index.profile then
		--오딜 생각말풍선 (현재 방향, sleep_deep, idle) : 의문투성이인 죽음이로군.
		scene_util.show_thought_speech_async(leader, 'mm_thief_main_s4_6_4')

		--오딜 생각말풍선 (현재 방향, sleep_deep, idle) : 루이스는 정말 루시의 친부였던 걸까…?
		scene_util.show_thought_speech_async(leader, 'mm_thief_main_s4_6_5')

		--오딜 생각말풍선 (현재 방향, sleep_deep, idle) : 그레모리가 옆에 있었으면 유전자 검사라도 의뢰했을 텐데… 아쉽군.
		scene_util.show_thought_speech_async(leader, 'mm_thief_main_s4_6_6')

		character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

		--조사 완료
		self:after_investigate_clue_scene(self.clue_index.profile, false)

	elseif clue_index == self.clue_index.controller then
		--오딜 생각말풍선 (현재 방향, sleep_deep, idle) : 안드로이드 컨트롤러…?
		scene_util.show_thought_speech_async(leader, 'mm_thief_main_s4_6_7')

		--오딜 생각말풍선 (현재 방향, sleep_deep, idle) : 기계에 대해선 노턴이 잘 알고 있겠지.
		scene_util.show_thought_speech_async(leader, 'mm_thief_main_s4_6_8')

		--오딜 생각말풍선 (현재 방향, sleep_deep, idle) : 그를 한 번 심문해 봐야겠어.
		scene_util.show_thought_speech_async(leader, 'mm_thief_main_s4_6_9')

		character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, leader)

	elseif clue_index == self.clue_index.pill then
		--오딜 생각말풍선 (현재 방향, sleep_deep, idle) : 수면제라… 생뚱맞군.
		scene_util.show_thought_speech_async(leader, 'mm_thief_main_s4_6_10')

		--오딜 생각말풍선 (현재 방향, sleep_deep, idle) : 나한테 수면제를 복용 중이라고 밝힌 사람이 있었는데…
		scene_util.show_thought_speech_async(leader, 'mm_thief_main_s4_6_11')

		--오딜 생각말풍선 (현재 방향, sleep_deep, idle) : 그래, 아시카를 찾아가 봐야겠군.
		scene_util.show_thought_speech_async(leader, 'mm_thief_main_s4_6_12')

		character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, leader)

	elseif clue_index == self.clue_index.records then
		--오딜 생각말풍선 (현재 방향, sleep_deep, idle) : 직원들도 루시가 교류회장에 올 걸 알고 있었던 모양이군.
		scene_util.show_thought_speech_async(leader, 'mm_thief_main_s4_6_13')

		--오딜 생각말풍선 (현재 방향, sleep_deep, idle) : 내 말을 고분고분 잘 들은 건 그 때문이었나.
		scene_util.show_thought_speech_async(leader, 'mm_thief_main_s4_6_14')

		--오딜 생각말풍선 (현재 방향, tired, idle) : 이 녀석들… 그럼 루시가 올 걸 알았으면서 검문을 그렇게 대충 한 거야?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
		scene_util.show_thought_speech_async(leader, 'mm_thief_main_s4_6_15')

		character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, leader)

	elseif clue_index == self.clue_index.android then
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'walk4legs', loop = false })

		--오딜 생각말풍선 (현재 방향, sleep_deep, idle) : 이런 위치에 로봇이 있었다고…?
		scene_util.show_thought_speech_async(leader, 'mm_thief_main_s4_6_16')

		--오딜 생각말풍선 (현재 방향, sleep_deep, idle) : …살인 트릭이 이해될 것 같기도…
		scene_util.show_thought_speech_async(leader, 'mm_thief_main_s4_6_17')

		--벤트에 있을 경우, 다시 기어 다녀야 하기 때문에.
		character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'walk4legs')
		leader.SpineController.TimeScale = 1

		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, leader)
	elseif clue_index == self.clue_index.piano then

		--오딜 생각말풍선 (현재 방향, sleep_deep, idle) : 이 그랜드 피아노 뭔가 이상하다….
		scene_util.show_thought_speech_async(leader, 'mm_thief_main_s4_6_18')
		--오딜 생각말풍선 (현재 방향, sleep_deep, idle) : 건반을 눌러도 소리가 제대로 안 나.
		scene_util.show_thought_speech_async(leader, 'mm_thief_main_s4_6_19')
		--오딜 생각말풍선 (현재 방향, sleep_deep, idle) : <b>리니아</b>에게 한 번 물어볼까.
		scene_util.show_thought_speech_async(leader, 'mm_thief_main_s4_6_20')

		character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, leader)
	end
end

function local_class:after_investigate_clue_scene(clue_index, is_show_narration, callback, exit_scene)
	--조사 단계가 없는 '피해자 신상'과 '와이어'는 저장하지 않는다.
	if self.clue_infos[clue_index].s4_progress_goal ~= self.clue_progress.gathered then
		self:add_clue_data_async(clue_index, self.clue_progress.investigate)
	end

	local is_all_clue = (self.clue_investigate_count == #self.clue_infos)

	--조사 단계가 없는 '피해자 신상'과 '와이어'는 제외
	is_show_narration = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_show_narration, true)
	if is_show_narration then
		--내레이션 박스 출력 : 증거품 ‘-’에 대한 정보가 갱신되었다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'thief_inventory_system_' .. clue_index })

		--증거품 확인 UI 즉시 출력한다.
		self.evidence_controller:show_clue_popup_async(clue_index - 1)
	end

	if callback then
		callback()
	end

	--해당 구역에서 얻을 수 있는 모든 증거를 얻었을 때
	-- 전부 다 모은 경우
	if is_all_clue then
		self.current_state = self.states.all_clue
		self.is_clear = true
		self:on_all_clue_scene()
		exit_scene = false
	end

	self:setting_quest_marker_by_clue_progress()

	exit_scene = lua_helper.get_or_default(exit_scene, true)

	if exit_scene then
		local leader = get_party_leader()
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, leader)
	end
end

function local_class:setting_quest_marker_by_clue_progress()
	--피아노 줄
	if self.clue_infos[self.clue_index.wire].progress == self.clue_progress.none then
		quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('clue_wire', {
			{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.marker.clue_pos(1) },
		}, nil, nil, false)
	else
		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('clue_wire')
	end

	--피해자 신상
	if self.clue_infos[self.clue_index.profile].progress == self.clue_progress.none then
		quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('clue_profile', {
			{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.marker.clue_pos(2) },
		}, nil, nil, false)
	else
		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('clue_profile')
	end

	--컨트롤러
	if self.clue_infos[self.clue_index.controller].progress == self.clue_progress.none then
		quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('clue_controller', {
			{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.marker.clue_pos(3) },
			{ zone = 'vent_field', target = get_field_object('vent_out_interact_2') },
		}, nil, nil, false)
	else
		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('clue_controller')
	end

	--안드로이드
	if self.clue_infos[self.clue_index.android].progress == self.clue_progress.none then
		quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('clue_android', {
			{ zone = 'vent_field', target = self.marker.clue_pos(6) },
		}, nil, nil, false)
	elseif self.clue_infos[self.clue_index.controller].progress == self.clue_progress.gathered and
			self.clue_infos[self.clue_index.android].progress == self.clue_progress.gathered then
		--노턴 (컨트롤러 + 안드로이드)
		quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('clue_android', {
			{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.npc.engineer() },
		})
	else
		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('clue_android')
	end

	--수면제
	if self.clue_infos[self.clue_index.pill].progress == self.clue_progress.none then
		quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('clue_pill', {
			{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.marker.clue_pos(4) },
			{ zone = 'vent_field', target = get_field_object('vent_out_interact_3') },
		}, nil, nil, false)
	elseif self.clue_infos[self.clue_index.pill].progress == self.clue_progress.gathered then
		quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('clue_pill', {
			{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.npc.noble_male() },
		})
	else
		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('clue_pill')
	end

	--출입기록
	if self.clue_infos[self.clue_index.records].progress == self.clue_progress.none then
		quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('clue_records', {
			{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.marker.clue_pos(5) },
		}, nil, nil, false)
	elseif self.clue_infos[self.clue_index.records].progress == self.clue_progress.gathered then
		quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('clue_records', {
			{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.npc.staff_male(1) },
		})
	else
		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('clue_records')
	end

	--그랜드 피아노
	if self.clue_infos[self.clue_index.piano].progress == self.clue_progress.none then
		quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('clue_piano', {
			{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.marker.clue_pos(7) },
		}, nil, nil, false)
	elseif self.clue_infos[self.clue_index.piano].progress == self.clue_progress.gathered then
		--그랜드 피아노를 가지고 있을 경우, 리니아 위치에 메인 퀘스트 마커 활성화된다.
		quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('clue_piano', {
			{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.npc.pianist() },
		})
	else
		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('clue_piano')
	end

end

function local_class:interact_pianist()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local pianist = self.npc.pianist()
	local disguised_thief = self.npc.disguised_thief()

	if self.clue_infos[self.clue_index.piano].progress == self.clue_progress.gathered then
		--그랜드 피아노 단서를 가지고 있을 경우, 인터렉트시 이벤트 발생한다.
		sp_util.enter_scene(nil)
		self.already_talk_with_clue.pianist = true

		--인터렉트시,
		--이벤트 시작과 함께 BGM 볼륨 0.6 으로 변경
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

		--플레이어 컨트롤 빼앗는다.

		--오딜 (right, idle, walk) 적용, 1초에 걸쳐 위 위치로 정렬한다. async
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
		wp_util.move_async(leader, vector_util.get_x0z(pianist.Position) + vector(-1, 0, 0), nil, 1,
				{ last_direction = 'right' })

		--오딜 (right, idle, release 2회) async
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

		--리니아 (left, idle, idle)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
		scene_util.set_direction(pianist, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_anim(pianist, self, 'idle')
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(pianist, self, nil,
				nil, nil, 'question')

		--오딜 (right, idle, cross_arm) : 이봐, 무엇 하나만 물어보지.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'right',

function local_class:interact_staff(npc)
	local staff_male = self.npc.staff_male(1)
	local staff_female = self.npc.staff_female(1)

	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.clue_infos[self.clue_index.records].progress == self.clue_progress.gathered then
		sp_util.enter_scene(nil)
		--플레이어 컨트롤 빼앗는다.

		--이벤트 시작과 함께 BGM 볼륨 0.6 으로 변경
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

		--오딜 (현재 방향, idle, walk) 적용, 1초에 걸쳐 정렬 위치로 정렬한다. async
		wp_util.move_async(leader, staff_male.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 1), nil, 1, { last_direction = 'down' })

		--직원 1, 2 (up, idle, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(staff_male, 'up', false)
		scene_util.set_direction(staff_female, 'up', false)

		--오딜 (down, idle, release 2회) : 이봐, 자네들 마침 잘 됐군.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'down',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s4_7_1')

		--오딜 (down, idle, idle) : 궁금했던 것 좀 묻지.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'down',
				nil, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s4_7_2')

		--오딜 (down, idle, idle) : 처음에 내가 검색대에서 입장 심사를 받았을 때, 왜 그렇게 검색을 대충했던 거지?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'down',
				nil, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s4_7_3')

		--오딜 (down, idle, idle) : 괴도가 올 수도 있다는 사실은 자네들도 알았을 텐데.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'down',
				nil, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s4_7_4')

		--직원 1 스파인 shake (0.02, 0.5) async 아님.
		character_util.shake(staff_male, 0.02, 0.5)

		--직원 1 (up, idle, idle) sweat 이모티콘 출력, async
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(staff_male, self, 'up',
				nil, nil, 'sweat')

		--직원 1 (up, idle, idle) : 그게 사실은…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff_male, self, 'up',
				nil, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s4_7_5')

		--직원 1 (right, tired, cast)
		scene_util.set_direction(staff_male, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(staff_male, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim(staff_male, self, 'cast')

		--직원 2 (left, idle, release 2회) : 아니, 내가 말할게.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff_female, self, 'left',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s4_7_6')

		--직원 2 (up, idle, idle) : 말씀하신대로 괴도가 행사장에 잡입할 수도 있다는 사실은 저희도 알았어요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff_female, self, 'up',
				nil, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s4_7_7')

		--직원 2 (up, idle, idle) : 그렇지만 저희같은 일반인이… 전설적인 괴도의 변장을 알아챌 수 있을 리 없잖아요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff_female, self, 'up',
				nil, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s4_7_8')

		--직원 2 (up, idle, idle) : 그래서 서류상의 정보만 일치하면 들여보내 드렸습니다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff_female, self, 'up',
				nil, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s4_7_9')

		--직원 2 (up, idle, idle) : 제 딴에는 위험물품만 철저하게 검사하면 괜찮을 줄 알았거든요….
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff_female, self, 'up',
				nil, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s4_7_10')

		--직원 2 (up, idle, idle) : 이런 일이 벌어질 줄은… 정말 몰랐어요. 죄송합니다.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff_female, self, 'up',
				nil, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s4_7_11')

		--오딜 (down, idle, idle) : 그렇게 된 것이었나.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'down',
				nil, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s4_7_12')

		--증거품에 대한 정보 최신화한다.
		--키값 : thief_inventory_item_5_desc_ex_1
		--나레이션 : 증거품 ‘검색대 출입 기록’에 대한 정보가 갱신되었다.
		--키값 : thief_inventory_system_5
		--증거품 확인 UI 즉시 출력한다.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_02')
		self:after_investigate_clue_scene(self.clue_index.records, true, function()
			--오딜 (down, idle, idle) : 좋아. 납득했어.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, nil,
					nil, nil, { key = 'mm_thief_main_s4_7_13', skip = true })

			--오딜 (down, idle, idle) : 계속 현장 관리에 신경써 줘.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, nil,
					nil, nil, { key = 'mm_thief_main_s4_7_14', skip = true })

			--직원1 (right, tired, cast)
			scene_util.set_direction(staff_male, 'right', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion(staff_male, self, 'tired')
			scene_util.set_anim(staff_male, self, 'cast')

			--직원2 (left, tired, idle)
			scene_util.set_direction(staff_female, 'left', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion(staff_female, self, 'tired')
			character_util.remove_anim(staff_female)
		end)

		--플레이어 컨트롤 돌려준다.
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		if not self.is_clear then
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
		end
	else
		if npc == staff_male then
			--직원1 (right, tired, cast) : 선배, 그러게 수면제 같은 물품도 다 잡아야 한다고 했잖아요…!
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff_male, self, nil,
					nil, nil, { key = 'mm_thief_main_s4_5_3', skip = false })
		else
			--직원2 (left, tired, idle) : 분명 위험 품목 검사는 제대로 했는데…
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff_female, self, nil,
					nil, nil, { key = 'mm_thief_main_s4_5_4', skip = false })
		end
	end

end

function local_class:on_all_clue_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	--증거 수집 종료 이후

	--이벤트 시작과 함께 BGM 볼륨 0.6 으로 변경
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--플레이어 컨트롤 빼앗는다.
	--오딜 (right, idle, idle) : 좋아, 증거품은 이 정도면 충분해.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'right',
			'idle', 'idle', 'mm_thief_main_s4_4_1')

	--오딜 (right, idle, idle) : 이걸로 용의자는 좁혀졌다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s4_4_2')

	--오딜 (right, idle, idle) : 하지만 정확히 누가 진짜 범인인지는 아직 불확실한 상태…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s4_4_3')

	--오딜 (right, idle, nod 2회) : 용의자들을 모아두고 이야기를 들어보는 게 좋겠군.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s4_4_4')

	--화면 페이드 아웃과 함께 BGM 재생 종료 시작
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0, 1)

	--1초에 걸쳐 화면 검정색 페이드아웃. async
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self:setting_after_all_clue()

	--카메라 포커스 위치는 노란색 마름모
	camera_util.set_position(self.marker.center_pos())

	--CODE : 임의로 0.5초 대기 넣었음.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self:ending_scene()
end

function local_class:ending_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local pianist = self.npc.pianist()
	local noble_male = self.npc.noble_male()
	local engineer = self.npc.engineer()
	local disguised_thief = self.npc.disguised_thief()

		scene_util.set_anim(dynamic_npc_5, self, 'idle')

		scene_util.set_emotion(dynamic_npc_6, self, 'surprise')
		scene_util.set_anim(dynamic_npc_6, self, 'cast2')

		--리니아 (left, attack, idle)

		scene_util.set_emotion(pianist, self, 'attack')

		--오딜 말풍선 : 리니아.
		--말풍선 위치 (x:0.5 , y:0.25)

	--동시 연출 async

function local_class:get_clue_ui_data()
	local data = {}

	for index, info in pairs(self.clue_infos) do
		table.insert(data, {
			id = index, info_index = index, sprite = info.sprite_name,
			enabled = (info.progress > 0), cur_count = self.clue_gather_count,
			progress = info.progress
		})
	end

	return data
end


--region 데이터 처리 유틸

-- 증거 습득 세팅
function local_class:add_clue_data_async(index, target_state)
	local info = self.clue_infos[index]
	local clue_binary = self:get_clue_data()

	local shift = info.binary_exponent * 2

	-- 00 : 미수집 / 01 : 수집 / 10 : 대화이벤트 완료 / 11 : 미사용
	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, self.clue_custom_state_key,
			(clue_binary & ~(3 << shift)) | (target_state << shift))

	info.progress = target_state

	if target_state == 1 then
		self.clue_gather_count = self.clue_gather_count + 1

		if info.progress == info.s4_progress_goal then
			self.clue_investigate_count = self.clue_investigate_count + 1
		end
	elseif target_state == 2 then
		if info.progress == info.s4_progress_goal then
			self.clue_investigate_count = self.clue_investigate_count + 1
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_clue_data()
	local clue_binary = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, self.clue_custom_state_key)

	if clue_binary < 0 then
		return 0
	end

	return clue_binary
end
--endregion

		self.evidence_controller:set_connected_class(nil)
		self.evidence_controller = nil
	end

function local_class:dispose()

--memo : 증거품 가져오기 데이터 함수를 미리 만들어 놨으니, 아고라 연출에 맞게 자유롭게 수정하셔도 됩니다.
function local_class:get_clue_ui_data()
	local data = {}

	for index, info in pairs(self.clue_infos) do
		table.insert(data, { item_id = info.item_id, id = index, info_index = index, sprite = info.sprite_name,
							 enabled = true, cur_count = #self.clue_infos, progress = info.progress_goal,
							 pending_title = info.pending_title })
	end

	return data
end

function local_class:progress_minigame_hp(is_player_turn_win)
	--리니아과 플레이어는 각각 HP를 갖고 있다.
	--리니아 HP = 3 / 플레이어 (오딜) HP = 3
	--미니 게임 진행 간 플레이어의 증거 제시에 따라 리니아 혹은 플레이어의 HP 감소
	if is_player_turn_win then
		--올바른 증거를 제시 할 시 리니아 HP 1 감소
		self.demon_pianist_hp = self.demon_pianist_hp - 1
	else
		--틀린 증거를 제시 할 시 플레이어 HP 1 감소
		self.player_hp = self.player_hp - 1
	end

	--플레이어의 HP가 0일 경우 미니 게임 실패 처리, 미니 게임 실패 연출 이벤트 진행.
	--마지막까지 리니아의 말을 성공적으로 논파할 경우 클리어.
end

function local_class:check_minigame_end()
	local is_ended = false

	if self.demon_pianist_hp < 1 or self.player_hp < 1 then
		is_ended = true
	end

	return is_ended
end

function local_class:is_player_win()
	local is_player_win = false

	if self.demon_pianist_hp < 1 then
		is_player_win = true
	end

	return is_player_win
end

function local_class:inspector_routine()
	local inspector = self.npc.demon_inspector()
	local pianist = self.npc.pianist()

	self.inspector_ui_round_widget:SetActive(false)

	self:inspector_enter()
	self:inspector_start_scene()

	self.current_inspector_state = self.inspector_state.in_game

	local success = true
	local round_text_index = 1
	for round = 1, self.inspector_round_info.target do
		-- 라운드 시작
		self.inspector_round_info.current = round

		-- 라운드 시작 시의 연출
		-- inspector_r1_pre_scene
		-- inspector_r2_pre_scene
		-- inspector_r3_pre_scene
		self:inspector_toggle_bottom_ui(true)
		self['inspector_r' .. round .. '_pre_scene'](self)

		--대화 상자 UI 비활성화.
		self:inspector_toggle_bottom_ui(false)

		--크로스페이드 BGM - A 올라옴, 볼륨 0.8
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.8, 1)

		--크로스페이드 BGM - B 내려감, 볼륨 0
		self.sfx_amb:ChangeVolume(0, 1)

		while self.inspector_hp_info.player.current > 0 do
			local round_text = game_string:Format('agora_battle_round_text', round_text_index)
			self.inspector_ui_controller:SetRoundLabel(round_text)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
			CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(round_text, 1.5)

			--오딜, 리니아(attack, dualsword_idle)
			character_util.set_emotion(inspector, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.set_anim(inspector, { name = 'dualsword_idle' })
			character_util.set_emotion(pianist, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.set_anim(pianist, { name = 'dualsword_idle' })

			wait_for_sec(1.5)

			--논쟁 대화 모드 UI 활성화
			self:inspector_toggle_bottom_ui(true)
			self.inspector_ui_round_widget:SetActive(true)

			self:inspector_enter_choice_mode(round)

			while self.inspector_round_info.selected_evidence_index == 0 do
				coroutine.yield()
			end

			self:inspector_exit_choice_mode()

			--논쟁 대화 모드 UI 비활성화
			self:inspector_toggle_bottom_ui(false)

			-- 맞는 선택을 한 경우
			if self.inspector_round_info.selected_evidence_index == self.inspector_round_info.choice[round].evidence.answer then
				-- inspector_r1_post_scene
				-- inspector_r2_post_scene
				-- inspector_r3_post_scene
				self['inspector_r' .. round .. '_post_scene'](self)
				round_text_index = round_text_index + 1
				break
			else
				-- 잘못된 선택을 한 경우
				self:inspector_round_wrong_choice()
				-- 다시 선택할 수 있도록 루프문 바깥을 빠져나가지 않음
			end
		end

		-- 체력이 다 깎이면 게임 실패 처리
		if self.inspector_hp_info.player.current == 0 then
			success = false
			break
		end
	end

	if success then
		self.current_state = self.states.win
	else
		--실패 연출
		self:inspector_lose()
	end

	self:inspector_exit()
end

function local_class:inspector_speech(talker, text, duration)
	local fo_info = self.inspector_speech_info.fo_infos[talker]

	if fo_info then
		local string_builder = CS.System.Text.StringBuilder()
		string_builder:Clear()
		string_builder:Append(game_string:GetStringWithReservedKeywords(text))
		local str_len = string_builder.Length

		self.inspector_ui_controller:SetBottomUI(fo_info.portrait, fo_info.name, '')

		if duration == nil then
			local life_time = self.inspector_speech_info.life_time
			local print_duration = str_len * self.inspector_speech_info.type_speed

			local time_passed = 0

			self.inspector_speech_info.state = self.inspector_speech_state.printing

			local text_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '03_dialogue_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'default',
			})
			while self.inspector_speech_info.state == self.inspector_speech_state.printing and time_passed < print_duration do
				local progress = time_passed / print_duration
				local sub_index = math.ceil(str_len * progress)

				if sub_index < str_len then
					self.inspector_ui_controller:SetBottomUI(fo_info.portrait, fo_info.name, string_builder:ToString(0, sub_index))
				end

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield()
			end
			text_sfx:FadeOut(0.05)

			self.inspector_ui_controller:SetBottomUI(fo_info.portrait, fo_info.name, string_builder:ToString())

			self.inspector_speech_info.state = self.inspector_speech_state.wait_skip

			while self.inspector_speech_info.state == self.inspector_speech_state.wait_skip and life_time > 0 do
				life_time = life_time - unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield()
			end
		else
			-- 대략 절반정도의 시간동안은 텍스트 출력만 함
			local print_duration = duration / 2

			self.inspector_speech_info.state = self.inspector_speech_state.non_skip_printing

			local time_passed = 0

			local text_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '03_dialogue_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'default',
			})
			while time_passed < print_duration do
				local progress = time_passed / print_duration
				local sub_index = math.ceil(str_len * progress)

				if sub_index < str_len then
					self.inspector_ui_controller:SetBottomUI(fo_info.portrait, fo_info.name, string_builder:ToString(0, sub_index))
				end

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield()
			end
			text_sfx:FadeOut(0.05)

			self.inspector_ui_controller:SetBottomUI(fo_info.portrait, fo_info.name, string_builder:ToString())

			wait_for_sec(duration - print_duration)
		end
	else
		self.inspector_ui_controller:SetBottomUI(nil, nil, nil)
	end

	self.inspector_speech_info.state = self.inspector_speech_state.idle
end

function local_class:on_inspector_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		if self.inspector_speech_info.state == self.inspector_speech_state.wait_skip then
			self.inspector_speech_info.state = self.inspector_speech_state.skipped
			return true
		elseif self.inspector_speech_info.state == self.inspector_speech_state.printing then
			self.inspector_speech_info.state = self.inspector_speech_state.wait_skip
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:inspector_update_selectable_speech()
	local selectables = self.inspector_round_info.choice[self.inspector_round_info.current].speech.selectables
	local cur_text_key = selectables[self.inspector_round_info.selected_speech_index]
	local fo_info = self.inspector_speech_info.fo_infos[self.npc.pianist()]

	self.inspector_ui_controller:SetBottomUI(fo_info.portrait, fo_info.name,
			game_string:GetStringWithReservedKeywords(cur_text_key))

	if self.inspector_round_info.selected_speech_index == self.inspector_round_info.choice[self.inspector_round_info.current].speech.answer then
		self.inspector_ui_controller:SetBottomDescColor(unity_class.color.yellow)
	else
		self.inspector_ui_controller:SetBottomDescColor(unity_class.color.white)
	end

	self:inspector_toggle_left_arrow(self.inspector_round_info.selected_speech_index > 1)
	self:inspector_toggle_right_arrow(self.inspector_round_info.selected_speech_index < #selectables)
end

--region 상단 UI
--기존 기믹에서 좌우가 바뀐 상태로 연출되어있기 때문에, player / enemy가 뜻하는 부분 교체 enemy : 실제 플레이어 \\ player : 리니아
function local_class:inspector_set_hp(is_player, diff, duration)
	if is_player then
		local info = self.inspector_hp_info.enemy

		info.current = info.current - diff
		self.inspector_ui_controller:SetPlayerHeart(info.current, info.max)
		self.inspector_ui_controller:SetPlayerProgressBar(info.current / self.inspector_hp_info.enemy.max)
	else
		local info = self.inspector_hp_info.player

		info.current = info.current - diff
		self.inspector_ui_controller:SetNpcHeart(info.current, info.max)
		self.inspector_ui_controller:SetNpcProgressBar(info.current / self.inspector_hp_info.player.max)
	end
end

--endregion

function local_class:inspector_enter_choice_mode(round)
	-- 증거 리스트 관련 처리
	self.inspector_round_info.selected_evidence_index = 0

	self.inspector_ui_controller.EvidenceButtonCb = function()
		self:inspector_toggle_button_red_dot(false)
		self:inspector_show_evidence_popup()
	end

	self.inspector_ui_controller:SetEvidenceButton(true)

	-- 대화창 관련 처리
	self.inspector_speech_info.state = self.inspector_speech_state.selecting

	if self.inspector_round_info.selected_speech_index == self.inspector_round_info.choice[round].evidence.answer then
		self.inspector_ui_controller:SetBottomDescColor(unity_class.color.yellow)
	else
		self.inspector_ui_controller:SetBottomDescColor(unity_class.color.white)
	end

	local speeches = self.inspector_round_info.choice[self.inspector_round_info.current].speech.selectables

	self.inspector_round_info.selected_speech_index = 1
	self:inspector_update_selectable_speech()

	-- 왼쪽 화살표 버튼 콜백 추가
	self.inspector_ui_controller.LeftButtonCb = function()
		if self.inspector_round_info.selected_speech_index > 1 then
			self.inspector_round_info.selected_speech_index = self.inspector_round_info.selected_speech_index - 1
			self:inspector_update_selectable_speech()
		end
	end

	-- 오른쪽 화살표 버튼 콜백 추가
	self.inspector_ui_controller.RightButtonCb = function()
		if self.inspector_round_info.selected_speech_index < #speeches then
			self.inspector_round_info.selected_speech_index = self.inspector_round_info.selected_speech_index + 1
			self:inspector_update_selectable_speech()
		end
	end

	self.inspector_ui_controller:SetArrowContainer(true)
end

function local_class:inspector_exit_choice_mode()
	-- 따로 뭔가가 다시 발동하지 않도록 콜백 리셋
	self.inspector_ui_controller.LeftButtonCb = nil
	self.inspector_ui_controller.RightButtonCb = nil
	self.inspector_ui_controller.EvidenceButtonCb = nil

	self.inspector_ui_controller:SetArrowContainer(false)
	self.inspector_ui_controller:SetEvidenceButton(false)

	self.inspector_ui_controller:SetBottomDescColor(unity_class.color.white)

	self.inspector_speech_info.state = self.inspector_speech_state.idle
end

function local_class:inspector_play_speech_action(fo, anim_data, emotion_data, talk_key)
	if anim_data ~= nil then
		if type_util.is_string(anim_data) then
			anim_data = { name = anim_data }
		end

		scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, anim_data)
	end

	if emotion_data ~= nil then
		if type_util.is_string(emotion_data) then
			emotion_data = { name = emotion_data }
		end

		scene_util.set_emotion(fo, self, emotion_data)
	end

	self:inspector_speech(fo, talk_key)

	if anim_data ~= nil then
		local is_upper = lua_helper.get_value(anim_data, 'upper', nil)
		character_util.remove_anim(fo, is_upper)
	end

	if emotion_data ~= nil then
		character_util.remove_emotion(fo)
	end
end

--region 공통 연출
function local_class:inspector_set_attachment(fo, item)
	local bone_follower = CS.GameObjectExtensions.GetOrAddComponent(item.SpriteTransform.parent.gameObject,
			typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
	bone_follower.followBoneRotation = false
	bone_follower.SkeletonRenderer = fo.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation
	bone_follower:SetBone('[base]weapon1_side')
	self:agora_set_item_layer(item, false)
end

function local_class:inspector_dispose_attachment(fo, item)
	local bone_follower = item.SpriteTransform.parent.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
	bone_follower.enabled = false
end

function local_class:inspector_create_item(evidence_index, pos)
	--피아노줄 예외 처리
	local is_wire = self.evidence_infos[evidence_index].item_id == 21768
	local custom_item_id = nil

	if is_wire then
		custom_item_id = self.piano_wire_id
	else
		custom_item_id = self.evidence_infos[evidence_index].item_id
	end
	local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
		item_id = custom_item_id,
		loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
		show_on_character = true,
		pos = pos,
	})

	item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero

	return item
end

function local_class:inspector_dispose_item(item)
	local bone_follower = item.SpriteTransform.parent.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
	if not is_unity_null(bone_follower) then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(bone_follower)
	end

	item:ConsumeComplete()
end

function local_class:inspector_set_item_layer(item, showoncharacter)
	if showoncharacter then
		item:SetSortingLayer('Top Effects')
	else
		item:SetSortingLayer('Under Effects')
	end
end

function local_class:inspector_item_move_async(start_pos, target_pos, evidence_index, duration, item, consume_target)
	item = item or self:inspector_create_item(evidence_index, start_pos)

	quest_drop_item_util.rotate(item, 720, duration)
	quest_drop_item_util.move_async(item, target_pos, { duration = duration })

	quest_drop_item_util.consumed(item, consume_target)
end

--정답 시 진행
function local_class:inspector_round_right_choice(on_hit_callback)
	local inspector = self.npc.demon_inspector()
	local pianist = self.npc.pianist()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--화면 shake (0.2, 0.2) async 아님.
	--오딜(right, attack, cross_arm): 받아랏!
	--해당 대사는 뷰포트 (x: 0.3 y: 0.6) 위치에서 출력.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.2)
	character_util.set_emotion(inspector, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.play_speech_action(inspector, 'cross_arm', nil,
			{ key = 'mm_thief_main_s6_20', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout', viewport_pos = vector(0.3, 0.5) })

	--오딜 (right, attack, sword_attack) 상태로 [수면제] (capsule_pill)을
	local evidence_info = self.evidence_infos[self.inspector_round_info.selected_evidence_index]

	inspector.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', evidence_info.sprite_name)
	character_util.set_anim(inspector, { name = 'sword_attack', scale = 0, mix_duration = 0.3 })
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_02')
	character_util.set_anim(inspector, { name = 'sword_attack', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	inspector.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')

	self:inspector_item_move_async(inspector.Position + vector(-0.3, 0.4, 0),
			pianist.Position + vector(0.2, 0.5, 0),
			self.inspector_round_info.selected_evidence_index, 0.4, nil, pianist)

	if on_hit_callback then
		on_hit_callback()
	end

	self:inspector_set_hp(true, 1, 0.5)

	--날아간 증거품이 카론과 충돌 시
	--잠시 강하게 카메라 쉐이크가 되며
	camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.4)

	--lasthit 이펙트 연출.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_02')
	self.fx.hit():Instantiate(pianist.Position + vector(0.2, 0.5, 0))
	self.fx.lasthit():Instantiate(pianist.Position + vector(0.2, 0.5, 0))
	damage_util.show_damage_number(pianist, 1, unity_class.color.red, pianist.Position + vector(0, -0.2, 0))

	--크로스페이드 BGM - A 내려감, 볼륨 0
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0, 0.1)
	self.sfx_amb:ChangeVolume(0.8, 0.1)

	--크로스페이드 BGM - B 올라옴, 볼륨 0.8

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_ronpa_brass_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(inspector)

	--증거품에 맞은 리니아은 제 자리에서 낮게 airspin 후
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(pianist)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(pianist)

	local spin_dur = 0.5

	character_util.set_emotion(pianist, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_anim(pianist, { name = 'prostrate', mix_duration = 0.4 })
	character_util.spine_rotate(pianist, -720, spin_dur)
	character_util.jump(pianist, 1, spin_dur)

	wait_for_sec(spin_dur)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bridge_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_03')

	character_util.spine_rotate(pianist, 0, 0)

	--confused, prostrate로 쓰러짐.
	character_util.set_emotion(pianist, { name = 'confused' })

	self:inspector_toggle_bottom_ui(true)
end

	--제 자리에서 낮게 airspin 이후 confused, prostrate로 쓰러짐.
	character_util.set_emotion(inspector, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_anim(inspector, { name = 'prostrate', mix_duration = 0.4 })

	self:inspector_play_speech_action(pianist, { name = 'release', count = 2 },

	self:inspector_play_speech_action(inspector, nil,
			'attack', 'mm_thief_main_s6_77')

	--오딜(right, tired, prostrate) : 저 녀석이 진범이다. 틀림없어.
	self:inspector_play_speech_action(inspector, nil,
			'tired', 'mm_thief_main_s6_78')

	--오딜(right, tired, prostrate) : 어디서부터 놓친 거지…!
	self:inspector_play_speech_action(inspector, nil,
			'tired', 'mm_thief_main_s6_79')

	self:inspector_toggle_bottom_ui(false)

	--화면 1초간 검정색 페이드 아웃

	--페이드 인 전 세팅
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(inspector)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pianist)

			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'mm_thief_main_s6_5')

		},
		sprite_table = {},
		sprite_table_origin_parent = {},
		create = function(this, name, pos, item_id, scale, showoncharacter, target, drop_type, skip_text)
			scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
			showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, false)

					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = item.SpriteTransform.parent

			return item
		end,
		get = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				return this.sprite_table[name]
			end

			return nil
		end,
		consumed = function(this, name, target)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				quest_drop_item_util.consumed(this.sprite_table[name], target)
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		fly = function(this, name, target)
			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end
	}
	--endregion Sprite

		end,

		set_active = function(this, boolean)

		end,

			this.controller:set_background_sorting_order(layer_name, sorting_order)
		end,

		set_background_color = function(this, r, g, b)
			this.controller:set_background_color(r, g, b)
		end,

		fade_in_async = function(this, duration, fade_value)
			local time_passed = 0
			local value = lua_helper.get_or_default(fade_value, 1)

			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Min(time_passed / duration, value)

				this.controller:set_background_alpha(progress)

				coroutine.yield()

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			end

			this.controller:set_background_alpha(value)
		end,

		fade_out_async = function(this, duration)
			local time_passed = 0

			local value = this.controller.background_renderer.color.a

			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress_ratio = time_passed / duration

				local current_alpha = value - progress_ratio

				-- 3. 알파 값을 [0, 1] 범위로 제한하여 오류 방지
				local clamped_alpha = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(current_alpha)

				this.controller:set_background_alpha(clamped_alpha)

				coroutine.yield()

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			end

			--this.controller:set_background_alpha(0.0)
		end
	}
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.fx:create_all()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self:set_pre_npc()
	self:set_current_scene_npc(self.npc_placement_group.first_deduction)

	self.grading_controller = get_or_create_global_table('utils/CameraColorGradingController')

	local fo = self.field_object.vent()
	fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	self.controller:set_connected_class_on_controller(false)
end

function local_class:start()
	start_coroutine(function()
		sp_util.enter_scene()

		self.background_util:load_resource()

		self.grading_controller:load_async('ondemand/memorial_thief/effects',
				'color_grading_image_effect_container', 'color_grading')
		self.grading_controller:attach()

		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(0.1, function(progress)
			self.grading_controller:set_progress(progress)
		end)

		if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
			screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
			screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')
		else
			--섹션7에서 시작하지 않았으면 스태프 NPC 비활성화
			local staff_1 = self.npc.staff_male(1)
			local staff_2 = self.npc.staff_female(1)

			field_object_util.set_active_state(staff_1, active_state_type.disabled)
			field_object_util.set_active_state(staff_2, active_state_type.disabled)
		end

		do
			local paper = get_field_object('s4_puzzle_paper')
			local trashcan = get_field_object('s4_puzzle_trashcan')

			local block_1 = get_field_object('s4_puzzle_1')
			local block_2 = get_field_object('s4_puzzle_2')

			message_system:SendSync(block_1, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
			message_system:SendSync(block_2, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)

			message_system:SendSync(paper, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
			message_system:SendSync(trashcan, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)

		end

		self:opening_event()

		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())

		if not self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
			start_coroutine(self.controller.set_connected_class_on_controller, self.controller)
		end
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.controller:set_disconnected_class_on_controller()

	self.background_util.controller = nil

	if self.grading_controller ~= nil then
		self.grading_controller:detach()
		self.grading_controller = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.first_deduction and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc.criminal()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.start_first_deduction, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.second_deduction and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc.criminal()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.start_second_deduction, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.third_deduction and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc.criminal()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.start_third_deduction, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.fourth_deduction and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc.business_male()) then
		start_coroutine(self.start_fourth_deduction, self)

		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.field_object.vent()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.on_interact_vent, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

			},

function local_class:set_current_scene_npc(section_state)
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[section_state]

	if pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	linq(pre_npc_data):foreach(function(_, npc_data)
		local npc = get_character(npc_data.name)

		if npc == nil then
			if npc_data.name == 'leader' then
				npc = user_party.Leader
			else
				return
			end
		end

		if npc_data.remove_lv_ui ~= nil and npc_data.remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		npc_data.active_state = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.active_state, active_state_type.enabled)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, npc_data.active_state)


		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if npc_data.pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if npc_data.fly ~= nil and npc_data.fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, npc_data.pos, isFlying)
		end

		if npc_data.dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, npc_data.dir, false)
		end

		if npc_data.emo ~= nil then
			if npc_data.emo == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, npc_data.emo)
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_info ~= nil then
			if npc_data.anim_info == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			elseif type_util.is_table(npc_data.anim_info) then
				npc_data.anim_info.one_shot_sfx = false

				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, npc_data.anim_info)
			elseif type_util.is_string(npc_data.anim_info) then
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = npc_data.anim_info, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_time_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, npc_data.anim_time_scale)
		end

		if npc_data.alpha_value ~= nil then
			local alpha_duration = 0

			if npc_data.alpha_duration ~= nil then
				alpha_duration = npc_data.alpha_duration
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, npc_data.alpha_value, alpha_duration)
		end

		if npc_data.keep_shake ~= nil and npc_data.keep_shake == true then
			character_util.shake(npc, npc_data.shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if npc_data.sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', npc_data.sorting_layer)
		end

		if npc_data.start_deactive_shadow then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, false)
		end

		if npc_data.scale_factor ~= nil then
			character_util.set_scale_factor(npc, npc.Name, npc_data.scale_factor)
		end

		if npc_data.attaching_equipment ~= nil then
			character_util.spine_set_attachment(npc, npc_data.attaching_equipment.slot, npc_data.attaching_equipment.equipment)
		end

		if npc_data.tint_color then
			local tint_color_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.tint_color_magnitude, 1)

			character_util.add_color(npc, npc_data.tint_color_key, npc_data.tint_color, tint_color_magnitude, 0.1)
		end

		if npc_data.talk ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk) then
			if not lua_helper.type_compare(npc.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
				npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			end

			npc.Interactable.Talk = npc_data.talk
		end

		if npc_data.talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk_sfx) then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = npc_data.talk_sfx
		end

		if npc_data.hitbox ~= nil then
			npc.Hitbox = npc_data.hitbox
		end

		if npc_data.post_func ~= nil then
			npc_data.post_func(npc)
		end
	end)
end

end

			showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, false)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item(

					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = item.SpriteTransform.parent

			return item
		end,
		get = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				return this.sprite_table[name]
			end

			return nil
		end,
		consumed = function(this, name, target)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then

				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		fly = function(this, name, target)
			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end
	}

function local_class:set_current_scene_npc(section_state)
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[section_state]

	if pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	linq(pre_npc_data):foreach(function(_, npc_data)
		local npc = get_character(npc_data.name)

		if npc == nil then
			if npc_data.name == 'leader' then
				npc = user_party.Leader
			else
				return
			end
		end

		if npc_data.remove_lv_ui ~= nil and npc_data.remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		npc_data.active_state = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.active_state, active_state_type.enabled)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, npc_data.active_state)


		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if npc_data.pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if npc_data.fly ~= nil and npc_data.fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, npc_data.pos, isFlying)
		end

		if npc_data.dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, npc_data.dir, false)
		end

		if npc_data.emo ~= nil then
			if npc_data.emo == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, npc_data.emo)
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_info ~= nil then
			if npc_data.anim_info == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			elseif type_util.is_table(npc_data.anim_info) then
				npc_data.anim_info.one_shot_sfx = false

				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, npc_data.anim_info)
			elseif type_util.is_string(npc_data.anim_info) then
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = npc_data.anim_info, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_time_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, npc_data.anim_time_scale)
		end

		if npc_data.alpha_value ~= nil then
			local alpha_duration = 0

			if npc_data.alpha_duration ~= nil then
				alpha_duration = npc_data.alpha_duration
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, npc_data.alpha_value, alpha_duration)
		end

		if npc_data.keep_shake ~= nil and npc_data.keep_shake == true then
			character_util.shake(npc, npc_data.shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if npc_data.sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', npc_data.sorting_layer)
		end

		if npc_data.start_deactive_shadow then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, false)
		end

		if npc_data.scale_factor ~= nil then
			character_util.set_scale_factor(npc, npc.Name, npc_data.scale_factor)
		end

		if npc_data.attaching_equipment ~= nil then
			character_util.spine_set_attachment(npc, npc_data.attaching_equipment.slot, npc_data.attaching_equipment.equipment)
		end

		if npc_data.tint_color then
			local tint_color_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.tint_color_magnitude, 1)

			character_util.add_color(npc, npc_data.tint_color_key, npc_data.tint_color, tint_color_magnitude, 0.1)
		end

		if npc_data.talk ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk) then
			if not lua_helper.type_compare(npc.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
				npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			end

			npc.Interactable.Talk = npc_data.talk
		end

		if npc_data.talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk_sfx) then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = npc_data.talk_sfx
		end

		if npc_data.hitbox ~= nil then
			npc.Hitbox = npc_data.hitbox
		end

		if npc_data.post_func ~= nil then
			npc_data.post_func(npc)
		end
	end)
end

function local_class:ending_event()
	local demon_inspector = self.npc.demon_inspector()
	local pianist = self.npc.pianist()
	local engineer = self.npc.engineer()
	local noble = self.npc.noble_male()
	local disguised_thief = self.npc.disguised_thief()
	local thief = self.npc.thief()

	--카메라 포커스 노란색 마름모 위치
	camera_util.set_position(self.marker.camera(1, 1))

	--카메라 크기 3.0
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3, 0)

	--화면 하얀색으로 2초간 페이드 인
	local fade_in_color = unity_class.color.white
	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		fade_in_color = unity_class.color.black
	else
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	local sfx_amb = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_01', loop = true, volume = 0.4, fade_in_time = 0.4 })

	screen_util.fade_in_async(2, fade_in_color)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--화면 shake (0.2, 0.2) async 아님.
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.2)

	--리니아 (left, cry, hurt) : [shout] 맞아요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(pianist, self, 'left',
			'hurt', 'cry', 'mm_thief_main_s8_1_1')

	--리니아 (left, cry, hurt) : 제가 죽였어요…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pianist, self, 'left',
			'hurt', 'cry', 'mm_thief_main_s8_1_2')

	--리니아 (left, cry, hurt) : 그렇지만… 정말… 정말 어쩔 수 없었어요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pianist, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'hurt', keep = true }, { name = 'cry', keep = true }, 'mm_thief_main_s8_1_3')

	--리니아 스파인 shake (0.03, 0.5) async 아님
	scene_util.shake(pianist, 0.03, 0.5)

	--리니아 (left, cry, hurt)
	scene_util.set_direction(pianist, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(pianist, self, 'cry')
	scene_util.set_anim(pianist, self, 'hurt')

	--리니아 (left, attack, hurt) : 루이스… 그 인간 때문에 저는 모든 것을 잃었어요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pianist, self, 'left',
			nil, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'mm_thief_main_s8_1_4')

	--리니아 스파인 shake (0.03, 0.5) async 아님
	scene_util.shake(pianist, 0.03, 0.5, false)

	--리니아 (left, attack, idle) : 피아노도… 그이도…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pianist, self, 'left',
			'idle', nil, 'mm_thief_main_s8_1_5')

	--동시 실행, async
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--리니아 (left, tired, idle) 스파인 shake (0.02, 1.0)
				character_util.shake(pianist, 0.02, 1)

				wait_for_sec(1)
			end,
			function()
				--리니아 (left, tired, idle) silence 이모티콘 출력
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
				scene_util.play_emoticon_action(pianist, self, 'left',
						nil, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'silence')
			end
	)

	--리니아 (left, tired, release 2회) : 아시카씨, 알고 계신지 모르겠지만…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pianist, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s8_1_6')

	--리니아 (left, tired, idle) : 당신의 아들과 저는… 정말로 서로 사랑하는 사이였어요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pianist, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'mm_thief_main_s8_1_6_1')

	--리니아 (left, attack, attack 1회) attack sfx 타이밍에 맞추어 21796 아이템 스프라이트 포물선으로 던진다.

	scene_util.set_emotion(pianist, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(pianist, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1, sfx_callback = function()
		self.sprite:create('necklace', pianist.Position,

function local_class:enter()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_switch_on_off_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	self:setting_npc_on_enter()
	self:setting_hidden_block_on_enter()
	self:setting_items_on_enter()

end

end

function local_class:exit()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))

	self.cached_item:dispose_all()

			'ondemand/v2_22_lilithtower/theatres/ending', 'white_tint_background')

	self.black_tint_sr_obj.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 40
	self.black_tint_sr_obj.transform.localPosition = vector(0, 10, 0)

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_interact_royal_guard and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc.royal_guard()) then

		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_royal_guard, self)

		return true

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.before_interact_common_hidden_block and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.field_object.common_hidden_block()) then

		--sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_common_hidden_block, self)

		return true

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.on_deliver_vampire_captain_letter then

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.field_object.vampire_secretary_hidden_block()) then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_vampire_secretary_hidden_block_without_delivery, self)

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.field_object.vampire_captain_hidden_block()) then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_vampire_captain_hidden_block, self)

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.field_object.vampire_captain_table()) then

			sp_util.start_scene(self.deliver_vampire_captain_letter, self)

		end

		return true

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.on_select_vampire_captain_gift then
		for idx = 1, 3 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.field_object.vampire_captain_gift(idx)) then
				sp_util.start_scene(self.select_vampire_captain_gift, self, idx)
				return true
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.on_give_gift_to_vampire_secretary then

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.field_object.vampire_secretary_hidden_block()) then

			sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_vampire_secretary_hidden_block, self)

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.field_object.vampire_secretary_table()) then

			sp_util.start_scene(self.give_gift_to_vampire_secretary, self)

		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.on_select_vampire_secretary_gift then
		for idx = 1, 3 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.field_object.vampire_secretary_gift(idx)) then
				sp_util.start_scene(self.select_vampire_secretary_gift, self, idx)
				return true
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.on_give_gift_to_vampire_captain then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.field_object.vampire_captain_table()) then

			sp_util.start_scene(self.give_gift_to_vampire_captain, self)

		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name.common_room) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.on_give_gift_to_vampire_secretary or
				self.current_state == self.states.on_give_gift_to_vampire_captain then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.leave_common_room_without_give_gift, self)
		end
	end

	if not self.is_already_enter_puzzle_npc_zone then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name.puzzle_npc_zone_1) and
				(self.current_state == self.states.before_enter_royal_guard_zone or
						self.current_state == self.states.before_interact_royal_guard) then

			self.is_already_enter_puzzle_npc_zone = true
			start_coroutine(self.enter_puzzle_npc_zone_before_royal_guard, self)
			return true

		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name.puzzle_npc_zone_2) and
				self.current_state == self.states.before_interact_common_hidden_block then

			self.is_already_enter_puzzle_npc_zone = true
			start_coroutine(self.enter_puzzle_npc_zone_after_royal_guard, self)
			return true

		end
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.before_enter_royal_guard_zone then

		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name.royal_guard) then
			start_coroutine(self.enter_royal_guard_zone, self)

			return true
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.on_select_vampire_captain_gift then

		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name.vampire_captain) then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.leave_vampire_captain_room_without_gift, self)

			return true
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.on_select_vampire_secretary_gift then

		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name.vampire_secretary) then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.leave_vampire_secretary_room_without_gift, self)

			return true
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.leave_common_room_after_give_gift then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name.leave_common_room) then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.leave_common_room_after_give_gift, self)

			return true
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.epilogue then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name.epilogue) then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.epilogue, self)

			return true
		end

	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	if self.current_state ~= self.states.before_interact_common_hidden_block then
		return true
	end

	local switch_name = e.SwitchObject.Name

	for i = 1, #self.switch_checker do
		if switch_name == 'fs_switch_' .. i then
			self.switch_checker[i] = e.IsTurningOn
			break
		end
	end

	if self.switch_checker[1] and self.switch_checker[2] and self.switch_checker[3] then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.clear_puzzle, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:deactivate_quest_on_main_section()
	--비밀 벽 상호작용 불가, WallCrashBehaviour 로.
	local hidden_block_list = {
		self.field_object.common_hidden_block(),
		self.field_object.vampire_captain_hidden_block(),
		self.field_object.vampire_secretary_hidden_block(),
	}
	for idx = 1, #hidden_block_list do
		local hidden_block = hidden_block_list[idx]
		hidden_block.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
		hidden_block.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end

	--선물 상호작용 불가, EtherealCrashBehaviour 로.
	--테이블 상호작용 불가, EtherealCrashBehaviour 로.
	local gift_list = {
		self.field_object.vampire_secretary_gift(1),
		self.field_object.vampire_secretary_gift(2),
		self.field_object.vampire_secretary_gift(3),

		self.field_object.vampire_captain_gift(1),
		self.field_object.vampire_captain_gift(2),
		self.field_object.vampire_captain_gift(3),

		self.field_object.vampire_secretary_table(),

		self.field_object.vampire_captain_table(),
	}

	for idx = 1, #hidden_block_list do
		local hidden_block = hidden_block_list[idx]
		hidden_block.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		hidden_block.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end

	--관련 npc 전부 비활성화. (로얄가드, 발렌시아, 멜리사)
	local npc_disable_list = {
		self.npc.vampire_captain(),
		self.npc.vampire_secretary(),
		self.npc.royal_guard(),
		self.npc.carpenter(1),
		self.npc.carpenter(2),
		self.npc.carpenter(3),
		self.npc.carpenter(4),
		self.npc.carpenter(5),
		self.npc.carpenter(6),
		self.npc.carpenter(7),
	}
	for idx = 1, #npc_disable_list do
		local npc = npc_disable_list[idx]
		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')
		character_util.remove_relate_event(npc, self)
		npc.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end

	--퀘스트 아이콘 제거
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_interact_royal_guard then
		local royal_guard = self.npc.royal_guard()
		quest_icon_util.remove(royal_guard)
	end

	--퀘스트 마커 전부 제거
	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('friendship')

	--스테이트 변경
	self.current_state = self.states.deactivate_quest
end

function local_class:enter_royal_guard_zone()
	self.current_state = self.states.before_interact_royal_guard

	--플레이어 트리거 존 입장할 시, NPC 1 번 하단의 대사 실행 +
	local royal_guard = self.npc.royal_guard()

	--인터렉트 가능 상태로 배치
	character_util.add_listener(royal_guard, self.controller)

	--머리 위에 퀘스트 마크 출력 상태. (느낌표 박스)
	quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(royal_guard)

function local_class:interact_royal_guard()
	local vampire_lord = get_party_leader()
	local royal_guard = self.npc.royal_guard()

	quest_icon_util.remove(royal_guard)

	--컨트롤 뺏기며 bgm 볼륨 0.6으로 조정, 믹스 디폴트
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	-- 이후 1번 인터렉트 시 클로드 지정된 위치에 right, idle, idle로 정렬.
	party_util.align_to_target(royal_guard, 'left', 1)

	-- 클로드 (right, idle, idle) : 발렌시아는 많이 바쁜 것 같군.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_ds_sub_friendship_s1_1', skip = true })

	-- NPC 1 (left, tired, idle) : 맞아… 아침 훈련도 그렇게 부려먹고선 또 어딜…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(royal_guard, self,
			{ dir = 'left' },
			nil,
			{ name = 'tired' },
			{ key = 'nm_ds_sub_friendship_s1_2', skip = true })

	-- 대사 종료되면 NPC 1 left, surprise, jump 1회 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.set_direction(royal_guard, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(royal_guard, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(royal_guard, nil)

	-- NPC 1 (left, damaged, embarrassed) : 크, 클로드님 실레했습니다! 감히 제 상관을…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(royal_guard, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'embarrassed', keep = true },
			{ name = 'damaged', keep = true },
			{ key = 'nm_ds_sub_friendship_s1_3', skip = true })

	-- 클로드 (right, idle, idle) : 뭔가 곤란하다면 해결해주지. 발렌시아를 찾고 있는 건가?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_ds_sub_friendship_s1_4', skip = true })

	-- NPC 1 (left, tired, cast) : 아, 실은…
	self:custom_normal_speech_action(royal_guard, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cast' },
			{ name = 'tired' },
			{ key = 'nm_ds_sub_friendship_s1_5', skip = true })

	-- 대사 종료되면 NPC 1 left, idle, eat를 1초간 실행.
	do
		local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })

		self:custom_wait_action(royal_guard, self,
				nil,
				{ name = 'eat' },
				nil,
				1)

		music_player_util.stop_sfx(equipping_sfx)

	end


	-- 완료하면 left, idle, cast가 되며,
	scene_util.set_anim(royal_guard, self, { name = 'cast' })

	--cast 한 손에서 snowmountain_mako_letter 를 스케일 상승으로 생성된 상태.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_paper_01')

	local letter_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ pos = royal_guard.Position + vector(-0.15, 0, 0.15),
			  itemid = self.item_id.letter,
			  notforinven = true,
			  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			  sprscale = 0.5,
			  skip_text = false })

	letter_item:SetSortingLayer('Default', 2)

	-- NPC 1 (left, idle, cast) : 발렌시아님께 멜리사님이 보낸 편지가 도착했습니다.
	self:custom_normal_speech_action(royal_guard, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_ds_sub_friendship_s1_6', skip = true })

	-- NPC 1 (left, tired, cast) : 차주 훈련 내용이라 빠르게 보고되어야 합니다만…
	self:custom_normal_speech_action(royal_guard, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'tired' },
			{ key = 'nm_ds_sub_friendship_s1_7', skip = true })

	-- 클로드 (right, idle, idle) : 흠, 그렇군. 그렇다면 내게 건네줘도 괜찮겠나?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_ds_sub_friendship_s1_8', skip = true })

	-- NPC 1 (left, attack, cast) : 네?! 아닙니다! 클로드님께 감히…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	self:custom_normal_speech_action(royal_guard, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'attack' },
			{ key = 'nm_ds_sub_friendship_s1_9', skip = true })

	-- 클로드 (right, idle, idle) : 신경쓰지 마라. 사소한 일까지 예의차리지 않아도 되니.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_ds_sub_friendship_s1_10', skip = true })

	-- NPC 1 (left, tired, cast) : 그, 그렇다면…
	self:custom_normal_speech_action(royal_guard, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'tired' },
			{ key = 'nm_ds_sub_friendship_s1_11', skip = true })

	-- 대사 종료되면 NPC 1 left, idle, eat를 실행하며,
	-- 손에서 ic_blueprint_blank를 스케일 하락으로 제거. (위치 확인해 보자)
	do
		local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })

		scene_util.set_anim(royal_guard, self, 'eat')
		drop_item_util.resize_to_async(letter_item, 0, 0.5)
		letter_item:ConsumeComplete()
		wait_for_sec(0.1)

		music_player_util.stop_sfx(equipping_sfx)

	end

	-- 제거 완료되면 NPC 1 left, idle, attack 을 실행하여 snowmountain_mako_letter를 클로드에게 던져준다.
	scene_util.set_anim(royal_guard, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1, sfx_name = '01_throw_01' })
	-- nightmare_ds_letter : 발렌시아에게 온 편지.
	letter_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ pos = royal_guard.Position,
			  target = vampire_lord.Position,
			  itemid = self.item_id.letter,
			  notforinven = true,
			  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			  sprscale = 0.75,
			  skip_text = false })
	letter_item:SetSortingLayer('Default', 2)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 클로드 ic_blueprint_blank 흡수.
	letter_item.ConsumeTarget = vampire_lord
	letter_item:Fly()
	letter_item = nil

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 클로드 (right, idle, idle) : 잘 받았다. 그럼 발렌시아에게 전해주도록 하지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_ds_sub_friendship_s1_12', skip = true })

	-- NPC 1 (left, attack, jump 1회) : 감사합니다 클로드님! 그럼 업무 복귀하겠습니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(royal_guard, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(royal_guard, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'attack' },
			{ key = 'nm_ds_sub_friendship_s1_13', skip = true })

	-- 대사 종료하면 NPC 1 down, attack, run(속도 7) 로 아래로 달려가며 화면에서 사라짐. 사라질 때 까지 대기.
	do
		local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })

		wp_util.move_async(royal_guard, royal_guard.Position + vector(0, 0, -10), 7, nil, { run = true })

		music_player_util.stop_sfx(dash_sfx)

		character_util.remove_relate_event(royal_guard, self)

		royal_guard.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

		character_util.set_active_state(royal_guard, 'disabled')

	end

	-- 클로드 (right, idle, idle) : 좋아, 발렌시아에게 직접 건네주면…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_ds_sub_friendship_s1_14', skip = true })

	-- 클로드 right, sleep_deep, cross_arm 상태로 머리 위에 emoticon_bubble_silence 출력.
	scene_util.set_emotion(vampire_lord, self, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim(vampire_lord, self, 'cross_arm')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(vampire_lord, nil, 'silence')

	-- 클로드 (right, sleep_deep, cross_arm) : 아니지, 요즘 태양제 때문에 발렌시아는 눈코뜰새 없이 바쁠 것이다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cross_arm', sfx_name = false, one_shot_sfx = false },
			{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
			{ key = 'nm_ds_sub_friendship_s1_15', skip = true })

	--클로드 (right, sleep_deep, cross_arm) : 이 편지는 방에 갖다놓으면 좋을 것 같다만…. 16
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cross_arm', sfx_name = false, one_shot_sfx = false },
			{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
			{ key = 'nm_ds_sub_friendship_s1_16', skip = true })


	--클로드 머리 위로 emoticon_bubble_exclamation 출력.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(vampire_lord, nil, 'notice')

	--클로드 (right, sleep_deep, cross_arm) : …분명 모든 방에는 전시 상황용 비밀 통로가 숨겨져 있었지. 17
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cross_arm' },
			{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
			{ key = 'nm_ds_sub_friendship_s1_17', skip = true })


	--클로드 (right, sleep_deep, cross_arm) : 그것을 강제로 열기 위해서 특수한 버튼이 필요하다고 했었나… 17_1
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_ds_sub_friendship_s1_17_1', skip = true })


	--클로드 (right, idle, idle) : 주변의 신하들이 알고 있을지도 모르겠군. 한 번 둘러보도록 할까. 18
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_ds_sub_friendship_s1_18', skip = true })

	--컨트롤 돌아오며 bgm 볼륨 1로 조정, 믹스 디폴트
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	-- 이후 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀.
	self.current_state = self.states.before_interact_common_hidden_block
	self:setting_common_hidden_block()
	self:setting_puzzle_after_interact_royal_guard()
end
