function local_class:vampire_lord_flower_scene()
	local vampire_lord = self.get_vampire_lord()
	local vampire_lord_flower = self.get_vampire_lord_flower()
	local pivot_pos = self.get_flower_event_scene_scene_pivot_pos()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	local flower_npcs = {}
	for idx = 1, 4 do
		local npc = self.get_flower_npc(idx)
		table.insert(flower_npcs, npc)
	end

	-- 트리거 존 입장 시 클로드 지정된 위치에 right, idle, idle로 정렬.
	local wp = pivot_pos
	wp_util.move_async(vampire_lord, wp, 3, nil, { run = false, last_direction = 'right' })

	-- NPC 1 (right, smile, eat) : 거기 오시는 분 잠시만요! 금방 드릴게요…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(flower_npcs[1], self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'eat', keep = true },
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
			{ key = 'nm_ds_main_s6_32', skip = true })

	-- 클로드 머리 위로 emoticon_bubble_silence 출력.
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(vampire_lord, self,
			'right',
			nil,
			nil,
			'silence')

	-- 클로드 (right, sleep_deep, cross_arm) : …알았다. 기다리도록 하지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cross_arm', keep = true },
			{ name = 'sleep_deep', keep = true },
			{ key = 'nm_ds_main_s6_33', skip = true })

	-- 2초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- NPC 1 (down, smile, cast2) : 자! 여기있습니다! 프리실라 공주님이 좋아하…!
	local stage_controller = get_stage_event_controller('NightmareDemonShire2Controller')

	for _, sfx in pairs(stage_controller.eat_sfx_list) do
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(sfx)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')

	-- 상단 대사와 함께 NPC 2 ~ 4 클로드 방향, smile, cast2 실행.
	for idx = 2, #flower_npcs do
		local npc = self.get_flower_npc(idx)
		character_util.look_at(npc, vampire_lord)
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'cast2')
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(flower_npcs[1], self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cast2', keep = true },
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
			{ key = 'nm_ds_main_s6_34', skip = true })

	-- 1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- NPC 1 ~ 4 방향 유지, surprise, jump 1회 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_05')
	scene_util.set_group_emotion(flower_npcs, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.group_normal_jump_async(flower_npcs, '01_jump_01')

	-- 1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- NPC 1 (down, damaged, cast) : 크, 클로드님?! 시, 실례했습니다! 감히 저희가 가시는 길을 방해하고…!
	-- 상단 대사와 함께 NPC 2 ~ 4 클로드 방향, damaged, cast 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')

	for idx = 2, #flower_npcs do
		local npc = self.get_flower_npc(idx)
		character_util.look_at(npc, vampire_lord)
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'cast')
	end

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(flower_npcs[1], self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cast', keep = true },
			{ name = 'damaged', keep = true },
			{ key = 'nm_ds_main_s6_35', skip = true })

	-- 클로드 (right, sleep_deep, cross_arm) : 그것보다. 방금 한 말 끝까지 해줄 수 있겠나?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_ds_main_s6_36', skip = true })

	-- NPC 1 (down, idle, idle) : 네? 아… 그, 그게…
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(flower_npcs[1])
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(flower_npcs[1], self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_ds_main_s6_37', skip = true })

	-- 상단 대사와 함께 NPC 2 ~ 4 클로드 방향, idle, idle 실행.
	for idx = 2, #flower_npcs do
		local npc = self.get_flower_npc(idx)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
	end

	-- 클로드 (right, sleep_deep, cross_arm) : ……프리실라가 좋아하는 것을 말하려 하지 않았나?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_ds_main_s6_38', skip = true })

	-- NPC 1 (down, tired, cast) : 아 맞습니다! 실은…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(flower_npcs[1], self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cast', keep = true },
			{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
			{ key = 'nm_ds_main_s6_39', skip = true })

	-- NPC 2 (down, tired, cast) : 프리실라님이 아이리스님 외에 사람이 다가오면 울음을 터뜨리곤 하시지만…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(flower_npcs[2], self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cast', keep = true },
			{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
			{ key = 'nm_ds_main_s6_40', skip = true })

	-- NPC 1 (down, tired, cast) : 머리에 꽃장식을 하면 웃으며 좋아하십니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(flower_npcs[1], self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_ds_main_s6_41', skip = true })

	-- NPC 2 (down, tired, cast) : 그래서 저희가 오시는 경비분들에게 꽃을 장식해드린 것이었습니다…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(flower_npcs[2], self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_ds_main_s6_42', skip = true })

	-- NPC 1 (down, damaged, cast) : 결고 저희가 클로드님을 무시하여 멈춰세운 건 아닙니다! 이 일은 달게 받을테니 용서를…
	-- 상단 대사와 함께 NPC 2 down, damaged, cast 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')

	scene_util.set_emotion(flower_npcs[2], self, 'damaged')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(flower_npcs[1], self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'damaged', keep = true },
			{ key = 'nm_ds_main_s6_43', skip = true })

	-- 클로드 (right, idle, cross_arm) : 용서하는 건 어렵지 않다. 하지만 내 부탁을 한가지 들어줄 수 있겠나?
	character_util.remove_emotion(vampire_lord)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_ds_main_s6_44', skip = true })

	-- NPC 2 (down, damaged, cast2) : 어떤 명령이라도 듣겠습니다! 당장 전근이라도…!
	-- 상단 대사와 함께 NPC 2 ~ 4 클로드 방향, damaged, cast2 실행.
	for idx = 2, #flower_npcs do
		local npc = self.get_flower_npc(idx)
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'cast2')
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(flower_npcs[2], self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cast2', keep = true },
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_ds_main_s6_45', skip = true })

	-- 클로드 (right, idle, cross_arm) : 꽃장식을 내 머리에 달아주거라.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_ds_main_s6_46', skip = true })

	-- NPC 1 (down, surprise, cast2) : 네… 네에?!
	-- 상단 대사와 함께 NPC 2 down, surprise, cast2 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')

	scene_util.set_emotion(flower_npcs[2], self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(flower_npcs[1], self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cast2', keep = true },
			{ name = 'surprise', keep = true },
			{ key = 'nm_ds_main_s6_47', skip = true })

	-- 클로드 (right, tired, cross_arm) : …어려운 부탁인가?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cross_arm', keep = true, one_shot_sfx = false },
			{ name = 'tired' },
			{ key = 'nm_ds_main_s6_48', skip = true })

	-- 클로드 right, idle, cross_arm 유지.

	-- NPC 2 (down, attack, release 2회) : 아, 아닙니다! 곧바로 해드리겠습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(flower_npcs[2], self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			{ name = 'attack' },
			{ key = 'nm_ds_main_s6_49', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(flower_npcs[1])
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(flower_npcs[2])

	-- 대사 종료되면, NPC 1 ~ 4 지정된 위치까지 이동한 후 클로드 방향, attack, eat 실행중.
	local eat_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01',
		parent = flower_npcs[1],
		loop = true,
		type_priority = 'loop',
		player_priority = 'npc'
	})

	local wp_key = 'wp_key'
	local speed = 3
	local callback = function(fo)
		return function()
			character_util.look_at(fo, vampire_lord)
			scene_util.set_emotion(fo, self, 'attack')
			scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, 'eat')
		end
	end

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(flower_npcs[1], wp, speed, nil, self, wp_key,
			{ run = false, end_callback = callback(flower_npcs[1]) })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(flower_npcs[2], wp, speed, nil, self, wp_key,
			{ run = false, end_callback = callback(flower_npcs[2]) })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(flower_npcs[3], wp, speed, nil, self, wp_key,
			{ run = false, end_callback = callback(flower_npcs[3]) })

	local wp = flower_npcs[4].Position + vector(0, 0, 1)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(flower_npcs[4], wp, speed, nil, self, wp_key,
			{ run = false, end_callback = callback(flower_npcs[4]) })

	vampire_lord_flower.Position = vampire_lord.Position

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_tree_01')

	character_util.convert_to_npc(vampire_lord)
	vampire_lord.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	local convert_param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam.ManualDefault()
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character_v2(vampire_lord_flower, convert_param, true)

	-- 1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- NPC 1 ~ 4 기존 위치로 복귀. 각자 클로드 방향, tired, cast 상태로 배치
	local wp_key = 'wp_key'
	local speed = 3
	local callback = function(fo)
		return function()
			character_util.look_at(fo, vampire_lord_flower)
			scene_util.set_emotion(fo, self, 'tired')
			scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, 'cast')
		end
	end

	local wp = flower_npcs[1].Position + vector(0, 0, 1)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(flower_npcs[1], wp, speed, nil, self, wp_key,
			{ run = false, end_callback = callback(flower_npcs[1]) })

	local wp = flower_npcs[2].Position + vector(0, 0, 1)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(flower_npcs[2], wp, speed, nil, self, wp_key,
			{ run = false, end_callback = callback(flower_npcs[2]) })

	local wp = flower_npcs[3].Position + vector(0, 0, -1)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(flower_npcs[3], wp, speed, nil, self, wp_key,
			{ run = false, end_callback = callback(flower_npcs[3]) })

	local wp = flower_npcs[4].Position + vector(0, 0, -1)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(flower_npcs[4], wp, speed, nil, self, wp_key,
			{ run = false, end_callback = callback(flower_npcs[4]) })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(eat_loop_sfx)

	-- NPC 1 (down, tired, cast2) : 그… 어떻게 마음에 드실까요? 혹시 제가 머리를 상하게 한 건 아닌지…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(flower_npcs[1], self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cast2' },
			{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
			{ key = 'nm_ds_main_s6_50', skip = true })

	-- 클로드 (right, smile, idle) : 아이가 좋아하겠군…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord_flower, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'nm_ds_main_s6_51', skip = true })

	-- NPC 2 (down, smile, cast2) : …좋아하실 겁니다! 프리실라 공주님도!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(flower_npcs[2], self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cast2' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'nm_ds_main_s6_52', skip = true })

	-- 클로드 (right, smile, idle) : …그래. 고맙구나.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord_flower, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'nm_ds_main_s6_53', skip = true })

	-- 이후 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀.
	--이후 NPC 1 ~ 4 원라인 배치.
	--NPC 1 (down, tired, cast) : 너무 무서웠어…
	--NPC 2 (down, smlie, cast) : 뭔가 클로드님… 예전에 비해 둥글어지신 것 같아…
	--NPC 3 (up, tired, cast) : 역시 아이가 생기면 사람이 바뀌는 걸까?
	--NPC 4 (up, tired, cast) : 혼나지 않아서 다행이다…
	scene_util.set_emotion(flower_npcs[1], self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(flower_npcs[1], self, 'cast')

	scene_util.set_emotion(flower_npcs[2], self, 'smlie')
	scene_util.set_anim(flower_npcs[2], self, 'cast')

	scene_util.set_anim(flower_npcs[3], self, 'cast')
	scene_util.set_anim(flower_npcs[4], self, 'cast')

	for idx = 1, #flower_npcs do
		local npc = self.get_flower_npc(idx)
		npc.Interactable.Talk = 'nm_ds_main_s6_oneline_' .. idx
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

	wp_util.move_async(vampire_secretary, outside_pos, 3, nil, { run = false })

	vampire_secretary.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	character_util.set_active_state(vampire_secretary, 'disabled')

	-- 클로드 (down, sleep_deep, idle) : 아이리스. 이제…
	-- 상단 대사와 함께 아이리스 left, idle, idle 실행.

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord_flower, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
			{ key = 'nm_ds_main_s6_76', skip = true })

	-- 아이리스 (left, smile, cast) : 네, 오늘도 힘내주세요, 클로드 님.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord_wife_flower, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cast' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'nm_ds_main_s6_77', skip = true })

	scene_util.set_emotion(vampire_lord_flower, self, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(vampire_lord_flower, self, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord_flower, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_ds_main_s6_78', skip = true })

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
	local marker_pos = vector(113.5, 0, 78.5)

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = get_field_object('office_in') },
		{ zone = 'state_capital_field', target = marker_pos },
	})

	for idx = 1, 4 do
		local guard = self.get_royalguard(idx)
		character_util.set_active_state(guard, 'disabled')
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'deactivate_friendship' }))
	-- 이후 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀.
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

function local_class:were_beast_protest_scene()
	-- 플레이어 메인 마커는 지정된 위치에 출력된 상태.
	local vampire_lord_flower = self.get_vampire_lord_flower()
	local vampire_captain = self.get_vampire_captain()
	local vampire_secretary = self.get_vampire_secretary()

	local pivot_pos = self.get_were_beast_protest_scene_pivot_pos()

	-- 플레이어 붉은색 트리거 존 진입 시, 클로드 지정된 위치에 right, idle, idle로 정렬.
	local move_dur = 1
	local camera_pos = pivot_pos
	camera_util.move(camera_pos, move_dur)

	local wp = pivot_pos + vector(-1.5, 0, 0)
	wp_util.move_async(vampire_lord_flower, wp, nil, move_dur, { run = false, last_direction = 'right' })

	-- 수인 무리 : [shout] 수인들의 권리를 보장하라!!!
	-- 상단 대사는 화면 하단, 말꼬리 없이, 1.5배로 출력하고, 출력하는 타이밍에 맞춰 0.5초간 화면 크게 shake 실행하고, 동시에 클로드 right, attack, idle 실행.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_09')

	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)
	scene_util.set_direction(vampire_lord_flower, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(vampire_lord_flower, self, 'attack')

	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(vampire_lord_flower, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_ds_main_s6_79', skip = true, viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2), scale = 1.5 })

			self.interact_item_data[gimmick_name].fx = twinkle_fx

	-- 클로드 (up, idle, idle) : 잠깐, 침실에 아이 장난감이 있었지…
	scene_util.set_direction(vampire_lord, 'up', false)

	-- 이후 up, idle 상태로 하단으로 2타일 walk(뒷걸음) 실행.

function local_class:interact_comic_book(gimmick_name)
	local data = self.interact_item_data[gimmick_name]
	local gimmick_fo = get_field_object(gimmick_name)

	party_util.align_party(gimmick_fo.Position, data.dir, 0.5, 'linear')

	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = data.string_key })

	self:choose_pack_item(gimmick_name)
end

function local_class:choose_pack_item(gimmick_name)
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 가져간다. (초록)
		{ 'nm_ds_main_s6_book_choose_1_1', 'mercy' },
		-- 그만둔다.
		{ 'nm_ds_main_s6_book_choose_1_2', 'normal' }
	})

	-- 그만둔다.
	if choose_result ~= 1 then
		-- 컨트롤 복귀.
		return
	end

	local vampire_lord = get_party_leader()

	-- 클로드 left, idle, eat 1초.
	local eat_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01',
		parent = vampire_lord,
		loop = true,
		type_priority = 'loop',
		player_priority = 'npc'
	})

	scene_util.set_direction(vampire_lord, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(vampire_lord, self, 'eat')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 클로드 아이템을 획득한다.
	if self.interact_item_data[gimmick_name].item ~= nil then
		self.select_item_data = self.interact_item_data[gimmick_name]
		self.controller.is_acquire_book[self.interact_item_data[gimmick_name].custom_state_key] = 1
		self.interact_item_data[gimmick_name].item.ConsumeTarget = vampire_lord

		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	-- 클로드 (스프라이트 별 방향, sleep_deep, idle) : …아이가 좋아하겠군
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(eat_loop_sfx)
	character_util.remove_anim(vampire_lord)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(vampire_lord, 'nm_ds_main_s6_book_event_1')

	for name, data in pairs(self.interact_item_data) do
		local gimmick_fo = get_field_object(name)

		if self.select_item_data.item_id == data.item_id then
			gimmick_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		else
			local narration_interactable = CS.Oak.NarrationInteractable()
			narration_interactable.StringKeys = { data.string_key }

			gimmick_fo.Interactable = narration_interactable
		end

		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(name)

		if data.fx ~= nil then
			data.fx:Dispose()
			data.fx = nil
		end
	end

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = get_field_object('office_in') },
		{ zone = 'state_capital_field', target = self.get_vampire_baby_room_pivot_pos() },
	})

	-- 컨트롤 복귀.
	self.current_state = self.states.vampire_baby_room_scene
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('NightmareDemonShireMainSection7')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareDemonShireMain @
		Comment = @
		Index = 6 @
		NextSections = 7 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type NightmareDemonShireMainController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	--self.available_stage_names = {}

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		before_loaded = 1,
		before_meet_goat_girl = 2,
		blocked_entrance = 3,
		before_battle = 4,
		in_battle = 5,
		after_battle = 6,
		done = 99
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.before_loaded

	self.get_office_entrance = function()
		return get_field_object('office_in')
	end

	self.fx = setmetatable({
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		last_hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,

		stabblade = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_nm_ds_sheep_rei_basic_stabblade')
		end,
	}, {
		__index = {
			create_all = function(this)
				for _, loader in pairs(this) do
					loader()
				end
			end
		}
	})

	local character_names = {
		vampire_lord = 'vampire_lord',
		vampire_captain = 'vampire_captain',
		goat_girl = 'goat_girl',
	}

	self.character = setmetatable({}, {
		__index = function(this, key)
			local name = character_names[key]

			if name ~= nil then
				return get_character(name)
			end

			return nil
		end
	})

	self.battle = {
		zone = 'main_s7_battle',
		group = 'main_s7_battle',
		get_goat_girl = function()
			return get_character('main_s7_battle_goat_girl')
		end
	}

	local dynamic_guard_name_prefix = 'guard_'
	local dynamic_werebeast_name_prefix = 'werebeast_'

	self.dynamic_npcs = setmetatable({
		npc_name_prefix = 'main_s7_dynamic_',
		guard_name_prefix = dynamic_guard_name_prefix,
		werebeast_name_prefix = dynamic_werebeast_name_prefix,

		guard_count = 8,
		werebeast_count = 8,

		data = {
			[dynamic_guard_name_prefix .. 1] = 'nightmare_ds_demon_royalguard',
			[dynamic_guard_name_prefix .. 2] = 'nightmare_ds_demon_royalguard',
			[dynamic_guard_name_prefix .. 3] = 'nightmare_ds_demon_royalguard',
			[dynamic_guard_name_prefix .. 4] = 'nightmare_ds_demon_royalguard',
			[dynamic_guard_name_prefix .. 5] = 'nightmare_ds_demon_royalguard',
			[dynamic_guard_name_prefix .. 6] = 'nightmare_ds_demon_royalguard',
			[dynamic_guard_name_prefix .. 7] = 'nightmare_ds_demon_royalguard',
			[dynamic_guard_name_prefix .. 8] = 'nightmare_ds_demon_royalguard',
			[dynamic_werebeast_name_prefix .. 1] = 'nightmare_ds_werebeast_soldier_female',
			[dynamic_werebeast_name_prefix .. 2] = 'nightmare_ds_werebeast_male',
			[dynamic_werebeast_name_prefix .. 3] = 'nightmare_ds_werebeast_soldier_female',
			[dynamic_werebeast_name_prefix .. 4] = 'nightmare_ds_werebeast_soldier_male',
			[dynamic_werebeast_name_prefix .. 5] = 'nightmare_ds_werebeast_male',
			[dynamic_werebeast_name_prefix .. 6] = 'nightmare_ds_werebeast_soldier_male',
			[dynamic_werebeast_name_prefix .. 7] = 'nightmare_ds_werebeast_female',
			[dynamic_werebeast_name_prefix .. 8] = 'nightmare_ds_werebeast_male',
		},
		container = nil,
	}, {
		__index = {
			load_async = function(this)
				if this.container ~= nil then
					return
				end

				local spec_data = {}

				for npc_name, spec_name in pairs(this.data) do
					spec_data[this.npc_name_prefix .. npc_name] = spec_name
				end

				this.container = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(spec_data)
			end,

			dispose = function(this)
				if this.container == nil then
					return
				end

				load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(this.container)

				this.container = nil
			end,

			get_guard = function(this, index)
				return this.container[this.npc_name_prefix .. this.guard_name_prefix .. index]
			end,

			foreach_guard = function(this, action)
				for i = 1, this.guard_count do
					local npc = this:get_guard(i)

					action(i, npc)
				end
			end,

			get_werebeast = function(this, index)
				return this.container[this.npc_name_prefix .. this.werebeast_name_prefix .. index]
			end,

			foreach_werebeast = function(this, action)
				for i = 1, this.werebeast_count do
					local npc = this:get_werebeast(i)

					action(i, npc)
				end
			end,

			get = function(this, postfix)
				return this.container[this.npc_name_prefix .. postfix]
			end
		}
	})

	self.stage_ended = false

	self.battle_controller = nil

	self.suspense_bgm_name = 'bgm_suspense_theme'

	self.crowd_loop_sfx = {
		---@private
		holder = nil,

		---@param this self
		play = function(this, play_pos, mix)
			if this.holder ~= nil then
				return
			end

			local data = {
				sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_02',
				loop = true,
				type_priority = sfx_type_priority.loop,
				player_priority = sfx_player_priority.npc,
				play_pos = play_pos,
				fade_in_time = mix,
			}

			if data.play_pos ~= nil then
				data.min_distance = 5
				data.max_distance = 8
			end

			this.holder = music_player_util.play_sfx(data)
		end,

		---@param this self
		stop = function(this, mix)
			if this.holder == nil then
				return
			end

			if mix ~= nil then
				music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(this.holder, mix)
			else
				music_player_util.stop_sfx(this.holder)
			end

			this.holder = nil
		end
	}
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
	self.dynamic_npcs:load_async()

	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		-- 미리 로드해서 Start에서 BGM 전환에 시간이 추가로 소요되지 않게 함
		yield_return_func(music_player.PreloadMusic, music_player, self.suspense_bgm_name)
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	self:set()
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

		do
			local entrance = self.get_office_entrance()

			entrance.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

			message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
		end

		start_coroutine(function()
			local start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s7_start')
			local leader = get_party_leader()

			party_util.position_party(start_pos, 'down', 'linear')

			-- 이벤트 음악으로 시작하도록 필드 클립을 비워버림
			music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'field' })

			wait_for_sec(0.1)

			screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black)
			screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')

			do
				local crowd_center_pos = (self.dynamic_npcs:get_werebeast(8).Position +
						self.dynamic_npcs:get_werebeast(8).Position) / 2

				self.crowd_loop_sfx:play(crowd_center_pos)
			end

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({
				state = 'event',
				name = self.suspense_bgm_name,
				mix = 2,
			})

			yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.DirectionalStageEntry, leader.Position,
					leader.Direction, game_string:GetString(stage.Name))

			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

			do
				local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s7_before_battle_align_pivot')

				quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
					{ zone = 'state_capital_field', target = get_field_object('office_out') },
					{ zone = 'main_field', target = target_pos },
				})
			end

			self.current_state = self.states.before_meet_goat_girl
		end)
	else
		self.current_state = self.states.before_battle

		sp_util.start_scene(self.before_battle_routine, self, true):Then(function()
			self.current_state = self.states.in_battle
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.crowd_loop_sfx:stop()

	self.stage_ended = true

	if self.battle_controller ~= nil then
		self.battle_controller:dispose()
		self.battle_controller = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil

	self.dynamic_npcs:dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_meet_goat_girl and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_office_entrance()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.blocked_entrance

		sp_util.start_scene(self.try_enter_house_scene, self):Then(function()
			self.current_state = self.states.before_meet_goat_girl
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_meet_goat_girl and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_s7_meet_goat_girl') then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_battle

		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

		sp_util.start_scene(self.before_battle_routine, self, false):Then(function()
			self.current_state = self.states.in_battle
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set()
	--기본 배치 상태.
	--NPC 1 ~ 8 (down, attack, idle) : nightmare_ds_demon_royalguard
	self.dynamic_npcs:foreach_guard(function(index, npc)
		local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s7_guard_' .. index)

		character_util.set_position(npc, target_pos)
		character_util.set_direction(npc, 'down')
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'attack')
	end)

	do
		--NPC 9, 11 (up, attack, release) : nightmare_ds_werebeast_soldier_female
		--NPC 12, 14 (up, attack, cast2) : nightmare_ds_werebeast_soldier_male
		--NPC 10, 13 (up, attack, jingak) : nightmare_ds_werebeast_male
		--NPC 15 (up, attack, release) : nightmare_ds_werebeast_female
		--NPC 16 (up, attack, release) : nightmare_ds_werebeast_male
		local anim_data = {
			{ name = 'release', sfx_name = false },
			{ name = 'jingak', loop = true },
			{ name = 'release', sfx_name = false },
			'cast2',
			{ name = 'jingak', loop = true },
			'cast2',
			{ name = 'release', sfx_name = false },
			{ name = 'release', sfx_name = false },
		}

		self.dynamic_npcs:foreach_werebeast(function(index, npc)
			local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s7_werebeast_' .. index)

			character_util.set_position(npc, target_pos)
			character_util.set_direction(npc, 'up')

			scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, anim_data[index])
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:try_enter_house_scene()
	--재접속 시 이탈 설정
	--플레이어 생성된 지점에서 주지사 관 입수 인터렉트 시 아래의 대사 실행.
	--클로드 (현재 방향, idle, idle) : 앞의 소란을 정리하는 것이 우선이다.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.character.vampire_lord, 'nm_ds_main_s7_0')

	--이후 컨트롤 복귀.
end

function local_class:before_battle_routine(on_start)
	self:before_battle_scene(on_start)

	-- 전투 시작 전에 field 클립을 비워서 muted (혹은 fanfare) 스테이트에서 남아있도록 설정
	music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'field' })

	--전투 시작, 발렌시아 파티원 상태로 토가와 2:1 전투 진입.
	self:activate_battle()
end

function local_class:before_battle_scene(on_start)
	local vampire_lord = self.character.vampire_lord
	local vampire_captain = self.character.vampire_captain
	local goat_girl = self.character.goat_girl

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.6, 4)

	do
		local align_pivot = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s7_before_battle_align_pivot')
		local camera_target_z = (align_pivot.z + self.dynamic_npcs:get_werebeast(1).Position.z) / 2
		local camera_target_pos = vector(align_pivot.x, 0, camera_target_z)
		local lord_target_pos = align_pivot + unity_class.vector3.left * 0.5
		local captain_target_pos = align_pivot + unity_class.vector3.right * 0.5

		if on_start then
			local speed = 5

			--해당 상태에서 클로드, 발렌시아 상단에서 down, idle, run으로 내려와 정렬.
			local appear_offset = unity_class.vector3.forward * 8

			character_util.set_position(vampire_lord, lord_target_pos + appear_offset)
			character_util.set_direction(vampire_lord, 'down')

			character_util.set_position(vampire_captain, captain_target_pos + appear_offset)
			character_util.set_direction(vampire_captain, 'down')

			--카메라 1번 상태.
			camera_util.move_async(camera_target_pos, 0.1)

			--플레이어 지정된 트리거 존 입장 시 클로드, 발렌시아 각각 지정된 위치에 down, idle, idle
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(vampire_lord, lord_target_pos, speed, nil,
					self, nil, {
						last_direction = 'down',
						run = true,
					})

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(vampire_captain, captain_target_pos, speed, nil,
					self, nil, {
						last_direction = 'down',
						run = true,
					})

			self.crowd_loop_sfx:play(nil, 2)

			screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

			wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
		else
			local speed = 3

			--플레이어 지정된 트리거 존 입장 시 클로드, 발렌시아 각각 지정된 위치에 down, idle, idle
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(vampire_lord, lord_target_pos, speed, nil,
					self, nil, {
						last_direction = 'down'
					})

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(vampire_captain, captain_target_pos, speed, nil,
					self, nil, {
						last_direction = 'down'
					})

			camera_util.move_async(camera_target_pos, 1)

			wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
		end
	end

	local set_aim_point = function(character, dir)
		character.SpineController.AimPoint = dir
	end

	--NPC 11 (up, attack, release) : 수인 사냥 사건에 대한 정당한 배상을!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.dynamic_npcs:get_werebeast(3), 'nm_ds_main_s7_1')

	--NPC 14 (up, attack, cast2) : 차별 행위를 멈춰라!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.dynamic_npcs:get_werebeast(6), 'nm_ds_main_s7_2')

	--NPC 13 (up, attack, jingak) : 우리의 자유를 인정하라!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.dynamic_npcs:get_werebeast(7), 'nm_ds_main_s7_3')

	--발렌시아 (down, attack, idle) : 아까 전보다 더욱 심해진 것 같습니다…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_captain, self, 'down',
			nil, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'nm_ds_main_s7_4')

	--클로드 (down, sleep_deep, idle) : …성난 군중을 진정시키는 것이 우선이다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self, 'down',
			nil, 'sleep_deep', 'nm_ds_main_s7_5')

	--발렌시아 (down, attack, idle) : 알겠습니다. 우선 병력들에게…!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(vampire_captain, 'nm_ds_main_s7_6')

	--NPC 16 (up, idle, release 2회) : 앗! 저기 주지사다! 주지사 놈이 모습을 보였다!!
	do
		local npc = self.dynamic_npcs:get_werebeast(8)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

		character_util.remove_anim(npc)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc, self, 'up',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_ds_main_s7_7')
	end

	--NPC 13 (up, idle, cast2) : 주지사에게 직접 추궁하자! 모두 달라붙어!!
	do
		local npc = self.dynamic_npcs:get_werebeast(5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')

		character_util.remove_anim(npc)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc, self, 'up',
				'cast2', nil, 'nm_ds_main_s7_8')
	end

	local get_opposite_guard = function(index)
		local guard_index = 0

		if index == 8 then
			guard_index = 4
		elseif index <= 3 then
			guard_index = index
		else
			guard_index = index + 1
		end

		return self.dynamic_npcs:get_guard(guard_index)
	end

	do
		local execute_fight = function(werebeast, guard)
			--애니메이션 push 실행한 후,
			scene_util.set_anim(werebeast, self, 'push')
			scene_util.normal_shake(werebeast, 99999, false)

			--NPC 1 ~ 16 모두에게 0.03 세기로 shake 지속.
			scene_util.set_emotion(guard, self, 'damaged')
			scene_util.set_anim(guard, self, 'push')
			scene_util.normal_shake(guard, 99999, false)
		end

		local speed = 5

		self.crowd_loop_sfx:stop(3)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_09')

		self.dynamic_npcs:foreach_werebeast(function(index, npc)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)

			local guard = get_opposite_guard(index)

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, guard.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.6,
					speed, nil, self, nil, {
						last_direction = 'up',
						run = true,
						end_callback = function()
							execute_fight(npc, guard)
						end
					})
		end)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
	end

	--카메라 도착한 뒤 다음 대사 실행.
	--NPC 3 (down, damaged, push) : 지, 진정하십시오 여러분…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.dynamic_npcs:get_guard(3), 'nm_ds_main_s7_9')

	--NPC 7 (down, damaged, push) : 여러분들은 지금 불법 시위를…!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.dynamic_npcs:get_guard(7), 'nm_ds_main_s7_9_1')

	--발렌시아 (down, attack, release 2회) : 주지사관이 뚫려서는 안된다! 모두 버텨!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_captain, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_ds_main_s7_9_2')

	--NPC 4 (down, damaged, push) : 크윽 이자식들이…!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.dynamic_npcs:get_guard(4), 'nm_ds_main_s7_9_3')

	--NPC 5 (down, damaged, push) : 보자보자하니까…!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.dynamic_npcs:get_guard(5), 'nm_ds_main_s7_9_4')

	--이후 NPC 4, 5번 현재 상태에서 down, attack, run(속도 7)을 0.5타일 달려간 뒤,
	do
		local execute_move = function(npc)
			character_util.stop_shake(npc)
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'attack')

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, npc.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.5,
					7, nil, self, nil, { run = true })
		end

		execute_move(self.dynamic_npcs:get_guard(4))
		execute_move(self.dynamic_npcs:get_guard(5))

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
	end

	--1타일 하단에 있는 NPC 12, 16번에게 부딪히고 (서로 레드 펄스 + 둘 사이로 부딪힐 때 Fx_hit + 화면 0.3초간 0.4의 크기로 shake),
	do
		local execute_crash = function(guard, werebeast)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(guard)
			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(guard)

			character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(werebeast)
			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(werebeast)

			character_util.stop_shake(werebeast)

			local center_pos = (guard.Position + werebeast.Position) / 2

			self.fx.hit():Instantiate(vector_util.get_x0z(center_pos, 0.35))
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')

		execute_crash(self.dynamic_npcs:get_guard(4), self.dynamic_npcs:get_werebeast(8))
		execute_crash(self.dynamic_npcs:get_guard(5), self.dynamic_npcs:get_werebeast(4))

		camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)
	end

	--완료되면 NPC 12(right), 16(left) 0.5타일 하단으로 confused, prostrate 자세로 밀려남
	do
		local execute_knockback = function(npc, look_dir)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)

			character_util.set_direction(npc, look_dir)
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'confused')
			scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'prostrate')

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, npc.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.5,
					nil, 0.3, self, nil, {
						locked_dir = look_dir,
						last_direction = look_dir
					})
		end

		execute_knockback(self.dynamic_npcs:get_werebeast(4), 'right')
		execute_knockback(self.dynamic_npcs:get_werebeast(8), 'left')

		--밀려날 때 아래의 대사 실행.
		--NPC 12 (right, confused, prostrate) : [shout] 크아악!!!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_03')
		scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(self.dynamic_npcs:get_werebeast(4), 'nm_ds_main_s7_9_5')

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
	end

	--이후 NPC 4, 5 basic_rifle을 든 채 down, attack, rifle_shoot 정지 상태 실행 후 유지.
	do
		local set_hold_rifle = function(npc)
			scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, {
				name = 'rifle_shoot',
				scale = 0,
			})

			character_util.spine_set_attachment(npc, '[base]weapon1', 'basic_rifle')
		end

		set_hold_rifle(self.dynamic_npcs:get_guard(4))
		set_hold_rifle(self.dynamic_npcs:get_guard(5))
	end

	--NPC 4 (down, attack, rifle_shoot 정지) : 이자식들이 말로 하니까…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_reload_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.dynamic_npcs:get_guard(4), 'nm_ds_main_s7_9_6')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		state = 'muted',
		mix = 4,
	})

	--클로드 (down, attack, jump 1회) : [shout] …안돼! 당장 멈춰!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_emphasize_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(vampire_lord, '01_jump_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(vampire_lord, self, 'down',
			nil, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'nm_ds_main_s7_9_7')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_02')

	do
		local anim_name = 'rifle_reload'
		local anim_scale = 0.5
		local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(self.dynamic_npcs:get_guard(4), anim_name) / anim_scale

		--NPC 4, 5 down, attack, rifle_reload 실행.
		scene_util.set_anim(self.dynamic_npcs:get_guard(4), self, {
			name = anim_name,
			scale = anim_scale,
			loop = false,
		})

		scene_util.set_anim(self.dynamic_npcs:get_guard(5), self, {
			name = anim_name,
			scale = anim_scale,
			loop = false,
		})

		--rifle_reload가 50% 실행된 시점에서 아래의 연출 동시에 실행
		wait_for_sec(anim_duration / 2)
	end

	do
		goat_girl.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'sword_idle'
		goat_girl.CustomWalkAnimationName = 'sword_walk'
		goat_girl.CustomRunAnimationName = 'sword_run'

		character_util.stop(goat_girl)

		character_util.spine_set_attachment(goat_girl, '[base]weapon1', 'cwp_goatgirl')

		do
			local jump_start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s7_before_battle_goat_girl_appear_target')

			--토가 : [shout] 주지사!!!
			--토가를 가리지 않는 화면 우측에 말꼬리 제거 + 1.3배 말풍선 출력
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(goat_girl, {
				key = 'nm_ds_main_s7_9_8',
				skip = false,
				bubble_type = 'shout',
				type_speed = 0,
				keep_display = true,
				world_pos = jump_start_pos + vector(-2, 0, -2.5),
				scale = 1.3
			})

			--화면 0.3 세기로 0.2초간 shake 실행.
			camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)

			--우측에서 토가가 전무 장착 상태로 left, attack, run으로 달려나온다.
			--토가 전무 [임시 : onehandsword_blackwood]
			do
				local start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s7_before_battle_goat_girl_appear_start')

				character_util.set_position(goat_girl, start_pos)
				character_util.set_direction(goat_girl, 'left')
				scene_util.set_emotion(goat_girl, self, 'attack')

				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(goat_girl, 0, 0)
				goat_girl.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0.01)
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(goat_girl, 1, 0.5)

				wp_util.move_async(goat_girl, jump_start_pos, 5.5, nil, {
					run = true,
					play_sfx = true,
					last_direction = 'left'
				})
			end

			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(goat_girl)
		end

		scene_util.set_anim(goat_girl, self, {
			name = 'sword_attack_stab',
			loop = false,
		})

		character_util.set_anim_time_scale(goat_girl, 0)

		do
			local start_xz = vector_util.get_x0z(goat_girl.Position)
			local target_xz = vector_util.get_x0z(goat_girl.Position) + unity_class.vector3.left
			local start_y = goat_girl.Position.y
			local jump_height = 1

			--토가 이후 지정된 지점에서 1의 높이로 0.5초만에 점프.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
			coroutine_util.while_each_frame(0.5, function(progress)
				local cur_height = math.sin(progress * math.pi / 2) * jump_height
				local cur_xz = start_xz * (1 - progress) + target_xz * progress

				character_util.set_position(goat_girl, vector_util.get_x0z(cur_xz, cur_height + start_y), true)
			end)
		end

		local left_npc = self.dynamic_npcs:get_guard(4)
		local right_npc = self.dynamic_npcs:get_guard(5)
		local land_target_pos = (left_npc.Position + right_npc.Position) / 2

		character_util.set_anim_time_scale(goat_girl, 1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_onehand_stinger_01')

		do
			local angle = 45
			--fx_sheep_rei_basic_stabblade 실행하며
			-- FIXME : 지금은 임의대로 y축 -45도를 수정했지만, 원래는 각도 계산을 해서 넣어줘야 함...
			self.fx.stabblade():Instantiate(goat_girl.Bounds.center,
					unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -angle, 0), goat_girl.Transform)

			character_util.spine_rotate(goat_girl, angle, 0)

			-- 왼쪽 아래 45도 각도로 조정
			set_aim_point(goat_girl, vector(-1, 1))
		end

		do
			--이후 토가 공중에서 0.2초만에
			local duration = 0.2
			local start_pos = goat_girl.Position

			--지정된 위치까지 left, attack, sword_attack_stab 상태로 fx_sheep_rei_basic_stabblade 실행하며 이동.
			coroutine_util.while_each_frame(duration, function(progress)
				local cur_pos = start_pos * (1 - progress) + land_target_pos * progress

				character_util.set_position(goat_girl, cur_pos, true)
			end)
		end

		--이동 완료하면 토가 전무 제거한 뒤, 히어로 랜딩 자세로 변경.
		character_util.spine_rotate(goat_girl, 0, 0)

		set_aim_point(goat_girl)

		character_util.remove_anim(goat_girl)
		scene_util.set_anim(goat_girl, self, {
			name = 'walk4legs',
			loop = false,
			scale = 999
		})

		--변경 타이밍에 맞춰 아래의 사항들 실행.
		--Fx_lasthit을 토가 중심으로 실행.
		self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(goat_girl.Position)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')

		--화면 0.3 세기 / 0.2 시간만큼 실행.
		camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.2)

		--NPC 4 left, damaged, prostrate, NPC 5 right, damaged, prostrate 일제히 실행.
		do
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(left_npc)
			character_util.set_direction(left_npc, 'left')
			scene_util.set_emotion(left_npc, self, 'damaged')
			scene_util.set_anim(left_npc, self, 'prostrate')
		end

		do
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(right_npc)
			character_util.set_direction(right_npc, 'right')
			scene_util.set_emotion(right_npc, self, 'damaged')
			scene_util.set_anim(right_npc, self, 'prostrate')
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--토가 (left, attack, 히어로 랜딩 자세) : 그 난폭함은 숨길 수 없어 보이네…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(goat_girl, self, 'left',
			nil, 'sleep_deep', 'nm_ds_main_s7_9_9')

	--토가 (up, idle, idle) : [shout] 역시 넌…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_equip_weapon_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(goat_girl, self, 'up',
			'sword_idle', { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'nm_ds_main_s7_9_10')

	do
		local goat_girl_stab_pos = (vampire_lord.Position + vampire_captain.Position) / 2
		local stab_delay = 0.06

		--쿠로 up, attack, sword_attack_stab을 실행하여 발렌시아와 클로드 사이를 1초 안에 다가감.
		--무기 : 쿠로 전무 [임시 : onehandsword_blackwood]
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_onehand_stinger_01')

		scene_util.set_anim(goat_girl, self, { name = 'sword_attack_stab', loop = false })

		-- 적당히 y축에 칼이 평행하도록 맞춰줌
		set_aim_point(goat_girl, vector(-0.3, 1))

		wait_for_sec(stab_delay)

		local backstab_duration = 0.5
		local lord_backstab_target_pos

		do
			local duration = backstab_duration
			local backstab_move = function(character, target_pos, move_dur, play_land_sfx)
				local look_dir = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(
						target_pos.x > character.Position.x, 'left', 'right')

				scene_util.set_anim(character, self, { name = 'boong_attack_ready', loop = false })

				--지정된 위치까지 0.5만큼 상승하며 이동함.
				character_util.jump(character, 0.5, move_dur)

				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(character, target_pos, nil, move_dur, self, nil, {
					last_direction = look_dir,
					locked_dir = look_dir,
					end_callback = function()
						if play_land_sfx then
							music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
						end

						character_util.remove_anim(character)
					end
				})
			end

			local battle_zone = field_util.get_zone(self.battle.zone)

			lord_backstab_target_pos = vector_util.get_0yz(vampire_lord.Position, battle_zone.Bounds.min.x + 0.5)

			--클로드 right, attack, boong_attack_ready / 발렌시아 left, attack, boong_attack_ready을 실행하며
			backstab_move(vampire_lord, lord_backstab_target_pos, duration)

			backstab_move(vampire_captain,
					vector_util.get_0yz(vampire_captain.Position, battle_zone.Bounds.max.x - 0.5), duration)
		end

		do
			local duration = 0.3

			self.fx.stabblade():Instantiate(goat_girl.Bounds.center,
					unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0), goat_girl.Transform)

			--쿠로 출발과 동시에
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(goat_girl, goat_girl_stab_pos, nil, duration, self, nil, {
				end_callback = function()
					character_util.remove_anim(goat_girl)
				end
			})
		end

		--클로드 카메라 중심인 상태.
		camera_util.move_async(lord_backstab_target_pos, backstab_duration)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

		stage_camera:SetTarget(vampire_lord)

		--0.5초 대기
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		set_aim_point(goat_girl)

		--토가 (left, attack, idle) : 이 나라를 다스릴 자격이 없어!!!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(goat_girl, self, 'left',
				nil, 'attack', 'nm_ds_main_s7_9_11')

		--각자 움직임 완료되면
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(goat_girl)

		party_util.remove_emotion()
		party_util.remove_animation()
	end
end

function local_class:activate_battle()
	local battle_gate_names = {}
	local battle_gate_count = 8

	for i = 1, battle_gate_count do
		table.insert(battle_gate_names, 'main_s7_battle_gate_' .. i)
	end

	local info = {
		waves = {
			{
				monster_infos = {
					{
						monster = self.battle.get_goat_girl(),
						death_type = 'none',
					}
				}
			},
		},
		common = {
			group_name = self.battle.group,
			zone_name = self.battle.zone,
			end_callback = function()
				if self.current_state == self.states.in_battle then
					self.current_state = self.states.after_battle

					start_coroutine(self.after_battle_routine, self)
				end
			end,

			battle_gate_names = battle_gate_names
		}
	}

	character_util.swap(self.battle.get_goat_girl(), self.character.goat_girl, { swap_active_state = false })

	local instant_battle_constructor = get_or_create_global_variable('utils/InstantBattleController')

	self.battle_controller = instant_battle_constructor(info)
	self.battle_controller:start_battle()
end

function local_class:after_battle_routine()
	sp_util.enter_scene()

	self:after_battle_scene(function()
		local monster = self.battle.get_goat_girl()

		character_util.set_active_state(monster, 'disabled')
		character_util.set_position(monster, vector(999, 0, 999))
	end)

	self.controller:progress_section()

	CS.Oak.Game.Instance:StageToWorldmap('exit_nightmare_demonshire_2', 'nightmare_demonshire_3', nil, true, nil)
end

function local_class:after_battle_scene(on_faded_out)
	local vampire_lord = self.character.vampire_lord
	local vampire_captain = self.character.vampire_captain
	local goat_girl = self.character.goat_girl

	--전투 완료 시 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	if on_faded_out ~= nil then
		on_faded_out()
	end

	do
		local pivot = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s7_before_battle_align_pivot')

		--토가 left, damaged, prostrate
		do
			character_util.set_position(goat_girl, pivot + unity_class.vector3.left * 0.5)
			character_util.set_direction(goat_girl, 'left')
			scene_util.set_emotion(goat_girl, self, 'damaged')
			scene_util.set_anim(goat_girl, self, 'prostrate')
		end

		--클로드 down, idle, idle
		do
			character_util.set_position(vampire_lord, pivot + unity_class.vector3.right * 0.5)
			character_util.set_direction(vampire_lord, 'down')
		end

		--발렌시아 left, attack, idle 배치된 상태.
		do
			local battle_zone = field_util.get_zone(self.battle.zone)

			character_util.set_position(vampire_captain, vector_util.get_0yz(pivot, battle_zone.Bounds.max.x - 0.5))
			character_util.set_direction(vampire_captain, 'down')
			scene_util.set_emotion(vampire_captain, self, 'attack')
		end
	end

	--화면 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	local foreach_werebeast_without_faller = function(action)
		self.dynamic_npcs:foreach_werebeast(function(index, npc)
			if index == 4 or index == 8 then
				return
			end

			action(index, npc)
		end)
	end

	foreach_werebeast_without_faller(function(_, npc)
		character_util.remove_anim(npc)
	end)

	--연출 종료된 뒤 대사 재개.
	--클로드 (down, attack, cast2) : 시위 참여자들에게 알린다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(vampire_lord)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self, 'down',
			'cast2', { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'nm_ds_main_s7_10')

	--클로드 (down, attack, release 2회) : 이 이상의 폭력 행위는 중범죄로 처벌하겠다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_ds_main_s7_11')

	--NPC 1 ~ 8 down, idle, idle
	self.dynamic_npcs:foreach_guard(function(index, npc)
		if index == 4 or index == 5 then
			return
		end

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		character_util.stop_shake(npc)
	end)

	--상단 대사와 함께 NPC 9 ~ 15 up, idle, cast를 실행하고, shake 지속 해제.
	foreach_werebeast_without_faller(function(_, npc)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'cast')
		character_util.stop_shake(npc)
	end)

	--상단 대사에 맞춰 아래의 연출 동시에 실행

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		state = 'event',
		name = 'ondemand/v2_39_demonshire/audio:bgm_demonshire_claude',
		mix = 4
	})

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--화면 0.3, 시간 0.3 수치로 shake.
				camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

				local duration = 0.5

				--기존 카메라 4의 크기로 0.5초 안에 복귀 + 카메라 클로드 중심으로 이동.
				camera_util.resize_to_default(duration)
				camera_util.return_to_leader(duration)
			end,
			function()
				--클로드 대사를 1.5배 실행.
				--클로드 (down, attack, jingak / 루프 안함) : 무기를 버리고 투항하라.
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
				scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(vampire_lord, self, 'down',
						'jingak', nil, {
							key = 'nm_ds_main_s7_12',
							skip = true,
							scale = 1.2,
							auto_layout = true,
						})
			end
	)

	--NPC 9 ~ 15번 0.02 세기로 shake 시작.
	foreach_werebeast_without_faller(function(_, npc)
		character_util.shake(npc, 0.02, 999)
	end)

	--NPC 12 (up, idle, idle) : 토, 토가님…!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.dynamic_npcs:get_werebeast(5), 'nm_ds_main_s7_12_1')

	--NPC 10 (up, idle, idle) : 계획은 실패한 건가…?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.dynamic_npcs:get_werebeast(2), 'nm_ds_main_s7_12_2')

	--NPC 9 ~ 15번 shake 종료.
	foreach_werebeast_without_faller(function(_, npc)
		character_util.stop_shake(npc)
	end)

	--이 상태에서 NPC 9 ~ 15번 아래의 순서대로 up, attack, attack 을 실행하며
	--mall_strike_picket를 스프라이트 지정 지점에(흰색 박스)에 던진다.(이때 9 ~ 11번은 좌측, 12 ~ 15는 우측에 투척)
	local picket_throw_target = {
		left = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s7_after_battle_throw_left'),
		right = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s7_after_battle_throw_right'),
	}

	local picket_items = {}
	local item_ids = {
		signboard = 21245,
		rifle = 21249,
	}

	local execute_throw_picket = function(character, type, to_left, target_offset, play_throw_sfx)
		if play_throw_sfx then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
		end

		scene_util.set_anim(character, self, { name = 'throw', loop = false, remove_after = 0.5 })

		local target_pivot = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(to_left,
				picket_throw_target.left, picket_throw_target.right)

		local item = drop_item_util.create_item({
			itemid = item_ids[type],
			pos = character.Bounds.center,
			target = target_pivot + target_offset,
			notforinven = true,
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		})

		table.insert(picket_items, item)
	end

	--연출 시작
	--9, 11번 투척
	execute_throw_picket(self.dynamic_npcs:get_werebeast(1), 'signboard',
			true, vector(-0.2, 0, 0), true)
	execute_throw_picket(self.dynamic_npcs:get_werebeast(3), 'signboard',
			true, vector(0.3, 0, 0))

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--10, 15번 투척
	execute_throw_picket(self.dynamic_npcs:get_werebeast(2), 'rifle',
			true, vector(0, 0, 0), true)
	execute_throw_picket(self.dynamic_npcs:get_werebeast(7), 'rifle',
			false, vector(0.3, 0, 0))

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--12, 13, 14번 투척
	execute_throw_picket(self.dynamic_npcs:get_werebeast(5), 'signboard',
			false, vector(-0.2, 0, 0), true)
	execute_throw_picket(self.dynamic_npcs:get_werebeast(6), 'rifle',
			false, vector(0, 0, 0))

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim(vampire_lord)

	--앞 연출 종료되면 다음 대사 실행.
	--발렌시아 (left, attack, idle) : 클로드 님. 이들은 어떻게…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_captain, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'nm_ds_main_s7_13')

	--클로드 (down, attack, idle) : 시위대는 구치소로 보내 과격한 시위에 대한 경고와 안전한 집회 방법을 알려주도록.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'nm_ds_main_s7_14')

	--클로드 (down, attack, idle) : 그리고 시민에게 총을 겨누어 과잉 대응을 한 자에게는…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'nm_ds_main_s7_14_1')

	--클로드 (down, attack, release 2회) : 내가 내릴 수 있는 가장 높은 징계를 부여하라.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'nm_ds_main_s7_14_2')

	--발렌시아 (left, idle, idle) : 알겠습니다. 그럼 저 수인도 구치소에…
	character_util.remove_emotion(vampire_captain)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_captain, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'nm_ds_main_s7_14_3')

	--클로드 (down, sleep_deep (유지), idle) : 아니, 저 수인은 특별 감방으로 이송하도록.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self, 'down',
			nil, { name = 'sleep_deep', keep = true }, 'nm_ds_main_s7_14_4')

	--클로드 (down, sleep_deep, idle) : 수인들의 집회를 선동한 것으로…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'nm_ds_main_s7_15')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		state = 'muted',
		mix = 6,
	})

	--화면 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	camera_util.move_async(vector(500, 0, 0), 0, { ignorecameragrids = true })

	--상단 대사 화면 암전 상태에서 화면 중앙에 크기 2배로 실행.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black)

	--클로드 (down, attack, idle) : 내일 공개 심문을 진행하겠다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(vampire_lord, 'nm_ds_main_s7_16', nil, {
		viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.5),
		scale = 1.5,
		force_sfx = true,
	})

	--화면 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black)

	for _, item in pairs(picket_items) do
		item:ConsumeComplete()
	end
end

return local_class

function local_class:start()
	for _, spec in pairs(self.interact_item_specs) do
		local gimmick_fo = get_field_object(spec.gimmick_name)

		local is_have_book = self.controller.is_acquire_book[spec.custom_state_key]

		if is_have_book <= 0 then
			local item = drop_item_util.create_item({
				pos = vector_util.get_x0z(gimmick_fo.Position, spec.height),
				itemid = spec.item_id,
				notforinven = true,
				lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
				sprscale = spec.scale
			})

			spec.twinkle_effect = self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(gimmick_fo.Position + vector(0, 0.03 + spec.height, 0))
			self.controller.cached_item[spec.gimmick_name] = item

			self.leftover_book.gimmick_name = spec.gimmick_name
			self.leftover_book.item_id = spec.item_id
		else
			gimmick_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			gimmick_fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end
	end

	sp_util.start_scene(self.section_start_scene, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.interact_item_specs = nil
	self.leftover_book = nil

	self:dispose_dynamic_npc()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state < self.states.pack_toy then
		for _, spec in pairs(self.interact_item_specs) do
			local gimmick_fo = get_field_object(spec.gimmick_name)

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, gimmick_fo) then
				sp_util.start_scene(spec.interact_func, self, gimmick_fo, spec)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.pack_toy and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_baby_half_vampire()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.interact_half_vampire
		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_half_vampire_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_state < self.states.enter_state_capitol and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's8_state_capitol_enter_event_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.enter_state_capitol
		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_state_capitol_zone_scene, self)
		return true
	elseif self.current_state <= self.states.enter_state_capitol and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's8_enter_toy_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.enter_toy_zone
		self:set_toy_zone_marker()
		return true
	elseif self.current_state < self.states.pack_toy and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's8_blocking_zone') then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.blocking_event, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

	local vampire_lord = get_party_leader()

function local_class:choose_pack_item(target_spec)
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 가져간다. (초록)
		{ 'nm_ds_main_s8_22_1', 'mercy' },
		-- 그만둔다.
		{ 'nm_ds_main_s8_22_2', 'normal' }
	})

	-- 그만둔다.
	if choose_result ~= 1 then
		-- 컨트롤 복귀.
		return
	end

	local item = self.controller.cached_item[target_spec.gimmick_name]

	self.controller.is_acquire_book[target_spec.custom_state_key] = 1
	self.leftover_book.gimmick_name = target_spec.gimmick_name
	self.leftover_book.item_id = target_spec.item_id

	local vampire_lord = get_party_leader()

	-- 클로드 left, idle, eat 1초.
	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	scene_util.set_direction(vampire_lord, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(vampire_lord, self, 'eat')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	for _, spec in pairs(self.interact_item_specs) do
		if spec.twinkle_effect ~= nil then
			spec.twinkle_effect:Dispose()
		end

		local gimmick_fo = get_field_object(spec.gimmick_name)
		gimmick_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		gimmick_fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	-- 클로드 아이템을 획득한다.
	if item ~= nil then
		item.ConsumeTarget = vampire_lord
		self.controller.cached_item[target_spec.gimmick_name] = nil
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	-- 클로드 : 어서 프리실라에게로 가야겠군.
	eat_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.remove_anim(vampire_lord)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(vampire_lord, 'nm_ds_main_s8_22_3')

	self.current_state = self.states.pack_toy

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = get_field_object('state_capitol_inner') },
		{ zone = 'state_capitol_field', target = self.get_baby_half_vampire() },
	})

	-- 컨트롤 복귀.
end

function local_class:interact_half_vampire_scene()

			nil, 'nm_ds_main_s8_23')

	-- 이 때 아이리스 책상 옆에 배치

	scene_util.set_direction(vampire_lord_wife, 'up', false)
	vampire_lord_wife.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('s8_vampire_lord_wife_pos') - vector(0.1, 0, 0)
	vampire_lord_wife.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)

	-- 클로드(right, smile, idle) : 그림책은 다음에 읽어줘야겠군.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(vampire_lord, 'nm_ds_main_s8_23_1')

	-- 클로드(남)(right, smile, push) : 어머니는 어디 갔는지 보았느냐, 나의 태양아.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self, nil, 'push',
			nil, 'nm_ds_main_s8_24')

	-- 화면 중앙 하단에 아이리스 대사

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(vampire_lord_wife, 'nm_ds_main_s8_25',
			true, { viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.25) })

	-- 카메라 사이즈 1초간 원복
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)

	-- 동시에 클로드 1초간 아래로 1.5칸 걸어내려온다.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(vampire_lord)
	wp_util.move(vampire_lord, vampire_lord.Position - vector(0, 0, 1.5), nil, 1)

	-- 동시에 카메라 포커스 1초간 아이리스에게로 이동.
	camera_util.move_async(vampire_lord_wife.Position, 1, { end_target = vampire_lord_wife })

	-- 아이리스(여)(left, smile, cast) : 둘의 모습이 좋아서… 잠시 보고 있었어요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord_wife, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			'cast', 'smile', 'nm_ds_main_s8_26')

	local flower_port = self.get_flower_port()
	local broken_flower_port = self.get_broken_flower_port()

	-- 아이리스 0.5초간 위로 1칸 움직인다.
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(vampire_lord_wife, vampire_lord_wife.Position + vector(0, 0, 1)
	, nil, 0.5, self, move_end_key, { last_direction = 'up' })

	-- 아이리스 이동 시작과 동시에 책상 0.3초간 shake.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_dummy_02')
	field_object_util.shake(flower_port, 0.05, 0.3)
	field_object_util.shake(self.get_table(), 0.05, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	local shadow_transform = flower_port.transform:Find('shadow')
	if not is_unity_null(shadow_transform) then
		shadow_transform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	-- 책상 위에 올려져 있던 wall_in5_flowerpot1 오브젝트가 1초간 항아리가 z축으로 -90도 회전하여 오른쪽 바닥으로 떨어져 깨진다.
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 0.3

	local start_pos = flower_port.Position
	local end_pos = flower_port.Position + vector(0.4, 0, 0.2)
	local progress = 0

	local start_z_angle = 0
	local end_z_angle = -90

	local start_y_angle = 0
	local end_y_angle = -45

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(time_passed, 0, 1, duration)
		flower_port.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

		local cur_y_angle = start_y_angle + end_y_angle * (math.min(1 - (duration - time_passed) / duration, 1))
		local cur_z_angle = start_z_angle + end_z_angle * (math.min(1 - (duration - time_passed) / duration, 1))

		flower_port.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, cur_y_angle, cur_z_angle))

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 바닥에 닿는 순간
	-- break_demonshire_in3_flowerpot 이펙트와 함께 wall_in5_flowerpot1_broken 오브젝트로 변경.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_break_bottle_01')
	self.fx.break_flowerpot():Instantiate(broken_flower_port.Position)
	broken_flower_port.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	flower_port.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	-- 카메라 shake 0.3초
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	-- 클로드 표정 attack으로 전환.
	scene_util.set_emotion(vampire_lord, self, 'attack')

	-- 아이리스 right, surprise, idle, jump 1회

	scene_util.set_emotion(vampire_lord_wife, self, 'surprise')

	-- 0.8초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	-- 아이리스(여)(right, tired, cast) : 죄송해요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord_wife, self, nil,
			{ name = 'cast', keep = true },
			{ name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'nm_ds_main_s8_27')

	-- 클로드가 속도 3으로 내려와 아이리스의 왼편에 선다.

	-- 클로드(남)(right, tired, push) : 아이리스. 괜찮소?

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self, nil,
			'push', { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'nm_ds_main_s8_28')

	-- 아이리스(여)(left, idle, nod 1회) : 네, 프리실라가 다치면 안 되니까 제가 치울게요.

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord_wife, self, nil,

	-- 클로드(남)(right, tired, bomb_idle) : 그대가 다칠 수 있으니 그대로 두시오. 사람을 부를테니.

			'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'nm_ds_main_s8_30')

	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.remove_emotion(vampire_lord)

	-- 클로드(남)(right, idle, idle) : 아이리스. 부탁하고 싶은 게 있소.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(vampire_lord, 'nm_ds_main_s8_31')

	-- 클로드(남)(right, tired, idle) : 지난 이틀간… 당신도 보았겠지만….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self, nil,
			nil, 'tired', 'nm_ds_main_s8_31_1')

	-- 클로드(남)(right, tired, bomb_idle) : 수인들의 행동이 심상치 않소.

			'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'nm_ds_main_s8_32')

	-- 아이리스(여)(left, tired, cast) : 알고 있어요. 수인 분들도 싸우지 않고 사이좋게 지내면 좋겠지만….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord_wife, self, nil, 'cast',
			{ name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'nm_ds_main_s8_34')

	-- 클로드(남)(right, tired, idle) : 하지만 당장은 그렇지 못하니.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self, nil,
			nil, 'tired', 'nm_ds_main_s8_35')

	-- 클로드 right, sleep_deep, idle 1초 대기
	scene_util.set_emotion(vampire_lord, self, 'sleep_deep')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 클로드(남)(right, attack, cast2) : 무슨 일이 발생하면 내가 곧장 달려올 것이오.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_lord, self, nil,

		},
	}

	self.is_control_animals_in_lab = true

	self.in_lab_grid_name = 'animal_lab_in_grid'
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	self.fx:load_all()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	self.super:dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	local data = self.characters
	local camera_grid = e.CameraGrid

	if camera_grid.name == self.in_lab_grid_name and self.is_control_animals_in_lab then
		local animals = {}

		if not camera_grid:Contains(data.pony().Position) then
			table.insert(animals, data.pony())
		end

		if not camera_grid:Contains(data.white_goat().Position) then
			table.insert(animals, data.white_goat())
		end

		if not camera_grid:Contains(data.black_rabbit().Position) then
			table.insert(animals, data.black_rabbit())
		end

		local leader = get_party_leader()
		local current_state = leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState

		if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
			character_util.release_hold_object(leader, leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget)
		end

		if not table_util.is_empty(animals) then
			for _, animal in pairs(animals) do
				character_util.stop(animal)
				animal.Position = self.minigame_animal_data[animal.Name].pos
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
end

function local_class:npc_eating_routine(npc, basket)
	--해당 동물이 (shaek0.03/0.5초) 후 애니메이션 /표정 (idle,idle) 상태
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(npc, 0.03, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--해당 동물 하늘색 스프라이트 바라보며 (jump1회) +(notice) 이모티콘 버블
	character_util.look_at(npc, basket)
	character_util.set_side_direction(npc)

	character_util.normal_jump(npc, '01_player_popup_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(
			npc,
			self,
			nil,
			'idle',
			'idle',
			'notice'
	)

	--속도 1로 0.5초간 (walk) 애니메이션으로 하늘색 스프라이트 이동 후
	--만약 0.5초안에 하늘색 스프라이트 위치까지 이동했다면 정지
	do
		-- 오른쪽을 바라보고 있다면 바구니 왼쪽에 정렬
		if npc.Position.x < basket.Position.x then
			local pos_basket_left = basket.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
			local waypoints = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(npc, pos_basket_left, false)

			wp_util.move_async(npc, waypoints, 1, nil)
		else
			local pos_basket_right = basket.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
			local waypoints = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(npc, pos_basket_right, false)

			wp_util.move_async(npc, waypoints, 1, nil)
		end
	end

	character_util.look_at(npc, basket)

	-- (side) 상태로 스프라이트 바라보며 (eat) 애니메이션 1초간 재생
	do
		local sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_eat_01', parent = npc, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		scene_util.play_wait_action(
				npc,
				self,
				nil,
				'eat',
				nil,
				1
		)

		sfx:Stop()
		sfx = nil
	end

	--(happy) 애니메이션 + (heart) 이모티콘 버블
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'happy')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(
			npc,
			self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			'happy'
	)

	--이 후 애니메이션과 표정 (idle,idle) 상태 holdable 가능한 상태
	npc.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
end

return local_class
